a cup of.context: 早上到了公司茶水间，同事问你想喝点什么，你用 a cup of 点一杯热咖啡。
a cup of.translation: 朋友：早啊 你想喝点什么 你：我想要一杯热拿铁 朋友：要加糖还是加奶 你：加一点牛奶就好 不要额外加糖了
a cup of.example: Friend: Good morning, what would you like to drink? You: I'd like a cup of hot latte, please. Friend: Would you like sugar or milk in it? You: Just a little milk, no extra sugar for me, thanks.

a few.context: 朋友组织周末野餐，问你要不要带几个同学，你说可以约几个相熟的朋友一起去。
a few.translation: 朋友：周末野餐你打算叫谁来 你：我打算约几个同班同学 朋友：大概多少人合适呢 你：来五六个就够了 太多了反而不好安排
a few.example: Friend: Who are you planning to invite for the weekend picnic? You: I'll invite a few classmates from my class. Friend: About how many people would be just right? You: Five or six would be enough, too many makes it hard to arrange.

a group of.context: 你在小区里散步，看到一群孩子在草坪上放风筝，朋友问你在看什么热闹。
a group of.translation: 朋友：你站在那里看什么呢 你：那边有一群小朋友在放风筝 朋友：他们玩得好像很开心啊 你：是啊 那个风筝飞得特别高
a group of.example: Friend: What are you standing there looking at? You: There is a group of children flying kites over on the lawn. Friend: They look like they are having so much fun. You: Yeah, that kite up there is flying really high.

a little.context: 煮面条时朋友问你汤是不是太咸，你说加一点水就好了，用 a little 修饰不可数的水。
a little.translation: 朋友：这锅汤尝起来是不是有点咸 你：确实 我再加一点水进去吧 朋友：别加太多了不然味道就淡了 你：放心 我只倒小半杯水进去
a little.example: Friend: Does this pot of soup taste a little too salty? You: It does, I'll add a little more water into it. Friend: Don't add too much or the flavor will become bland. You: Don't worry, I'll only pour in about half a cup.

a long time.context: 朋友很久没看你打球了，你跟他说自己坚持晨练已经很久了，用 a long time 强调时间长。
a long time.translation: 朋友：你最近身材保持得真好 你：我坚持早起跑步已经很长时间了 朋友：有没有想过放弃的时候呢 你：当然有 但慢慢就变成习惯了
a long time.example: Friend: You've really kept in great shape lately. You: I've been sticking to morning runs for a long time now. Friend: Were there times you wanted to give it up? You: Sure, but it slowly turned into a regular habit.

a long time ago.context: 周末翻到老相册，朋友指着一张黑白照片问那是什么时候拍的，你说那是很久以前的事了。
a long time ago.translation: 朋友：这张老照片是在哪里拍的呀 你：那是很久以前在老家拍的 朋友：那时候你看起来好小啊 你：对 我还在上小学呢
a long time ago.example: Friend: Where was this old photo taken? You: That was taken in my hometown a long time ago. Friend: You look so little in that picture. You: Yeah, I was still in primary school back then.

a lot of.context: 朋友搬新家邀请你去暖房，你问他客厅多大，他说能容纳很多客人。
a lot of.translation: 朋友：我新家周末办暖房派对 你来吗 你：当然去 客厅能坐多少人呀 朋友：挺大的 能请很多朋友过来 你：那我带点饮料过去吧
a lot of.example: Friend: I'm having a housewarming party at my new place this weekend, coming? You: Of course, how many people can your living room fit? Friend: It's pretty big, we can invite a lot of friends over. You: Then I'll bring some drinks along.

a piece of.context: 你去邮局寄包裹，工作人员让你填一张快递单，你用 a piece of 表示一张单子。
a piece of.translation: 朋友：寄这个包裹需要填什么 你：请给我一张快递单 我来填一下 朋友：地址要写中英文都有吗 你：写中文就可以 这边只看国内地址
a piece of.example: Friend: What do I need to fill out to send this package? You: Please give me a piece of express form to fill in. Friend: Should the address be in both Chinese and English? You: Chinese is fine, they only read the domestic address here.

after school.context: 放学之后你和朋友约好去操场打球，妈妈打电话问你什么时候回家。
after school.translation: 朋友：放学后我们去操场打篮球吧 你：好啊 先打一个小时再回去 朋友：你妈妈不会催你回家吗 你：我跟她说好了 六点前到家
after school.example: Friend: Let's go play basketball on the playground after school. You: Great idea, let's play for an hour before heading back. Friend: Won't your mom be calling you home? You: I already told her, I'll be home before six.

after that.context: 朋友问你接下来有什么计划，你说先吃完饭，然后再写作业。
after that.translation: 朋友：晚上你打算怎么安排时间 你：先吃饭 然后再开始写作业 朋友：写完作业要不要一起打局游戏 你：好呀 写完叫你上线
after that.example: Friend: How are you planning to arrange your evening? You: I'll have dinner first, and then start on my homework. Friend: Want to play a game together once you're done? You: Sure, I'll ping you online when I finish.

alarm clock.context: 朋友早上起不来上班总迟到，你建议他把闹钟调早十分钟。
alarm clock.translation: 朋友：我最近上班天天迟到 怎么办 你：你把闹钟调早十分钟试试看 朋友：可是我按掉闹钟还会接着睡 你：那你把手机放到离床远一点的地方
alarm clock.example: Friend: I've been late for work every day recently, what should I do? You: Try setting your alarm clock ten minutes earlier. Friend: But I just turn the alarm off and go right back to sleep. You: Then put your phone across the room away from your bed.

all over the world.context: 朋友问你旅行最想去哪里，你说想去环游世界，看看不同国家的风景。
all over the world.translation: 朋友：如果有长假你最想去哪里玩 你：我想环游世界 去看看不同国家 朋友：那得攒多少年的钱呀 你：先从周边国家开始慢慢走
all over the world.example: Friend: If you had a long vacation, where would you most want to go? You: I want to travel all over the world to see different countries. Friend: How many years would it take to save up for that? You: I'll start with nearby countries and go from there.

all the time.context: 你减肥减了一个月，朋友说你看起来没什么变化，你说自己一直在坚持运动。
all the time.translation: 朋友：你减肥减了一个月了 有效果吗 你：我一直都在坚持运动 没怎么松懈 朋友：但看起来变化不大呀 你：体重掉了几斤 体型慢慢在变
all the time.example: Friend: You've been dieting for a month now, any results? You: I've been sticking to exercising all the time, I never slacked off. Friend: But it doesn't look like much has changed. You: I've lost a few pounds, my shape is slowly shifting.

amusement park.context: 周末朋友提议带小朋友出去玩，你说市中心那个游乐园就很不错。
amusement park.translation: 朋友：周末带孩子去哪里玩比较好 你：市中心那个游乐园就很合适 朋友：里面都有什么项目呀 你：有旋转木马和过山车 小孩都爱去
amusement park.example: Friend: Where would be a good place to take the kids on the weekend? You: That amusement park downtown would work really well. Friend: What kind of rides do they have inside? You: Carousels and roller coasters, kids love going there.

and so on.context: 你列购物清单，朋友问你还要买什么，你说蔬菜水果、牛奶面包等等。
and so on.translation: 朋友：你购物清单上都写了些什么 你：蔬菜水果、牛奶、面包等等 朋友：要不要顺便买瓶洗手液 你：好的 我把它也加上去
and so on.example: Friend: What all did you write on your shopping list? You: Fruits and vegetables, milk, bread, and so on. Friend: Should we grab a bottle of hand soap too? You: Good idea, I'll add that to the list as well.

and then.context: 周末你先起床煮早饭，然后叫朋友起来吃，用完早餐一起去看电影。
and then.translation: 朋友：今天周末 我们怎么安排 你：先吃早饭 然后一起去看电影 朋友：看哪一场比较合适 你：十一点那场吧 看完正好午饭
and then.example: Friend: It's the weekend, how should we plan our day? You: Let's have breakfast first, and then go see a movie. Friend: Which showing would be a good choice? You: The eleven o'clock one, lunch right after.

around the world.context: 你立志要在三十岁之前环游世界，朋友问你旅行梦想实现了多少。
around the world.translation: 朋友：你环游世界的梦想走到哪一步了 你：已经去过十几个国家了 还在继续 朋友：下一站打算去哪里 你：打算去非洲看动物大迁徙
around the world.example: Friend: How far along is your dream of traveling around the world? You: I've already visited over ten countries and I keep going. Friend: Where do you plan to go next? You: I'm heading to Africa to see the great migration.

ask about.context: 你打电话给餐厅，想打听一下今晚有没有空位。
ask about.translation: 朋友：你在给谁打电话呀 你：我打给餐厅 想问一下今晚有没有空位 朋友：需要预订几点的位子 你：订晚上七点 两个人的桌
ask about.example: Friend: Who are you calling on the phone? You: I'm calling the restaurant to ask about tonight's availability. Friend: What time do you need to book a table for? You: Book seven o'clock, a table for two.

ask for.context: 你在商场看中一件外套，朋友问你要不要让店员拿你的尺码。
ask for.translation: 朋友：你看上这件外套了吗 要不要让店员拿 你：麻烦帮我拿一下M码 我想试试 朋友：试衣间在那边左转 你：好的 试完我告诉你
ask for.example: Friend: Do you like that jacket, want me to ask the clerk to get it? You: Could you ask them for a medium, I want to try it on. Friend: The fitting room is over there on the left. You: OK, I'll let you know after I try it.

ask questions.context: 课堂上老师鼓励大家积极提问，说不懂就问才能进步。
ask questions.translation: 朋友：上课我总不敢举手发言 你：老师鼓励我们多提问 不懂就问 朋友：可是怕问的问题太简单 你：不会的 老师很有耐心
ask questions.example: Friend: I'm always too afraid to raise my hand in class. You: The teacher encourages us to ask questions, just ask. Friend: But I'm afraid my questions are too simple. You: No way, the teacher is very patient.

at large.context: 警方还在搜捕在逃的嫌疑人，整个街区的居民都被通知注意安全。
at large.translation: 朋友：听说咱们小区附近有小偷出没 你：警方还在搜捕那个在逃的嫌疑人 朋友：那晚上出门要小心一点 你：对 尽量结伴走 别单独行动
at large.example: Friend: I heard a thief is on the loose near our neighborhood. You: The police are still searching for the suspect at large. Friend: Then we should be careful going out at night. You: Right, try to go in groups, don't go alone.

at least.context: 朋友请你吃晚饭，你说至少得七点才能到，因为要加班。
at least.translation: 朋友：今晚一起吃晚饭呗 你：我至少要七点才能到 得先加班 朋友：那我们七点半再开桌吧 你：好 我尽量准时赶到
at least.example: Friend: Let's have dinner together tonight. You: I can't get there until at least seven, I have to work overtime. Friend: Then we'll start dinner at seven thirty. You: OK, I'll try to be there on time.

at night.context: 你朋友是个夜猫子，经常半夜还在外面骑车兜风。
at night.translation: 朋友：你昨晚几点睡的呀 你：我经常在夜里出去骑车兜风 朋友：那不危险吗 你：戴上头盔走专门的绿道就好
at night.example: Friend: What time did you go to sleep last night? You: I often go for bike rides at night. Friend: Isn't that dangerous? You: Wear a helmet and stick to the dedicated greenways.

at once.context: 老师一口气问了三个问题，让你一时不知道先回答哪个好。
at once.translation: 朋友：老师刚才问了你好几个问题吗 你：他一下子问了好几个 我都不知道先答哪个 朋友：你慢慢答 一个个说清楚 你：好的 我从第一个问题开始
at once.example: Friend: Did the teacher ask you several questions just now? You: He asked several at once, I didn't know which to answer first. Friend: Take your time, answer them one by one clearly. You: OK, I'll start with the first question.

at school.context: 周末朋友问你在哪儿，你说你还在学校，正在图书馆自习。
at school.translation: 朋友：周末你在哪儿呢 出来玩呀 你：我还在学校 正在图书馆自习呢 朋友：那你晚上有空一起吃饭吗 你：好呀 学完这章就去找你
at school.example: Friend: Where are you on the weekend, come out and hang out. You: I'm still at school, studying in the library right now. Friend: Are you free for dinner tonight? You: Sure, I'll come find you after I finish this chapter.

at that time.context: 你回忆起大学刚入学那会儿，室友们每天晚上都卧谈。
at that time.translation: 朋友：你大学寝室关系怎么样 你：那时候我们每天晚上都卧谈 朋友：都聊些什么内容呀 你：聊未来梦想 也聊八卦
at that time.example: Friend: How was your dorm back in college? You: At that time we stayed up chatting every night. Friend: What did you all talk about? You: Future dreams, and also plenty of gossip.

away from.context: 你周末不想待在家里，想约朋友去远离市区的郊外走走。
away from.translation: 朋友：周末我们去哪儿放松一下呢 你：去远离市区的郊外走走吧 空气好 朋友：那要开车过去吗 你：坐地铁到终点 再骑一段车就到
away from.example: Friend: Where should we go to relax this weekend? You: Let's go somewhere far away from the city, the air is fresher. Friend: Do we need to drive there? You: Take the subway to the end, then bike the rest of the way.

bad weather.context: 你原计划周末去爬山，结果遇上暴雨天气，只能待在家里。
bad weather.translation: 朋友：周末爬山的计划还作数吗 你：天气预报说有暴雨天气 去不了了 朋友：那我们在家看电影吧 你：好 我点个外卖 窝沙发上看
bad weather.example: Friend: Is the weekend hiking plan still on? You: The forecast says there will be bad weather with heavy rain, we can't go. Friend: Then let's watch movies at home. You: OK, I'll order delivery and we'll watch on the couch.

clean up.context: 做完晚饭你把厨房收拾干净，再洗个澡准备睡觉。
clean up.translation: 朋友：今晚晚饭吃完谁洗碗呀 你：我做饭 你先去洗漱吧 朋友：那我来洗碗 你去洗澡 你：行 洗完碗我去收拾灶台
clean up.example: Friend: Who does the dishes after dinner tonight? You: I cooked, you go clean up first. Friend: Then I'll wash dishes, you go take a shower. You: OK, after dishes I'll wipe down the stove.

come back.context: 你毕业离家好几年了，过年终于能回一趟老家。
come back.translation: 朋友：你今年过年回家吗 你：好几年没回去了 终于能回家看看 朋友：家里人肯定特别想你 你：是啊 我妈已经备好了年货
come back.example: Friend: Are you going home for the New Year this year? You: I haven't been back in years, I can finally come back. Friend: Your family must miss you so much. You: Yeah, my mom already stocked up on New Year goods.

come from.context: 新同事自我介绍说他来自昆明，朋友问他老家是哪里的。
come from.translation: 朋友：新同事 你老家是哪里的呀 你：我来自昆明 那里四季如春 朋友：那是个好地方 有空去玩 你：欢迎来玩 我给你当导游
come from.example: Friend: New colleague, where is your hometown? You: I come from Kunming, it's like spring all year round. Friend: That sounds lovely, I'll visit sometime. You: Welcome, I'll be your tour guide.

come in.context: 下雨天你没带伞，正好便利店有热水供应，你进去躲雨。
come in.translation: 朋友：突然下大雨了 我们去哪躲躲 你：前面那家便利店可以进去 朋友：里面有没有热饮卖 你：有 我去买杯热可可
come in.example: Friend: It's pouring suddenly, where can we take shelter? You: We can take shelter in that convenience store ahead. Friend: Do they sell hot drinks inside? You: Yes, I'll go buy a hot cocoa.

come out.context: 你喜欢的漫画家终于出新书了，周末书店一开门你就去排队。
come out.translation: 朋友：你这周末有什么安排吗 你：我喜欢的漫画家出新书了 要去买 朋友：签售会吗 你：对 周六上午首发 我早点去排队
come out.example: Friend: Any plans for the weekend? You: My favorite manga artist released a new book, I'm going to buy it. Friend: Is it a book signing? You: Yeah, Saturday morning launch, I'll line up early.

each other.context: 室友之间要互相体谅，才能和睦相处。
each other.translation: 朋友：你和室友相处得怎么样 你：我们互相体谅 关系特别好 朋友：有没有闹过矛盾呀 你：偶尔有 说开就好了
each other.example: Friend: How do you get along with your roommates? You: We look out for each other, we get along really well. Friend: Have you ever had a fight? You: Occasionally, but talking it out fixes it.

far away.context: 你老家在一个很远的小山村，坐火车要二十多个小时。
far away.translation: 朋友：你老家离广州有多远呀 你：特别远 坐火车要二十多个小时 朋友：那你平时多久回一次家 你：一年回去一两次
far away.example: Friend: How far is your hometown from Guangzhou? You: It's really far, twenty-plus hours by train. Friend: How often do you go back then? You: Once or twice a year.

for a long time.context: 这家餐厅主打川菜，菜单上几乎全是辣味菜。
for a long time.translation: 朋友：这家餐厅主打什么菜系呀 你：它专注于做川菜 菜单上全是辣的 朋友：那不能吃辣的人怎么办 你：有几个不辣的素菜可以选
for a long time.example: Friend: What cuisine does this restaurant specialize in? You: It focuses on Sichuan food, the menu is all spicy. Friend: What about people who can't eat spicy? You: There are a few non-spicy veggie options.

for example.context: 你周末没事，想找个咖啡馆坐一会儿看看书。
for example.translation: 朋友：周末你打算怎么打发时间 你：我想找个咖啡馆坐一会儿看看书 朋友：要不要一起 你：好呀 找个安静点的店
for example.example: Friend: How do you plan to spend your weekend? You: I want to find a cafe to sit for a while and read. Friend: Want company? You: Sure, find a quieter place.

get changed.context: 晚上要去参加朋友的婚礼，你先回家换一身正式的衣服。
get changed.translation: 朋友：晚上参加婚礼你穿什么去 你：我先回家换一身正式衣服 朋友：你那套西装就很合适 你：对 穿上显得精神一点
get changed.example: Friend: What are you wearing to the wedding tonight? You: I'll go home and get changed into something formal first. Friend: That suit of yours would work well. You: Yeah, makes me look sharp.

get ready for.context: 明天要去爬山，你今晚把背包、水壶都收拾好准备着。
get ready for.translation: 朋友：明天爬山你东西都准备好了吗 你：我把背包水壶都收拾好了 准备出发 朋友：别忘了带雨衣 你：带了 天气预报说可能下雨
get ready for.example: Friend: Is your stuff ready for tomorrow's hike? You: I've got my backpack and water bottle packed, ready to go. Friend: Don't forget the rain jacket. You: Packed, the forecast says it might rain.

get ready to.context: 演出马上开始了，演员们在后台做着最后的准备。
get ready to.translation: 朋友：演出马上开始了 你紧张吗 你：我准备好了 随时可以上台 朋友：祝演出成功 别紧张 你：谢谢 我调整一下状态
get ready to.example: Friend: The show is about to start, are you nervous? You: I'm ready to go on stage anytime now. Friend: Break a leg, don't be nervous. You: Thanks, I'll get in the zone.

get up.context: 你每天早上六点半准时起床，先做二十分钟拉伸再吃早饭。
get up.translation: 朋友：你每天几点起床呀 你：我六点半准时起 先拉伸再吃早饭 朋友：你怎么起这么早 你：早上空气好 脑子也清醒
get up.example: Friend: What time do you get up every day? You: I get up at six thirty sharp, stretch then have breakfast. Friend: Why do you get up so early? You: Morning air is fresh, my mind is clear.

go for a walk.context: 晚饭后你和朋友沿着河边散步，吹着晚风特别舒服。
go for a walk.translation: 朋友：吃完饭咱们出去走走吧 你：好啊 去河边散散步 朋友：晚上河边人多不多 你：挺多的 大家都出来纳凉
go for a walk.example: Friend: Let's go out for a walk after dinner. You: Sure, let's go for a walk by the river. Friend: Are there many people by the river at night? You: Quite a few, everyone's out enjoying the cool air.

go to work.context: 你每天早上七点出门上班，挤地铁要坐四十分钟。
go to work.translation: 朋友：你每天几点出门上班呀 你：我七点出门 坐地铁四十分钟 朋友：那你几点到家呢 你：晚上七点半才能到家
go to work.example: Friend: What time do you leave for work every day? You: I leave at seven, the subway takes forty minutes. Friend: Then what time do you get home? You: Not until seven thirty in the evening.

grow up.context: 你朋友大学毕业后在大城市打拼，慢慢闯出了自己的事业。
grow up.translation: 朋友：你那同学现在混得怎么样 你：他毕业之后在大城市打拼 事业做得不错 朋友：真厉害 怎么做到的 你：他特别拼 天天加班
grow up.example: Friend: How is your old classmate doing these days? You: He grew up and built a career in the big city after graduation. Friend: Impressive, how did he do it? You: He's a hard worker, working overtime every day.

have a look.context: 你路过蛋糕店，朋友说里面新出了一款慕斯，让你看看。
have a look.translation: 朋友：那家蛋糕店新出了款慕斯 你去看看 你：好啊 我进去瞧一瞧 朋友：帮我带一块巧克力味的 你：行 顺便我也买一块
have a look.example: Friend: That cake shop released a new mousse, go take a look. You: OK, I'll have a look. Friend: Bring me a chocolate one. You: Alright, I'll grab one for myself too.

have to.context: 朋友提醒你明天有个重要会议，你说你必须参加。
have to.translation: 朋友：明天那个会你能来吗 你：我必须参加 很重要 朋友：那我把材料提前发给你 你：好 我今晚先看看
have to.example: Friend: Can you make that meeting tomorrow? You: I have to be there, it's important. Friend: Then I'll send you the materials in advance. You: OK, I'll read them tonight.

help with.context: 朋友数学题不会做，你过去帮他讲解了一下午。
help with.translation: 朋友：这道数学题我怎么都搞不懂 你：我来帮你解决一下这道题 朋友：太好了 我卡了一晚上 你：你看 先列方程就简单了
help with.example: Friend: I just can't figure out this math problem. You: Let me help you with this problem. Friend: Great, I've been stuck all night. You: Look, set up the equation first and it's simple.

how about.context: 周末你朋友问你想去看电影还是唱歌，让你选一个。
how about.translation: 朋友：周末你想干什么 看电影还是唱歌 你：看电影怎么样 最近新上了一部 朋友：行 那我们下午场见 你：好 我买票
how about.example: Friend: What do you want to do this weekend, see a movie or sing karaoke? You: How about a movie, something new just came out. Friend: OK, let's meet for the afternoon show. You: Good, I'll book tickets.

hundreds of.context: 国庆景区里人山人海，游客多到数不清。
hundreds of.translation: 朋友：国庆景区人多不多呀 你：人特别多 成千上万的游客 朋友：那不是拍照全是人头 你：对 想拍个照都得排队
hundreds of.example: Friend: Was the scenic spot crowded on National Day? You: Super crowded, hundreds of thousands of visitors. Friend: Then every photo is just a sea of heads. You: Yeah, you even have to line up for photos.

ice cream.context: 夏天你最喜欢吃的就是冰淇淋，尤其是巧克力味的。
ice cream.translation: 朋友：夏天你最爱吃什么甜品 你：我最爱吃冰淇淋 尤其是巧克力味 朋友：一天吃几个呀 你：热的时候一天一个 不然太凉
ice cream.example: Friend: What's your favorite summer dessert? You: I love ice cream most, especially chocolate. Friend: How many do you have a day? You: One a day when it's hot, too much is too cold.

in bed.context: 你昨晚发烧到现在还没睡，一直在床上躺着休息。
in bed.translation: 朋友：你怎么大白天还在被窝里 你：我发烧了 在床上躺了一天了 朋友：吃药了吗 要不要去医院 你：吃了退烧药 再观察一晚
in bed.example: Friend: Why are you still in bed in broad daylight? You: I have a fever, I've been in bed all day. Friend: Did you take medicine, should we go to the hospital? You: Took some fever medicine, wait and see tonight.

in fact.context: 朋友问你为什么今天不上班，你说其实今天是调休。
in fact.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么没去上班 你：其实今天是调休 我刚好休息 朋友：那我们出来逛街呗 你：好 你在哪 我去找你
in fact.example: Friend: Why aren't you at work today? You: In fact, today's a compensatory day off. Friend: Then let's go shopping. You: OK, where are you, I'll come to you.

in front of.context: 你教室前面那块黑板写满了字，朋友问你擦黑板。
in front of.translation: 朋友：黑板上写满了字 你擦一下 你：好 我把黑板前面擦干净 朋友：擦完写今天的作业 你：行 你说我写
in front of.example: Friend: The board is full, go erase it. You: OK, I'll clean the front of the board. Friend: After erasing, write today's homework. You: Sure, you tell me and I'll write.

in the future.context: 你说你以后想当一名医生，帮助更多的人。
in the future.translation: 朋友：你长大了想做什么工作 你：在将来 我想当一名医生 朋友：为什么选医生呢 你：想帮更多的人 很有意义
in the future.example: Friend: What job do you want when you grow up? You: In the future, I want to be a doctor. Friend: Why pick medicine? You: To help more people, it's meaningful.

in the middle.context: 你站在人群中间，朋友从后面拍你肩膀把你吓一跳。
in the middle.translation: 朋友：你站在哪里等我呀 你：我就在广场中间 你过来就能看到 朋友：我看到你了 挥挥手 你：好 这里人太多了
in the middle.example: Friend: Where are you standing waiting for me? You: I'm in the middle of the square, you'll see me. Friend: I see you, waving. You: OK, it's so crowded here.

in the middle of.context: 你走到图书馆的时候，正好赶上开门，里面一个人都没有。
in the middle of.translation: 朋友：图书馆人多不多呀 你：我到的时候 正好在开门 里面空无一人 朋友：那你占个好位置 你：对 靠窗那个位置
in the middle of.example: Friend: Is the library crowded? You: When I got there, it was in the middle of opening, no one inside. Friend: Then grab a good spot. You: Yeah, the one by the window.

in the past.context: 你回忆起上学的那些日子，觉得那时候虽然穷但很快乐。
in the past.translation: 朋友：你最怀念哪段时光 你：在过去上学的那段日子最怀念 朋友：那时候不是很穷吗 你：是穷 但朋友多 很开心
in the past.example: Friend: Which period do you miss most? You: In the past, my school days are what I miss most. Friend: Weren't you poor back then? You: Yeah, but I had many friends, it was fun.

in this way.context: 你通过调整学习方法，效率一下子提高了很多。
in this way.translation: 朋友：你最近学习效率怎么提高了 你：我换了种学习方式 效率就高了 朋友：你怎么做到的呀 你：把手机放远 专注学一小时
in this way.example: Friend: How did your study efficiency go up lately? You: I studied in this way, and the efficiency jumped. Friend: How did you do it? You: Put the phone away, focus for an hour.

just like.context: 你家那只猫就像个小主子，全家人都围着它转。
just like.translation: 朋友：你家猫最近怎么样 你：它就像个小主子 全家人都宠着 朋友：它平时都干什么呀 你：吃了睡 睡了吃 特别胖
just like.example: Friend: How is your cat doing lately? You: It's just like the little master, the whole family spoils it. Friend: What does it do all day? You: Eat and sleep, really chubby.

knock at.context: 你在朋友家门口站着，敲门看他在不在家。
knock at.translation: 朋友：你到他家门口了吗 你：到了 我敲敲门看看他在不在 朋友：有人应门吗 你：没声音 可能不在家
knock at.example: Friend: Are you at his door yet? You: Here, I'll knock at the door to see if he's home. Friend: Anyone answer? You: No sound, probably not home.

know about.context: 朋友跟你说的那个八卦你早就知道了，问他从哪听来的。
know about.translation: 朋友：我跟你说个大八卦 你听过吗 你：这件事我早就知道了 你从哪听来的 朋友：群里说的 真的假的 你：八九不离十
know about.example: Friend: I've got some gossip for you, heard it? You: I already know about it, where did you hear it? Friend: The group chat, is it real? You: Pretty much.

later on.context: 你刚学骑车的时候摔过几次，后来慢慢就熟练了。
later on.translation: 朋友：你骑车是什么时候学会的 你：刚开始摔过几次 后来慢慢熟练了 朋友：现在骑得溜吧 你：当然 还能单手骑
later on.example: Friend: When did you learn to ride a bike? You: I fell a few times at first, later on I got the hang of it. Friend: You're smooth now, right? You: Of course, can even ride one-handed.

learn about.context: 你在博物馆里看到很多古代文物，边看边学历史知识。
learn about.translation: 朋友：周末你去博物馆感觉怎么样 你：看到很多文物 学到了不少历史 朋友：哪个展品最有意思 你：那个金缕玉衣 特别精致
learn about.example: Friend: How was the museum this weekend? You: I saw many relics and learned a lot about history. Friend: Which exhibit was most interesting? You: That jade burial suit, really exquisite.

listen to.context: 你每天通勤路上都听播客，一边听歌一边学英语。
listen to.translation: 朋友：你通勤路上都干嘛呀 你：我每天都听播客 一边听一边学英语 朋友：听什么节目好 你：推荐你那个英语播客
listen to.example: Friend: What do you do on your commute? You: I listen to podcasts every day, listening to English. Friend: What show is good? You: I'll recommend that English podcast.

long ago.context: 你爷爷跟你说他年轻的时候，那是很久很久以前的事了。
long ago.translation: 朋友：爷爷都跟你聊什么呀 你：他讲他年轻时候的故事 那是很久以前了 朋友：那一定很有意思 你：对 他当过兵
long ago.example: Friend: What does your grandpa chat with you about? You: He tells stories from when he was young, that was long ago. Friend: That must be interesting. You: Yeah, he was a soldier.

look at.context: 你朋友盯着手机看半天，你问他在看什么。
look at.translation: 朋友：你一直盯着手机看什么呢 你：我在看招聘软件 找新工作 朋友：有合适的机会吗 你：有几个在面试
look at.example: Friend: What are you staring at your phone for? You: I'm looking at a job app, looking for work. Friend: Any good opportunities? You: A few in interviews.

look for.context: 你手机坏了想找个替代品，朋友问你想买什么样的。
look for.translation: 朋友：你手机坏了 打算买个什么样的 你：我在找个性价比高的替代品 朋友：预算多少 你：三千以内就行
look for.example: Friend: Your phone broke, what kind do you want? You: I'm looking for a good value alternative. Friend: What's the budget? You: Under three thousand.

look like.context: 你妹妹长得特别像你妈妈，别人见了都说是一个模子刻出来的。
look like.translation: 朋友：你妹妹长得好像谁呀 你：她长得特别像我妈妈年轻时候 朋友：那就是个小美人胚子 你：对 大家都这么说
look like.example: Friend: Who does your sister look like? You: She looks just like my mom when she was young. Friend: Then she's a little beauty. You: Yeah, everyone says so.

lots of.context: 自助餐厅里有很多水果和甜点，你一吃就停不下来。
lots of.translation: 朋友：这自助餐厅种类真多 你：是啊 有很多水果和甜点 朋友：你最想吃哪一个 你：那个巧克力蛋糕 看着特别诱人
lots of.example: Friend: This buffet has so many kinds. You: Yeah, there are lots of fruits and desserts. Friend: Which do you want most? You: That chocolate cake, looks so tempting.

millions of.context: 国庆期间景区里人山人海，游客多到数不清。
millions of.translation: 朋友：国庆景区人多不多呀 你：人特别多 成千上万的游客挤在一起 朋友：那不是拍照全是人头 你：对 想拍个照都得排队
millions of.example: Friend: Was the scenic spot crowded on National Day? You: Super crowded, millions of visitors packed together. Friend: Then every photo is just a sea of heads. You: Yeah, you even line up for photos.

more and more.context: 城市里养猫养狗的人越来越多，宠物医院越开越多。
more and more.translation: 朋友：你发现这几年养宠物的人多了吗 你：是啊 越来越多人养猫养狗 朋友：那宠物经济很火吧 你：对 宠物店一家接一家
more and more.example: Friend: Have you noticed more people having pets lately? You: Yeah, more and more people are raising cats and dogs. Friend: Then the pet industry is booming. You: Yeah, pet shops keep opening.

more than.context: 你朋友每月工资一万多，比你多两三千。
more than.translation: 朋友：你一个月工资多少呀 你：我一万出头 比你多两三千 朋友：那你挺不错的 你：也就够生活 存不下多少
more than.example: Friend: How much do you make a month? You: I make more than ten thousand, about two or three thousand more than you. Friend: That's pretty good. You: Just enough to live, not much savings.

most of.context: 你把工资大部分都交给家里存着，自己留一点零花钱。
most of.translation: 朋友：你工资都怎么安排的 你：大部分交给家里存着 自己留一点 朋友：那你自己够花吗 你：够 不怎么买东西
most of.example: Friend: How do you handle your salary? You: Most of it goes home to savings, I keep some for myself. Friend: Is that enough for you? You: Yeah, I don't buy much.

most of the time.context: 你朋友周末大部分时间都在加班，很少休息。
most of the time.translation: 朋友：你周末一般都干嘛呀 你：大部分时间都在加班 朋友：那你也太惨了 你：是啊 项目紧 没办法
most of the time.example: Friend: What do you usually do on weekends? You: Most of the time I'm working overtime. Friend: That's rough. You: Yeah, the project is tight, no choice.

next to.context: 你家小区门口紧挨着地铁站，出行特别方便。
next to.translation: 朋友：你家那地铁站远不远 你：就在小区旁边 出门就是 朋友：那通勤太方便了 你：对 上班二十分钟就到
next to.example: Friend: Is the subway far from your place? You: It's right next to the complex, out the door. Friend: That's so convenient for commuting. You: Yeah, twenty minutes to work.

not at all.context: 朋友谢谢你帮他带饭，你说不客气，一点小事。
not at all.translation: 朋友：今天谢谢你帮我带午饭 你：一点也不客气 小事而已 朋友：明天我帮你带 你：好 那就说定了
not at all.example: Friend: Thanks for bringing me lunch today. You: Not at all, it was nothing. Friend: Tomorrow I'll bring yours. You: OK, it's a deal then.

of course.context: 朋友约你周末出去玩，你说当然有空，随时奉陪。
of course.translation: 朋友：周末有空一起出去玩吗 你：当然有 随时都可以 朋友：那我们去看个电影 你：好 我买票
of course.example: Friend: Are you free to hang out this weekend? You: Of course, anytime works. Friend: Then let's go see a movie. You: OK, I'll book tickets.

on foot.context: 你家离公司不远，每天走路上下班，不用挤地铁。
on foot.translation: 朋友：你每天怎么上班呀 你：走路去 离公司就十分钟 朋友：那太舒服了 不用挤地铁 你：对 还能顺便锻炼
on foot.example: Friend: How do you get to work every day? You: On foot, it's ten minutes from home. Friend: That's so nice, no subway crowds. You: Yeah, I get some exercise too.

on time.context: 你每天定好闹钟按时起床，从不迟到。
on time.translation: 朋友：你上班从来没迟到过吗 你：我每天都准时到 从不迟到 朋友：你怎么做到的 你：定好几个闹钟 不起都不行
on time.example: Friend: Have you ever been late for work? You: I arrive on time every day, never late. Friend: How do you do it? You: Set several alarms, can't oversleep.

pay attention.context: 老师上课讲重点的时候，你提醒走神的同学认真听。
pay attention.translation: 朋友：老师刚才说的你记了吗 你：我走神了 你提醒我一下 朋友：让你注意听 这是考点 你：好 我赶紧记下来
pay attention.example: Friend: Did you note what the teacher just said? You: I zoned out, remind me. Friend: Pay attention, this is on the exam. You: OK, writing it down now.

pay attention to.context: 朋友上课总走神，你让他把注意力集中在老师讲的内容上。
pay attention to.translation: 朋友：我上课总走神 怎么办 你：把注意力集中在老师讲的内容上 朋友：可是内容太枯燥 你：记笔记 手不动就会走神
pay attention to.example: Friend: I always zone out in class, what to do? You: Pay attention to what the teacher is saying. Friend: But the content is so boring. You: Take notes, your mind wanders when your hands are idle.

pay for.context: 你买东西用信用卡支付，下个月再还钱。
pay for.translation: 朋友：你今天买这台电脑花了多少钱 你：刷信用卡买的 下个月再还钱 朋友：那有利息吗 你：免息期内还就没有
pay for.example: Friend: How much did you pay for this computer today? You: I paid for it with the credit card, pay it back next month. Friend: Is there interest? You: Not if paid within the interest-free period.

point at.context: 朋友在人群中找不到你，你指着自己的位置让他看。
point at.translation: 朋友：你在哪儿呢 这么多人 你：我在这边 你往我这边看 朋友：看到你了 挥着手那个是吧 你：对 走过来吧
point at.example: Friend: Where are you, so many people? You: I'm over here, point at me with your finger. Friend: I see you, the one waving? You: Yeah, come over.

run away.context: 小时候被大狗追，或者不敢面对某件想逃避的事，就会讲自己转身跑开了。
run away.translation: 朋友：刚才巷子里那条狗冲你叫，你怎么一下就跑了 你：我当时特别害怕，转身就跑开了 朋友：下次别乱跑，慢慢走开就好 你：我知道，但我那时脑子一片空白
run away.example: Friend: That dog barked at you just now, why did you suddenly run away? You: I was so scared that I turned around and ran away. Friend: Next time don't run, just walk away slowly. You: I know, but my mind went blank then.

sit down.context: 朋友逛累了或开完会，招呼对方坐下休息、或者请人落座时，就用它。
sit down.translation: 朋友：站着聊了半天，腿都酸了 你：快坐下吧，我去给你倒杯水 朋友：不用麻烦，我站会儿就行 你：别客气，坐下慢慢说
sit down.example: Friend: We've stood chatting for ages, my legs are sore. You: Sit down quickly, I'll pour you some water. Friend: No trouble needed, I'll stand a while. You: Don't be polite, sit down and take your time.

speak to.context: 表示“与某人交谈”，或某件事能“证明、说明”某个观点时，就用它。
speak to.translation: 朋友：刚才找你半天，你跟谁在走廊里说话呢 你：我跟班主任聊了聊下学期的选课 朋友：他怎么说 你：他的态度就说明了学校很重视这件事
speak to.example: Friend: I looked for you ages, who were you talking to in the hallway? You: I was speaking to the head teacher about next term's courses. Friend: What did he say? You: His attitude speaks to how much the school cares about this.

stand up.context: 坐久了腿麻，招呼身边的人“起身、站起来活动一下”时，就用它。
stand up.translation: 朋友：开了一上午会，腰都快僵了 你：站起来伸个懒腰吧，别老坐着 朋友：我站起来走动走动 你：对，起身放松一下再继续
stand up.example: Friend: We've been in a meeting all morning, my back is stiff. You: Stand up and stretch, don't just sit. Friend: I'll stand up and walk around. You: Right, stand up to relax a bit then continue.

stay at home.context: 外面下雨或不想出门，提议干脆待在家里追剧、休息时，就用它。
stay at home.translation: 朋友：今天这么大的雨，还出去吗 你：算了，我们干脆待在家里吧 朋友：那在家干嘛呢 你：就待在家里看看电影，多舒服
stay at home.example: Friend: It's raining so hard today, still going out? You: Forget it, let's just stay at home. Friend: Then what do we do at home? You: Just stay at home watching movies, so cozy.

stay in bed.context: 感冒发烧或周末赖床，说明自己“躺在床上休息、不起床”，就用它。
stay in bed.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么还不起床 你：我头有点疼，想在床上多躺一会儿 朋友：用不用给你带点早饭 你：好，我就继续躺着了
stay in bed.example: Friend: Why aren't you getting up today? You: My head aches a bit, I want to stay in bed a while longer. Friend: Want me to bring you breakfast? You: OK, I'll just stay in bed.

table tennis.context: 课间或周末约人打球，聊起乒乓球这项运动时，就用它。
table tennis.translation: 朋友：周末有空一起运动吗 你：好啊，我们去打乒乓球吧 朋友：你水平怎么样 你：一般，就是随便玩玩乒乓球
table tennis.example: Friend: Free to exercise together this weekend? You: Sure, let's play table tennis. Friend: How's your level? You: Average, just playing table tennis for fun.

talk about.context: 朋友间聊起、谈论某个话题，或对某事表示不满“说起就来气”时，就用它。
talk about.translation: 朋友：你们刚才在聊什么呢 你：我们在聊周末去哪玩 朋友：聊出结果了吗 你：还没，正说起这件事呢
talk about.example: Friend: What were you talking about just now? You: We were talking about where to go this weekend. Friend: Did you reach a result? You: Not yet, we're still talking about it.

talk to.context: 需要找某人“当面谈、对……说”，或调侃某人在跟谁“暧昧聊天”时，就用它。
talk to.translation: 朋友：我想找老师谈一下成绩的事 你：那你直接去办公室找他谈 朋友：他会不会很忙 你：没事，你就去找他谈谈
talk to.example: Friend: I want to talk to the teacher about my grades. You: Then just go to the office to talk to him. Friend: Will he be busy? You: It's fine, just go talk to him.

talk with.context: 强调平等地“和……交谈、聊聊”，比 talk to 更侧重双向交流时，就用它。
talk with.translation: 朋友：我心里有点事想找人聊聊 你：那我陪你好好聊聊 朋友：会不会耽误你时间 你：不会，我很愿意和你聊聊
talk with.example: Friend: I have something on my mind and want to talk with someone. You: Then let me have a good talk with you. Friend: Will it waste your time? You: No, I'd love to talk with you.

tidy up.context: 房间乱了，招呼人“整理、收拾一下”时，就用它。
tidy up.translation: 朋友：你的桌子上怎么乱成一团 你：我这就收拾一下桌面 朋友：客人马上来了 你：好，我赶紧整理整理
tidy up.example: Friend: Why is your desk such a mess? You: I'll tidy up the desk right now. Friend: Guests are coming soon. You: OK, I'll quickly tidy up.

video games.context: 课余聊起“电子游戏、电玩”，该不该玩、玩多久，就用它。
video games.translation: 朋友：你周末一般在家干嘛 你：我打打电子游戏放松一下 朋友：不耽误学习吗 你：适量玩玩无妨
video games.example: Friend: What do you usually do at home on weekends? You: I play video games to relax. Friend: Doesn't it hurt study? You: Playing video games moderately is fine.

wait a minute.context: 突然想起某事、或让对方“等一下”，就用它。
wait a minute.translation: 朋友：咱们出发吧 你：等一下，我钥匙忘拿了 朋友：你怎么老丢三落四 你：别急，马上回来
wait a minute.example: Friend: Let's set off. You: Wait a minute, I forgot my keys. Friend: Why are you always so forgetful? You: Hold on, I'll be right back.

wait a second.context: 与上一条相近，让对方“稍等一下”，语气更随意，就用它。
wait a second.translation: 朋友：我把账单结了 你：稍等一下，让我看看明细 朋友：怎么了 你：这一项好像算错了
wait a second.example: Friend: I've settled the bill. You: Wait a second, let me see the details. Friend: What's up? You: This item seems miscalculated.

wake up.context: 早上醒来、或把睡着的人“叫醒”，以及突然“醒悟”时，就用它。
wake up.translation: 朋友：你今天几点醒的 你：早上六点就醒了 朋友：怎么不再睡会儿 你：被窗外的鸟吵醒了
wake up.example: Friend: What time did you wake up today? You: I woke up at six in the morning. Friend: Why not sleep more? You: I was woken up by the birds outside.

walk around.context: 在景点、商场“四处逛逛、走来走去”时，就用它。
walk around.translation: 朋友：下午去哪打发时间 你：我们去老街随便走走吧 朋友：不买点东西吗 你：就四处逛逛，不买也行
walk around.example: Friend: Where to kill time this afternoon? You: Let's walk around the old street casually. Friend: Not buy anything? You: Just walk around; not buying is fine.

washing machine.context: 聊起家里的电器，衣服脏了用“洗衣机”洗，省手时，就用它。
washing machine.translation: 朋友：这堆脏衣服你手洗吗 你：当然用洗衣机啊，省事 朋友：洗衣机在哪儿买的 你：网上买的，用着挺顺手
washing machine.example: Friend: Will you hand-wash this pile of dirty clothes? You: Of course with the washing machine, it saves trouble. Friend: Where did you buy the washing machine? You: Bought online, it's handy.

wild animal.context: 去动物园、聊到“野生动物”该不该保护，就用它。
wild animal.translation: 朋友：动物园里你最喜欢哪种动物 你：我喜欢看那些野生动物，比如老虎 朋友：它们看着真精神 你：是啊，野生动物就该在野外
wild animal.example: Friend: Which animal do you like best at the zoo? You: I like watching those wild animals, like tigers. Friend: They look so spirited. You: Yes, wild animals should be in the wild.

go to bed.context: 晚上准备“上床睡觉”（未必立刻睡着），就用它。
go to bed.translation: 朋友：这么早就上床吗 你：我困了，想早点睡 朋友：不再看会儿剧吗 你：不了，我先上床了
go to bed.example: Friend: Going to bed this early? You: I'm sleepy, I want to go to bed early. Friend: Not watch a show more? You: No, I'm going to bed now.

go to sleep.context: 真正“入睡、睡着”的那个过程，就用它。
go to sleep.translation: 朋友：昨晚你几点睡着的 你：躺下好半天才睡着 朋友：失眠了吗 你：翻来覆去才入睡
go to sleep.example: Friend: What time did you go to sleep last night? You: I lay down ages before I went to sleep. Friend: Insomnia? You: I tossed and turned before going to sleep.

go to school.context: 孩子“去上学”（抽象概念，非去校舍），就用它。
go to school.translation: 朋友：你家孩子几点上学 你：每天七点就去学校了 朋友：他爱上学吗 你：挺喜欢的
go to school.example: Friend: What time does your kid go to school? You: He goes to school at seven every day. Friend: Does he like going to school? You: He quite likes it.

go home.context: 下班、下课后“回家”（home 是副词，不加 to），就用它。
go home.translation: 朋友：这么早就要走吗 你：我想早点回家 朋友：不一起吃晚饭吗 你：不了，我回家了
go home.example: Friend: Leaving this early? You: I want to go home early. Friend: Not have dinner together? You: No, I'm going home.

go shopping.context: 约人“去购物、逛商店”，就用它。
go shopping.translation: 朋友：周末去哪 你：我们去逛街吧 朋友：买什么呢 你：随便逛逛也行
go shopping.example: Friend: Where this weekend? You: Let's go shopping. Friend: Buy what? You: Just going shopping is fine.

go swimming.context: 天热约人“去游泳”，就用它。
go swimming.translation: 朋友：今天真热 你：我们去游泳吧 朋友：泳池人多吗 你：去了就知道
go swimming.example: Friend: It's so hot today. You: Let's go swimming. Friend: Is the pool crowded? You: We'll know when we go swimming.

go fishing.context: 周末休闲“去钓鱼”，就用它。
go fishing.translation: 朋友：你爷爷周末一般干嘛 你：他常去河边钓鱼 朋友：钓得到吗 你：玩个乐子
go fishing.example: Friend: What does your grandpa usually do on weekends? You: He often goes fishing by the river. Friend: Does he catch anything? You: He goes fishing for fun.

go hiking.context: 秋高气爽约人“去远足、爬山”，就用它。
go hiking.translation: 朋友：这天气真适合户外活动 你：那我们去远足吧 朋友：走哪条路线 你：找个山走走
go hiking.example: Friend: The weather is great for outdoor activities. You: Then let's go hiking. Friend: Which route? You: Go hiking on some mountain.

go skating.context: 冬天约人“去滑冰”，就用它。
go skating.translation: 朋友：冰场开了吗 你：开了，我们去滑冰吧 朋友：我可不会滑 你：慢慢学
go skating.example: Friend: Is the ice rink open? You: Yes, let's go skating. Friend: I can't skate. You: Go skating and learn slowly.

go skiing.context: 雪季约人“去滑雪”，就用它。
go skiing.translation: 朋友：今年雪下得不错 你：那我们去滑雪吧 朋友：你滑得好吗 你：一般，去玩玩
go skiing.example: Friend: The snow this year is quite good. You: Then let's go skiing. Friend: Do you ski well? You: Average; go skiing for fun.

go walking.context: 饭后“去散步”消食，就用它。
go walking.translation: 朋友：刚吃完好撑 你：我们出去走走吧 朋友：就在小区里转转 你：对，散步消食
go walking.example: Friend: So full just after eating. You: Let's go walking outside. Friend: Just around the community? You: Right, go walking to digest.

come on.context: 催促人“快点”、给人“加油”，或对荒谬的事说“得了吧”，就用它。
come on.translation: 朋友：快点，要迟到了 你：来了来了，别催 朋友：加油啊 你：来了，走了
come on.example: Friend: Come on, we're going to be late. You: Coming, coming, stop rushing. Friend: Come on, hurry up. You: Coming, let's go.

come here.context: 招手叫人“到这儿来”，就用它。
come here.translation: 朋友：你站在那儿干嘛 你：你过来一下 朋友：干嘛叫我过去 你：过来我给你看个东西
come here.example: Friend: What are you standing there for? You: Come here a second. Friend: Why call me over? You: Come here, I'll show you something.

look the same.context: 两个东西“看起来一样、长得像”，就用它。
look the same.translation: 朋友：这对双胞胎我分不出来 你：他俩长得真一模一样 朋友：性格也像吗 你：样子看着一样，脾气不同
look the same.example: Friend: I can't tell these twins apart. You: They really look the same. Friend: Are their personalities alike too? You: They look the same, but have different tempers.

hear from.context: “收到……的来信/消息”，久未联系就用它。
hear from.translation: 朋友：你最近有你老同学的消息吗 你：好久没收到他的信了 朋友：他去哪了 你：自从搬家就没他消息
hear from.example: Friend: Any news from your old classmate lately? You: I haven't heard from him for ages. Friend: Where did he go? You: I haven't heard from him since he moved.

watch tv.context: 晚上在家“看电视”放松，就用它。
watch tv.translation: 朋友：晚上你一般干嘛 你：看看电视呗 朋友：都看什么节目 你：随便看看
watch tv.example: Friend: What do you usually do at night? You: Watch TV. Friend: What shows? You: Just watch TV casually.

read books.context: 业余爱好看书，“读书”增长知识，就用它。
read books.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么过的 你：在家看书 朋友：看什么类型 你：多读好书
read books.example: Friend: How did you spend the weekend? You: Read books at home. Friend: What genre? You: Reading more good books.

play football.translation: 朋友：放学后一起干嘛 你：去踢足球吧 朋友：你踢得好吗 你：一般，随便踢
play football.example: Friend: What to do after school? You: Let's play football. Friend: Do you play well? You: Average; just play football for fun.

play basketball.translation: 朋友：篮球场有人吗 你：走，我们去打球 朋友：叫上别人吗 你：人多好打
play basketball.example: Friend: Is anyone at the basketball court? You: Let's go play basketball. Friend: Call others? You: More people make playing basketball fun.

play ping-pong.translation: 朋友：雨天没处去 你：去活动室打乒乓球吧 朋友：你水平如何 你：随便打打
play ping-pong.example: Friend: Nowhere to go on a rainy day. You: Let's play ping-pong in the activity room. Friend: How good are you? You: Just play ping-pong for fun.

play the piano.context: 会“弹钢琴”，乐器前加 the，就用它。
play the piano.translation: 朋友：你有什么特长 你：我会弹钢琴 朋友：弹了几年 你：学了八年
play the piano.example: Friend: Any special skill? You: I can play the piano. Friend: How many years? You: I've played the piano for eight years.

play games.context: 孩子“玩游戏”或大家比赛“做游戏”，就用它。
play games.translation: 朋友：周末孩子们都在干嘛 你：他们在家玩游戏 朋友：不担心影响视力吗 你：限量玩会儿
play games.example: Friend: What are the kids doing on weekends? You: They're playing games at home. Friend: Worried about eyesight? You: Limit playing games a while.

do homework.translation: 朋友：放学后先干嘛 你：先做作业 朋友：多吗 你：不少，得做半天
do homework.example: Friend: What first after school? You: Do homework first. Friend: Is it a lot? You: Quite a lot; doing homework takes ages.

do housework.context: 帮家里“做家务”，扫地洗碗，就用它。
do housework.translation: 朋友：你在家帮父母干活吗 你：我常帮着做家务 朋友：都做哪些 你：扫地洗碗
do housework.example: Friend: Do you help your parents at home? You: I often help do housework. Friend: What chores? You: Do housework like sweeping and washing dishes.

do morning exercises.translation: 朋友：你们学校几点集合 你：八点做早操 朋友：每天都做吗 你：对，天天做
do morning exercises.example: Friend: What time does your school gather? You: Do morning exercises at eight. Friend: Every day? You: Yes, do morning exercises every day.

have breakfast.context: 早上“吃早饭”，三餐前不加冠词，就用它。
have breakfast.translation: 朋友：你早上一般吃什么 你：简单吃点早饭 朋友：不早起做吗 你：随便吃点
have breakfast.example: Friend: What do you usually eat in the morning? You: Have breakfast simply. Friend: Not cook early? You: Just have breakfast casually.

have lunch.translation: 朋友：中午一起吃饭吗 你：好，我们去吃午饭 朋友：去哪一家 你：食堂就行
have lunch.example: Friend: Eat lunch together at noon? You: Sure, let's have lunch. Friend: Which place? You: The cafeteria is fine for having lunch.

have dinner.translation: 朋友：今晚来我家吃饭吧 你：好，去你家吃晚饭 朋友：想吃点什么 你：随便，晚饭简单点
have dinner.example: Friend: Come to my place for dinner tonight. You: Great, let's have dinner at yours. Friend: What to eat? You: Whatever; keep dinner simple.

have supper.context: 英式用法，晚上“吃晚饭”，就用它。
have supper.translation: 朋友：你们那儿晚饭几点吃 你：一般六点吃晚饭 朋友：吃得早啊 你：习惯了
have supper.example: Friend: What time do you have supper where you are? You: We usually have supper at six. Friend: That's early. You: Used to having supper early.

have a class.translation: 朋友：下一节是什么 你：我们要上英语课 朋友：老师严吗 你：还不错
have a class.example: Friend: What's the next period? You: We'll have an English class. Friend: Is the teacher strict? You: The class is not bad.

have a rest.translation: 朋友：干了一上午活了 你：歇会儿吧 朋友：好，休息十分钟 你：喝口水
have a rest.example: Friend: We've worked all morning. You: Have a rest. Friend: OK, have a rest for ten minutes. You: Have a rest and drink some water.

have a good time.context: 祝愿或描述“玩得开心、过得愉快”，就用它。
have a good time.translation: 朋友：祝你假期愉快 你：谢谢，你也玩得开心 朋友：回来分享照片 你：好，一定玩痛快
have a good time.example: Friend: Wish you a nice holiday. You: Thanks, you have a good time too. Friend: Share photos when back. You: OK, I'll have a good time for sure.

would like.context: 礼貌地“想要、愿意”做某事或要某物，就用它。
would like.translation: 朋友：你想喝点什么 你：我想要一杯热水 朋友：加糖吗 你：不用，谢谢
would like.example: Friend: What would you like to drink? You: I would like a cup of hot water. Friend: Sugar? You: No, thanks.

take photos.context: 旅游、聚会“拍照”留念，就用它。
take photos.translation: 朋友：这风景太美了 你：快拍照留念 朋友：帮我也拍一张 你：好，笑一个
take photos.example: Friend: This scenery is so beautiful. You: Quick, take photos. Friend: Take one of me too. You: OK, take photos and smile.

take a walk.translation: 朋友：晚上一起走走吗 你：好啊，去散个步 朋友：江边走走挺舒服 你：对，散步吹吹风
take a walk.example: Friend: Walk together tonight? You: Sure, let's take a walk. Friend: Taking a walk by the river is nice. You: Right, take a walk in the breeze.

take a shower.translation: 朋友：一身汗味 你：我去冲个澡 朋友：水热了 你：洗完就舒服了
take a shower.example: Friend: You smell of sweat. You: I'll take a shower. Friend: Is the water hot? You: Taking a shower will freshen me up.

take a bus.translation: 朋友：怎么去车站 你：坐公交去吧 朋友：远吗 你：几站路
take a bus.example: Friend: How to get to the station? You: Take a bus. Friend: Is it far? You: Taking a bus is a few stops.

try one's best.context: 鼓励某人“尽最大努力”，就用它。
try one's best.translation: 朋友：这次比赛我没把握 你：尽力就好 朋友：怕发挥失常 你：哪怕输，也要全力以赴
try one's best.example: Friend: I'm not sure about this match. You: Try your best. Friend: Afraid of choking. You: Even if you lose, try your best.

help oneself to.context: 请客时招呼客人“随便吃、自便”，就用它。
help oneself to.translation: 朋友：菜都凉了 你：别客气，随便吃 朋友：那我就不客气了 你：想吃什么自己夹
help oneself to.example: Friend: The dishes are getting cold. You: Help yourselves to the food. Friend: Then I won't stand on ceremony. You: Help yourselves to whatever you like.

help sb with sth.context: 在学习、工作上“帮某人做某事”，搭把手，就用它。
help sb with sth.translation: 朋友：这道数学题我不会 你：我来帮你讲讲 朋友：你有空吗 你：有，我帮你弄
help sb with sth.example: Friend: I can't do this math problem. You: Let me help you with it. Friend: Are you free? You: Yes, I'll help you with it.

thank you for.context: 为某事“感谢你”，接受帮助或礼物时就用它。
thank you for.translation: 朋友：你今天送我回家 你：不客气，路上小心 朋友：谢谢你送我 你：小事一桩
thank you for.example: Friend: You took me home today. You: Don't mention it, be careful on the way. Friend: Thank you for taking me. You: It was nothing.

be from.context: 自我介绍“来自”哪里，就用它。
be from.translation: 朋友：你老家是哪儿的 你：我来自广州 朋友：那边气候怎么样 你：暖和
be from.example: Friend: Where is your hometown? You: I'm from Guangzhou. Friend: How's the climate there? You: I'm from a warm place.

be born.context: 聊“出生”的时间或地点，就用它。
be born.translation: 朋友：你是哪年出生的 你：我出生于2000年 朋友：在哪儿出生的 你：在老家出生
be born.example: Friend: What year were you born? You: I was born in 2000. Friend: Where were you born? You: I was born in my hometown.

be busy with.context: 正“忙于、忙着做”某事，没空，就用它。
be busy with.translation: 朋友：周末有空吗 你：我正忙着写论文 朋友：什么时候忙完 你：这阵都挺忙
be busy with.example: Friend: Free this weekend? You: I'm busy with my paper. Friend: When will you finish? You: I'm busy with it these days.

be careful with.context: 提醒人“当心、小心对待”易碎品或钱物，就用它。
be careful with.translation: 朋友：这杯子挺脆的 你：我会小心拿 朋友：别打碎了 你：放心
be careful with.example: Friend: This cup is quite fragile. You: I'll be careful with it. Friend: Don't break it. You: I'll be careful with the fragile cup.

be famous for.context: 某地或某人“因……而出名”，就用它。
be famous for.translation: 朋友：杭州什么最有名 你：杭州以西湖闻名 朋友：值得一去吗 你：当然
be famous for.example: Friend: What is Hangzhou famous for? You: Hangzhou is famous for West Lake. Friend: Worth a visit? You: It's famous for a reason.

be friendly to.context: 形容某人“对……友好、和气”，就用它。
be friendly to.translation: 朋友：那个新同事好相处吗 你：他对人很友好 朋友：真的吗 你：对谁都笑眯眯的
be friendly to.example: Friend: Is the new coworker easy to get along with? You: He's friendly to people. Friend: Really? You: He's friendly to everyone.

be kind to.context: 夸赞或叮嘱“对……和善、厚道”，就用它。
be kind to.translation: 朋友：你奶奶人真好 你：她对谁都很和善 朋友：不像有些老人 你：她总教育我们要善待他人
be kind to.example: Friend: Your grandma is so nice. You: She's kind to everyone. Friend: Unlike some elders. You: She always tells us to be kind to others.

be nice to.translation: 朋友：你男朋友对你好吗 你：他对我可好了 朋友：怎么个好法 你：事事都想着我
be nice to.example: Friend: Is your boyfriend good to you? You: He's so nice to me. Friend: How so? You: He's nice to me in every way.

be ready for.context: 为考试、比赛“做好准备”，就用它。
be ready for.translation: 朋友：明天就要考试了 你：我已经复习好了 朋友：有把握吗 你：准备得差不多了
be ready for.example: Friend: The exam is tomorrow. You: I'm ready for it. Friend: Confident? You: I'm ready for it after reviewing.

be sorry for.context: 为做错事“感到抱歉、懊悔”，就用它。
be sorry for.translation: 朋友：昨天的话我说重了 你：没事，我已经不生气了 朋友：真的对不起 你：我也为冲动的话后悔
be sorry for.example: Friend: I went too far with my words yesterday. You: It's fine, I'm not angry anymore. Friend: I'm really sorry. You: I'm sorry for my rash words too.

be strict with.context: 老师、家长“对……严格要求”，就用它。
be strict with.translation: 朋友：你们班主任凶吗 你：他对我们要求很严 朋友：作业很多吗 你：非常严
be strict with.example: Friend: Is your head teacher tough? You: He's strict with us. Friend: Lots of homework? You: He's strict with us on homework.

be the same as.translation: 朋友：你这款跟我那部一样吗 你：对，型号完全相同 朋友：价格呢 你：也一样
be the same as.example: Friend: Is yours the same as mine? You: Yes, the model is the same as yours. Friend: And the price? You: It's the same as well.

be like.context: 问“……是什么样的、像什么”，描述人或物的特征，就用它。
be like.translation: 朋友：你新搬的小区怎么样 你：环境挺安静的 朋友：周边方便吗 你：配套很全
be like.example: Friend: What's your new community like? You: It's quiet. Friend: Is it convenient around? You: It's like a well-serviced place.

keep quiet.context: 在图书馆、影院提醒“保持安静”，就用它。
keep quiet.translation: 朋友：大家都在睡觉呢 你：我们小声点 朋友：别吵着人 你：好，保持安静
keep quiet.example: Friend: Everyone's sleeping. You: Let's keep quiet. Friend: Don't wake them. You: OK, let's keep quiet.

keep healthy.context: 劝人“保持健康、注意身体”，就用它。
keep healthy.translation: 朋友：最近总感冒 你：得多锻炼 朋友：怎么练 你：规律作息才能保持健康
keep healthy.example: Friend: I keep catching colds lately. You: You must exercise more. Friend: How? You: Keeping healthy needs regular habits.

in the morning.context: 描述“在早上”做什么，就用它。
in the morning.translation: 朋友：你几点起床 你：我早上六点起 朋友：早起干嘛 你：读读书
in the morning.example: Friend: What time do you get up? You: I get up at six in the morning. Friend: Why so early? You: In the morning I read.

in the afternoon.context: 描述“在下午”的安排，就用它。
in the afternoon.translation: 朋友：下午有什么计划 你：我下午去打球 朋友：几点 你：三点
in the afternoon.example: Friend: Any plan in the afternoon? You: I'll play ball in the afternoon. Friend: What time? You: At three in the afternoon.

in the evening.context: 描述“在晚上”做什么，就用它。
in the evening.translation: 朋友：晚上你一般干啥 你：我晚上看看书 朋友：不看电视吗 你：很少
in the evening.example: Friend: What do you usually do in the evening? You: In the evening I read. Friend: Not watch TV? You: Rarely in the evening.

at noon.translation: 朋友：中午一起吃饭吗 你：我中午十二点有空 朋友：食堂见 你：好
at noon.example: Friend: Eat together at noon? You: I'm free at noon. Friend: See at the cafeteria. You: See you at noon.

at home.translation: 朋友：周末你出去吗 你：我在家待着 朋友：干嘛呢 你：在家看看剧
at home.example: Friend: Going out this weekend? You: I'll stay at home. Friend: Do what? You: At home I'll watch shows.

at last.context: 盼了很久“终于、最后”等到了，就用它。
at last.translation: 朋友：车终于来了 你：等了半小时 朋友：再晚就走不了了 你：太好了
at last.example: Friend: The bus finally came. You: At last! We waited half an hour. Friend: If it were later we couldn't leave. You: At last it arrived.

at the age of.translation: 朋友：你几岁开始学琴的 你：我五岁开始学 朋友：这么小 你：五岁就学了
at the age of.example: Friend: At what age did you start piano? You: I started at the age of five. Friend: So young. You: At the age of five I began.

on the left.translation: 朋友：厕所在哪 你：进门往左走 朋友：是这边吗 你：对，在左手边
on the left.example: Friend: Where's the restroom? You: Go left when you enter. Friend: This side? You: Yes, it's on the left.

on the right.translation: 朋友：银行在哪 你：马路对面右边 朋友：看到了 你：对，就在右边
on the right.example: Friend: Where's the bank? You: On the right across the road. Friend: I see it. You: Yes, it's on the right.

on the way.context: “在路上、途中”，或即将到来，就用它。
on the way.translation: 朋友：你到哪儿了 你：我正在路上 朋友：还有多久 你：快了，在半路上
on the way.example: Friend: Where are you? You: I'm on the way. Friend: How much longer? You: Soon, I'm on the way.

on the phone.translation: 朋友：他怎么不回消息 你：他在打电话 朋友：打多久了 你：一直在通话
on the phone.example: Friend: Why isn't he replying? You: He's on the phone. Friend: How long? You: He's been on the phone.

by bike.translation: 朋友：你每天骑车上班吗 你：对，我骑车 朋友：远不远 你：二十分钟
by bike.example: Friend: Do you ride a bike to work every day? You: Yes, I go by bike. Friend: Is it far? You: Going by bike takes twenty minutes.

by car.translation: 朋友：周末怎么去郊区 你：我们开车去 朋友：你有驾照吗 你：有
by car.example: Friend: How to get to the suburbs this weekend? You: We'll go by car. Friend: Do you have a license? You: Going by car, I do.

by plane.translation: 朋友：去海南怎么去 你：当然坐飞机 朋友：快不快 你：三个小时
by plane.example: Friend: How to get to Hainan? You: Of course go by plane. Friend: Is it fast? You: Going by plane takes three hours.

by train.translation: 朋友：去邻市怎么走方便 你：坐火车吧 朋友：要多久 你：一个半小时
by train.example: Friend: How to get to the neighboring city conveniently? You: Go by train. Friend: How long? You: Going by train takes an hour and a half.

by ship.translation: 朋友：去那个岛怎么去 你：只能坐船 朋友：风浪大吗 你：有点
by ship.example: Friend: How to get to that island? You: Only go by ship. Friend: Is it rough? You: Going by ship, a bit.

by subway.translation: 朋友：市中心堵得很 你：那我们坐地铁 朋友：快不快 你：准点又快
by subway.example: Friend: The city center is jammed. You: Then let's go by subway. Friend: Is it fast? You: Going by subway is on time and fast.

after class.translation: 朋友：下课后一起打球吗 你：好啊 朋友：几点 你：四点
after class.example: Friend: Play ball after class? You: Sure. Friend: What time? You: At four after class.

after breakfast.translation: 朋友：你习惯早上干嘛 你：早饭后去散步 朋友：走多久 你：半小时
after breakfast.example: Friend: What do you do in the morning? You: After breakfast I take a walk. Friend: How long? You: After breakfast I walk half an hour.

next week.translation: 朋友：你休假吗 你：我下周出差 朋友：去哪 你：去上海
next week.example: Friend: Are you on leave? You: Next week I'm on a business trip. Friend: Where? You: Next week I go to Shanghai.

next month.translation: 朋友：房租什么时候交 你：下个月交 朋友：多少 你：两千
next month.example: Friend: When is the rent due? You: Next month. Friend: How much? You: Next month it's two thousand.

next year.translation: 朋友：你毕业后什么计划 你：我明年考研 朋友：有把握吗 你：正在准备
next year.example: Friend: What's your plan after graduation? You: Next year I'll take the postgraduate exam. Friend: Confident? You: Next year I'm preparing.

last week.translation: 朋友：你上周去哪了 你：我上周回老家了 朋友：待了几天 你：三天
last week.example: Friend: Where were you last week? You: Last week I went back home. Friend: How many days? You: Last week I stayed three days.

last year.translation: 朋友：你今年比去年瘦了 你：对，我去年开始跑步 朋友：有效果吗 你：明显
last year.example: Friend: You're thinner than last year. You: Yes, last year I started running. Friend: Does it work? You: Since last year, clearly.

every day.translation: 朋友：你怎么保持精力好 你：我每天早睡 朋友：几点睡 你：十点
every day.example: Friend: How do you keep your energy? You: I sleep early every day. Friend: What time? You: Every day at ten.

every week.translation: 朋友：你周末都干嘛 你：我每周都去游泳 朋友：雷打不动 你：对，风雨无阻
every week.example: Friend: What do you do on weekends? You: Every week I go swimming. Friend: Rain or shine? You: Every week, come what may.

once a week.translation: 朋友：你多久理一次发 你：我一周一次 朋友：这么频繁 你：头发长得快
once a week.example: Friend: How often do you get a haircut? You: Once a week. Friend: So often? You: Once a week because my hair grows fast.

twice a week.translation: 朋友：你健身吗 你：我一周练两次 朋友：哪两天 你：周二和周五
twice a week.example: Friend: Do you work out? You: Twice a week. Friend: Which days? You: Twice a week, Tuesday and Friday.

just now.translation: 朋友：你刚才在跟谁说话 你：我刚才在接电话 朋友：谁打来的 你：快递
just now.example: Friend: Who were you talking to just now? You: Just now I was answering the phone. Friend: Who called? You: Just now it was the courier.

right away.translation: 朋友：快递到了，下去拿一下 你：我马上来 朋友：快点 你：这就来
right away.example: Friend: The courier is here, go down and get it. You: I'll come right away. Friend: Hurry. You: Coming right away.

the day after tomorrow.translation: 朋友：你什么时候走 你：我后天走 朋友：这么快 你：是的
the day after tomorrow.example: Friend: When do you leave? You: The day after tomorrow. Friend: So soon? You: Yes, the day after tomorrow.

the day before yesterday.translation: 朋友：你什么时候感冒的 你：我前天开始的 朋友：吃药了吗 你：吃了
the day before yesterday.example: Friend: When did you catch a cold? You: The day before yesterday. Friend: Taken medicine? You: Since the day before yesterday I have.

in the front of.context: 在某物“内部的前部”，就用它。
in the front of.translation: 朋友：你坐哪儿听课 你：我坐教室前排 朋友：看得清吗 你：清楚
in the front of.example: Friend: Where do you sit in class? You: I sit in the front of the classroom. Friend: Can you see clearly? You: In the front of it, clearly.

near to.translation: 朋友：你新租的房子离公司近吗 你：离公司很近 朋友：走路多久 你：五分钟
near to.example: Friend: Is your new flat near to the company? You: It's near to the company. Friend: How long on foot? You: Near to it, five minutes.

far away from.translation: 朋友：你老家离这儿远吗 你：离这儿好几百公里 朋友：回家要多久 你：挺远的，坐高铁半天
far away from.example: Friend: Is your hometown far away from here? You: It's far away from here, hundreds of kilometers. Friend: How long home? You: Far away from here, half a day by train.

across from.translation: 朋友：邮局在哪儿 你：就在超市对面 朋友：是那家吗 你：对，正对面
across from.example: Friend: Where's the post office? You: It's across from the supermarket. Friend: That one? You: Yes, across from it.

between...and.translation: 朋友：你想吃面还是米饭 你：都行，你们定 朋友：定个中间的吧 你：那我吃饺子
between...and.example: Friend: Do you want noodles or rice? You: Either, you decide. Friend: Pick something between the two. You: Then I'll eat dumplings.

from...to.context: “从……到……”，表时间、地点范围，就用它。
from...to.translation: 朋友：你们几点上班 你：从九点到六点 朋友：午休多久 你：一个小时
from...to.example: Friend: What time do you work? You: From nine to six. Friend: How long is lunch? You: From nine to six, one hour break.

a glass of.context: 点饮品“一玻璃杯”，就用它。
a glass of.translation: 朋友：想喝点什么 你：给我一杯水 朋友：要冰的吗 你：常温就行
a glass of.example: Friend: What to drink? You: A glass of water, please. Friend: Iced? You: A glass of water at room temperature.

a bottle of.translation: 朋友：冰箱里还有喝的吗 你：还有一瓶可乐 朋友：开了吗 你：没开
a bottle of.example: Friend: Anything to drink in the fridge? You: There's a bottle of cola. Friend: Opened? You: A bottle of cola, unopened.

a bowl of.translation: 朋友：早饭想吃什么 你：给我一碗粥 朋友：配点咸菜吗 你：好
a bowl of.example: Friend: What for breakfast? You: A bowl of porridge, please. Friend: Pickles with it? You: A bowl of porridge and pickles.

a pair of.translation: 朋友：你眼镜多少度 你：刚配了一副新的 朋友：多少钱 你：五百
a pair of.example: Friend: What degree are your glasses? You: I just got a new pair. Friend: How much? You: A pair of them is five hundred.

a box of.translation: 朋友：你给阿姨带了什么 你：一盒巧克力 朋友：她爱吃这个 你：对
a box of.example: Friend: What did you bring for your aunt? You: A box of chocolates. Friend: She loves these. You: A box of chocolates, yes.

a bag of.translation: 朋友：去超市买点什么 你：拎一袋米回来 朋友：多重 你：十斤
a bag of.example: Friend: Buy what at the supermarket? You: Bring back a bag of rice. Friend: How heavy? You: A bag of rice, five kilos.

a kilo of.context: 按重量“一千克”买东西，就用它。
a kilo of.translation: 朋友：苹果怎么卖 你：来两斤 朋友：要哪种 你：称两斤
a kilo of.example: Friend: How much are the apples? You: Give me a kilo. Friend: Which kind? You: A kilo of these.

a bit of.context: “一点、少许”，修饰不可数或表程度，就用它。
a bit of.translation: 朋友：这汤味道怎么样 你：咸了一点 朋友：加水吗 你：加点就行
a bit of.example: Friend: How's the soup? You: It's a bit salty. Friend: Add water? You: A bit of water will do.

all right.context: 同意“好吧、行”，或形容身体“还好”，就用它。
all right.translation: 朋友：那我们就这么定了 你：行，就这么办 朋友：没问题吧 你：好的
all right.example: Friend: Then let's settle it. You: All right, let's do it. Friend: No problem? You: All right.

all kinds of.context: “各种各样的”，形容种类繁多，就用它。
all kinds of.translation: 朋友：这家店东西全吗 你：五花八门，应有尽有 朋友：价格怎么样 你：高低都有
all kinds of.example: Friend: Is this shop well stocked? You: All kinds of things. Friend: How about prices? You: All kinds of prices.

both...and.translation: 朋友：你喜欢咖啡还是茶 你：两个都喜欢 朋友：那你常喝哪个 你：换着来
both...and.example: Friend: Do you like coffee or tea? You: Both coffee and tea. Friend: Which do you drink more? You: Both of them, I alternate.

not...at all.context: “一点也不、根本不”，加强否定，就用它。
not...at all.translation: 朋友：你介意我开窗吗 你：一点也不介意 朋友：有点凉 你：没事
not...at all.example: Friend: Do you mind me opening the window? You: Not at all. Friend: It's a bit cold. You: Not at all, it's fine.

speak english.translation: 朋友：你会说几国语言 你：我会说英语 朋友：流利吗 你：还行
speak english.example: Friend: How many languages do you speak? You: I speak English. Friend: Fluently? You: I speak English fairly well.

say goodbye to.translation: 朋友：火车快开了 你：我得跟家人道别了 朋友：抱抱再走 你：好
say goodbye to.example: Friend: The train is leaving soon. You: I must say goodbye to my family. Friend: Hug before going. You: Saying goodbye to them now.

tell stories.context: 老人、家长“讲故事”哄孩子，就用它。
tell stories.translation: 朋友：你小时候最爱听什么 你：奶奶常给我讲故事 朋友：都讲什么 你：神话故事
tell stories.example: Friend: What did you love as a kid? You: Grandma used to tell me stories. Friend: What kind? You: She told stories about myths.

tell sb about.translation: 朋友：你昨晚去哪了 你：我想跟你说说那件事 朋友：说吧 你：你听了别意外
tell sb about.example: Friend: Where were you last night? You: I want to tell you about it. Friend: Go on. You: Let me tell you about it; don't be shocked.

help sb do.context: “帮某人做某事”，省 to 的结构，就用它。
help sb do.translation: 朋友：这箱子真沉 你：我帮你抬 朋友：太感谢了 你：小事
help sb do.example: Friend: This box is so heavy. You: Let me help you carry it. Friend: Thanks so much. You: Let me help you do it.

answer the phone.context: 电话铃响，“接电话”，就用它。
answer the phone.translation: 朋友：电话响了 你：我去接一下 朋友：谁打来的 你：喂，哪位
answer the phone.example: Friend: The phone is ringing. You: I'll answer the phone. Friend: Who is it? You: Answering the phone now, hello?

make a phone call.translation: 朋友：我得给家里报个平安 你：那你打个电话吧 朋友：用公用电话吗 你：手机就行
make a phone call.example: Friend: I must call home to say I'm safe. You: Then make a phone call. Friend: Use a payphone? You: Make a phone call on your mobile.

make friends.context: 到新环境“交朋友”，就用它。
make friends.translation: 朋友：你在新学校适应了吗 你：我交到了几个朋友 朋友：容易吗 你：挺好相处的
make friends.example: Friend: Are you settling in at the new school? You: I've made a few friends. Friend: Was it easy? You: I made friends easily with them.

make a noise.context: 在安静场所“出声、制造噪音”，就用它。
make a noise.translation: 朋友：图书馆里有人吵闹 你：嘘，别出声 朋友：真讨厌 你：保持安静
make a noise.example: Friend: Someone's making a noise in the library. You: Shh, don't make a noise. Friend: So annoying. You: Don't make a noise.

make the bed.context: 早上起床“整理床铺、叠被”，就用它。
make the bed.translation: 朋友：你的床怎么那么乱 你：我这就整理 朋友：养成习惯 你：每天整理
make the bed.example: Friend: Why is your bed so messy? You: I'll make the bed now. Friend: Make it a habit. You: I make the bed every day.

do one's best.context: “尽力、尽全力”，与 try one's best 近义，就用它。
do one's best.translation: 朋友：这次比赛有信心吗 你：我会尽全力的 朋友：输赢不重要 你：关键是尽心
do one's best.example: Friend: Confident about this match? You: I'll do my best. Friend: Winning isn't everything. You: I'll do my best.

try again.context: 失败后鼓励“再试一次”，就用它。
try again.translation: 朋友：这题我还是不会 你：别急，再试一次 朋友：万一又错呢 你：多试几次
try again.example: Friend: I still can't do this problem. You: Don't rush, try again. Friend: What if I'm wrong again? You: Try again a few times.

wait in line.context: 在商店、车站“排队等候”，就用它。
wait in line.translation: 朋友：结账的人真多 你：咱们排队吧 朋友：要等多久 你：慢慢排
wait in line.example: Friend: So many people checking out. You: Let's wait in line. Friend: How long? You: We'll wait in line.

turn left.context: 开车或走路“左转”，就用它。
turn left.translation: 朋友：书店在哪个方向 你：前面路口左转 朋友：转过去就到吗 你：对
turn left.example: Friend: Which direction is the bookshop? You: Turn left at the next intersection. Friend: There it is? You: Turn left and you're there.

turn right.context: 开车或走路“右转”，就用它。
turn right.translation: 朋友：地铁站怎么走 你：往前直走再右转 朋友：远吗 你：不远
turn right.example: Friend: How to get to the subway? You: Go straight then turn right. Friend: Is it far? You: Turn right and it's near.

go straight.context: 指路“直走、一直往前走”，就用它。
go straight.translation: 朋友：厕所在哪儿 你：沿这条路直走 朋友：要转弯吗 你：不用
go straight.example: Friend: Where's the restroom? You: Go straight along this road. Friend: Need to turn? You: Just go straight.

smile at.translation: 朋友：那个服务员态度真好 你：她一直冲我笑 朋友：真贴心 你：对谁都笑
smile at.example: Friend: That waitress is so nice. You: She keeps smiling at me. Friend: So thoughtful. You: She smiles at everyone.

get to.context: “到达”某地（接地点名词），就用它。
get to.translation: 朋友：你几点到公司 你：我八点到公司 朋友：路上堵吗 你：还行
get to.example: Friend: What time do you get to the office? You: I get to the office at eight. Friend: Traffic? You: Getting to the office is fine.

set the table.context: 开饭前“摆餐具、摆桌子”，就用它。
set the table.translation: 朋友：饭好了吗 你：快了，先摆桌子 朋友：要帮忙吗 你：拿碗筷就行
set the table.example: Friend: Is dinner ready? You: Soon, set the table first. Friend: Need help? You: Just set the table with bowls and chopsticks.

wash hands.translation: 朋友：吃饭前先干嘛 你：先洗手 朋友：用洗手液吗 你：当然
wash hands.example: Friend: What first before eating? You: Wash hands first. Friend: Use soap? You: Wash hands with soap.

wash clothes.translation: 朋友：周末你干嘛 你：我洗衣服 朋友：用洗衣机吗 你：手洗几件
wash clothes.example: Friend: What do you do on weekends? You: I wash clothes. Friend: Use the machine? You: I wash clothes by hand for a few.

brush teeth.translation: 朋友：你每天刷几次牙 你：早晚各一次 朋友：每次多久 你：三分钟
brush teeth.example: Friend: How many times a day do you brush teeth? You: Brush teeth morning and night. Friend: How long each? You: Brushing teeth for three minutes.

comb hair.context: 出门前“梳头、整理头发”，就用它。
comb hair.translation: 朋友：你的头发真整齐 你：我刚梳过 朋友：用发油吗 你：不用
comb hair.example: Friend: Your hair is so neat. You: I just combed my hair. Friend: Use hair oil? You: No, just combing hair.

eat up.context: 劝孩子“吃光、吃完”，就用它。
eat up.translation: 朋友：你怎么剩饭了 你：我吃不下了 朋友：把它吃完 你：实在吃不动
eat up.example: Friend: Why did you leave food? You: I can't eat up anymore. Friend: Eat it up. You: I really can't eat up.

drink up.context: 举杯劝酒“喝光、干了”，就用它。
drink up.translation: 朋友：这杯祝你顺利 你：干了 朋友：我也干 你：喝完
drink up.example: Friend: This cup to your success. You: Drink up. Friend: I'll drink up too. You: Let's drink up.

open the door.context: 来客或进屋“开门”，就用它。
open the door.translation: 朋友：有人敲门 你：我去开 朋友：看看是谁 你：来了
open the door.example: Friend: Someone's knocking. You: I'll open the door. Friend: See who it is. You: Opening the door now.

close the door.translation: 朋友：外面风好大 你：把门关上吧 朋友：别夹着手 你：好
close the door.example: Friend: It's windy outside. You: Close the door. Friend: Don't pinch your hand. You: Closing the door now.

turn around.context: 背后有人叫你“转身”，就用它。
turn around.translation: 朋友：你看谁来了 你：谁啊，我转过身 朋友：你老同学 你：哎呀，好久不见
turn around.example: Friend: Look who's here. You: Who? I turned around. Friend: Your old classmate. You: Oh, long time no see.

catch a cold.translation: 朋友：你怎么打喷嚏了 你：我好像感冒了 朋友：吃药了吗 你：还没
catch a cold.example: Friend: Why are you sneezing? You: I think I caught a cold. Friend: Taken medicine? You: Caught a cold, not yet.

have a fever.translation: 朋友：你脸怎么这么红 你：我好像发烧了 朋友：多少度 你：三十八度
have a fever.example: Friend: Why is your face so red? You: I think I have a fever. Friend: What temperature? You: I have a fever of thirty-eight.

have a headache.translation: 朋友：你老揉太阳穴 你：我头痛 朋友：是不是没睡好 你：熬夜了
have a headache.example: Friend: You keep rubbing your temples. You: I have a headache. Friend: Didn't sleep well? You: Having a headache from staying up.

have a stomachache.translation: 朋友：你捂着肚子干嘛 你：我肚子痛 朋友：吃坏东西了吗 你：可能吧
have a stomachache.example: Friend: Why are you holding your belly? You: I have a stomachache. Friend: Ate something bad? You: Having a stomachache, maybe.

have a toothache.translation: 朋友：你半边脸都肿了 你：我牙痛 朋友：去看牙医吧 你：周末就去
have a toothache.example: Friend: Half your face is swollen. You: I have a toothache. Friend: Go see a dentist. You: Having a toothache, I'll go this weekend.

take medicine.translation: 朋友：感冒好点了吗 你：吃了药好多了 朋友：按时吃 你：一天三次
take medicine.example: Friend: Is your cold better? You: I took medicine and feel better. Friend: Take it on time. You: Taking medicine three times a day.

see a doctor.context: 身体不适“看医生”，就用它。
see a doctor.translation: 朋友：你咳嗽好几天了 你：我得去看医生 朋友：挂哪个科 你：呼吸科
see a doctor.example: Friend: You've coughed for days. You: I must see a doctor. Friend: Which department? You: Seeing a doctor at the respiratory clinic.

see a film.context: 英式说法“看电影”，就用它。
see a film.translation: 朋友：周末去看个电影吗 你：好啊，看哪部 朋友：新上映的那部 你：行
see a film.example: Friend: See a film this weekend? You: Sure, which one? Friend: The newly released one. You: OK, let's see a film.

go to the cinema.translation: 朋友：今晚有什么安排 你：我们去电影院吧 朋友：几点场 你：七点
go to the cinema.example: Friend: Any plan tonight? You: Let's go to the cinema. Friend: What time? You: Going to the cinema at seven.

go to the park.context: 周末“去公园”散步，就用它。
go to the park.translation: 朋友：天气这么好 你：我们去公园吧 朋友：划船吗 你：随便逛逛
go to the park.example: Friend: The weather is so nice. You: Let's go to the park. Friend: Row a boat? You: Just go to the park for a stroll.

go to the zoo.context: 带孩子“去动物园”，就用它。
go to the zoo.translation: 朋友：孩子周末想去哪 你：他想去动物园 朋友：看什么动物 你：熊猫
go to the zoo.example: Friend: Where does the kid want to go this weekend? You: He wants to go to the zoo. Friend: What animals? You: Going to the zoo to see pandas.

go to the library.context: 备考、借书“去图书馆”，就用它。
go to the library.translation: 朋友：你下午去哪 你：我去图书馆自习 朋友：占得到座吗 你：早点去
go to the library.example: Friend: Where are you going this afternoon? You: I'll go to the library to study. Friend: Can you get a seat? You: Go to the library early.

read english.context: 晨读、练习“读英语”，就用它。
read english.translation: 朋友：你每天早上干嘛 你：我读英语 朋友：大声读吗 你：对
read english.example: Friend: What do you do every morning? You: I read English. Friend: Loudly? You: Reading English aloud.

practice speaking.context: 为了口语进步“练习说话、练口语”，就用它。
practice speaking.translation: 朋友：你口语怎么练的 你：我每天对着镜子练 朋友：有效吗 你：坚持就有
practice speaking.example: Friend: How do you practice speaking? You: I practice speaking in front of a mirror daily. Friend: Does it work? You: Practicing speaking consistently works.

study hard.translation: 朋友：你成绩怎么这么好 你：我平时努力 朋友：熬夜吗 你：不用
study hard.example: Friend: How are your grades so good? You: I study hard. Friend: Stay up? You: I study hard but rest enough.

work hard.context: 职场人“努力工作”，就用它。
work hard.translation: 朋友：你升职那么快 你：我一直努力 朋友：有诀窍吗 你：踏实干
work hard.example: Friend: How did you get promoted so fast? You: I work hard. Friend: Any trick? You: I work hard and steady.

come true.context: 梦想、愿望“实现、成真”，就用它。
come true.translation: 朋友：你小时候想当什么 你：我想当飞行员 朋友：实现了吗 你：成真了
come true.example: Friend: What did you want to be as a kid? You: I wanted to be a pilot. Friend: Did it come true? You: My dream came true.

give sb a hand.context: 看人手忙脚乱，主动“帮一把”，就用它。
give sb a hand.translation: 朋友：这桌子我一个人搬不动 你：我来帮你 朋友：太谢谢了 你：搭把手
give sb a hand.example: Friend: I can't move this table alone. You: Let me give you a hand. Friend: Thanks so much. You: Let me give you a hand with it.

show sb around.context: 带新来的人“参观、领……转转”，就用它。
show sb around.translation: 朋友：新同事对公司不熟 你：我带他转转 朋友：你有空吗 你：走
show sb around.example: Friend: The new coworker doesn't know the company. You: I'll show him around. Friend: Are you free? You: Let me show him around.

point to.context: 用手指“指向”远处的东西，就用它。
point to.translation: 朋友：那栋高楼是什么 你：就是那栋 朋友：我看不清 你：看到了吗
point to.example: Friend: What's that tall building? You: The one I'm pointing to. Friend: I can't see clearly. You: Pointing to it; see it?

shake hands.context: 见面、谈成后“握手”，就用它。
shake hands.translation: 朋友：合同终于谈成了 你：来，握个手 朋友：合作愉快 你：愉快
shake hands.example: Friend: The contract is finally settled. You: Let's shake hands. Friend: Happy cooperation. You: Shaking hands to seal it.

say hello to.context: 见面或代人“问好、打招呼”，就用它。
say hello to.translation: 朋友：好久不见 你：你好呀 朋友：替我向你妈问好 你：一定带到
say hello to.example: Friend: Long time no see. You: Hello. Friend: Say hello to your mom for me. You: I'll say hello to her for you.

say sorry to.translation: 朋友：昨天是我不对 你：那你跟人家道歉了吗 朋友：我不好意思 你：该说就说
say sorry to.example: Friend: I was wrong yesterday. You: Did you say sorry to them? Friend: I'm embarrassed. You: You should say sorry to them.

a bit.context: 天气微凉，你和朋友站在便利店门口等车，朋友问你是不是觉得有点冷，你用 a bit 表示稍微有点。
a bit.translation: 朋友：今天出门好像风变大了 你：我觉得有一点点凉 朋友：那你要不要把外套穿上 你：好的 我们等车的时候就先披着吧
a bit.example: Friend: It seems the wind has picked up outside today. You: I feel a bit chilly standing here. Friend: Do you want to put your jacket on first? You: Sure, let me put it on while we wait for the bus.

a couple of.context: 你在书店翻杂志，朋友打电话问你几点能到，你说还要等两三分钟，用 a couple of 表示两三个。
a couple of.translation: 朋友：你现在到书店了吗 你：到了 我还要再挑两三本书 朋友：那你大概还要多久 你：再过几分钟就好 我们半小时后地铁站见吧
a couple of.example: Friend: Have you arrived at the bookstore yet? You: Yes, I just need to pick a couple more books. Friend: About how much longer will that take? You: Just a few more minutes, let's meet at the subway station in half an hour.

a few of.context: 班级里发了一批新笔记本，老师让你来分给同学，你挑出几本分给前排的人。
a few of.translation: 朋友：这些新本子你打算怎么分 你：我先挑出其中几本给前排同学 朋友：剩下的放在讲台上吗 你：好的 后面的人下课自己来拿
a few of.example: Friend: How are you planning to hand out these new notebooks? You: I'll give a few of them to the students in the front row. Friend: Should we leave the rest on the teacher's desk? You: Yes, the back row can pick theirs up after class.

a number of.context: 公司年会上老板问今年团队招了多少新人，你说新入职了不少同事。
a number of.translation: 朋友：今年咱们部门进了多少新人 你：新招了不少 大概有二十来个 朋友：那培训压力挺大的吧 你：是啊 我们分了好几个小组带他们
a number of.example: Friend: How many new people joined our department this year? You: We hired a number of new colleagues, about twenty in total. Friend: That must put a lot of pressure on training. You: Yeah, we split them into several groups to mentor.

a pile of.context: 你整理书桌时发现桌上堆了一堆旧报纸，朋友问你打算怎么处理。
a pile of.translation: 朋友：你桌上怎么堆了这么多报纸 你：这是一堆攒了好久的旧报纸 朋友：卖废品能卖不少钱吧 你：我周末一起拿去回收站处理掉
a pile of.example: Friend: Why is there such a pile of newspapers on your desk? You: That's a pile of old papers I've saved up for ages. Friend: You could get some money selling them as waste paper. You: I'll take them all to the recycling station this weekend.

a set of.context: 朋友生日你送了他一套新茶具，他打开盒子一看是六个茶杯和一个茶壶。
a set of.translation: 朋友：你送的这套餐具真精致 你：这是一套白瓷茶具 共六件 朋友：正好我家缺一套喝茶的东西 你：那以后来你家泡茶喝
a set of.example: Friend: This tea set you gave me is really exquisite. You: It's a set of white porcelain tea ware, six pieces in all. Friend: My place was exactly missing a tea set for drinking. You: Then let's come over and brew tea at your place.

a short time.context: 你在高铁站等车，朋友问你还要等多久，你说只需要很短时间车就来了。
a short time.translation: 朋友：咱们这趟车还要等多久 你：只需要很短时间了 屏幕上显示马上检票 朋友：那我去便利店买瓶水来得及吗 你：来得及 快去快回就行
a short time.example: Friend: How much longer do we have to wait for this train? You: Only a short time left, the screen says boarding starts soon. Friend: Do I have time to grab a bottle of water at the store? You: Yeah, hurry back and you won't miss it.

a short while.context: 排队买咖啡时前面的人接电话走开了，店员让你稍等片刻。
a short while.translation: 朋友：店员怎么还不叫号 你：他让我们稍等片刻 前面那位在打电话 朋友：那我们要不要换一家店 你：再等一小会儿吧 快到我们了
a short while.example: Friend: Why isn't the barista calling the next number? You: He asked us to wait for a short while, the person ahead is on a call. Friend: Should we just go to another shop instead? You: Wait just a bit longer, it's almost our turn.

a sort of.context: 你形容那家新开的餐厅风格有点奇怪，朋友问你具体是怎么个奇怪法。
a sort of.translation: 朋友：那家新开的馆子你吃过吗 你：吃过一次 是有点说不上来的味道 朋友：是好吃还是不好吃呢 你：怎么说呢 算一种很特别的风味吧
a sort of.example: Friend: Have you tried that newly opened restaurant yet? You: I went once, it's a sort of hard-to-describe taste. Friend: Is it good or not so good then? You: How should I put it, it's just a very unusual flavor.

a variety of.context: 学校社团招新，操场上摆了各种各样的摊位，你和朋友挨个逛。
a variety of.translation: 朋友：操场上今天怎么这么热闹 你：社团招新呢 摆了各种各样的摊位 朋友：你打算报哪一个社团 你：我还在看 街舞社好像挺有意思
a variety of.example: Friend: Why is the school field so crowded today? You: It's club recruitment, there are a variety of booths set up. Friend: Which club are you planning to sign up for? You: I'm still looking, the hip-hop club seems fun.

a waste of time.context: 朋友拉你去看一部评价很差的电影，你看了半小时就觉得这完全是浪费时间。
a waste of time.translation: 朋友：今晚一起去看那部新片吧 你：我上周看过了 真的是浪费时间 朋友：不是说特效做得不错吗 你：特效再好看 剧情太烂了不值得
a waste of time.example: Friend: Let's go see that new movie tonight together. You: I saw it last week, it was a real waste of time. Friend: Didn't people say the special effects were great? You: Even with good effects, the plot was so bad it wasn't worth it.

a while.context: 朋友下班路过你家楼下，问要不要上来坐一会儿喝杯茶。
a while.translation: 朋友：我刚下班路过你家楼下 你：那你上来坐一会儿吧 喝杯茶 朋友：方便吗 会不会打扰你 你：不会 我正好也想歇一歇
a while.example: Friend: I just got off work and passed by your building. You: Come up and stay for a while, let's have some tea. Friend: Is it okay, will I be bothering you? You: Not at all, I was actually looking for a break too.

about to.context: 电话响了你正要出门去接，朋友说你别动他去开门，用 be about to 表示正要。
about to.translation: 朋友：门铃响了 你去开一下门 你：我正要出去倒垃圾呢 你去开吧 朋友：那我先把垃圾也顺手带下去 你：行 谢谢你啦
about to.example: Friend: The doorbell is ringing, can you go open the door? You: I was just about to take the trash out, could you get it? Friend: Then I'll carry the trash down on my way out too. You: Great, thanks a lot for that.

according to.context: 朋友问你天气预报说明天会不会下雨，你说根据最新预报下午有阵雨。
according to.translation: 朋友：明天我们去爬山合适吗 你：根据天气预报 下午可能有阵雨 朋友：那带把伞备用吧 你：好的 我早上先看下雷达图再出门
according to.example: Friend: Is it a good day for us to go hiking tomorrow? You: According to the weather report, there may be showers in the afternoon. Friend: Then let's bring an umbrella just in case. You: Good idea, I'll check the radar before we head out.

across the world.context: 你在做旅游分享 PPT，朋友问你的旅行足迹有多广，你说去过世界各地。
across the world.translation: 朋友：你这几年都去过哪些地方玩 你：利用假期去了世界各地不少国家 朋友：哪个国家让你印象最深 你：应该是冰岛 极光太美了
across the world.example: Friend: Which places have you traveled to over these years? You: I've visited quite a few countries across the world on my holidays. Friend: Which country left the deepest impression on you? You: Probably Iceland, the Northern Lights were stunning.

act as.context: 小组作业里没人会做 PPT，朋友推选你来担任汇报人，用 act as 表示充当。
act as.translation: 朋友：这次小组汇报谁来讲 PPT 呀 你：我来担任主讲人吧 朋友：那我们几个帮你做数据和图表 你：好的 我负责把整段话串起来
act as.example: Friend: Who is going to present the slides for our group project? You: I'll act as the main presenter for this one. Friend: Then the rest of us will handle the data and charts. You: Great, I'll be responsible for putting the whole talk together.

add to.context: 朋友本来心情不错，你又告诉他周末要加班，这让他更加烦躁了。
add to.translation: 朋友：本来周末想好好休息一下 你：刚刚通知说周末要全员加班 朋友：这消息真是让我心情更差了 你：别太难过 加班结束请你喝奶茶
add to.example: Friend: I was actually looking forward to a good rest this weekend. You: They just announced we all have to work overtime this weekend. Friend: That news really adds to my bad mood. You: Don't be too upset, I'll buy you milk tea after the overtime.

add up.context: 你每个月攒一点零钱，几个月下来发现积少成多，已经够买一台新相机了。
add up.translation: 朋友：你这个月又往储蓄罐里放钱啦 你：是啊 一点点攒下来也累积了不少 朋友：攒这些钱打算买什么呢 你：想买一台心心念念的相机
add up.example: Friend: You're putting money into your piggy bank again this month? You: Yeah, small amounts really add up over time. Friend: What are you saving up to buy? You: I want to buy that camera I've been dreaming of.

afraid of.context: 朋友小时候被狗咬过，现在特别害怕狗，路过宠物店都绕着走。
afraid of.translation: 朋友：你为什么每次都绕着那条路走 你：我小时候被狗咬过 特别害怕狗 朋友：那以后我陪你一起走吧 你：谢谢你 有你在我安心多了
afraid of.example: Friend: Why do you always take a different route around here? You: I was bitten by a dog as a kid, so I'm really afraid of dogs. Friend: Then I'll walk with you from now on. You: Thanks a lot, I feel much safer with you around.

after a while.context: 你等朋友吃饭等了半天，过了一会儿他才急匆匆赶来。
after a while.translation: 朋友：抱歉我来晚了 路上特别堵 你：没关系 我刚等了一会儿 你就到了 朋友：你点菜了吗 我快饿死了 你：点了 菜马上就上来
after a while.example: Friend: Sorry I'm late, the traffic was terrible on the way. You: No worries, I only waited for a while before you showed up. Friend: Did you already order, I'm starving. You: Yeah, the dishes will be coming out any minute now.

after all.context: 朋友比赛输了心情低落，你安慰他毕竟对方是上届冠军，输了也正常。
after all.translation: 朋友：今天比赛输了 我好不甘心 你：毕竟对方是上届冠军 你已经打得很好了 朋友：可是我还是觉得自己没发挥好 你：下次再来 我们一起加练
after all.example: Friend: We lost the game today, I feel so frustrated. You: After all, they were the defending champions, you already played really well. Friend: But I still feel like I didn't play my best. You: Next time we'll come back, let's practice more together.

again and again.context: 朋友总忘记带钥匙被锁在门外，你提醒他别再反复丢三落四了。
again and again.translation: 朋友：我今天又忘带钥匙被锁外面了 你：你怎么老是这样 反复忘带钥匙 朋友：下次我一定在门口放一把备用的 你：那最好 不然又要等开锁师傅
again and again.example: Friend: I forgot my keys again and got locked out today. You: How do you keep doing this, forgetting your keys again and again. Friend: Next time I'll definitely keep a spare by the door. You: You'd better, otherwise you'll be waiting for a locksmith again.

agree on.context: 两个团队就方案细节争执很久，最终在价格条款上达成一致。
agree on.translation: 朋友：两边对这个合同谈得怎么样了 你：我们终于就付款时间达成一致了 朋友：其他条款还有分歧吗 你：主要是价格 还需要再商量一下
agree on.example: Friend: How are the contract talks going between the two sides? You: We finally agreed on the payment schedule just now. Friend: Are there still disagreements on other clauses? You: Mainly the price, we still need to discuss it further.

ahead of.context: 期中考试你的成绩排在全班前列，比其他同学领先了十分。
ahead of.translation: 朋友：这次期中你考了多少名呀 你：我排在前十 比上次提前了五名 朋友：你是怎么做到进步这么快的 你：每天多刷两套真题练出来的
ahead of.example: Friend: What rank did you get on the midterm exam? You: I made it into the top ten, ahead of my last result by five places. Friend: How did you improve so quickly? You: By working through two more practice tests every day.

aim at.context: 广告策划要瞄准年轻消费群体，朋友问你这次营销主打什么方向。
aim at.translation: 朋友：这次新产品的广告要主打谁 你：我们的目标是瞄准年轻上班族 朋友：那投放平台选短视频吗 你：对 他们刷手机时间最长
aim at.example: Friend: Who should our new product's advertising target focus on? You: We should aim at young office workers for this campaign. Friend: Then should we run the ads on short video platforms? You: Yes, that's where they spend the most time on their phones.

aim for.context: 你定下了期末备考目标，打算冲刺年级前二十，朋友问你有没有信心。
aim for.translation: 朋友：这学期你给自己定了什么目标 你：我力争期末冲进年级前二十 朋友：差距还有点大吧 你：每天多学两小时 慢慢追上去
