aim for.example: Friend: What goal have you set for yourself this semester? You: I'm aiming for the top twenty in the grade by finals. Friend: That's still quite a gap to close, isn't it? You: Studying two more hours each day will help me catch up gradually.

aim to.context: 社团活动的目的是帮助新生更快适应校园生活，朋友问你们招新打算做什么。
aim to.translation: 朋友：你们社团新学期打算组织什么活动 你：我们旨在帮助新生熟悉校园环境 朋友：具体会安排哪些内容呢 你：带他们参观图书馆和食堂
aim to.example: Friend: What activities does your club plan to organize this new semester? You: We aim to help new students get familiar with the campus. Friend: What kind of specific arrangements will there be? You: We'll show them around the library and the canteen.

air pollution.context: 学校组织环保讲座，老师说现在城市空气污染越来越严重，要大家重视。
air pollution.translation: 朋友：今天下午的环保讲座你去听了吗 你：去了 老师说空气污染影响很大 朋友：我们平时能做些什么呢 你：多坐地铁出行 少开车就好
air pollution.example: Friend: Did you go to the environmental lecture this afternoon? You: Yes, the teacher said air pollution is a serious problem. Friend: What can we do about it in our daily lives? You: Take the subway more often and drive our cars less.

all in all.context: 你做年终总结罗列了一堆优缺点，最后总的来说今年收获还是很大。
all in all.translation: 朋友：你今年的工作感觉怎么样 你：总的来说 收获还是挺多的 朋友：有没有什么遗憾的地方 你：就是有几个项目没坚持做下去
all in all.example: Friend: How do you feel about your work this whole year? You: All in all, I've actually gained quite a lot. Friend: Are there any things you regret? You: Just a few projects I didn't manage to stick with.

all of a sudden.context: 你正走在回家路上，突然天空开始打雷下雨，你没带伞被淋到了。
all of a sudden.translation: 朋友：你怎么浑身都淋湿了 你：刚才走着走着突然就下起大雨来了 朋友：你没带伞出门吗 你：出门的时候还是晴天 谁知道突然变天了
all of a sudden.example: Friend: Why are you completely soaked all over? You: I was walking home when all of a sudden it poured rain. Friend: Didn't you bring an umbrella with you? You: It was sunny when I left, who knew the weather would turn so fast.

all over.context: 你周末把整个屋子打扫了一遍，地板家具都擦得干干净净，朋友来串门吓了一跳。
all over.translation: 朋友：你今天在家大扫除了吗 你：是啊 把整个屋子都收拾了一遍 朋友：地板擦得能反光了 你：累死我了 终于收拾干净了
all over.example: Friend: Did you do a whole house cleaning today? You: Yeah, I cleaned the whole place from top to bottom. Friend: The floor is so clean it almost reflects light. You: I'm exhausted, it's finally all tidy now.

all sorts of.context: 自助餐台上摆着各种各样的菜，朋友端着盘子问你想吃什么。
all sorts of.translation: 朋友：这自助餐种类真多呀 你：是啊 各种各样的菜都有 朋友：你打算先拿哪一类 你：我先去拿海鲜区 那里最受欢迎
all sorts of.example: Friend: There is such a huge variety of dishes at this buffet. You: Yeah, all sorts of food are available here. Friend: Which section are you heading to first? You: I'll start with the seafood area, it's the most popular.

all the same.context: 朋友问你这家餐厅新菜好不好吃，你说虽然评价褒贬不一，但你还是挺喜欢的。
all the same.translation: 朋友：这家店新出的菜你尝了吗 你：尝了 虽然大家说法不一 我还是很喜欢 朋友：你点的是哪一道菜 你：那个酸甜口的排骨 特别下饭
all the same.example: Friend: Have you tried the new dishes at this restaurant? You: Yes, though reviews are mixed, I still like them a lot. Friend: Which dish did you order? You: That sweet and sour pork ribs, it goes great with rice.

all the way.context: 朋友骑车带你去郊外，一路风景很美，你说这趟路程风景真不错。
all the way.translation: 朋友：这条路骑起来感觉怎么样 你：风景太美了 一路都是稻田 朋友：我们骑了多久了呀 你：快两个小时了 前面就到水库了
all the way.example: Friend: How does this route feel to ride along? You: The scenery is beautiful, it's rice fields all the way. Friend: About how long have we been riding? You: Almost two hours now, the reservoir is just ahead.

along with.context: 你去外地出差，同事托你顺便带一份当地特产回来。
along with.translation: 朋友：你这次去上海出差 能帮我带点东西吗 你：可以 你想要什么 连同你的需求一起说 朋友：帮我带两盒那家老字号点心 你：没问题 我回来带给你
along with.example: Friend: On your business trip to Shanghai, can you bring me something? You: Sure, what would you like? Tell me along with what you need. Friend: Help me bring two boxes of that famous old pastry. You: No problem, I'll bring it back to you.

and so forth.context: 朋友问你周末集市都卖些什么，你说有手工艺品、小吃、旧书等等。
and so forth.translation: 朋友：周末那个创意集市都卖些什么呀 你：有手工艺品、小吃、旧书等等 朋友：有没有卖老唱片的摊位 你：有呀 你可以去淘一淘
and so forth.example: Friend: What kind of things are sold at that weekend craft market? You: Handicrafts, snacks, old books, and so forth. Friend: Are there any stalls selling old records? You: Yeah, you can go dig around for some finds.

apart from.context: 你除了周末要加班之外，其他时间都在准备考试，朋友问你最近忙什么。
apart from.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么约都约不出来 你：除了周末加班 其他时间都在备考 朋友：你在准备什么考试呀 你：雅思 下个月就要考了
apart from.example: Friend: Why can't I ever get you to come out lately? You: Apart from working overtime on weekends, I'm studying for exams. Friend: What exam are you preparing for? You: IELTS, I'm taking it next month.

are good at.context: 你在公司里最擅长做数据分析，同事有问题都来找你帮忙。
are good at.translation: 朋友：咱们部门谁最擅长做数据分析呀 你：我比较擅长这个 有问题可以找我 朋友：那这个报表你能帮我看看吗 你：放这儿吧 我下午帮你弄
are good at.example: Friend: Who in our department is best at data analysis? You: I'm quite good at it, you can come to me with questions. Friend: Can you help me take a look at this report then? You: Leave it here, I'll work on it this afternoon.

argue with.context: 朋友总跟你抱怨室友半夜打游戏吵，你问他有没有跟室友好好谈过。
argue with.translation: 朋友：我室友每天半夜打游戏吵死了 你：你有没有跟他好好谈过这件事 朋友：谈过好几次 他就是不改 你：那你跟宿管反映一下情况
argue with.example: Friend: My roommate plays games till midnight and it drives me crazy. You: Have you actually argued with him about it? Friend: We've talked several times, he just won't change. You: Then report the situation to the dorm manager.

arrive at.context: 你们小组讨论了很久，最终在预算问题上达成了一致意见。
arrive at.translation: 朋友：咱们这个项目预算谈得怎么样了 你：我们终于在预算金额上达成一致了 朋友：接下来就可以开始执行了吧 你：对 先把采购清单列出来
arrive at.example: Friend: How are the budget talks going for our project? You: We finally arrived at an agreement on the budget amount. Friend: Then we can start executing it now, right? You: Yeah, let's first list out the procurement items.

arrive in.context: 你出差飞了五个小时，终于抵达了广州，打了辆车去酒店。
arrive in.translation: 朋友：你落地广州了吗 那边天气怎么样 你：刚抵达机场 这边比老家暖和多了 朋友：你订好酒店了吗 你：订好了 打车二十分钟就到
arrive in.example: Friend: Have you landed in Guangzhou yet, how's the weather there? You: I just arrived at the airport, it's much warmer than back home. Friend: Have you booked your hotel yet? You: Yes, it's a twenty-minute taxi ride away.

as a result.context: 你昨晚复习到很晚，结果今天考试脑子发懵，没考好。
as a result.translation: 朋友：你今天考试发挥得怎么样 你：复习到太晚了 结果今天特别困 朋友：那成绩肯定受影响了吧 你：是啊 好几道题都没来得及细看
as a result.example: Friend: How did you do on today's exam? You: I studied too late last night, as a result I was really sleepy. Friend: That must have affected your score then. You: Yeah, I didn't have time to read several questions carefully.

as a result of.context: 你由于连续加班身体垮了，请了一周病假在家休息。
as a result of.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么脸色这么差 你：由于连续加班 我身体撑不住了 朋友：那你请假在家好好休息吧 你：已经请了一周假 慢慢恢复
as a result of.example: Friend: Why do you look so run down lately? You: As a result of working overtime nonstop, my body gave out. Friend: Then take some leave and rest at home. You: I've already taken a week off to recover slowly.

as far as.context: 朋友问你觉得这份工作如何，你说就薪水而言还不错，但压力大。
as far as.translation: 朋友：你新工作感觉怎么样呀 你：就薪水而言还不错 就是压力有点大 朋友：那加班多不多呢 你：偶尔加 整体还算能接受
as far as.example: Friend: How do you feel about your new job? You: As far as the salary goes, it's not bad, just a bit stressful. Friend: Do they make you work overtime often? You: Occasionally, overall it's manageable.

as far as possible.context: 朋友让你帮忙搬家，你说会尽可能早到，多帮他搬几趟。
as far as possible.translation: 朋友：明天搬家你能几点过来帮忙 你：我会尽可能早点到 多帮你搬几趟 朋友：那就太感谢你了 你：客气什么 中午我请你吃饭
as far as possible.example: Friend: What time can you come help me move tomorrow? You: I'll get there as early as possible and help you make several trips. Friend: I really appreciate that so much. You: Don't mention it, I'll treat you to lunch.

as for.context: 朋友问你周末打算去哪，你说至于去哪还没定，看天气再说。
as for.translation: 朋友：周末咱们一起出去逛逛呗 你：至于去哪 我还没拿定主意 朋友：要是晴天就去爬山 你：好 周六早上再看天气预报
as for.example: Friend: Let's go out together this weekend. You: As for where to go, I haven't decided yet. Friend: If it's sunny, let's go hiking. You: Good, we'll check the weather forecast Saturday morning.

as if.context: 朋友看着窗外发呆，你问他怎么了，他说感觉好像整个世界都安静了。
as if.translation: 朋友：你在窗边发什么呆呢 你：你听 安静得好像整座城市都睡着了 朋友：是啊 雨后的夜晚特别宁静 你：这种时候最适合听听音乐
as if.example: Friend: What are you spacing out by the window for? You: Listen, it's as if the whole city has fallen asleep. Friend: Yeah, nights after rain are especially peaceful. You: Moments like this are perfect for listening to music.

as long as.context: 朋友说你只要坚持每天练半小时，口语一定会有进步。
as long as.translation: 朋友：我口语总是提不上去 怎么办 你：只要你每天坚持练半小时 一定会进步 朋友：真的有这么神奇吗 你：当然 积累下去效果很明显
as long as.example: Friend: My spoken English just won't improve, what should I do? You: As long as you keep practicing for half an hour daily, you'll definitely improve. Friend: Is it really that effective? You: Of course, the results show over time.

as many as.context: 这次比赛报名的人数多达五百人，竞争非常激烈。
as many as.translation: 朋友：这次比赛报名的人多不多呀 你：多达五百人报名 竞争特别激烈 朋友：那获奖的概率岂不是很低 你：尽力就好 重在参与嘛
as many as.example: Friend: Are there many people signing up for this competition? You: As many as five hundred people signed up, the competition is fierce. Friend: Then the chance of winning must be really low. You: Just do our best, it's the taking part that counts.

as much as.context: 你为了这次比赛准备了整整一个月，投入了大量时间。
as much as.translation: 朋友：你为了这个比赛准备了多久 你：差不多准备了整整一个月时间 朋友：花了这么多精力 一定要好好比 你：希望能进决赛就满足了
as much as.example: Friend: How long have you been preparing for this competition? You: I've been preparing for as much as a whole month. Friend: You've put in so much effort, you must do well. You: I'd be happy just to make it to the finals.

as soon as.context: 你早上一到公司就开始处理邮件，忙到中午才停下来吃饭。
as soon as.translation: 朋友：你今天早上几点到公司的 你：我一到公司就开始处理邮件 忙到中午 朋友：中午一起下去吃个饭吧 你：好 我正好也饿了
as soon as.example: Friend: What time did you get to the office this morning? You: As soon as I arrived, I started answering emails and was busy till noon. Friend: Let's go grab lunch downstairs together. You: Great, I'm hungry too.

as soon as possible.context: 朋友发微信催你出门，说电影还有十分钟就开场了，让你尽快到。
as soon as possible.translation: 朋友：电影还有十分钟就开场了 你快点 你：我已经在路上了 会尽快赶到的 朋友：你别跑太急 注意安全 你：放心 我跑着过来 马上到
as soon as possible.example: Friend: The movie starts in ten minutes, hurry up. You: I'm already on my way, I'll get there as soon as possible. Friend: Don't run too fast, watch your safety. You: Don't worry, I'm jogging over, I'll be there soon.

as well.context: 朋友约你周末去露营，你说你也想去，正好有空。
as well.translation: 朋友：周末我们去郊外露营吧 你：好呀 我也正想出去透透气 朋友：那我们周六早上出发 你：行 我带帐篷和睡袋
as well.example: Friend: Let's go camping in the suburbs this weekend. You: Sounds good, I'd love to get some fresh air as well. Friend: Then let's set off Saturday morning. You: OK, I'll bring the tent and sleeping bags.

as well as.context: 你周末既要复习考试，还要帮妈妈做家务，时间排得很满。
as well as.translation: 朋友：周末你都安排了些什么事 你：除了复习考试 还要帮妈妈做家务 朋友：那你不累吗 你：习惯了 合理安排时间就行
as well as.example: Friend: What all did you arrange for the weekend? You: As well as reviewing for exams, I also help my mom with chores. Friend: Aren't you exhausted? You: I'm used to it, just arrange my time well.

ask for directions.context: 你到了一个陌生的街区迷路了，只好拦住一位路人问路。
ask for directions.translation: 朋友：你怎么站在路口愣着 你：我迷路了 正想找人问路 朋友：前面就有个保安 你去问他吧 你：好的 我问问地铁站怎么走
ask for directions.example: Friend: Why are you standing at the intersection looking lost? You: I got lost, I was just about to ask for directions. Friend: There's a security guard ahead, go ask him. You: OK, I'll ask how to get to the subway station.

at a time.context: 你一次只能吃一碗饭，朋友问你要不要再来一碗，你说一碗就够了。
at a time.translation: 朋友：你要不要再来一碗饭呀 你：不了 我一次只能吃一碗 朋友：那你慢慢吃 不够再添 你：好的 今天的菜真好吃
at a time.example: Friend: Would you like another bowl of rice? You: No thanks, I can only eat one bowl at a time. Friend: Then take your time, ask for more if you need. You: OK, today's dishes are really delicious.

at all.context: 朋友问你到底吃不吃辣，你说一点也不吃，完全接受不了辣味。
at all.translation: 朋友：你到底能不能吃辣呀 你：我一点辣都吃不了 真的不行 朋友：那我们下次去吃粤菜吧 你：好呀 清淡的我最喜欢
at all.example: Friend: Can you actually eat spicy food or not? You: I can't handle spicy food at all, really can't. Friend: Then let's go have Cantonese food next time. You: Great, I love light flavorful dishes.

at any time.context: 你做了自由职业者，时间很灵活，朋友随时都能找到你。
at any time.translation: 朋友：你现在做自由职业 时间自由吗 你：很自由 随时都能联系到我 朋友：那我们随时约咖啡都行 你：好呀 你提前说一声就好
at any time.example: Friend: Now that you're a freelancer, is your schedule flexible? You: Very flexible, you can reach me at any time. Friend: Then we can meet for coffee whenever. You: Great, just let me know ahead.

at first.context: 你刚学做菜时经常把菜炒糊，朋友问你现在厨艺进步了吗。
at first.translation: 朋友：你现在做饭手艺进步了吗 你：一开始总是把菜炒糊 现在好多了 朋友：你最拿手的菜是什么呀 你：番茄炒蛋 每次都成功
at first.example: Friend: Has your cooking improved by now? You: At first I always burned the dishes, now it's much better. Friend: What's your signature dish? You: Tomato and egg stir-fry, it always turns out well.

at present.context: 你现在还在找工作，朋友问你目前有没有拿到 offer。
at present.translation: 朋友：你最近工作找得怎么样了 你：目前还在面试几家公司 还没定下来 朋友：那经济上还撑得住吗 你：还好 之前有一点积蓄
at present.example: Friend: How is your job search going lately? You: At present I'm still interviewing at a few companies, nothing decided. Friend: Are you doing okay financially? You: It's fine, I have some savings from before.

at the back of.context: 你把自行车停在楼后面，朋友问你车停哪儿了，你指给他看。
at the back of.translation: 朋友：你的自行车停在哪儿了 你：就停在这栋楼后面 你跟着我来 朋友：后面那片不太好找吧 你：没事 我带你过去 一分钟就到
at the back of.example: Friend: Where did you park your bike? You: It's parked at the back of the building, follow me. Friend: The back area might be hard to find. You: Don't worry, I'll lead you there, a minute's walk.

at the beginning of.context: 每学期初学校都会组织新生参观校园，你作为志愿者带队。
at the beginning of.translation: 朋友：开学第一周你都在忙什么呀 你：在开学初带新生参观校园 朋友：你负责哪个部分呢 你：带他们看教学楼和操场
at the beginning of.example: Friend: What have you been busy with during the first week of school? You: At the beginning of the term, I show new students around campus. Friend: Which part are you responsible for? You: I take them to see the teaching buildings and playground.

at the bottom of.context: 你登山时腿软差点摔倒，朋友一把拉住你，说小心山脚下都是石头。
at the bottom of.translation: 朋友：你没事吧 刚才吓我一跳 你：我脚滑了一下 差点摔到山脚下 朋友：走路看着点路 别东张西望 你：好 我抓紧你的胳膊走
at the bottom of.example: Friend: Are you okay? You just scared me. You: My foot slipped, I almost fell to the bottom of the hill. Friend: Watch your step, don't look around everywhere. You: OK, I'll hold your arm as we walk.

at the end.context: 你排队排了好久终于轮到你了，结果店员说今天的号发完了。
at the end.translation: 朋友：你排了这么久买到票了吗 你：排到最后 他们说今天的票卖光了 朋友：那白排这么久了 你：是啊 明天再来赶早吧
at the end.example: Friend: Did you get the ticket after waiting so long in line? You: At the end of the line, they said today's tickets were sold out. Friend: Then you waited in vain for so long. You: Yeah, I'll come back early tomorrow.

at the end of.context: 电影结束的时候已经十一点了，你和朋友匆匆赶末班车回家。
at the end of.translation: 朋友：电影散场了 我们快点走 你：到十一点了 我们得赶在结束前出去 朋友：末班车是几点呀 你：十一点半 赶紧走应该赶得上
at the end of.example: Friend: The movie is over, let's hurry. You: It's already eleven, we have to leave before the end of the line. Friend: What time is the last bus? You: Eleven thirty, if we rush we should make it.

at the moment.context: 朋友打电话问你在干嘛，你说你此刻正在超市买晚饭的菜。
at the moment.translation: 朋友：你这会儿在做什么呢 你：我此刻正在超市挑晚上做饭的菜 朋友：那你打算做什么菜呀 你：做个红烧排骨 再炒个青菜
at the moment.example: Friend: What are you doing right now? You: At the moment I'm at the supermarket picking dinner ingredients. Friend: What dish are you planning to cook? You: Braised pork ribs, plus stir-fried greens.

at the same time.context: 朋友一边给你发微信一边吃饭，结果手机掉进了汤碗里。
at the same time.translation: 朋友：你怎么吃饭的时候还看手机 你：我一边回消息 一边吃饭 朋友：小心别把手机掉进碗里 你：哎呀 真的掉进去了
at the same time.example: Friend: Why are you looking at your phone while eating? You: I'm replying to messages while eating at the same time. Friend: Be careful not to drop your phone in the bowl. You: Oh no, it actually fell in.

at the time.context: 你回忆高中那时候，大家每天都在刷题备考，日子过得很单纯。
at the time.translation: 朋友：你最怀念人生哪一段时光 你：我最怀念高中那时候 天天刷题 朋友：那时候不是很累吗 你：累是累 但是很充实
at the time.example: Friend: Which period of your life do you miss the most? You: At the time back in high school, we drilled problems every day. Friend: Wasn't that really exhausting? You: It was tiring, but also very fulfilling.

at the top of.context: 你公司里部门总监坐在楼层最里面的办公室，级别最高。
at the top of.translation: 朋友：你们公司谁的办公室位置最好 你：总监坐在楼层最里面 级别最高 朋友：那他平时好接触吗 你：挺随和的 经常下来和大家聊天
at the top of.example: Friend: Who has the best office spot at your company? You: The director sits at the top of the floor, with the highest rank. Friend: Is he approachable on a daily basis? You: Pretty easygoing, he comes down to chat often.

at times.context: 你朋友偶尔会周末约你打球，但大部分时间他都在加班。
at times.translation: 朋友：你周末常约小王打球吗 你：他偶尔会约我 但大部分时间在加班 朋友：那你们多久打一次 你：大概一个月打一次吧
at times.example: Friend: Do you often invite Xiao Wang to play ball on weekends? You: At times he invites me, but most of the time he's working overtime. Friend: Then how often do you play? You: About once a month, I guess.

at work.context: 朋友打电话来约你周末露营，你说你现在正在上班不方便聊天。
at work.translation: 朋友：周末我们去露营怎么样 你：我现在在工作中 不方便多聊 朋友：那你下班再回我消息吧 你：好的 下班我马上回复你
at work.example: Friend: How about going camping this weekend? You: I'm at work right now, it's not a good time to talk. Friend: Then message me back after you get off work. You: OK, I'll reply as soon as I'm off.

back then.context: 你翻出高中时的旧校服，朋友问你那是什么年代买的。
back then.translation: 朋友：你翻出这件旧衣服干什么 你：这是高中时的校服 那时候大家都穿 朋友：现在看款式有点土了 你：是啊 那时候就流行这个
back then.example: Friend: Why are you digging out that old piece of clothing? You: This was my school uniform back then, everyone wore it. Friend: The style looks a bit dated now. You: Yeah, that was the trend back in those days.

back up.context: 你说的话需要有数据来支撑，不然老板不会相信你的报告。
back up.translation: 朋友：老板问我这个结论怎么得出的 你：你需要用数据来支撑你的观点 朋友：那我去把报表拉出来 你：好 把数字摆出来最有说服力
back up.example: Friend: The boss asked how I came to that conclusion. You: You need data to back up your point. Friend: Then I'll go pull up the reports. You: Good, showing the numbers is the most convincing.

base on.context: 你写论文时所有论点都要依据文献，不能凭空捏造。
base on.translation: 朋友：你这篇论文的结论是怎么得出的 你：所有论点都依据已发表的文献 朋友：那引用格式注意规范了吗 你：注意了 都是按标准格式写的
base on.example: Friend: How did you come to the conclusions in this paper? You: All the arguments are based on published literature. Friend: Did you follow the citation format properly? You: Yes, I followed the standard format throughout.

be about to.context: 你正准备出门上班，朋友突然打电话来说急事找你。
be about to.translation: 朋友：喂 你现在方便说话吗 你：我正准备出门上班 正要走呢 朋友：那你路上小心 中午再聊 你：好的 我先挂了
be about to.example: Friend: Hello, is it a good time to talk now? You: I'm just about to head out for work right now. Friend: Then drive safe, let's chat at noon. You: OK, I'll hang up now.

be ashamed of.context: 你不小心把朋友的杯子打碎了，觉得很不好意思，连声道歉。
be ashamed of.translation: 朋友：哎呀 你把我最喜欢的杯子打碎了 你：真对不起 我不小心碰掉了 我再赔你一个吧 朋友：算了 也不是什么大杯子 你：不行 我必须赔你一个新的
be ashamed of.example: Friend: Oh no, you broke my favorite cup. You: I'm so sorry, I knocked it over by accident, let me buy you a new one. Friend: Forget it, it wasn't an expensive cup. You: No way, I must replace it with a new one.

be aware of.context: 朋友提醒你明天有个重要会议，你说你已经意识到了，会准时参加。
be aware of.translation: 朋友：明天上午十点那个会你别忘了 你：我知道 我已经意识到它很重要 朋友：材料你都准备好了吗 你：准备好了 今晚再检查一遍
be aware of.example: Friend: Don't forget the meeting at ten tomorrow morning. You: I know, I'm well aware of how important it is. Friend: Do you have the materials ready? You: Ready, I'll double-check tonight.

be based on.context: 这部电影是根据真实事件改编的，朋友问你剧情是不是真的。
be based on.translation: 朋友：这部电影剧情看起来好真实 你：它是根据真实事件改编的 朋友：那结局也是真的吗 你：大体一样 细节上有一些艺术加工
be based on.example: Friend: The plot of this movie looks so realistic. You: It is based on a true story. Friend: Is the ending also true to life? You: Mostly the same, with some artistic touches in details.

be curious about.context: 朋友对宇宙星空特别感兴趣，总问一些关于黑洞的问题。
be curious about.translation: 朋友：黑洞到底是什么呀 你：你怎么对这些天文问题这么好奇 朋友：就是觉得宇宙特别神奇 你：那周末一起去天文馆看看
be curious about.example: Friend: What exactly is a black hole? You: Why are you so curious about all these astronomy questions? Friend: I just think the universe is so fascinating. You: Then let's go to the planetarium together this weekend.

be excited about.context: 朋友明天要去海边度假，兴奋得一晚上没睡着。
be excited about.translation: 朋友：我明天就要去海边度假了 你：看得出来你特别兴奋呀 朋友：我期待了整整一年了 你：好好玩 记得多拍点照片
be excited about.example: Friend: I'm going to the beach tomorrow for vacation. You: You seem really excited about it. Friend: I've been looking forward to this for a whole year. You: Have a great time, remember to take lots of photos.

be familiar with.context: 你在这个城市住了五年，对每条大街小巷都很熟悉。
be familiar with.translation: 朋友：这附近哪家馆子最好吃呀 你：我在这儿住了五年 对这里很熟悉 朋友：那你推荐一家呗 你：巷子里那家面馆特别地道
be familiar with.example: Friend: Which restaurant around here tastes the best? You: I've lived here for five years, I'm very familiar with this area. Friend: Then recommend one to me. You: That noodle shop in the alley is really authentic.

be filled with.context: 节日的广场上挤满了人，到处都是欢声笑语，充满了节日气氛。
be filled with.translation: 朋友：今天广场上人真多呀 你：到处都是人 整个广场充满了节日气氛 朋友：那边在表演舞龙 我们去看看 你：好 挤过去瞧一瞧
be filled with.example: Friend: There are so many people in the square today. You: The whole place is filled with festive atmosphere. Friend: They're doing a dragon dance over there, let's go see. You: OK, let's push through and take a look.

be full of.context: 你过生日的时候收到了很多礼物，心里全是感动和幸福。
be full of.translation: 朋友：生日快乐 这是给你的礼物 你：谢谢你 我心里全是感动和幸福 朋友：快拆开看看喜不喜欢 你：好 是我一直想要的那本书
be full of.example: Friend: Happy birthday, this gift is for you. You: Thank you, my heart is full of gratitude and happiness. Friend: Open it up and see if you like it. You: OK, it's the book I've always wanted.

be good for.context: 朋友说你每天喝牛奶对身体好，你说牛奶确实对骨骼有益。
be good for.translation: 朋友：你每天都喝牛奶吗 你：对啊 牛奶对骨骼健康很有益处 朋友：那你喝全脂还是脱脂的 你：我喝全脂的 口感更好
be good for.example: Friend: Do you drink milk every day? You: Yeah, milk is really good for bone health. Friend: Do you drink whole milk or skimmed? You: I drink whole milk, it tastes better.

be honest.context: 朋友问你对这件事真实的看法，你说老实讲你觉得不太靠谱。
be honest.translation: 朋友：你觉得他说的这个项目靠谱吗 你：老实讲 我觉得不太靠谱 朋友：为什么这么说呢 你：收益高得反常 小心是骗局
be honest.example: Friend: Do you think the project he mentioned is reliable? You: To be honest, I don't think it's very reliable. Friend: Why do you say that? You: The returns are suspiciously high, watch out for a scam.

be known as.context: 北京被称为帝都，朋友问你为什么大家都这么叫它。
be known as.translation: 朋友：大家为什么都叫北京为帝都 你：因为它曾经是好几个朝代的首都 朋友：那西安呢 你：西安也是古都 历史更悠久
be known as.example: Friend: Why do people call Beijing the Imperial Capital? You: Because it was the capital of several dynasties. Friend: What about Xi'an then? You: Xi'an is also an ancient capital, with even longer history.

be known for.context: 杭州以西湖美景闻名天下，朋友问你杭州最出名的是什么。
be known for.translation: 朋友：杭州最有名的景点是哪个呀 你：杭州以西湖的美景而闻名 朋友：那春天去最合适吧 你：对 春天桃花开的时候最美
be known for.example: Friend: What is the most famous spot in Hangzhou? You: Hangzhou is known for the beauty of West Lake. Friend: Then spring must be the best time to go. You: Yeah, it's most beautiful when the peach blossoms bloom.

be likely to.context: 朋友问你明天会不会下雨，你说根据天气预报很可能是晴天。
be likely to.translation: 朋友：明天会不会下雨呀 我们还能去野餐吗 你：根据预报 明天很可能是晴天 朋友：那太好了 我们早上出发 你：好 我带野餐垫和水果
be likely to.example: Friend: Will it rain tomorrow, can we still go on a picnic? You: According to the forecast, it's likely to be sunny tomorrow. Friend: That's great, let's head out in the morning. You: OK, I'll bring the picnic mat and fruit.

be responsible for.context: 团队项目出了问题，经理主动承担责任，说是自己没安排好。
be responsible for.translation: 朋友：这次项目出错 经理怎么说 你：他主动承担责任 说自己没安排好 朋友：他没怪下面的人吗 你：没有 他说要从自己找原因
be responsible for.example: Friend: What did the manager say about the project mistake? You: He took responsibility, saying he didn't arrange things well. Friend: Did he blame the people below? You: No, he said we should look for reasons in ourselves.

be similar to.context: 你写的文章和上次那篇风格很像，朋友问你是不是同一个作者。
be similar to.translation: 朋友：你写的这篇和上次那篇好像啊 你：这两篇风格确实很相似 朋友：都是你一个人写的吗 你：对 我都喜欢用这种叙事方式
be similar to.example: Friend: The piece you wrote is so similar to last one. You: The style of these two is indeed very similar. Friend: Did you write both of them yourself? You: Yes, I like using this narrative style.

be used to.context: 你刚到北方上学时不习惯吃面食，现在已经爱吃面条了。
be used to.translation: 朋友：你现在吃得惯北方面食了吗 你：刚来的时候不习惯 现在已经习惯了 朋友：你最爱吃哪一种面 你：油泼面 香得很
be used to.example: Friend: Are you used to northern-style noodles now? You: I wasn't used to it when I first arrived, now I am. Friend: Which noodle dish do you like most? You: Youpo noodles, they're incredibly flavorful.

because of.context: 你上班迟到是因为路上堵车，朋友问你怎么晚到了半小时。
because of.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么晚到了半小时 你：因为路上堵车 被堵了好久 朋友：那你明天提早出门吧 你：好 我提前半小时出发
because of.example: Friend: Why are you half an hour late today? You: Because of the traffic jam on the way, I was stuck forever. Friend: Then leave earlier tomorrow. You: OK, I'll set out half an hour earlier.

before long.context: 你刚说想学吉他，朋友说不久以后你就能弹唱了。
before long.translation: 朋友：我最近想学吉他 难不难呀 你：不难 不久以后你就能自弹自唱了 朋友：真的吗 我先买把琴试试 你：好 从基础和弦练起
before long.example: Friend: I want to learn guitar recently, is it hard? You: Not at all, before long you'll be singing and playing. Friend: Really, I'll buy a guitar and try it. You: Good, start with the basic chords.

begin by.context: 老师上课先从介绍课程大纲开始，再进入正式内容。
begin by.translation: 朋友：第一节课老师都讲了些什么 你：他先介绍课程大纲 再开始讲第一章 朋友：作业多不多呀 你：每周有一次小作业 不算多
begin by.example: Friend: What did the teacher cover in the first class? You: He began by introducing the syllabus, then started chapter one. Friend: Is there a lot of homework? You: One small assignment per week, not too much.

begin with.context: 你介绍自己喜欢的电影时，先从最喜欢的一部开始讲起。
begin with.translation: 朋友：给我推荐几部好电影呗 你：我先从我最喜欢的一部开始说 朋友：是哪一部呀 你：《肖申克的救赎》 你看过吗
begin with.example: Friend: Recommend some good movies to me. You: I'll begin with my favorite one first. Friend: Which one is it? You: The Shawshank Redemption, have you seen it?

believe in.context: 你朋友是个很有信仰的人，始终相信努力终会有回报。
believe in.translation: 朋友：你为什么每天这么拼呀 你：我相信努力终会有回报 朋友：可是有时候付出也没结果 你：坚持下去 总会被看到的
believe in.example: Friend: Why do you work so hard every day? You: I believe in the idea that hard work pays off. Friend: But sometimes effort doesn't lead to results. You: Keep going, it'll be seen eventually.

belong to.context: 你在书店看到一本封面很眼熟的书，朋友问这书是谁的。
belong to.translation: 朋友：这本放在你桌上的书是谁的 你：它属于我 是我上周买的 朋友：好看吗 讲什么内容 你：讲旅行的 特别治愈
belong to.example: Friend: Whose is this book on your desk? You: It belongs to me, I bought it last week. Friend: Is it good, what's it about? You: It's about travel, really healing to read.

benefit from.context: 你坚持每周健身三次，从中收获了好身材和好心情。
benefit from.translation: 朋友：你最近状态怎么这么好 你：我从健身中收获了很多 朋友：你每周练几次呀 你：大概三次 每次一小时
benefit from.example: Friend: Why are you in such great shape lately? You: I've really benefited from working out. Friend: How many times a week do you train? You: About three times, an hour each session.

blame for.context: 项目失败大家互相指责，老板说不能把错都怪在新人头上。
blame for.translation: 朋友：项目搞砸了 大家都在互相埋怨 你：不能把错都怪在新人身上 朋友：那问题到底出在哪呢 你：是流程设计有漏洞
blame for.example: Friend: The project failed, everyone's blaming each other. You: We can't blame the new hires for everything. Friend: Then where did the problem actually lie? You: It was a flaw in the process design.

blow up.context: 朋友把一个小感冒夸张成大病，你说他太小题大做了。
blow up.translation: 朋友：我觉得我得重症了 头特别晕 你：你就是个小感冒 别把它夸大了 朋友：可是真的很难受呀 你：多喝热水睡一觉就好
blow up.example: Friend: I think I've got something serious, my head is spinning. You: It's just a small cold, don't blow it out of proportion. Friend: But I really feel terrible. You: Drink more hot water and sleep it off.

body language.context: 面试时除了说话内容，面试官也会观察你的肢体语言。
body language.translation: 朋友：面试的时候除了说什么 还要注意什么 你：面试官也会看你的肢体语言 朋友：那我应该注意哪些呢 你：坐姿端正 眼神自然交流
body language.example: Friend: Besides what I say, what else should I watch in an interview? You: The interviewer also watches your body language. Friend: What should I pay attention to? You: Sit up straight, make natural eye contact.

bored with.context: 朋友天天加班到深夜，对这种枯燥的工作早就厌烦了。
bored with.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么一提到上班就叹气 你：我对这份枯燥的工作早就厌倦了 朋友：那你打算换工作吗 你：在看机会 有合适的就跳
bored with.example: Friend: Why do you sigh whenever work comes up lately? You: I'm bored with this tedious job long ago. Friend: Are you planning to change jobs then? You: I'm looking around, I'll jump if I find something good.

break down.context: 你的电脑突然死机了，正在写的文档全部丢失。
break down.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么突然拍桌子 你：电脑突然死机了 写的文档全没了 朋友：你没保存吗 你：忘了 我以后一定边写边存
break down.example: Friend: Why did you just slam the desk? You: My computer broke down and the document I was writing is gone. Friend: Didn't you save it? You: I forgot, from now on I'll save as I go.

break into.context: 小偷趁大家不注意闯进了一家便利店，监控拍下了全过程。
break into.translation: 朋友：昨晚咱们小区便利店怎么了 你：有小偷半夜闯入了那家便利店 朋友：抓到人了吗 你：监控都拍到了 警察很快就能破案
break into.example: Friend: What happened at the convenience store in our complex last night? You: A thief broke into the store in the middle of the night. Friend: Did they catch the person? You: The cameras recorded everything, the police will solve it soon.

break up.context: 两个人的感情出现了裂痕，最后和平分手了。
break up.translation: 朋友：你和女朋友最近怎么不一起吃饭了 你：我们感情出了问题 已经和平分手了 朋友：真的吗 我一点都不知道 你：没关系 好聚好散吧
break up.example: Friend: Why don't you eat with your girlfriend lately? You: Our relationship broke up, we parted peacefully. Friend: Really, I had no idea at all. You: It's okay, we parted on good terms.

breathe in.context: 瑜伽老师让你深吸一口气，再慢慢吐出来，感受身体放松。
breathe in.translation: 朋友：上瑜伽课都做些什么动作呀 你：老师让我们先深吸一口气 再慢慢呼出 朋友：这种呼吸法有用吗 你：特别解压 练完浑身轻松
breathe in.example: Friend: What kind of moves do you do in yoga class? You: The teacher tells us to breathe in deeply first, then exhale slowly. Friend: Does this breathing method actually work? You: It's very calming, I feel all loose after.

bring back.context: 听到老歌，朋友说这旋律勾起了他中学时代的回忆。
bring back.translation: 朋友：这首歌一响起 我就想起中学时代 你：是呀 它总能勾起很多回忆 朋友：那时候我们一起上下学 你：对 一晃都十年了
bring back.example: Friend: The moment this song plays, I think of my middle school days. You: Yeah, it always brings back so many memories. Friend: Back then we went to and from school together. You: Right, ten years have flown by.

bring in.context: 新店开业第一个月就赚了不少钱，朋友问你是怎么做到的。
bring in.translation: 朋友：你新店开业这一个月赚了不少吧 你：生意不错 第一个月就有了不错的收入 朋友：你是怎么招揽客人的 你：靠朋友圈发广告引流
bring in.example: Friend: Your new shop must have made a lot in its first month. You: Business is good, the first month brought in decent income. Friend: How did you attract customers? You: Promoting on my Moments to drive traffic.

bring together.context: 老同学毕业十年聚会，大家从各地赶来相聚在一起。
bring together.translation: 朋友：毕业十年聚会你去不去 你：当然去 大家从各地聚在一起多难得 朋友：你最想见哪个老同学 你：最想见大学时的室友
bring together.example: Friend: Are you going to the ten-year reunion? You: Of course, it's rare to get everyone together from all over. Friend: Which old classmate do you most want to see? You: Most of all my college roommate.

build up.context: 你每天背十个单词，时间长了词汇量就慢慢积累起来了。
build up.translation: 朋友：你怎么词汇量这么大 你：我每天坚持背单词 慢慢积累起来的 朋友：你背了多久了呀 你：快两年了 一天都没断过
build up.example: Friend: How come your vocabulary is so large? You: I keep memorizing words daily, I've built it up over time. Friend: How long have you been at it? You: Almost two years, not a single day missed.

bump into.context: 你周末在超市偶然碰到了多年未见的老同学，两个人都很惊喜。
bump into.translation: 朋友：周末在超市碰到谁了 你：我偶然碰到了多年未见的老同学 朋友：真的吗 他现在在做什么 你：他回老家当老师了
bump into.example: Friend: Who did you run into at the supermarket on the weekend? You: I bumped into an old classmate I hadn't seen for years. Friend: Really, what is he doing now? You: He went back to his hometown to teach.

burn down.context: 村里老房子在一场大火中被烧毁了，幸好没人受伤。
burn down.translation: 朋友：老家那间老房子怎么没了 你：它在一场大火中被烧掉了 朋友：有没有人受伤呀 你：幸好大家都跑出来了 就是房子没了
burn down.example: Friend: What happened to the old house in your hometown? You: It burned down in a big fire. Friend: Was anyone hurt? You: Luckily everyone got out, just the house is gone.

business trip.context: 你下周要去上海出差，朋友问你行程安排好了没有。
business trip.translation: 朋友：你下周去上海出差 机票订了吗 你：订好了 周三早上飞过去 朋友：那边有同事接应你吗 你：有 客户那边会来接我
business trip.example: Friend: Are you flying to Shanghai on business next week, ticket booked? You: Booked, flying out Wednesday morning. Friend: Is there a colleague to meet you there? You: Yeah, the client will pick me up.

by accident.context: 你不小心把朋友的相机摔到地上，赶紧道歉说是不小心的。
by accident.translation: 朋友：哎呀 我的相机怎么掉地上了 你：真对不起 我不是故意碰掉的 朋友：开机还能正常用吗 你：应该没事 我帮你检查一下
by accident.example: Friend: Oh no, why is my camera on the floor? You: I'm so sorry, I knocked it over by accident. Friend: Does it still turn on normally? You: Should be fine, let me check it for you.

by hand.context: 奶奶织毛衣不用看图纸，全靠手工一针一线织出来。
by hand.translation: 朋友：奶奶这件毛衣织得真好 你：这是奶奶亲手一针一线织的 朋友：比商店买的还有温度 你：是呀 手工做的最暖心
by hand.example: Friend: Grandma knitted this sweater so beautifully. You: Grandma knitted this by hand stitch by stitch. Friend: It's even warmer than ones from the store. You: Yeah, handmade things are the heart-warming ones.

by now.context: 你朋友迟到了半小时，按理说他早该到了，电话也打不通。
by now.translation: 朋友：他怎么还没来 都半小时了 你：按理说他现在应该早就到了 朋友：电话也打不通 真让人着急 你：再等五分钟看看
by now.example: Friend: Why isn't he here yet, it's been half an hour. You: By now he should have arrived long ago. Friend: His phone isn't even going through, this is worrying. You: Let's wait another five minutes.

by the end of.context: 到学期末的时候，所有课程都要结课考试。
by the end of.translation: 朋友：期末复习从什么时候开始 你：到学期末 所有课程都要结课考试 朋友：那复习压力很大吧 你：是啊 六门课挤在一起考
by the end of.example: Friend: When do we start reviewing for finals? You: By the end of the term, all courses have closing exams. Friend: Then the review pressure must be huge. You: Yeah, six exams all packed together.

by the time.context: 等你赶到车站的时候，公交车已经开走了。
by the time.translation: 朋友：你怎么错过了那趟车呀 你：等我赶到车站 车已经开走了 朋友：那只能等下一班了 你：下一班要二十分钟 急死人了
by the time.example: Friend: How did you miss that bus? You: By the time I got to the stop, the bus had already left. Friend: Then we'll just have to wait for the next one. You: The next one is twenty minutes away, so frustrating.

by the way.context: 朋友聊完正事，突然想起一件无关紧要的事，顺便问你一句。
by the way.translation: 朋友：对了 顺便问一下 周末你有空吗 你：周末怎么了 你说 朋友：我想请你帮我搬个家 你：行 几点到你家
by the way.example: Friend: Oh, by the way, are you free this weekend? You: What's up, tell me. Friend: I want to ask you to help me move. You: OK, what time should I get to your place?

call for.context: 这个紧急情况需要马上开会讨论，不能再拖了。
call for.translation: 朋友：出了点紧急状况 需要马上处理 你：这件事需要立刻开会讨论解决方案 朋友：那我现在通知所有人 你：好 十五分钟后会议室见
call for.example: Friend: There's an emergency situation that needs handling now. You: This situation calls for an immediate meeting to discuss solutions. Friend: Then I'll notify everyone right now. You: Good, see you in the conference room in fifteen minutes.

call off.context: 天气预报说有暴雨，社区通知把户外比赛取消掉。
call off.translation: 朋友：今天下午的球赛还踢不踢了 你：因为天气不好 比赛被取消了 朋友：那改到什么时候呢 你：等通知 看明天天气再说
call off.example: Friend: Are we still playing this afternoon's match? You: Because of the bad weather, the game has been called off. Friend: When is it rescheduled to? You: Wait for the notice, depends on tomorrow's weather.

call on.context: 周末你去拜访多年不见的小学老师，带了点水果上门。
call on.translation: 朋友：周末你打算去哪儿呀 你：我想去拜访一下小学老师 好久没见了 朋友：要不要带点礼物过去 你：买了点水果和茶叶 表表心意
call on.example: Friend: Where are you planning to go this weekend? You: I want to call on my primary school teacher, it's been ages. Friend: Should you bring some gifts? You: I bought some fruit and tea as a small gesture.

calm down.context: 朋友比赛输了蹲在路边哭，你坐到他旁边，让他先冷静下来。
calm down.translation: 朋友：我这次比赛又输了 好没用 你：先冷静下来 一次输赢不算什么 朋友：可是我准备了那么久 你：下次再来 我们继续练
calm down.example: Friend: I lost the competition again, I'm so useless. You: Calm down first, one loss means nothing. Friend: But I prepared for it for so long. You: Next time we'll come back, keep practicing.

can't stand.context: 你室友总爱在深夜外放音乐，你实在受不了，让他戴耳机。
can't stand.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总说室友 你：他深夜还外放音乐 我实在受不了 朋友：那你跟他说过了吗 你：说过好几次 他就是不改
can't stand.example: Friend: Why are you always talking about your roommate lately? You: He blares music late at night, I can't stand it. Friend: Have you talked to him about it? You: Several times, he just won't change.

care about.context: 你朋友嘴上说不在乎成绩，其实他特别在意大家怎么看他。
care about.translation: 朋友：他考砸了还说无所谓 你：他其实心里特别在意 只是嘴上不说 朋友：那我们安慰安慰他吧 你：好 别提成绩 约他出去散心
care about.example: Friend: He failed the exam and says it doesn't matter. You: He actually cares a lot, he just doesn't show it. Friend: Then let's go comfort him. You: OK, don't mention grades, ask him out to unwind.

care for.context: 你生病的时候朋友主动来照顾你，给你熬粥吃药。
care for.translation: 朋友：你发烧了 我来照顾你吧 你：谢谢你 还特意过来 朋友：我给你熬点粥 再量个体温 你：麻烦你了 我自己躺会儿就好
care for.example: Friend: You have a fever, let me take care of you. You: Thank you for going out of your way to come. Friend: I'll make some porridge and take your temperature. You: Sorry to trouble you, I can just lie down a bit.

carry on.context: 老板让你不要中断手头的项目，继续按原计划推进。
carry on.translation: 朋友：老板找你说什么了呀 你：让我不要停 继续按原计划做 朋友：那就是不用改方向了 你：对 接着把这个项目做完
carry on.example: Friend: What did the boss want with you? You: He told me not to stop, just carry on with the original plan. Friend: So we don't need to change direction. You: Right, just finish this project.

carry out.context: 实验室团队正在进行一项新课题的研究，已经做了半年。
carry out.translation: 朋友：你们实验室最近在忙什么 你：我们在做一项新课题的研究 朋友：进展顺利吗 你：还行 已经发了一篇小论文
carry out.example: Friend: What has your lab been busy with lately? You: We're carrying out research on a new topic. Friend: Is it going smoothly? You: Not bad, we've already published a small paper.

catch up.context: 你请假一周出去玩，回来发现工作积压了一大堆，要赶紧赶上进度。
catch up.translation: 朋友：你这一周没来 工作堆了不少吧 你：我得赶紧补上 才能跟上进度 朋友：要不要我帮你分担一点 你：好 先把这几份报表给我
catch up.example: Friend: You were out for a week, work has piled up quite a bit. You: I have to catch up quickly to get back on track. Friend: Want me to help you with some? You: Yeah, start with these reports.

catch up with.context: 国庆放假你约了多年未见的老同学，出来边吃饭边叙旧。
catch up with.translation: 朋友：国庆假期你有什么安排 你：我约了几个老同学见面叙叙旧 朋友：你们有多久没见了 你：快五年了 好多话想说
catch up with.example: Friend: What are your plans for the National Day holiday? You: I've asked some old friends to meet up and catch up. Friend: How long has it been since you saw them? You: Almost five years, so much to catch up on.

chat about.context: 午休时你和同事闲聊周末去哪玩，越聊越起劲。
chat about.translation: 朋友：午休时间咱们聊点什么呢 你：就闲聊一下周末打算去哪玩 朋友：你有什么想法没 你：想去那个新开的咖啡馆坐坐
chat about.example: Friend: What should we chat about during lunch break? You: Let's just chat about where to go this weekend. Friend: Do you have any ideas? You: I want to check out that newly opened cafe.

chat with.context: 你晚上和朋友打电话，一边聊日常一边追剧，特别放松。
chat with.translation: 朋友：晚上有空聊聊天吗 你：好呀 我一边追剧一边和你聊 朋友：你最近在看什么剧呢 你：那部悬疑剧 剧情特别紧凑
chat with.example: Friend: Are you free to chat tonight? You: Sure, I'll chat with you while watching my show. Friend: What show are you watching lately? You: That thriller, the plot is really tight.

check into.context: 你到外地出差，第一件事是去酒店办理入住手续。
check into.translation: 朋友：你到上海了吗 住哪一家酒店 你：刚到 正在酒店前台办理入住 朋友：房间订好了吗 环境怎么样 你：订好了 能看到江景 特别棒
check into.example: Friend: Have you arrived in Shanghai yet, which hotel are you at? You: Just got here, I'm checking into the hotel at the front desk. Friend: Is the room booked, how's the environment? You: Booked, it has a river view, amazing.

check out.context: 你旅行结束离开酒店前，要先去前台办理退房。
check out.translation: 朋友：明天几点的返程车呀 你：早上九点的 我们先去前台退房 朋友：押金什么时候退呢 你：退房的时候当场就退
check out.example: Friend: What time is the return trip tomorrow? You: Nine in the morning, let's check out at the front desk first. Friend: When is the deposit refunded? You: They return it right when you check out.

cheer up.context: 朋友考试没考好情绪低落，你陪他吃饭散步，让他振作起来。
cheer up.translation: 朋友：这次考试又没考好 我好郁闷 你：别难过 振作起来 下次再努力 朋友：我感觉自己怎么都学不会 你：慢慢来 我陪你一起复习
cheer up.example: Friend: I failed the exam again, I'm so down. You: Don't be sad, cheer up, we'll try harder next time. Friend: I feel like I just can't learn it. You: Take it slow, I'll review with you.

choose from.context: 甜品店里有十几种口味的蛋糕，朋友让你挑一个喜欢的。
choose from.translation: 朋友：甜品店这么多蛋糕 你选哪个 你：这么多口味 我都不知道选哪个了 朋友：我推荐你试试巧克力的 你：好 那就来一块巧克力蛋糕
choose from.example: Friend: So many cakes at the dessert shop, which one do you pick? You: With all these flavors, I don't know which to choose from. Friend: I recommend you try the chocolate one. You: OK, I'll have a slice of chocolate cake.

clear up.context: 早上起来还下着雨，到了下午天就放晴了，你们决定出去走走。
clear up.translation: 朋友：早上还在下雨 下午能出去玩吗 你：雨停了 天已经放晴了 朋友：那我们去公园散散步吧 你：好 出门带件外套
clear up.example: Friend: It was raining this morning, can we go out in the afternoon? You: The rain stopped, the sky has cleared up now. Friend: Then let's take a walk in the park. You: OK, bring a jacket when we go out.

close by.context: 你在陌生的城市找车站，问路人地铁站在不在附近。
close by.translation: 朋友：这附近有没有地铁站呀 你：我也在找 我们问问路人吧 朋友：您好 请问地铁站在附近吗 你：就在前面路口 左转走两百米
close by.example: Friend: Is there a subway station near here? You: I'm looking for it too, let's ask someone. Friend: Excuse me, is the subway station close by? You: Right at the intersection ahead, two hundred meters after turning left.

close friend.context: 你和发小从小一起长大，是关系特别铁的挚友。
close friend.translation: 朋友：你那个一起吃饭的男生是谁呀 你：他是我从小玩到大的挚友 朋友：你们认识多少年了 你：快二十年了 比亲兄弟还亲
close friend.example: Friend: Who is that guy you're eating with? You: He's a close friend of mine since we were kids. Friend: How long have you known each other? You: Almost twenty years, closer than brothers.

come along.context: 朋友问你项目进展如何，你说一切顺利，正在按计划推进。
come along.translation: 朋友：你那边项目进展得怎么样了 你：挺顺利的 一直在按计划推进 朋友：那有什么需要帮忙的吗 你：暂时没有 有事我叫你
come along.example: Friend: How is the project going on your end? You: Pretty well, it's coming along as planned. Friend: Then is there anything I can help with? You: Not for now, I'll let you know if something comes up.

come over.context: 周末你朋友来你家找你玩，敲门让你开门。
come over.translation: 朋友：我到你家楼下啦 你下来接我 你：你上来吧 我家就在三楼 朋友：我带了烧烤和啤酒 你下来开门 你：好 我马上来开门
come over.example: Friend: I'm downstairs at your place, come let me in. You: Come on up, my place is on the third floor. Friend: I brought BBQ and beer, come open the door. You: OK, I'm coming right down.

come together.context: 毕业多年后同学们又聚在一起，回忆起当年的校园时光。
come together.translation: 朋友：毕业五周年聚会你来吗 你：当然来 大家又能聚在一起多难得 朋友：你最想见谁呀 你：最想见当年睡我上铺的兄弟
come together.example: Friend: Are you coming to the five-year reunion? You: Of course, it's rare for everyone to come together again. Friend: Who do you most want to see? You: The guy who slept in the bunk above me.

come up.context: 你正开会呢，突然一个好消息冒出来，项目审批通过了。
come up.translation: 朋友：你们会开到哪一步了 你：正讨论着 突然有个新情况 项目批下来了 朋友：那太好了 晚上庆祝一下 你：行 我订个餐厅
come up.example: Friend: How far along is your meeting? You: We were discussing when something new came up, the project got approved. Friend: That's great, let's celebrate tonight. You: OK, I'll book a restaurant.

come up with.context: 组会上你提出了一个新点子，老板听了特别赞赏。
come up with.translation: 朋友：组会上你说什么了 老板那么开心 你：我提出了一个新方案 解决了卡点 朋友：真的吗 太厉害了 你：我也是昨天晚上突然想到的
come up with.example: Friend: What did you say in the meeting that made the boss so happy? You: I came up with a new plan that solved the bottleneck. Friend: Really, that's awesome. You: It just hit me last night.

come with.context: 你买了台新电脑，朋友问里面都附带了什么软件。
come with.translation: 朋友：你这台新电脑买的时候多少钱 你：价格挺合适 还附带了正版办公软件 朋友：那挺划算的 你：对 省得我自己再装了
come with.example: Friend: How much did you pay for that new computer? You: The price was decent, it comes with genuine office software. Friend: That's a good deal then. You: Yeah, saves me from installing it myself.

communicate with.context: 你和外地客户合作，主要靠邮件和视频会议沟通。
communicate with.translation: 朋友：你和那个外地客户怎么对接呀 你：主要靠邮件和视频会议沟通 朋友：有时差会不会不方便 你：还好 我们约固定时间开会
communicate with.example: Friend: How do you coordinate with that out-of-town client? You: We mostly communicate through email and video calls. Friend: Isn't the time difference inconvenient? You: It's okay, we set a fixed meeting time.

compare with.context: 你把现在的生活和上学时对比，发现现在自由多了。
compare with.translation: 朋友：你觉得现在上班和上学比哪个好 你：和上学时候比 现在自由多了 朋友：但压力也大多了吧 你：是 各有各的好
compare with.example: Friend: Do you think working or being in school is better? You: Compared with school days, life now is much freer. Friend: But the pressure is much bigger too. You: Yeah, each has its own good parts.

compared to.context: 和去年相比，你今年的体重轻了十斤。
compared to.translation: 朋友：你今年瘦了好多呀 你：和去年这个时候比 我轻了十斤 朋友：你是怎么做到的呀 你：每天跑步加控制饮食
compared to.example: Friend: You've lost so much weight this year. You: Compared to this time last year, I'm ten jin lighter. Friend: How did you do it? You: Running daily plus watching my diet.

complain about.context: 你朋友天天抱怨工作累、老板坑，你听多了也烦。
complain about.translation: 朋友：我老板今天又安排了一堆活 真烦 你：你怎么天天抱怨工作呀 朋友：是真的累嘛 你：要不换个工作试试
complain about.example: Friend: My boss dumped a bunch of work on me again today, so annoying. You: Why do you complain about work every single day? You: It's really exhausting. Friend: Then maybe try switching jobs.

concern about.context: 朋友考试前总担心考不好，你问他在焦虑些什么。
concern about.translation: 朋友：我最近一到考试就睡不好 你：你是在为什么事担忧呀 朋友：怕考不上理想的学校 你：别给自己太大压力 尽力就好
concern about.example: Friend: I can't sleep well whenever exams come around. You: What are you so concerned about? Friend: I'm afraid I won't get into my dream school. You: Don't put too much pressure on yourself, just do your best.

connect to wi-fi.context: 到了酒店房间，你第一件事是连上房间里的无线网络。
connect to wi-fi.translation: 朋友：到酒店了 你那边网能用吗 你：我先连一下房间里的无线网络试试 朋友：密码在房卡上写着 你：找到了 信号还挺强的
connect to wi-fi.example: Friend: We're at the hotel, does the internet work on your end? You: Let me connect to the room Wi-Fi first. Friend: The password is written on the room key card. You: Found it, the signal is pretty strong.

connect with.context: 你旅行时通过写日记和当地背包客交朋友，建立了深厚友谊。
connect with.translation: 朋友：你在旅行中认识的那些朋友现在还联系吗 你：我们通过邮件保持联系 成了很好的朋友 朋友：真不错 跨国友谊呀 你：对 明年他来中国我带他玩
connect with.example: Friend: Do you still keep in touch with those friends you met traveling? You: We connect through email and became great friends. Friend: That's lovely, an international friendship. You: Yeah, next year he'll visit China and I'll show him around.

consist of.context: 这个蛋糕由面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶等原料组成。
consist of.translation: 朋友：你做这个蛋糕都放了些什么材料 你：它主要由面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶组成 朋友：需要烤多久呢 你：一百八十度 烤四十分钟
consist of.example: Friend: What ingredients did you put in this cake? You: It consists mainly of flour, eggs, and milk. Friend: How long does it need to bake? You: At 180 degrees, for forty minutes.

consists of.context: 这个班级由三十名男生和二十名女生组成。
consists of.translation: 朋友：你们班一共多少人呀 你：它由三十名男生和二十名女生组成 朋友：男女比例挺均衡的 你：对 大家相处得特别好
consists of.example: Friend: How many people are in your class in total? You: It consists of thirty boys and twenty girls. Friend: The gender ratio is pretty balanced. You: Yeah, everyone gets along really well.

cool down.context: 剧烈运动完你要先慢走一会儿，让身体慢慢降温。
cool down.translation: 朋友：刚跑完步能不能马上坐下 你：不能 要先慢走 让身体慢慢降温 朋友：那要走多久呀 你：大概十分钟就缓过来了
cool down.example: Friend: Can I sit down right after running? You: No, walk around first to let your body cool down. Friend: For how long should I walk? You: About ten minutes and you'll feel better.

date back.context: 这座老寺庙的历史可以追溯到宋朝。
date back.translation: 朋友：这座古寺有多少年历史了 你：它的历史可以追溯到宋朝 朋友：那快一千年了吧 你：对 经历了好几个朝代
date back.example: Friend: How old is this ancient temple? You: Its history dates back to the Song Dynasty. Friend: That's almost a thousand years then. You: Yeah, it's gone through several dynasties.

date back to.context: 这家小咖啡馆从二十世纪初就开始营业了，一直开到现在。
date back to.translation: 朋友：这家咖啡馆开了多久啦 你：它从二十世纪初就开始营业了 朋友：那是不是很有历史感 你：对 装修都是老上海风格
date back to.example: Friend: How long has this cafe been open? You: It dates back to the early twentieth century. Friend: Then it must be full of history. You: Yeah, the decor is all old Shanghai style.

date from.context: 这条老街的传统工艺从明清时期就流传下来了。
date from.translation: 朋友：这条街上的手工艺历史很久吗 你：这些工艺从明清时期就流传下来 朋友：现在还有人在做吗 你：有 都是老师傅在坚持
date from.example: Friend: Do the crafts on this old street have a long history? You: These crafts date from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Friend: Are there still people making them now? You: Yes, master craftsmen keep it alive.

day and night.context: 为了赶项目进度，团队连续好几天日夜加班。
day and night.translation: 朋友：你们这几天怎么天天加班 你：项目快截止了 我们没日没夜地赶工 朋友：那也要注意休息 你：等项目结束就能好好睡一觉了
day and night.example: Friend: Why are you working overtime every day these days? You: The deadline is near, we're working day and night. Friend: But you need to rest too. You: Once the project ends, I'll sleep well.

day by day.context: 你刚入职时什么都不懂，一天天地慢慢学会了所有流程。
day by day.translation: 朋友：你刚进公司时适应得怎么样 你：一开始什么都不会 一天天慢慢学 朋友：现在完全上手了吗 你：对 整个流程都熟了
day by day.example: Friend: How was your adaptation when you first joined the company? You: At first I knew nothing, I learned day by day. Friend: Are you fully up to speed now? You: Yeah, the whole process is familiar to me.

day off.context: 你这周轮休一天，打算在家好好睡个懒觉。
day off.translation: 朋友：你这周哪天休息呀 你：我周三休息 打算在家睡个懒觉 朋友：要不要一起出来吃个饭 你：好呀 下午约个下午茶
day off.example: Friend: Which day are you off this week? You: I have a day off on Wednesday, planning to sleep in. Friend: Want to grab a meal together? You: Sure, let's do afternoon tea.

deal with.context: 你工作中遇到难缠的客户，不知道该怎么处理。
deal with.translation: 朋友：那个难搞的客户你处理得怎么样了 你：我还在想办法应对他的要求 朋友：需要我帮忙吗 你：好 你陪我一起去见他
deal with.example: Friend: How are you handling that difficult client? You: I'm still figuring out how to deal with his demands. Friend: Want me to help? You: OK, come with me to meet him.

depend on.context: 假期去哪里玩取决于天气，晴天就出门，下雨就宅家。
depend on.translation: 朋友：周末我们去哪玩比较好 你：去哪玩要看天气情况再定 朋友：那你先看看天气预报 你：我看了 周六晴天 周日下雨
depend on.example: Friend: Where should we go this weekend? You: Where to go depends on the weather. Friend: Then check the forecast first. You: I did, sunny Saturday, rainy Sunday.

depend upon.context: 你一个人在外地打拼，很多事情都得靠自己。
depend upon.translation: 朋友：你一个人在外面生活习惯吗 你：很多事情都得靠自己 慢慢学会独立 朋友：那生病了怎么办 你：自己去医院 也习惯了
depend upon.example: Friend: Are you used to living on your own out there? You: A lot of things depend on yourself, you learn to be independent. Friend: What do you do when you get sick? You: Go to the hospital alone, I'm used to it.

depends on.context: 旅行预算取决于你想去多少个国家，朋友问你计划花多少钱。
depends on.translation: 朋友：你这趟环游打算花多少钱 你：花多少钱取决于去几个国家 朋友：那你大概列个预算 你：控制在两万以内吧
depends on.example: Friend: How much are you planning to spend on this round trip? You: How much to spend depends on how many countries you visit. Friend: Then roughly set a budget. You: Keep it under twenty thousand.

die from.context: 医生说这种病如果不及时治疗会死于并发症。
die from.translation: 朋友：这个病严重吗 会有什么后果 你：严重的话会死于并发症 要及时治疗 朋友：那我赶紧去医院看看 你：对 别拖
die from.example: Friend: Is this illness serious, what could happen? You: In severe cases, people can die from complications, treat it early. Friend: Then I'll go to the hospital right away. You: Yeah, don't delay.

die out.context: 很多古老的方言随着年轻人外流而渐渐消失了。
die out.translation: 朋友：你老家那边还讲方言吗 你：年轻人都出去了 方言快消失了 朋友：那多可惜呀 你：是呀 以后可能就没人会说了
die out.example: Friend: Do people still speak the dialect in your hometown? You: Young people all left, the dialect is dying out. Friend: That's such a pity. You: Yeah, soon no one will speak it.

died out.context: 这种传统手工艺在工业化浪潮中逐渐失传了。
died out.translation: 朋友：那种老手艺现在还有人会吗 你：会的人都老了 这手艺慢慢失传了 朋友：那以后岂不是看不到了 你：正在抢救性保护 希望能传下去
died out.example: Friend: Is there still anyone who knows that old craft? You: Those who know it are all old, the craft has died out. Friend: Then we won't see it anymore. You: They're doing rescue preservation, hoping to pass it on.

different from.context: 你发现自己现在的生活和上学时完全不一样了。
different from.translation: 朋友：你觉得上班和上学最大的区别是什么 你：现在的生活和上学时完全不一样 朋友：哪里不一样呢 你：上学时轻松 上班后压力大
different from.example: Friend: What's the biggest difference between working and being a student? You: Life now is completely different from when I was in school. Friend: How so? You: School was easy, work is stressful.

different to.context: 英式英语和美式英语在拼写上有细微差别。
different to.translation: 朋友：英式英语和美式英语差别大吗 你：拼写和发音上有些不同 朋友：那学哪种比较好呢 你：都可以 看你喜欢哪种口音
different to.example: Friend: Is there a big difference between British and American English? You: It's different to British English in spelling and pronunciation. Friend: Which is better to learn? You: Either, depends on which accent you like.

divide into.context: 老师把全班同学分成几个小组，分别讨论不同话题。
divide into.translation: 朋友：课堂上老师让我们做什么活动 你：把全班分成几个小组 讨论不同话题 朋友：你分到哪个组了 你：分到科技组 讨论人工智能
divide into.example: Friend: What activity did the teacher have us do in class? You: We were divided into groups to discuss different topics. Friend: Which group did you get? You: The tech group, discussing AI.

do harm.context: 医生说长期熬夜对身体有害，会影响免疫力。
do harm.translation: 朋友：我最近总熬夜 感觉浑身不舒服 你：熬夜对身体有害 免疫力会下降 朋友：那我几点睡比较好 你：尽量十二点前睡
do harm.example: Friend: I've been staying up late lately, feeling under the weather. You: Staying up late does harm to your health, your immunity drops. Friend: Then what time should I sleep? You: Try to be in bed before twelve.

dozens of.context: 广场上聚集了几十个晨练的老人，一起打太极。
dozens of.translation: 朋友：早上公园怎么这么多人 你：有几十个老人在打太极 朋友：他们每天都来吗 你：对 风雨无阻 身体都特别棒
dozens of.example: Friend: Why are there so many people in the park in the morning? You: Dozens of elderly people are doing tai chi. Friend: Do they come every day? You: Yeah, rain or shine, they're all in great shape.

dream of.context: 你从小就梦想当一名飞行员，现在终于考上了航校。
dream of.translation: 朋友：你小时候最大的梦想是什么 你：我一直梦想当一名飞行员 朋友：现在实现了吗 你：刚考上航校 离梦想近了一步
dream of.example: Friend: What was your biggest childhood dream? You: I always dreamed of becoming a pilot. Friend: Have you achieved it yet? You: Just got into aviation school, one step closer.

due to.context: 你上班迟到是因为早高峰堵车，朋友问你怎么晚了。
due to.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么晚到了 你：因为早高峰堵车 被堵在路上了 朋友：那你以后提早十分钟出门 你：好 明天就早点走
due to.example: Friend: Why are you late today? You: Due to the morning rush, I was stuck in traffic. Friend: Then leave ten minutes earlier from now on. You: OK, I'll head out earlier tomorrow.

earn a living.context: 他离开家乡后靠在餐厅打工谋生，一干就是五年。
earn a living.translation: 朋友：他刚到大城市时是怎么生活的 你：他靠在餐厅打工谋生 朋友：那时候肯定很辛苦 你：是呀 一步步熬过来的
earn a living.example: Friend: How did he make a living when he first arrived in the big city? You: He earned a living by working in a restaurant. Friend: That must have been really tough. You: Yeah, he worked his way through.

end up.context: 你本来只是想随便逛逛，结果最后买了一大堆东西回家。
end up.translation: 朋友：你不是说只逛不买吗 你：我本来想随便看看 结果最后买了一堆 朋友：你又剁手了 你：那些东西太划算了 忍不住
end up.example: Friend: Didn't you say you were just browsing? You: I only meant to look around, but I ended up buying a lot. Friend: You spent too much again. You: Those deals were too good to pass up.

even if.context: 就算明知道会失败，你也想试一试，因为不留遗憾。
even if.translation: 朋友：你明知道比赛赢不了 还去参加吗 你：即使知道赢不了 我也想试一试 朋友：为什么这么执着呀 你：不想给自己留遗憾
even if.example: Friend: You know you can't win the competition, still want to join? You: Even if I know I can't win, I still want to try. Friend: Why are you so determined? You: I don't want any regrets.

even though.context: 虽然雨下得很大，你们还是决定按原计划去爬山。
even though.translation: 朋友：雨下这么大 爬山还去吗 你：虽然雨很大 我们还是决定去 朋友：路滑要注意安全 你：穿防滑鞋 慢慢走就好
even though.example: Friend: It's raining so hard, are we still going hiking? You: Even though it's raining hard, we still decided to go. Friend: Watch out for slippery roads. You: Wear grip shoes, take it slow.

ever since.context: 你五年前去过一次云南，从那以后就一直想再去。
ever since.translation: 朋友：你去过云南几次呀 你：五年前去过一次 从那以后就一直想去 朋友：那你今年再去一次呗 你：好 秋天去最美
ever since.example: Friend: How many times have you been to Yunnan? You: I went once five years ago, and ever since I've wanted to go back. Friend: Then go again this year. You: OK, autumn is the most beautiful time.

except for.context: 这篇作文写得不错，除了有几个小拼写错误之外。
except for.translation: 朋友：我这篇作文写得怎么样 你：整体不错 除了几个小拼写错误 朋友：哪里写错了 你：第三段那个单词少了个字母
except for.example: Friend: How is my essay? You: It's good overall, except for a few small spelling mistakes. Friend: Where did I make mistakes? You: One word in the third paragraph is missing a letter.

face to face.context: 网友认识了半年，你们第一次约在咖啡馆面对面聊天。
face to face.translation: 朋友：你和那个网友见面了吗 你：我们约在咖啡馆 面对面聊了一下午 朋友：感觉和网上一样吗 你：差不多 人特别好聊
face to face.example: Friend: Did you meet that online friend in person? You: We met at a cafe and chatted face to face all afternoon. Friend: Was it the same as online? You: Pretty much, really easy to talk to.

faced with.context: 公司面临激烈的市场竞争，团队必须拿出更好的产品。
faced with.translation: 朋友：你们公司最近压力大吗 你：面对激烈竞争 我们必须拿出更好产品 朋友：团队士气怎么样 你：大家都很拼 想打个翻身仗
faced with.example: Friend: Is your company under a lot of pressure lately? You: Faced with fierce competition, we must deliver better products. Friend: How's team morale? You: Everyone's pushing hard, aiming for a turnaround.

fall apart.context: 两个人因为一点小事吵翻，友谊彻底破裂了。
fall apart.translation: 朋友：你和小王怎么不一起吃饭了 你：我们因为一点小事闹翻了 友谊都破裂了 朋友：多大点事 互相道个歉就好了 你：等双方都冷静一下再说
fall apart.example: Friend: Why don't you eat with Xiao Wang anymore? You: We fell apart over a small thing, the friendship is broken. Friend: It's not that big a deal, just apologize to each other. You: Let's wait till both cool off.

fall asleep.context: 你昨晚赶方案到三点，今天上课的时候趴在桌上睡着了。
fall asleep.translation: 朋友：你今天上课怎么一直在点头 你：昨晚赶方案到三点 今天直接睡着了 朋友：你也要注意身体呀 你：以后再也不熬这么晚了
fall asleep.example: Friend: Why were you nodding off in class today? You: I was working on a proposal till three last night, I fell asleep. Friend: You need to take care of your health. You: I'll never stay up that late again.

fall behind.context: 你生病缺了一周课，回学校后发现功课落下了一大截。
fall behind.translation: 朋友：你这一周没来上课 跟得上进度吗 你：我落下了一大截功课 得赶紧补上 朋友：需要我把笔记借你吗 你：好 太感谢了
fall behind.example: Friend: You missed a week of class, are you keeping up? You: I've fallen behind on the coursework, I need to catch up fast. Friend: Want to borrow my notes? You: Yes, thanks so much.

fall down.context: 小朋友学走路时经常摔倒，但每次都自己爬起来。
fall down.translation: 朋友：你家宝宝会走路了吗 你：会走两步了 但经常摔倒 朋友：摔疼了会哭吗 你：哭一下 又自己爬起来继续走
fall down.example: Friend: Can your baby walk yet? You: A couple of steps, but falls down often. Friend: Does he cry when he gets hurt? You: Cries a bit, then gets back up and keeps going.

fall ill.context: 你连续加班一周后终于累倒了，发烧请假在家休息。
fall ill.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么没来上班呀 你：我累倒了 发烧在家躺着呢 朋友：那你好好休息 多喝热水 你：好 明天退烧就回去上班
fall ill.example: Friend: Why didn't you come to work today? You: I fell ill with a fever and I'm resting at home. Friend: Then rest well and drink more hot water. You: OK, I'll be back once the fever breaks tomorrow.

fall in love.context: 你在朋友的婚礼上认识了一个人，一见钟情，很快就相恋了。
fall in love.translation: 朋友：你和你对象是怎么认识的 你：在朋友婚礼上认识的 一见钟情 朋友：那也太浪漫了 你：是呀 现在感情特别好
fall in love.example: Friend: How did you and your partner meet? You: We met at a friend's wedding and fell in love at first sight. Friend: That's so romantic. You: Yeah, our relationship is great now.

fall off.context: 最近咖啡店生意不太好，客流量下降了不少。
fall off.translation: 朋友：你家咖啡店最近生意怎么样 你：客流比上个月下降了不少 朋友：是什么原因呢 你：可能是新开了几家竞品店
fall off.example: Friend: How's business at your cafe lately? You: The customer numbers have fallen off a lot compared to last month. Friend: What's the reason? You: Probably several new competitors opened up.

far from.context: 你说自己一点也不累，其实已经连续工作十四个小时了。
far from.translation: 朋友：你看起来状态还好吧 要不要休息一下 你：我一点也不累 还能继续干 朋友：你都连续干十四个小时了 你：那就再坚持一会儿
far from.example: Friend: You look okay, want to take a break? You: I'm far from tired, I can keep going. Friend: You've been working for fourteen hours straight. You: Then I'll just push through a bit longer.

feed on.context: 大熊猫主要吃竹子，每天要花十几个小时进食。
feed on.translation: 朋友：动物园里大熊猫都吃些什么呀 你：它们主要以竹子为食 朋友：一天要吃多少呀 你：几十公斤 吃的时间特别长
feed on.example: Friend: What do pandas at the zoo mostly eat? You: They feed mainly on bamboo. Friend: How much do they eat a day? You: Dozens of kilos, they spend hours eating.

feel like.context: 下雨天你不想出门，就想窝在沙发上点个外卖。
feel like.translation: 朋友：周末咱们出去逛街吧 你：今天下雨 我就想窝在家里不想动 朋友：那你想吃什么 我帮你点 你：点个披萨吧 我们一起看电影
feel like.example: Friend: Let's go shopping this weekend. You: It's raining today, I feel like just lazing on the couch. Friend: What do you want to eat, I'll order for you. You: Let's get pizza and watch a movie.

fight against.context: 环卫工人早上四点就开始清扫街道，和恶劣天气作斗争。
fight against.translation: 朋友：你知道环卫工人几点上班吗 你：他们凌晨四点就开始工作 与恶劣天气作斗争 朋友：太辛苦了 我们要爱护环境 你：对 不乱扔垃圾就是支持他们
fight against.example: Friend: Do you know what time sanitation workers start work? You: They start at four in the morning, fighting against bad weather. Friend: That's so hard, we should care for the environment. You: Right, not littering supports them.

fight for.context: 消防员冲进火海救人，为了保护群众安全而英勇奋战。
fight for.translation: 朋友：今天新闻里那个消防员太勇敢了 你：他为了救人冲进火海 朋友：真的是英雄 你：是呀 为了大家安全奋不顾身
fight for.example: Friend: That firefighter in the news today was so brave. You: He fought his way into the flames to save people. Friend: A real hero. You: Yeah, risking himself for everyone's safety.

fight with.context: 你在留学时和各国同学一起做项目，并肩完成了课题。
fight with.translation: 朋友：你在国外学习感觉怎么样 你：和各国同学一起做项目 并肩合作 朋友：有没有文化差异上的困难 你：一开始有 后来磨合好了
fight with.example: Friend: How did studying abroad feel? You: I worked on projects with classmates from all over, fighting side by side. Friend: Were there cultural differences? You: At first, but we worked it out.

figure out.context: 你卡了一道数学题半天做不出来，朋友过来一看帮你想通了。
figure out.translation: 朋友：你盯着这道题看了半小时了 你：我就是琢磨不出来这题怎么做 朋友：你换个思路 用方程试试 你：对啊 一下子就通了
figure out.example: Friend: You've been staring at this problem for half an hour. You: I just can't figure out how to solve it. Friend: Try a different approach, use equations. You: Right, it just clicked.

fill out.context: 你去健身房报名，前台让你先填一张个人资料表。
fill out.translation: 朋友：去健身房要办理什么手续 你：先填一张个人资料表 再做体测 朋友：费用是怎么算的 你：按年卡算 一年两千块
fill out.example: Friend: What procedures do I go through to join the gym? You: First fill out a personal info form, then a fitness test. Friend: How is the fee calculated? You: Annual membership, two thousand a year.

filled with.context: 国庆节那天广场上挤满了人，到处都是国旗和欢笑。
filled with.translation: 朋友：国庆那天你去看升旗了吗 你：去了 广场上挤满了人 特别热闹 朋友：几点起来排队的 你：凌晨三点就去了
filled with.example: Friend: Did you go watch the flag-raising on National Day? You: Yes, the square was filled with people, really lively. Friend: What time did you get in line? You: I went at three in the morning.

find out.context: 你想知道快递什么时候到，主动打电话给客服查询。
find out.translation: 朋友：你快递到哪了 我帮你看看 你：我打电话查一下 看到底什么时候到 朋友：客服怎么说 你：说明天就能派送了
find out.example: Friend: Where is your package, let me check for you. You: I'll call to find out when it will arrive. Friend: What did customer service say? You: It will be delivered tomorrow.

first of all.context: 面试的时候你先做自我介绍，再回答面试官的问题。
first of all.translation: 朋友：明天面试你紧张吗 你：有点 我先准备个自我介绍 朋友：你打算怎么介绍自己 你：先讲教育背景 再讲项目经历
first of all.example: Friend: Are you nervous about tomorrow's interview? You: A bit, I'll prepare a self-introduction first. Friend: How do you plan to introduce yourself? You: Start with education, then project experience.

for a moment.context: 朋友问你等了多久，你说在这个站台已经等了很长时间了。
for a moment.translation: 朋友：这趟车怎么还没来 你：我在这个站等了很长时间了 朋友：要不要查一下实时公交 你：好 看看车还有多久到
for a moment.example: Friend: Why hasn't this bus come yet? You: I've been waiting at this stop for a long time now. Friend: Should we check the live bus info? You: OK, see how far away it is.

for a while.context: 老师让你等一下，他接完电话再跟你说。
for a while.translation: 朋友：老师现在方便找他问问题吗 你：他在接电话 让你等一会儿 朋友：那我在走廊站一会儿 你：行 等他挂了我叫你
for a while.example: Friend: Is the teacher available to ask questions now? You: He's on a call, asked you to wait for a moment. Friend: Then I'll wait in the hallway. You: OK, I'll call you when he hangs up.

for free.context: 老师课上举了个例子，说明什么是现在完成时。
for free.translation: 朋友：语法课今天讲了什么 你：老师举了几个例子 讲现在完成时 朋友：你听懂了吗 你：基本懂了 就是用法还不太熟
for free.example: Friend: What did grammar class cover today? You: The teacher gave a few examples to explain the present perfect. Friend: Did you understand? You: Mostly, just the usage isn't familiar yet.

for now.context: 商场搞周年庆活动，你凭会员卡免费领了一杯饮料。
for now.translation: 朋友：你这杯饮料是买的吗 你：不是 商场周年庆免费领的 朋友：还有这种好事 我也去看看 你：在一楼服务台 凭会员卡领
for now.example: Friend: Did you buy that drink? You: No, it was for free at the mall anniversary event. Friend: Nice, I'll go get one too. You: At the first-floor service desk, show your membership card.

for sale.context: 你暂时还没想好换不换工作，先维持现状看看。
for sale.translation: 朋友：你新工作找得怎么样了 你：暂时先不换 维持现状看看 朋友：那原公司继续待着吗 你：对 骑驴找马 不急
for sale.example: Friend: How's your job search going? You: For now I'll stay put and see how things go. Friend: Then you're staying at your current company? You: Yeah, look while you work, no rush.

for sure.context: 小区门口贴了告示，说那套三居室的房子正在出售。
for sure.translation: 朋友：小区门口那套房要卖吗 你：是的 上面写着待售 朋友：多少钱一平呀 你：大概五万 比隔壁小区便宜
for sure.example: Friend: Is that apartment at the gate of our complex for sale? You: Yes, the sign says it's for sale. Friend: How much per square meter? You: About fifty thousand, cheaper than the complex next door.

for the first time.context: 朋友问你周末要不要一起去露营，你说那肯定好玩。
for the first time.translation: 朋友：周末一起去露营怎么样 你：那肯定好玩 我早就想去了 朋友：那我们周六早上出发 你：好 我来准备帐篷和食物
for the first time.example: Friend: How about going camping together this weekend? You: That'll be fun for sure, I've wanted to go for ages. Friend: Then we set off Saturday morning. You: OK, I'll prepare the tent and food.

for the moment.context: 你第一次一个人出远门，又紧张又兴奋。
for the moment.translation: 朋友：你第一次一个人坐飞机感觉怎么样 你：特别紧张 但也很兴奋 朋友：有没有害怕呀 你：有点 但落地就踏实了
for the moment.example: Friend: How did it feel taking a plane alone for the first time? You: I was really nervous but also excited. Friend: Were you scared? You: A bit, but once we landed I felt at ease.

from now on.context: 朋友为了方便自己开车通勤，每天要早起半小时。
from now on.translation: 朋友：你每天开车上班累不累 你：为了方便 我宁愿早起半小时开车 朋友：那油费不低吧 你：是 但节省时间
from now on.example: Friend: Is driving to work every day tiring? You: For the sake of convenience, I'd rather get up half an hour early. Friend: Isn't gas expensive? You: Yeah, but it saves time.

from the beginning.context: 你说你从一开始就知道这个项目不会成功，但大家都没听你的。
from the beginning.translation: 朋友：这个项目失败了 你怎么看 你：我从一开始就觉得它会失败 朋友：那你当时怎么没拦着 你：我说了 但没人听我的
from the beginning.example: Friend: The project failed, what do you think? You: From the beginning I felt it would fail. Friend: Then why didn't you stop it? You: I did say so, but no one listened.

full of.context: 你在公园湖边喂鸽子，手里全是鸟食，鸽子围了一圈。
full of.translation: 朋友：你在湖边干什么呢 你：我在喂鸽子 手里全是鸟食 朋友：鸽子不怕人吗 你：一点都不怕 都飞到我手上来了
full of.example: Friend: What are you doing by the lake? You: I'm feeding the pigeons, my hands are full of birdseed. Friend: Aren't they scared of people? You: Not at all, they've landed right on my hands.

get along with.context: 你新换了室友，两个人性格都很随和，相处得很融洽。
get along with.translation: 朋友：你新室友好相处吗 你：我们俩性格合得来 相处得很融洽 朋友：有没有什么生活习惯上的摩擦 你：目前没有 大家都很自觉
get along with.example: Friend: Is your new roommate easy to get along with? You: Our personalities click, we get along really well. Friend: Any friction over living habits? You: Not yet, everyone's considerate.

get back.context: 你出差一周回到家，放下行李就瘫在沙发上不想动。
get back.translation: 朋友：你出差终于回来了 累不累 你：我回来了 放下行李就不想动了 朋友：那你好好休息 晚上出来吃饭 你：好 我先睡一觉
get back.example: Friend: You're finally back from your trip, tired? You: I'm back, I plopped on the couch and don't want to move. Friend: Then rest well, come out for dinner tonight. You: OK, I'll take a nap first.

get in touch with.context: 你到了新城市，先加几个当地朋友的微信，方便以后联系。
get in touch with.translation: 朋友：你到了新城市怎么认识当地人呀 你：先加几个朋友微信 保持联系 朋友：周末可以约着一起玩 你：对 有空就约饭
get in touch with.example: Friend: How do you meet locals in a new city? You: First get in touch with a few friends on WeChat. Friend: You can hang out together on weekends. You: Yeah, let's grab a meal when free.

get into.context: 你最近开始喜欢上摄影，周末总出去拍风景。
get into.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总背着相机出去 你：我开始喜欢上摄影了 朋友：你都拍些什么呢 你：拍城市街景和日落
get into.example: Friend: Why are you always going out with a camera lately? You: I've got into photography recently. Friend: What do you mostly shoot? You: City street scenes and sunsets.

get lost.context: 朋友拉你去凑数玩桌游，你说你不会玩，朋友说去了再说。
get lost.translation: 朋友：今晚桌游局三缺一 你来不来 你：我不会玩呀 去了也尴尬 朋友：来嘛 边玩边学 你：那行 我去凑个人数
get lost.example: Friend: We're short one for board games tonight, coming? You: I don't know how to play, it'd be awkward. Friend: Come on, you'll learn as you play. You: OK, I'll come make up the numbers.

get off.context: 你坐公交到了站，跟司机说在前面那站下车。
get off.translation: 朋友：我们还有几站到呀 你：我在前面那站下 司机麻烦停一下 朋友：下了车还要走多远 你：五分钟就到我家
get off.example: Friend: How many stops left for us? You: I'll get off at the next stop, driver please stop. Friend: How far after getting off? You: Five minutes' walk to my place.

get on.context: 你在公交站等车，车来了你从前门上车刷码。
get on.translation: 朋友：车来了 咱们从前门上吧 你：好 我刷个码就上去 朋友：后面有座位 你：走 坐后面靠窗的位置
get on.example: Friend: The bus is here, let's board through the front door. You: OK, I'll scan my code and get on. Friend: There are seats in the back. You: Let's go sit by the window in the back.

get on with.context: 你和新同事性格合拍，工作配合得特别顺畅。
get on with.translation: 朋友：你和新搭档合作得怎么样 你：我们俩合得来 配合得特别顺畅 朋友：那效率肯定很高 你：对 有事一起商量着来
get on with.example: Friend: How are you getting along with your new partner? You: We click, we get on really well working together. Friend: Then your efficiency must be high. You: Yeah, we discuss things together.

get out of.context: 朋友找你帮忙替班，你找了个借口推脱说自己有事。
get out of.translation: 朋友：周末你能帮我顶个班吗 你：我那天有事 没法替你 朋友：那你有什么事呀 你：早就约好去看医生了
get out of.example: Friend: Can you cover a shift for me this weekend? You: I have plans that day, I can't get out of it for you. Friend: What are you up to then? You: I already made a doctor's appointment.

get over.context: 你刚失恋时特别难受，朋友陪你聊了一晚上，你慢慢走出来了。
get over.translation: 朋友：你最近状态好多了 怎么缓过来的 你：多亏朋友陪我聊天 我慢慢克服了 朋友：时间确实是良药 你：对 现在已经放下了
get over.example: Friend: You're in much better shape now, how did you get over it? You: Thanks to friends talking with me, I got over it gradually. Friend: Time really is the best healer. You: Yeah, I've let it go now.

get rid of.context: 你抽屉里堆了好多旧文具，决定清理掉不用的东西。
get rid of.translation: 朋友：你整理抽屉怎么扔了这么多东西 你：我把那些用不上的旧文具清理掉 朋友：留着万一以后用呢 你：一年都没用过 肯定不需要了
get rid of.example: Friend: Why are you throwing out so much while tidying the drawer? You: I'm getting rid of the old stationery I don't use. Friend: Keep it in case you need it later? You: I haven't used it in a year, definitely don't need it.

get through.context: 项目进展不顺利，你不知道要熬多久才能结束。
get through.translation: 朋友：这个项目还要熬多久 你：我不知道要多久才能熬过这阵子 朋友：大家都在硬撑 你：是啊 再坚持一下就结束了
get through.example: Friend: How much longer do we have to grind through this project? You: I don't know how long I'll have to get through this stretch. Friend: We're all just pushing through. You: Yeah, hang on a bit more and it'll be over.

get to know.context: 你到了新城市工作，周末多出去走动，慢慢认识新朋友。
get to know.translation: 朋友：你在新城市交到朋友了吗 你：周末多出去走走 慢慢认识新朋友 朋友：你一般去哪里社交呀 你：去徒步群 大家一起爬山
get to know.example: Friend: Have you made friends in the new city yet? You: Get to know new people by going out on weekends. Friend: Where do you usually socialize? You: In a hiking group, we go climb together.

get together.context: 毕业多年后班级组织聚会，大家从各个城市赶来相聚。
get together.translation: 朋友：毕业十周年聚会你来吗 你：当然来 大家聚在一起多难得 朋友：你最想见到谁 你：最想见到当年的班主任
get together.example: Friend: Are you coming to the ten-year reunion? You: Of course, it's rare for everyone to get together. Friend: Who do you most want to see? You: Mostly want to see our homeroom teacher.

get used to.context: 你刚搬到新城市住，朋友说时间长了就会慢慢习惯新环境。
get used to.translation: 朋友：你搬到新城市住还习惯吗 你：刚开始不太适应 现在慢慢习惯了 朋友：交了新朋友吗 你：认识了几个同事 周末一起吃饭
get used to.example: Friend: Are you settling into your new city yet? You: It was hard at first, but I'm getting used to it now. Friend: Made any new friends? You: Met a few coworkers, we eat out on weekends.

give back.context: 你工作稳定后开始回馈社会，定期去社区做志愿者。
give back.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么总去社区做志愿 你：我想回馈社会 帮社区里的老人 朋友：你都做些什么服务 你：陪老人聊天 教他们用手机
give back.example: Friend: Why are you always volunteering in the community on weekends? You: I want to give back to the community, help the elderly there. Friend: What kind of service do you do? You: Chat with them, teach them to use phones.

give in.context: 朋友劝了你半天你还是坚持自己的想法，最后他只好让步。
give in.translation: 朋友：我都劝你这么久了 你就听我一句吧 你：我还是想按自己的想法做 朋友：那行吧 我让步了 你：谢谢你理解我
give in.example: Friend: I've been persuading you so long, just listen to me. You: I still want to do it my way. Friend: Fine, I give in. You: Thanks for understanding me.

give off.context: 路边那盏旧路灯一到晚上就发出昏黄的光。
give off.translation: 朋友：这条路晚上怎么这么暗 你：那盏路灯发出的光特别暗 朋友：我们走快点吧 你：好 这路灯坏了好几天了
give off.example: Friend: Why is this road so dark at night? You: That street lamp gives off a really dim light. Friend: Let's walk faster then. You: OK, that lamp's been broken for days.

give out.context: 公司年会上老板给大家发红包和礼品，人人有份。
give out.translation: 朋友：年会上老板都发了什么 你：他给每个人都发了红包和礼品 朋友：你抽到什么大奖了吗 你：中了个三等奖 一台电饭煲
give out.example: Friend: What did the boss give out at the annual party? You: He gave out red envelopes and gifts to everyone. Friend: Did you win any big prize? You: Third prize, a rice cooker.

give up.context: 你劝朋友再试一次，别因为一次失败就彻底放弃。
give up.translation: 朋友：这次面试又挂了 我不想再找了 你：别放弃 再试一次 朋友：可是我真的没信心了 你：失败是成功之母 下次会更好
give up.example: Friend: I failed another interview, I don't want to keep trying. You: Don't give up, try one more time. Friend: But I really have no confidence left. You: Failure is the mother of success, next time will be better.

give up on.context: 朋友一直没联系上你，你回消息说他别再等你了。
give up on.translation: 朋友：我发你消息半天不回 你：不好意思 我刚才在开会 你别等我了 朋友：那我们改约时间吧 你：好 明天下午怎么样
give up on.example: Friend: I texted you ages ago and you didn't reply. You: Sorry, I was in a meeting, you can give up on waiting for me. Friend: Then let's reschedule. You: OK, how about tomorrow afternoon?

go abroad.context: 朋友问你毕业之后打算留在国内还是出国发展。
go abroad.translation: 朋友：毕业之后你打算去哪里发展 你：我打算出国 去国外读研 朋友：想去哪个国家呀 你：想去英国 学制短
go abroad.example: Friend: Where do you plan to develop after graduation? You: I plan to go abroad for graduate school. Friend: Which country? You: The UK, the program is shorter.

go ahead with.context: 老板已经批准了你的方案，让你放手继续推进项目。
go ahead with.translation: 朋友：老板看了你的方案怎么说 你：他同意了 让我继续推进 朋友：那太好了 你终于可以开干了 你：对 下周一开始执行
go ahead with.example: Friend: What did the boss say about your proposal? You: He approved, told me to go ahead with it. Friend: Great, you can finally start. You: Yeah, execution starts next Monday.

go away.context: 朋友总在你学习的时候来打扰你，你客气地让他先离开。
go away.translation: 朋友：我来找你玩啦 你：我今天要写论文 你先离开一会儿吧 朋友：那你写完叫我 你：好 写完我给你打电话
go away.example: Friend: I've come over to hang out. You: I have to write my paper today, please go away for a bit. Friend: Then call me when you're done. You: OK, I'll call you when finished.

go back.context: 你出差一个星期终于回到自己的城市，感觉还是家里最舒服。
go back.translation: 朋友：出差一周感觉怎么样 你：终于回来了 还是自己家最舒服 朋友：这一周累坏了吧 你：是 明天要睡到中午
go back.example: Friend: How was your week-long business trip? You: I'm finally back, there's no place like home. Friend: Must have been exhausting. You: Yeah, I'm sleeping till noon tomorrow.

go back to.context: 你周末回母校看看，发现图书馆翻新过了。
go back to.translation: 朋友：周末你去哪儿了呀 你：我回了一趟母校 看看学校变化 朋友：学校变化大吗 你：图书馆翻新了 比以前气派
go back to.example: Friend: Where did you go this weekend? You: I went back to my old school to see how it changed. Friend: Did the school change much? You: The library got renovated, much fancier now.

go bad.context: 冰箱里的牛奶放了一个星期，你闻着变味了，不能喝了。
go bad.translation: 朋友：冰箱里那盒牛奶还能喝吗 你：放太久了 已经变质了 不能喝了 朋友：那赶紧扔掉吧 你：好 再买一盒新的
go bad.example: Friend: Is that milk in the fridge still drinkable? You: It's been too long, it's gone bad, can't drink it. Friend: Then throw it out quickly. You: OK, I'll buy a new carton.

go off.context: 你前一天晚上忘了关闹钟，结果早上它响起来把你吵醒。
go off.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么起这么早 你：我的闹钟六点就响了 把我吵醒了 朋友：那你再睡个回笼觉呗 你：算了 起来吃个早饭
go off.example: Friend: Why did you get up so early today? You: My alarm went off at six and woke me up. Friend: Then go back to sleep. You: Nah, I'll get up and have breakfast.

go on.context: 你跟朋友约好周末继续看那部没追完的剧。
go on.translation: 朋友：那部剧我们看到第几集了 你：上次看到一半 周末接着看 朋友：今晚能看两集吗 你：好 边吃零食边看
go on.example: Friend: Which episode of that show did we get to? You: We stopped halfway last time, let's go on this weekend. Friend: Can we watch two episodes tonight? You: Sure, with snacks.

go on holiday.context: 你攒了好久的年假，终于可以出去玩一趟了。
go on holiday.translation: 朋友：你这年假攒了多久了 你：快一年了 终于可以出去度假了 朋友：打算去哪儿玩 你：去云南 一直想去
go on holiday.example: Friend: How long have you saved up those annual leave days? You: Almost a year, finally I can go on holiday. Friend: Where do you plan to go? You: Yunnan, I've always wanted to go.

go out.context: 傍晚你在海边看潮水慢慢退去，沙滩上留下很多贝壳。
go out.translation: 朋友：海边这个时候潮水退了吗 你：退了 沙滩上好多贝壳 朋友：我们捡点贝壳回去做纪念吧 你：好 捡几个好看的
go out.example: Friend: Has the tide gone out by the sea this time? You: It's gone out, there are lots of shells on the sand. Friend: Let's pick some shells as souvenirs. You: OK, pick a few nice ones.

go through.context: 你刚入职就要经历项目上线的压力，连轴转了一个月。
go through.translation: 朋友：你新工作感觉怎么样 你：刚入职就经历了项目上线 特别累 朋友：那你学到东西了吗 你：学了很多 就是熬得够呛
go through.example: Friend: How's the new job? You: I went through a project launch right after joining, really exhausting. Friend: Did you learn a lot? You: Learned a lot, but it was a grind.

go wrong.context: 你照着导航走却迷路了，结果发现导航指错了路。
go wrong.translation: 朋友：你怎么比约定时间晚了这么久 你：我跟着导航走 结果走错路了 朋友：那你现在到哪了 你：在一个小巷子里 绕了半天才出来
go wrong.example: Friend: Why are you so much later than we agreed? You: I followed the navigation, but something went wrong on the way. Friend: Then where are you now? You: In an alley, took me ages to get out.

good at.context: 你朋友最擅长打篮球，校队比赛经常拿分。
good at.translation: 朋友：你们班谁篮球打得最好 你：小张最擅长 每次比赛都拿分 朋友：那我们组队叫上他 你：好 周末约一场
good at.example: Friend: Who on your class plays basketball best? You: Xiao Zhang is good at it, he scores every game. Friend: Then let's team up and invite him. You: OK, let's set up a game this weekend.

grow out of.context: 小朋友以前总爱咬指甲，长大之后这个习惯就慢慢没了。
grow out of.translation: 朋友：你家孩子以前不是总咬指甲吗 你：是啊 长大之后这个习惯就没了 朋友：那现在还有什么坏习惯吗 你：就爱啃铅笔头
grow out of.example: Friend: Didn't your kid used to bite his nails? You: Yeah, he grew out of that habit as he got older. Friend: Any other bad habits now? You: Just chewing on pencil tips.

hand in.context: 老师明天要收作业，你今晚赶紧把没写完的交上去。
hand in.translation: 朋友：明天就要交作业了 你写完了吗 你：我今晚赶紧把作业交上去 朋友：你哪部分没写完 你：最后那道大题 还得查资料
hand in.example: Friend: The assignment is due tomorrow, did you finish? You: I'll hand in the homework tonight. Friend: Which part aren't you done with? You: The last big problem, still need to look things up.

hand out.context: 学校运动会上校长给获奖同学发奖牌和奖状。
hand out.translation: 朋友：运动会今天都发了什么奖 你：校长给冠军颁发了奖牌和奖状 朋友：你拿了第几名呀 你：跑了个第二 拿了个银牌
hand out.example: Friend: What awards were given out at the sports meet today? You: The principal handed out medals and certificates to the winners. Friend: What place did you get? You: Second, I got a silver medal.

hang out.context: 周末你没事就约朋友去商场闲逛，也不买东西。
hang out.translation: 朋友：周末咱们出去逛逛呗 你：好啊 去商场闲逛一下 朋友：你不买东西也逛呀 你：就喜欢那种氛围 吹着空调
hang out.example: Friend: Let's go out and hang out this weekend. You: Sure, let's hang out at the mall. Friend: You like browsing even without buying? You: I love the vibe, walking around in the AC.

hang up.context: 你打完电话忘了挂，和朋友聊了半天才意识到。
hang up.translation: 朋友：你刚才跟谁打电话聊那么久 你：打完忘了挂 我们又聊了半天 朋友：那电话费不扣很多吗 你：没事 包月的
hang up.example: Friend: Who were you on the phone with for so long? You: I forgot to hang up, we chatted away for ages. Friend: Won't that cost a lot? You: It's fine, it's a monthly plan.

happen to.context: 你在书店偶遇了一本找了很久的书，简直像中奖一样。
happen to.translation: 朋友：你手里那本书找了多久了 你：我找了好久 今天碰巧在书店看到 朋友：那赶紧买下来 你：对 这种偶遇太难得了
happen to.example: Friend: How long have you been looking for that book in your hand? You: I looked for ages, it happened to be at the bookstore today. Friend: Then buy it right away. You: Yeah, finding it by chance is too rare.

have a hard time.context: 你刚来这座城市的时候语言不通，买菜都费劲。
have a hard time.translation: 朋友：你刚到这座城市时适应得怎么样 你：那时候语言不通 连买菜都困难 朋友：现在好多了吧 你：对 现在口语溜得很
have a hard time.example: Friend: How was your adaptation when you first arrived in this city? You: Back then I had a hard time even buying groceries. Friend: Much better now? You: Yeah, my spoken language is fluent now.

have got to.context: 你今天身体不舒服，朋友说你必须去医院看一下。
have got to.translation: 朋友：你脸色这么差 今天怎么了 你：我有点发烧 你：那你得赶紧去医院看看 你：好 下午就去挂号
have got to.example: Friend: You look so pale, what's wrong today? You: I have a bit of a fever. Friend: You've got to go to the hospital. You: OK, I'll register this afternoon.

have nothing to do with.context: 你跟同事解释这个误会，说这件事和他一点关系都没有。
have nothing to do with.translation: 朋友：这次出事是不是跟我有关 你：完全和你没关系 你别多想 朋友：那我就放心了 你：对 是我自己没弄好
have nothing to do with.example: Friend: Is this incident related to me? You: It has nothing to do with you at all, don't overthink. Friend: Then I'm relieved. You: Yeah, it was my own fault.

have to do with.context: 朋友问你最近怎么总提起他，你说其实那件事跟他有关。
have to do with.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老提到我 你：有件事跟你有关 想跟你商量 朋友：什么事呀 你：想请你帮个忙
