have to do with.example: Friend: Why do you keep bringing me up lately? You: There's something that has to do with you, I want to discuss. Friend: What is it? You: I want to ask you a favor.

head for.context: 下班了你看时间不早，跟同事说走吧，朝地铁站方向去。
head for.translation: 朋友：下班了 咱们往哪边走 你：我朝地铁站方向走 你呢 朋友：我坐公交 那明天见 你：好 明天同一时间
head for.example: Friend: Work's over, which way are we heading? You: I'm heading for the subway station, what about you? Friend: I take the bus, see you tomorrow. You: OK, same time tomorrow.

head off.context: 看到同事要把错误方案报上去，你赶紧拦下他，避免了损失。
head off.translation: 朋友：你刚才急急忙忙跑过去干什么 你：我拦下了他 不然他把错方案报上去就糟了 朋友：好险 你反应真快 你：是啊 差点出大事
head off.example: Friend: What were you rushing over there for just now? You: I headed him off, otherwise he'd have submitted the wrong plan. Friend: That was close, you reacted fast. You: Yeah, almost a disaster.

head out.context: 周末天气好，你和朋友决定出发去郊外野餐。
head out.translation: 朋友：今天天气这么好 别在家待着了 你：那我们出发去郊外野餐吧 朋友：我带野餐垫 你带吃的 你：好 半小时后地铁口见
head out.example: Friend: The weather's so nice today, don't stay cooped up. You: Let's head out to the countryside for a picnic. Friend: I'll bring the mat, you bring the food. You: OK, see you at the subway in half an hour.

hear about.context: 朋友告诉你他要出国了，你问他什么时候走。
hear about.translation: 朋友：我跟你说个事 我要出国了 你：真的吗 我刚听说这件事 什么时候走 朋友：下个月就走 你：那走之前聚一聚
hear about.example: Friend: Let me tell you something, I'm going abroad. You: Really, I just heard about it, when are you leaving? Friend: Next month. You: Let's get together before you go.

help out.context: 朋友搬家忙不过来，你周末过去帮他打包收拾。
help out.translation: 朋友：我这周末搬家 东西太多了 你：我过来帮你收拾 朋友：那太好了 你几点到 你：上午十点到 帮你打包箱子
help out.example: Friend: I'm moving this weekend, there's too much stuff. You: I'll come help you out. Friend: That's great, what time will you be here? You: Ten in the morning, to pack the boxes.

hold back.context: 你很想笑但硬是忍住了，因为在严肃的会议上。
hold back.translation: 朋友：刚才那个笑话那么好笑 你怎么没笑 你：在开会呢 我硬忍住没笑 朋友：憋得难受吧 你：是啊 脸都憋红了
hold back.example: Friend: That joke was so funny, why didn't you laugh? You: We were in a meeting, I held back my laughter. Friend: That must have been hard. You: Yeah, my face turned red holding it in.

hold on to.context: 经济不好的时候你别乱卖股票，拿住手里的筹码等反弹。
hold on to.translation: 朋友：这股票跌成这样 要不要割肉 你：先拿着 别卖 等反弹再说 朋友：可是我心慌 你：相信我 长期拿着会回来的
hold on to.example: Friend: The stock has dropped so much, should I cut my losses? You: Hold on to it for now, wait for the rebound. Friend: But I'm panicking. You: Trust me, hold it long-term and it'll come back.

home to.context: 成都出产熊猫和火锅，朋友问你那座城市以什么出名。
home to.translation: 朋友：成都是什么的故乡呀 你：它是大熊猫的故乡 朋友：除了熊猫还有什么 你：火锅也特别有名
home to.example: Friend: What is Chengdu home to? You: It's home to the giant panda. Friend: What else besides pandas? You: Its hotpot is also famous.

if only.context: 你多希望明天不用上班啊，那样就可以睡个懒觉。
if only.translation: 朋友：明天周末 你打算几点起 你：要是明天不用上班就好了 我想睡个懒觉 朋友：你已经连上七天了 是该休息 你：对 明天睡到自然醒
if only.example: Friend: Tomorrow's the weekend, what time will you get up? You: If only I didn't have to work tomorrow, I'd sleep in. Friend: You've worked seven days straight, you need rest. You: Yeah, tomorrow I'll wake up naturally.

in a minute.context: 你朋友说马上就到楼下了，让你再等一会儿。
in a minute.translation: 朋友：你到哪儿啦 我们等你吃饭 你：我马上就到楼下 再等我一分钟 朋友：好 我们在餐厅门口等你 你：好 跑着过来了
in a minute.example: Friend: Where are you, we're waiting for you to eat. You: I'll be downstairs in a minute, wait for me just one more minute. Friend: OK, we'll wait at the restaurant entrance. You: OK, I'm running over.

in a moment.context: 外卖小哥说你点的餐马上就送到了，让你留意手机。
in a moment.translation: 朋友：你点的外卖到哪了 你：骑手说马上就送到 让我留意手机 朋友：点的什么好吃的 你：点了份黄焖鸡米饭
in a moment.example: Friend: Where is your delivery? You: The rider said it'll be here in a moment, told me to watch my phone. Friend: What delicious thing did you order? You: A braised chicken rice.

in a row.context: 你最近连续加了三天班，朋友问你是不是又熬夜了。
in a row.translation: 朋友：你眼睛怎么这么黑 又熬夜了 你：我连续加了三天班 朋友：那身体撑得住吗 你：还好 周末补个觉就好
in a row.example: Friend: Why are your eyes so dark, staying up again? You: I've worked overtime three days in a row. Friend: Can your body handle it? You: It's OK, I'll catch up on sleep this weekend.

in a way.context: 你朋友觉得你说话做事有点奇怪，但又说不上来哪里怪。
in a way.translation: 朋友：你不觉得他最近有点怪怪的吗 你：是有点 说不上来哪里怪 朋友：可能是我们多心了 你：对 应该是我们想多了
in a way.example: Friend: Don't you think he's been a bit odd lately? You: In a way, but I can't say what's odd. Friend: Maybe we're imagining things. You: Yeah, probably overthinking.

in a word.context: 朋友问你对这部电影的看法，你说总之就是很好看。
in a word.translation: 朋友：那部新电影你觉得怎么样 你：总之 就是很好看 值得去看 朋友：剧情精彩吗 你：特别精彩 反转超多
in a word.example: Friend: What did you think of that new movie? You: In a word, it's just great, worth watching. Friend: Is the plot exciting? You: Really exciting, so many twists.

in addition.context: 你周末除了写作业，还要去健身房锻炼。
in addition.translation: 朋友：你周末一般都忙些什么 你：写完作业 还要去健身房锻炼 朋友：那你时间安排得真满 你：是呀 一点都不闲着
in addition.example: Friend: What do you usually do on weekends? You: In addition to doing homework, I also go to the gym. Friend: Your schedule is really packed. You: Yeah, not a moment idle.

in addition to.context: 除了英语，你还会说一点日语，朋友问你都会几门外语。
in addition to.translation: 朋友：你都会说哪几门外语 你：除了英语 我还会一点日语 朋友：那日语水平怎么样 你：能日常交流 看动漫不用字幕
in addition to.example: Friend: Which foreign languages do you speak? You: In addition to English, I also speak a little Japanese. Friend: How good is your Japanese? You: Conversational, I watch anime without subtitles.

in case.context: 你出门带把伞，万一下雨也好有个准备。
in case.translation: 朋友：今天天气看着挺好 还带伞吗 你：带上吧 以防万一 朋友：好吧 多带个东西 你：对 淋雨感冒不值得
in case.example: Friend: The weather looks nice today, still bring an umbrella? You: Bring one, just in case it rains. Friend: OK, extra stuff to carry. You: Yeah, catching a cold isn't worth it.

in charge of.context: 部门经理负责整个团队的日常管理，你问他归谁管。
in charge of.translation: 朋友：咱们部门现在谁负责呀 你：张经理负责整个团队的日常管理 朋友：他好说话吗 你：挺好说话的 有问题就找他
in charge of.example: Friend: Who's in charge of our department now? You: Manager Zhang is in charge of the whole team. Friend: Is he approachable? You: Pretty easy to talk to, go to him with questions.

in common.context: 你和朋友都是篮球迷，聊起球星来有说不完的话。
in common.translation: 朋友：你们俩怎么一见面就聊个没完 你：我们有共同爱好 都喜欢篮球 朋友：那你们平时一起打球吗 你：周末经常约
in common.example: Friend: How come you two chat nonstop whenever you meet? You: We have a lot in common, both love basketball. Friend: Do you play together usually? You: We set up games on weekends.

in danger.context: 森林里的大熊猫现在数量很少，处于濒危状态。
in danger.translation: 朋友：野生大熊猫现在多不多呀 你：很少 它们现在处于危险之中 朋友：那我们更要保护它们了 你：对 建立了自然保护区
in danger.example: Friend: Are wild pandas still around much? You: Very few, they're now in danger. Friend: Then we really need to protect them. You: Yeah, nature reserves have been set up.

in danger of.context: 你每天都熬夜，医生说你有健康透支的风险。
in danger of.translation: 朋友：我最近总熬夜 要不要紧 你：长期这样 你有健康透支的危险 朋友：那我几点睡比较好 你：十二点前必须睡
in danger of.example: Friend: I've been staying up late lately, is it a problem? You: Doing this long-term, you're in danger of burning out. Friend: Then what time should I sleep? You: Must be in bed before twelve.

in detail.context: 面试的时候面试官详细地问了你过往的项目经历。
in detail.translation: 朋友：今天面试面了多久呀 你：他详细地问了我之前做过的项目 朋友：都问了哪些问题 你：问了技术细节和团队合作
in detail.example: Friend: How long did today's interview last? You: He asked me in detail about my past projects. Friend: What kind of questions? You: Technical details and teamwork.

in general.context: 一般来说，早上的空气质量比晚上好，适合锻炼。
in general.translation: 朋友：你一般几点出去跑步 你：通常我早上六点去跑 空气最好 朋友：晚上跑步不行吗 你：一般来说 早上空气更新鲜
in general.example: Friend: What time do you usually go running? You: In general, I go at six in the morning, the air is best. Friend: Can't I run at night? You: Generally speaking, morning air is fresher.

in my opinion.context: 朋友问你周末去哪玩比较好，你说在你看来去公园散步就很舒服。
in my opinion.translation: 朋友：周末去哪玩比较好呀 你：依我看 去公园散散步就很舒服 朋友：那要不要顺便野餐 你：好 带点三明治和水果
in my opinion.example: Friend: Where is a good place to go this weekend? You: In my opinion, a walk in the park is really relaxing. Friend: Should we bring a picnic along? You: Sure, bring some sandwiches and fruit.

in need of.context: 你的车坏了，急需去修，朋友问你怎么还没到。
in need of.translation: 朋友：你怎么堵车堵这么久 你：我车坏了 现在急需找人修 朋友：需要我过来接你吗 你：好 你开车到地铁站
in need of.example: Friend: Why are you stuck in traffic so long? You: My car broke down, I'm in need of someone to fix it. Friend: Should I come pick you up? You: OK, drive to the subway station.

in no time.context: 你动作特别麻利，十几分钟就把早餐做好了。
in no time.translation: 朋友：你早饭做这么快 怎么做到的 你：我手脚麻利 转眼就做好了 朋友：做的什么好吃的 你：三明治加牛奶 五分钟搞定
in no time.example: Friend: You made breakfast so fast, how? You: I'm quick, I finished it in no time. Friend: What did you make? You: Sandwich and milk, done in five minutes.

in order to.context: 你早起是为了赶早班车，朋友问你这么早出门干嘛。
in order to.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么起这么早 你：我早起是为了赶早班车 朋友：要去哪里这么急 你：去邻市开个会 下午就回来
in order to.example: Friend: Why did you get up so early today? You: I get up early in order to catch the early bus. Friend: Where are you going in such a rush? You: To a meeting in the neighboring city, back this afternoon.

in other words.context: 朋友问你工资多少，你说简单讲就是够花但不富裕。
in other words.translation: 朋友：你现在一个月工资多少呀 你：换句话说 就是够花但存不下钱 朋友：那在大城市压力大吧 你：是 房租就占一半
in other words.example: Friend: How much do you make a month now? You: In other words, it's enough to live on but can't save much. Friend: Then pressure in the big city is high. You: Yeah, rent takes half.

in particular.context: 这份工作待遇很好，尤其是福利特别全。
in particular.translation: 朋友：你新工作最吸引你的是什么 你：待遇很好 尤其是年假特别长 朋友：有多少天年假呀 你：十五天 还能分开休
in particular.example: Friend: What attracts you most about the new job? You: The pay is great, especially the benefits package. Friend: How many vacation days? You: Fifteen, can take them separately.

in public.context: 你在发言时有点紧张，怕在大家面前说错话。
in public.translation: 朋友：你明天要上台演讲了 紧不紧张 你：一想到要在众人面前说话就紧张 朋友：多练几遍就好了 你：好 我对着镜子练
in public.example: Friend: You're presenting tomorrow, nervous? You: The thought of speaking in public makes me nervous. Friend: Practice it a few more times. You: OK, I'll practice in front of the mirror.

in recent years.context: 最近几年大家越来越重视健康，健身房越开越多。
in recent years.translation: 朋友：你发现这几年健身的人多了吗 你：是呀 最近几年健身房越开越多 朋友：大家开始注重养生了 你：对 健康最重要
in recent years.example: Friend: Have you noticed more people working out lately? You: Yeah, in recent years more and more gyms are opening. Friend: People are focusing on wellness now. You: Right, health comes first.

in return.context: 你帮朋友搬了家，他请你吃了顿大餐作为感谢。
in return.translation: 朋友：昨天帮你搬家辛苦了 你：我请你吃顿好的 作为回报 朋友：那多不好意思 你：必须的 下次有事再叫我
in return.example: Friend: Thanks for helping me move yesterday. You: I'll treat you to a nice meal in return. Friend: That's too kind of you. You: It's a must, call me next time.

in spite of.context: 虽然已经很晚了，你们还是决定再干一会儿把活做完。
in spite of.translation: 朋友：都这么晚了 我们收工吧 你：尽管很晚了 再干一会儿把它做完 朋友：那我们再加把劲 你：好 半小时后收工
in spite of.example: Friend: It's so late, let's call it a day. You: In spite of the lateness, let's push a bit more to finish. Friend: Then let's dig in. You: OK, wrap up in half an hour.

in that case.context: 朋友说今晚可能下雨，你说既然这样那就改天去爬山。
in that case.translation: 朋友：天气预报说今晚有雨 爬山还去吗 你：既然这样 我们就改天再去吧 朋友：那改到周六怎么样 你：好 周六看天气再说
in that case.example: Friend: The forecast says rain tonight, still going hiking? You: In that case, let's go another day. Friend: How about Saturday? You: OK, depends on Saturday's weather.

in the beginning.context: 项目刚启动的时候大家都没经验，手忙脚乱。
in the beginning.translation: 朋友：这个项目一开始顺利吗 你：刚开始的时候大家都没经验 朋友：那后来怎么理顺的 你：多做几次就熟了
in the beginning.example: Friend: Was this project smooth at the start? You: In the beginning, none of us had any experience. Friend: Then how did you sort it out? You: After doing it a few times, we got the hang of it.

in the end.context: 你复习了一个月，最后终于考出了好成绩。
in the end.translation: 朋友：期末成绩出来了 你考得怎么样 你：最后 终于考进了班级前十 朋友：太好了 请你吃饭庆祝 你：好 我想吃火锅
in the end.example: Friend: Finals are out, how did you do? You: In the end, I finally made it into the top ten of the class. Friend: Great, dinner on me to celebrate. You: OK, I want hotpot.

in the first place.context: 朋友问你为什么选这个专业，你说当初其实是被调剂的。
in the first place.translation: 朋友：你当初为什么选这个专业呀 你：说起来 一开始是被调剂过来的 朋友：那你现在喜欢吗 你：越学越喜欢了
in the first place.example: Friend: Why did you choose this major back then? You: In the first place, I was actually reassigned to it. Friend: Do you like it now? You: The more I study, the more I like it.

in the meantime.context: 等朋友化妆打扮的这段时间，你在客厅刷手机打发时间。
in the meantime.translation: 朋友：我换衣服化妆还要半小时 你：好 我在这期间刷刷手机 朋友：你先看会儿剧 我马上好 你：行 我先看一集
in the meantime.example: Friend: I need another half hour to change and do makeup. You: OK, I'll watch my phone in the meantime. Friend: Watch a show first, I'll be quick. You: Alright, I'll watch an episode.

in the near future.context: 朋友问你毕业之后打算什么时候结婚，你说不久的将来。
in the near future.translation: 朋友：你和对象打算什么时候结婚 你：就在不久的将来吧 朋友：日子定了吗 你：计划明年 具体再商量
in the near future.example: Friend: When do you and your partner plan to get married? You: In the near future, I guess. Friend: Is a date set? You: Planning next year, details TBD.

in the same way.context: 你朋友学日语的方法和你学英语的方法完全一样。
in the same way.translation: 朋友：你日语是怎么学的呀 你：和我学英语的方法一模一样 就是多听多说 朋友：那要学多久才能交流 你：坚持半年基本对话没问题
in the same way.example: Friend: How did you learn Japanese? You: In the same way I learned English, just listen and speak more. Friend: How long until I can converse? You: Stick with it half a year, basic conversation is fine.

in this case.context: 既然你都这么说了，那我们就按你的意思办吧。
in this case.translation: 朋友：这个方案你不同意吗 你：既然这样 那按你说的办 朋友：你没意见就好 你：没有 我配合你
in this case.example: Friend: Don't you agree with this plan? You: In this case, let's do it your way. Friend: Good that you have no objection. You: None, I'll cooperate.

in time.context: 你赶在最后一刻到达车站，车刚开走。
in time.translation: 朋友：你赶上那趟车了吗 你：我及时赶到了车站 车刚好到站 朋友：好险 差一点就错过了 你：是啊 跑过来一身汗
in time.example: Friend: Did you catch that bus? You: I got to the station just in time, the bus was pulling in. Friend: That was close, almost missed it. You: Yeah, ran all the way here sweating.

in total.context: 你点了一桌子菜，结账的时候一算总共五百多。
in total.translation: 朋友：咱们今天这顿饭花了多少钱 你：算下来 一共五百多块 朋友：人均一百多 挺划算 你：对 菜量还特别大
in total.example: Friend: How much did today's meal cost? You: Adding it all up, in total over five hundred yuan. Friend: Over a hundred per person, not bad. You: Yeah, the portions are huge.

in touch.context: 你和高中同学虽然不在一个城市，但一直保持着联系。
in touch.translation: 朋友：你和高中同学还联系吗 你：我们一直保持联系 虽然不在一个城市 朋友：都怎么联系呀 你：周末打个视频电话
in touch.example: Friend: Do you still keep in touch with high school friends? You: We stay in touch all the time, though in different cities. Friend: How do you stay in touch? You: Video calls on weekends.

in touch with.context: 你刚到新公司就和同事打成一片，很快熟悉了业务。
in touch with.translation: 朋友：你在新公司适应得怎么样 你：我和大家保持联系 很快就上手了 朋友：同事们好相处吗 你：特别好 中午一起吃饭
in touch with.example: Friend: How are you settling into the new company? You: I stay in touch with everyone, I got up to speed fast. Friend: Are the coworkers easy? You: Great, we eat lunch together.

insist on.context: 你朋友非要自己做饭，谁劝都不听，坚持按自己的方子做。
insist on.translation: 朋友：要不我们还是点外卖吧 你：不 我坚持要自己做 朋友：那你别又把菜炒糊了 你：放心 这次一定成功
insist on.example: Friend: Shall we just order takeout? You: No, I insist on cooking it myself. Friend: Then don't burn the dish again. You: Relax, this time it'll work.

instead of.context: 朋友问你今晚吃什么，你说吃火锅吧，不吃饭了。
instead of.translation: 朋友：今晚咱们吃什么 你：吃火锅吧 不吃米饭了 朋友：那你涮肉还是涮菜 你：肉菜都要 再来份面
instead of.example: Friend: What should we eat tonight? You: Let's have hotpot, instead of eating rice. Friend: Then meat or veggies? You: Both, plus some noodles.

intend to.context: 你打算毕业之后自己创业，做一个教育类的小项目。
intend to.translation: 朋友：你毕业之后有什么打算 你：我打算自己创业 做个小项目 朋友：做什么方向呀 你：做在线教育 帮学生学英语
intend to.example: Friend: What are your plans after graduation? You: I intend to start my own business, a small project. Friend: What direction? You: Online education, helping students learn English.

interested in.context: 你朋友对历史特别感兴趣，一跟他聊古代史就停不下来。
interested in.translation: 朋友：你最近在看什么书呀 你：我对中国古代史特别感兴趣 朋友：那你给我讲讲三国呗 你：好 从赤壁之战说起
interested in.example: Friend: What book are you reading lately? You: I'm very interested in ancient Chinese history. Friend: Then tell me about the Three Kingdoms. You: OK, starting from the Battle of Red Cliffs.

join in.context: 足球赛中场休息时你加入旁边那组人一起踢了两脚。
join in.translation: 朋友：下半场我们还少一个人 你要不要加入 你：好啊 我加入你们一起踢 朋友：你踢什么位置 你：踢前锋吧 我跑的快
join in.example: Friend: We're still one short for the second half, want to join in? You: Sure, I'll join your group and play. Friend: What position do you play? You: Striker, I run fast.

junk food.context: 医生说你常吃炸鸡薯条对身体不好，要少吃垃圾食品。
junk food.translation: 朋友：我最近总吃炸鸡 感觉胖了 你：这些都是垃圾食品 要少吃 朋友：那我换成什么好 你：多吃蔬菜水果 蛋白质
junk food.example: Friend: I've been eating fried chicken lately, feel like I gained weight. You: That's all junk food, eat less of it. Friend: Then what should I switch to? You: More fruits, veggies, and protein.

just as.context: 你朋友笑起来和他妈妈简直一模一样。
just as.translation: 朋友：你朋友笑起来像谁呀 你：他笑起来 正像他妈妈年轻时候 朋友：真的吗 你怎么知道 你：我见过他妈妈 长得特别像
just as.example: Friend: Who does your friend look like when he smiles? You: He smiles just as his mom did when she was young. Friend: Really, how do you know? You: I've met his mom, they look just alike.

keep fit.context: 医生建议你每周锻炼三次，保持身体健康。
keep fit.translation: 朋友：我总感觉浑身没劲 怎么办 你：每周锻炼三次 保持身体健康 朋友：做什么运动好呢 你：跑步 游泳 都可以
keep fit.example: Friend: I always feel run down, what to do? You: Exercise three times a week to keep fit. Friend: What kind of exercise? You: Running, swimming, anything works.

keep going.context: 你鼓励朋友别放弃，再坚持一下就到终点了。
keep going.translation: 朋友：我真的跑不动了 想放弃 你：别停 继续坚持 马上就到终点了 朋友：那我再跑五百米 你：加油 我在终点等你
keep going.example: Friend: I really can't run any further, want to quit. You: Don't stop, keep going, the finish line is near. Friend: Then I'll do another five hundred meters. You: Go for it, I'll wait at the finish.

keep in touch.context: 你去外地工作后和老朋友靠微信保持联络。
keep in touch.translation: 朋友：你去外地工作 老朋友都怎么联系 你：我们靠微信保持联络 朋友：多久聊一次呀 你：有空就聊 分享日常
keep in touch.example: Friend: You work out of town, how do you stay in touch with old friends? You: We keep in touch through WeChat. Friend: How often do you chat? You: Whenever free, sharing daily life.

keep in touch with.context: 你出长差半年，和女朋友靠视频通话保持联系。
keep in touch with.translation: 朋友：你出差这么久 和女朋友感情好吗 你：我们靠视频通话保持联系 朋友：不会因为距离变淡吗 你：不会 心里都有彼此
keep in touch with.example: Friend: You've been away so long, how's things with your girlfriend? You: We keep in touch through video calls. Friend: Doesn't distance make things fade? You: No, we both care for each other.

keep off.context: 公园里立着牌子说请勿践踏草坪，你绕着走。
keep off.translation: 朋友：我们直接从草坪穿过去吧 你：别踩 牌子说请勿践踏草坪 朋友：那就绕一圈吧 你：好 多走几步而已
keep off.example: Friend: Let's cut across the lawn. You: Keep off, the sign says don't step on the grass. Friend: Then let's walk around. You: OK, just a few extra steps.

keep on.context: 朋友一直学不会骑自行车，你鼓励他继续练别放弃。
keep on.translation: 朋友：我学了三天还不会骑车 真笨 你：别放弃 继续练 肯定能学会 朋友：可是我总摔 你：戴护具 慢慢来
keep on.example: Friend: I've been learning to ride for three days, still can't, so stupid. You: Don't give up, keep on practicing, you'll get it. Friend: But I keep falling. You: Wear guards, take it slow.

keep to.context: 减肥的时候你要严格遵守计划，不能乱吃零食。
keep to.translation: 朋友：减肥期间我能吃零食吗 你：要严格遵守计划 不能乱吃 朋友：那嘴馋了怎么办 你：吃点坚果 解解馋
keep to.example: Friend: Can I snack while dieting? You: Keep to the plan strictly, no random snacking. Friend: What if I crave something? You: Have some nuts to curb it.

keep up.context: 周围人都在卷进度，你也得加油别落后。
keep up.translation: 朋友：大家都加班到十点 我要不要也加 你：跟上大家的节奏 别落后了 朋友：可是我真的累 你：再坚持一下 大家都在拼
keep up.example: Friend: Everyone works till ten, should I too? You: Keep up, don't fall behind. Friend: But I'm really tired. You: Hang in there, everyone's pushing.

keep up with.context: 朋友追的那部剧更新太慢，他让你别剧透。
keep up with.translation: 朋友：那部剧你看到第几集了 你：我看到最新一集了 你别给我剧透 朋友：我还没看呢 怎么剧透 你：那等你看完再聊
keep up with.example: Friend: Which episode of that show are you on? You: I'm caught up with the show, don't spoil it for me. Friend: I haven't watched it yet, how could I spoil? You: Then we'll chat once you're caught up.

kill time.context: 等飞机的时候你在候机厅里随便逛逛打发时间。
kill time.translation: 朋友：还有两个小时才登机 干嘛呢 你：在候机厅随便逛逛 打发一下时间 朋友：那边有书店 去看看 你：好 买本杂志路上看
kill time.example: Friend: Two hours till boarding, what do we do? You: Kill time wandering around the departure lounge. Friend: There's a bookstore over there, let's look. You: OK, buy a magazine for the flight.

kind of.context: 你觉得这部电影有点无聊，节奏太慢了。
kind of.translation: 朋友：这部新片你觉得怎么样 你：感觉有点一般 节奏太慢了 朋友：那你还要不要看下去 你：再看半小时 不行就走
kind of.example: Friend: What did you think of the new film? You: It's kind of mediocre, the pace is too slow. Friend: Then do you still want to keep watching? You: Another half hour, if not I'll leave.

knock down.context: 你不小心把朋友搭在椅背上的杯子碰掉打碎了。
knock down.translation: 朋友：哎呀 我那个杯子怎么碎了 你：我不小心把它碰掉摔碎了 朋友：算了 也用了好几年了 你：我赔你个新的吧
knock down.example: Friend: Oh no, why is my cup broken? You: I knocked it down and it shattered. Friend: Forget it, it was years old anyway. You: Let me buy you a new one.

known as.context: 杭州以西湖和龙井茶而闻名，朋友问你杭州有什么特产。
known as.translation: 朋友：杭州最出名的是什么呀 你：它以龙井茶和西湖美景而闻名 朋友：那你带点特产回来 你：好 买两盒龙井
known as.example: Friend: What is Hangzhou known for? You: It's known for Longjing tea and West Lake. Friend: Then bring back some local specialties. You: OK, I'll get two boxes of Longjing.

known for.context: 景德镇以瓷器出名，朋友问你哪座城市的陶瓷最有名。
known for.translation: 朋友：中国哪个城市瓷器最有名 你：景德镇以陶瓷而闻名世界 朋友：那一定很精美 你：对 青花瓷最经典
known for.example: Friend: Which Chinese city is most famous for porcelain? You: Jingdezhen is known for its porcelain worldwide. Friend: It must be exquisite. You: Yeah, blue and white porcelain is the classic.

lack of.context: 你这次考试失利主要是因为复习时间不够，准备不充分。
lack of.translation: 朋友：这次怎么没考好呀 你：主要是复习时间不够 准备不充分 朋友：下次早点开始准备 你：好 提前一个月复习
lack of.example: Friend: Why didn't you do well this time? You: Mainly due to a lack of study time, not well prepared. Friend: Start earlier next time. You: OK, start a month ahead.

large amount of.context: 灾区需要大量物资，志愿者们连夜运送过去。
large amount of.translation: 朋友：灾区那边现在缺什么 你：需要大量的水和食物 朋友：我们能捐点什么 你：捐点被褥和药品
large amount of.example: Friend: What is the disaster area short of right now? You: A large amount of water and food is needed. Friend: What can we donate? You: Some blankets and medicine.

last for.context: 电影放映了两个小时，结束的时候大家都站起来鼓掌。
last for.translation: 朋友：这部电影演了多久呀 你：它持续了两个小时 剧情特别紧凑 朋友：结尾你觉得怎么样 你：特别感人 我都看哭了
last for.example: Friend: How long was the movie? You: It lasted for two hours, the plot was tight. Friend: What did you think of the ending? You: Really moving, I cried.

laugh at.context: 别人说话的时候你别总笑人家，要尊重别人。
laugh at.translation: 朋友：他普通话说得不标准 我老想笑 你：别嘲笑别人 要尊重 朋友：好吧 我注意点 你：对 多换位思考
laugh at.example: Friend: His Mandarin isn't standard, I keep wanting to laugh. You: Don't laugh at others, be respectful. Friend: OK, I'll watch it. You: Yeah, put yourself in their shoes.

lead to.context: 食用过多垃圾食品会导致肥胖和各种疾病。
lead to.translation: 朋友：现在人为什么越来越胖 你：吃太多垃圾食品 导致各种健康问题 朋友：那我们要怎么注意 你：清淡饮食 多运动
lead to.example: Friend: Why are people getting fatter nowadays? You: Eating too much junk food leads to all kinds of health problems. Friend: Then how should we watch it? You: Light diet, more exercise.

learn from.context: 朋友考试失败了，你安慰他说从失败中学习才能进步。
learn from.translation: 朋友：这次又没考过 我好挫败 你：别灰心 从失败中学习才能进步 朋友：可是我真的努力了 你：方向不对 换个方法再试
learn from.example: Friend: I failed again, so frustrated. You: Don't lose heart, learn from failure to improve. Friend: But I really tried hard. You: Wrong approach, try a different way.

leave alone.context: 小朋友在哭，你朋友说别去管他，让他自己冷静一下。
leave alone.translation: 朋友：小孩在那边哭 我们去看看 你：别管他 让他自己待一会儿 朋友：这样好吗 你：没事 他哭完就好了
leave alone.example: Friend: A kid is crying over there, let's go check. You: Leave him alone, let him be by himself for a bit. Friend: Is that OK? You: It's fine, he'll stop after a while.

leave behind.context: 你毕业离开学校的时候，把很多旧书都留给了学弟。
leave behind.translation: 朋友：你毕业的时候那些书怎么处理了 你：都留给学弟了 没带回来 朋友：那不是可惜了 你：留给有用的人更好
leave behind.example: Friend: What did you do with those books at graduation? You: I left them behind for the juniors, didn't bring them back. Friend: Isn't that a pity? You: Better to leave them for someone who needs them.

leave for.context: 你下周五要去北京出差，朋友问你什么时候出发。
leave for.translation: 朋友：你下周五去北京 几点的高铁 你：早上八点出发 中午到 朋友：那边有人接你吗 你：公司同事会来接
leave for.example: Friend: You're going to Beijing next Friday, what time's the train? You: I leave at eight in the morning, arriving noon. Friend: Is someone meeting you there? You: A colleague will pick me up.

leave out.context: 写报告的时候你不小心把最重要的那页漏掉了。
leave out.translation: 朋友：报告我看了 少了一部分 你：啊 我漏了最重要的那页 朋友：赶紧补上再交 你：好 我马上加进去
leave out.example: Friend: I read the report, something's missing. You: Oh, I left out the most important page. Friend: Add it back in before submitting. You: OK, I'll add it right now.

let down.context: 你答应朋友的事没做到，他特别失望，说你辜负了他的信任。
let down.translation: 朋友：你答应帮我的那件事怎么没办成 你：抱歉 我那天临时有事 朋友：你真的让我很失望 你：对不起 下次一定办到
let down.example: Friend: Why didn't you get that thing you promised me done? You: Sorry, something came up that day. Friend: You really let me down. You: Sorry, next time I'll get it done.

let go.context: 你朋友跟对象分手了，难过了好久，你劝他该放手就放手。
let go.translation: 朋友：我和对象分手了 好难受 你：既然不合适 就放手吧 朋友：可是我真的舍不得 你：时间会治愈一切
let go.example: Friend: I broke up with my partner, it hurts so much. You: If it's not working, just let go. Friend: But I really can't bear to. You: Time heals everything.

let out.context: 看完电影特别感动，你忍不住流下眼泪。
let out.translation: 朋友：你怎么眼睛红红的 你：那部电影太感人了 我忍不住哭了 朋友：哪段最戳你 你：主角和家人告别那段
let out.example: Friend: Why are your eyes red? You: That movie was so touching, I let out tears. Friend: Which part hit you? You: The part where the lead says goodbye to family.

let someone down.context: 你答应帮朋友复习却没做到，他说你这次真的让他失望了。
let someone down.translation: 朋友：你说帮我复习 结果自己去玩了 你：真的抱歉 我忘了 朋友：你又一次让我失望了 你：我下次一定补回来
let someone down.example: Friend: You said you'd help me review, then went out to play. You: I'm really sorry, I forgot. Friend: You've let me down again. You: I'll make it up next time.

light up.context: 夜幕降临，街上的路灯一盏盏亮起来，城市开始热闹起来。
light up.translation: 朋友：这条街晚上几点亮灯呀 你：天一黑 路灯就都亮起来了 朋友：晚上是不是特别热闹 你：对 夜市摊都出来了
light up.example: Friend: What time do the lights on this street come on? You: Once it gets dark, the streetlights light up. Friend: Is it lively at night? You: Yeah, the night market stalls come out.

line up.context: 演唱会开始前大家排好队，依次入场找座位。
line up.translation: 朋友：演唱会快开始了 人真多 你：大家都在排队 依次入场 朋友：我们的座位在哪 你：内场前排 跟着人流走
line up.example: Friend: The concert's about to start, such a crowd. You: Everyone is lining up to enter in order. Friend: Where are our seats? You: Front pit, follow the crowd.

little by little.context: 你学英语是一点点积累起来的，几年下来就很流利了。
little by little.translation: 朋友：你英语怎么说这么流利 你：我一点点积累 慢慢练出来的 朋友：学了多久了 你：五六年了 每天坚持
little by little.example: Friend: How is your English so fluent? You: Little by little, I built it up over time. Friend: How long have you studied? You: Five or six years, every day.

long before.context: 你奶奶说她小时候，那时候还没有电视呢。
long before.translation: 朋友：奶奶小时候是什么样的呀 你：她说很早以前 家里连电视都没有 朋友：那时候都玩什么呀 你：跳皮筋 抓石子
long before.example: Friend: What was grandma's childhood like? You: She said long before, there wasn't even a TV at home. Friend: What did they play back then? You: Rubber band skipping, stone games.

look after.context: 你出差时把猫托付给朋友照顾，朋友每天上门喂猫铲屎。
look after.translation: 朋友：你出差这几天猫怎么办 你：托给朋友照顾 每天上门喂 朋友：你朋友人真好 你：对 我回来请他吃饭
look after.example: Friend: What happens to your cat when you travel? You: I ask a friend to look after it, coming by daily to feed. Friend: Your friend is so kind. You: Yeah, I'll treat him to dinner when back.

look around.context: 你到了一个新城市，周末四处逛逛熟悉环境。
look around.translation: 朋友：你到新城市感觉陌生吗 你：周末多出去四处看看 就熟了 朋友：你都去哪逛呀 你：附近的公园和菜市场
look around.example: Friend: Does the new city feel unfamiliar? You: Look around on weekends and you'll get familiar. Friend: Where do you explore? You: The nearby parks and wet markets.

look down on.context: 同事家孩子学习不好，别的家长都看不起他，你说别这样。
look down on.translation: 朋友：那孩子成绩差 大家都不喜欢他 你：别看不起别人 成绩不能代表一切 朋友：也是 他体育特别好 你：对 各有所长
look down on.example: Friend: That kid has bad grades, no one likes him. You: Don't look down on others, grades don't mean everything. Friend: True, he's great at sports. You: Yeah, everyone has strengths.

look forward.context: 你盼着国庆放假，早就开始计划去哪里玩了。
look forward.translation: 朋友：国庆放假你激动吗 你：我特别期待 早就开始计划了 朋友：打算去哪玩 你：去川西 看彩林
look forward.example: Friend: Are you excited for the National Day holiday? You: I'm really looking forward to it, I've been planning. Friend: Where do you plan to go? You: Western Sichuan, see the fall colors.

look into.context: 客户投诉了产品质量问题，公司派人去调查情况。
look into.translation: 朋友：客户那边投诉处理得怎么样了 你：我们派人去调查具体情况了 朋友：什么时候有结果 你：三天内给答复
look into.example: Friend: How is the customer complaint being handled? You: We sent someone to look into the situation. Friend: When will we have results? You: An answer within three days.

look out.context: 朋友在马路上没注意看路，你赶紧拉住他小心车。
look out.translation: 朋友：你拉我干什么呀 你：当心 后面有车过来 朋友：哎呀 真没看到 谢谢你 你：走路看着点路
look out.example: Friend: Why did you grab me? You: Look out, a car's coming from behind. Friend: Oh, I really didn't see, thanks. You: Watch where you're walking.

look out for.context: 你在超市里找货架上的酸奶，朋友帮你一起找。
look out for.translation: 朋友：你在找什么呢 我帮你 你：我在找酸奶 你看到了吗 朋友：在那边冷藏区 你过去看看 你：好 我去拿两盒
look out for.example: Friend: What are you looking for, let me help. You: I'm looking out for the yogurt, do you see it? Friend: Over in the cold section, go check. You: OK, I'll grab two cartons.

look up.context: 你遇到不认识的单词就查字典，慢慢词汇量就上去了。
look up.translation: 朋友：你阅读的时候遇到生词怎么办 你：我就查字典 把它记下来 朋友：那阅读不会被打断吗 你：一开始会 慢慢就熟了
look up.example: Friend: What do you do when you hit new words reading? You: I look them up in the dictionary and write them down. Friend: Doesn't it break your reading flow? You: At first, but you get used to it.

look up to.context: 你从小就敬仰那些救死扶伤的医生，长大也想当医生。
look up to.translation: 朋友：你为什么想当医生呀 你：我一直敬仰那些救死扶伤的医生 朋友：那你要好好学习 你：对 目标医学院
look up to.example: Friend: Why do you want to be a doctor? You: I've always looked up to doctors who save lives. Friend: Then study hard. You: Yeah, aiming for med school.

looking forward to.context: 朋友问你新工作感觉怎么样，你说特别期待正式入职。
looking forward to.translation: 朋友：新工作感觉怎么样呀 你：我特别期待 下周一就入职了 朋友：紧张吗 你：有一点 但更多是兴奋
looking forward to.example: Friend: How does the new job feel? You: I'm really looking forward to it, starting next Monday. Friend: Nervous? You: A bit, but mostly excited.

lose weight.context: 你朋友最近在减肥，每天只吃水煮菜。
lose weight.translation: 朋友：你最近是不是瘦了好多 你：对啊 我在减肥 每天只吃水煮菜 朋友：那也太苦了 你：为了穿好看的裙子 值得
lose weight.example: Friend: Have you lost a lot of weight lately? You: Yeah, I'm losing weight, only eating boiled veggies daily. Friend: That's so tough. You: Worth it to fit into a nice dress.

made from.context: 这张桌子是用回收旧木材做的，看不出原来是什么。
made from.translation: 朋友：这张桌子什么材质的呀 你：它是由回收旧木材做成的 朋友：那挺环保的 你：对 表面做了旧 特别有味道
made from.example: Friend: What material is this table? You: It's made from recycled old wood. Friend: That's pretty eco-friendly. You: Yeah, distressed finish, lots of character.

make a difference.context: 你去山区支教一年，觉得自己真的改变了孩子们的生活。
make a difference.translation: 朋友：你去支教那一年感觉怎么样 你：真的对孩子们产生了很大影响 朋友：你教他们什么 你：英语和音乐
make a difference.example: Friend: How was that year you taught in the mountains? You: It really made a difference to the kids' lives. Friend: What did you teach them? You: English and music.

make a living.context: 你刚毕业的时候靠在餐厅打工维持生活。
make a living.translation: 朋友：你刚毕业那会怎么生活的 你：我靠在餐厅打工维持生活 朋友：那时候一定很辛苦 你：是 但一步一步过来了
make a living.example: Friend: How did you make a living right after graduation? You: I made a living working in a restaurant. Friend: That must have been hard back then. You: Yeah, but I got through it step by step.

make an effort.context: 朋友英语不好，你建议他每天花点功夫练习，一定能进步。
make an effort.translation: 朋友：我英语口语怎么练都练不好 你：你要每天努力练习 坚持住 朋友：要练多久才有效果 你：半年就能看到变化
make an effort.example: Friend: No matter how I practice, my spoken English won't improve. You: You have to make an effort to practice every day. Friend: How long till I see results? You: Half a year and you'll see changes.

make fun of.context: 同事个子矮，有人开玩笑拿他身高说事，你说别取笑别人。
make fun of.translation: 朋友：他们总拿小张身高开玩笑 你：别取笑别人 大家都是同事 朋友：就是开玩笑嘛 你：开玩笑也要有个度
make fun of.example: Friend: They always joke about Xiao Zhang's height. You: Don't make fun of him, we're all coworkers. Friend: It's just a joke. You: Even jokes need a line.

make notes.context: 上课的时候你边听老师讲边记笔记，怕漏了重点。
make notes.translation: 朋友：你上课怎么一直埋头写呀 你：我边听边记笔记 怕漏了重点 朋友：下课可以借别人的看 你：自己记的印象深
make notes.example: Friend: Why are you writing nonstop in class? You: I take notes while listening so I don't miss key points. Friend: You can borrow others' after class. You: My own notes stick better.

make sense.context: 朋友问你这道题为什么选 C，你解释了一下他就懂了。
make sense.translation: 朋友：这道题为什么选 C 呀 你：它这样理解就讲得通了 朋友：哦 原来是这样 你：对 把公式套进去就好
make sense.example: Friend: Why is the answer to this C? You: It makes sense once you understand it this way. Friend: Oh, I see now. You: Yeah, plug in the formula.

make sure.context: 你出门前反复检查钥匙带了没，确认锁好门才走。
make sure.translation: 朋友：你出门怎么又回去了 你：我确认一下钥匙带了没 朋友：你天天这么谨慎 你：对 上次被锁在外面有阴影
make sure.example: Friend: Why did you go back out again? You: I make sure I brought my keys. Friend: You're so cautious every day. You: Yeah, I got locked out once, still traumatized.

make up.context: 朋友约会前要化妆，你问她大概要多久。
make up.translation: 朋友：我出门前要化个妆 你先等会儿 你：还要画眼影吗 那要多久呀 朋友：半小时吧 你：好 我在楼下等你
make up.example: Friend: I need to put on makeup before going out, wait a sec. You: Eye shadow too, how long will that take? Friend: About half an hour. You: OK, I'll wait downstairs.

make up for.context: 你错过了朋友的生日，赶紧买份礼物补偿他。
make up for.translation: 朋友：你上周生日怎么没叫我 你：抱歉 我送你份礼物补偿一下 朋友：算你有良心 你：晚上请你吃饭赔罪
make up for.example: Friend: Why didn't you call me for your birthday last week? You: Sorry, let me make it up to you with a gift. Friend: You're not totally heartless. You: Dinner on me tonight to apologize.

make up one' mind.context: 朋友纠结选哪个 offer，你说他得自己拿主意。
make up one' mind.translation: 朋友：两个 offer 我到底选哪个 你：这个得你自己拿主意 别人不好替你决定 朋友：我真的拿不定 你：列个优缺点对比一下
make up one' mind.example: Friend: Which of the two offers should I pick? You: You have to make up your own mind, no one can decide for you. Friend: I really can't decide. You: List pros and cons and compare.

manage to.context: 你试了好几次，终于把那个坏掉的门锁修好了。
manage to.translation: 朋友：那把锁你修好了吗 你：试了好几次 终于修好了 朋友：你怎么这么厉害 你：跟着视频教程一步步弄的
manage to.example: Friend: Did you fix that lock? You: I tried several times and managed to fix it. Friend: How are you so handy? You: Followed a video tutorial step by step.

meet up.context: 周末你和朋友约好下午三点在咖啡馆碰头。
meet up.translation: 朋友：周末我们几点在哪见呀 你：下午三点在老地方咖啡馆碰头 朋友：好 到时候不见不散 你：行 我提前十分钟到
meet up.example: Friend: Where and when do we meet this weekend? You: Let's meet up at the usual cafe at three in the afternoon. Friend: OK, don't be a no-show. You: Alright, I'll be ten minutes early.

more or less.context: 朋友问你这道菜好不好吃，你说大概还凑合吧。
more or less.translation: 朋友：你点的这道菜味道怎么样 你：也就一般般 凑合吃吧 朋友：那下次别点这家了 你：好 换一家尝尝
more or less.example: Friend: How does the dish you ordered taste? You: More or less so-so, just okay to eat. Friend: Then don't order from here next time. You: OK, try a different place.

move on.context: 你失恋很久了，朋友劝你向前看，别一直沉溺在过去。
move on.translation: 朋友：你和前任分开这么久 还好吗 你：还在慢慢调整 朋友：向前看吧 会遇到更好的 你：好 我也该放下了
move on.example: Friend: It's been a while since the breakup, how are you? You: Still slowly moving on. Friend: Move on, you'll find someone better. You: OK, I should let it go too.

never mind.context: 朋友不小心踩了你一脚，赶紧道歉，你说没关系不要紧。
never mind.translation: 朋友：哎呀 不好意思踩到你了 你：没事 不要紧 不用在意 朋友：真的抱歉 你穿的白鞋脏了 你：没事 擦擦就好
never mind.example: Friend: Oh sorry, I stepped on your foot. You: Never mind, it's nothing, don't worry about it. Friend: Really sorry, your white shoe got dirty. You: It's fine, wipe it off.

no doubt.context: 朋友问你明天会不会下雨，你说肯定是晴天。
no doubt.translation: 朋友：明天我们去爬山 天气怎么样 你：毫无疑问是晴天 放心去吧 朋友：那要带水吗 你：带两瓶 山上热
no doubt.example: Friend: We're hiking tomorrow, how's the weather? You: No doubt it'll be sunny, go ahead. Friend: Should we bring water? You: Bring two bottles, it's hot up there.

no longer.context: 你以前总熬夜，现在身体不好，再也不熬夜了。
no longer.translation: 朋友：你以前不是天天熬夜吗 你：现在身体垮了 再也不敢熬了 朋友：几点睡比较好 你：十二点前必须上床
no longer.example: Friend: Didn't you used to stay up every night? You: Now my health is bad, I no longer do that. Friend: What time should I sleep? You: Must be in bed before twelve.

no matter.context: 朋友劝你别难过，不管发生什么事都有大家陪着你。
no matter.translation: 朋友：这次失败你别太难过 你：不管怎么样 我们都在你身边 朋友：谢谢你们陪我 你：客气什么 一家人
no matter.example: Friend: Don't be too sad about this failure. You: No matter what happens, we're all here for you. Friend: Thanks for staying with me. You: Don't mention it, we're family.

no wonder.context: 朋友跟你说那家餐厅排队两小时，你说难怪大家都说好吃。
no wonder.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅排了两个小时队 你：难怪大家都说它家味道好 朋友：值不值得等这么久 你：值得 招牌菜特别棒
no wonder.example: Friend: That restaurant had a two-hour line. You: No wonder everyone says the food is great. Friend: Is it worth the wait? You: Yeah, the signature dish is amazing.

not only.context: 学外语不仅要背单词，还要练口语。
not only.translation: 朋友：学英语怎么提高最快 你：不仅要背单词 还要多练口语 朋友：那听力呢 你：听力也要磨耳朵 多听广播
not only.example: Friend: What's the fastest way to improve English? You: You need not only memorize words, but also practice speaking. Friend: What about listening? You: That needs practice too, listen to broadcasts.

not until.context: 朋友每天复习到深夜，直到考试结束才放松下来。
not until.translation: 朋友：你最近天天几点睡呀 你：直到考试结束前我都不敢放松 朋友：那你考得怎么样 你：发挥得还行
not until.example: Friend: What time have you been sleeping lately? You: I didn't relax until the exam was over. Friend: How did you do? You: Did okay.

not yet.context: 朋友问你作业写完没，你说还没有，正在写呢。
not yet.translation: 朋友：你作业写完了吗 明天就要交了 你：还没有 我正在写呢 朋友：那你快点写 别熬太晚 你：好 我再写一点就睡
not yet.example: Friend: Have you finished your homework yet? You: Not yet, I'm still working on it. Friend: Then hurry up, it's due tomorrow. You: OK, I'll stay up a bit.

now that.context: 朋友说你现在不用住宿舍了，可以自己租房子。
now that.translation: 朋友：你现在毕业了 不用住宿舍了 你：既然这样 我就自己租个房子住 朋友：找好房子了吗 你：找了个离公司近的
now that.example: Friend: Now that you graduated, you don't need the dorm. You: Now that's the case, I'll rent my own place. Friend: Found a place? You: Found one near the office.

on average.context: 你问朋友这个城市平均工资是多少，他说大概八千。
on average.translation: 朋友：你知道这边平均工资多少吗 你：大概平均八千块左右 朋友：那房租多少 你：单间要三千
on average.example: Friend: Do you know the average salary here? You: On average it's about eight thousand. Friend: How much is rent? You: A single room is three thousand.

on holiday.context: 你下个月要去海南度假，朋友问你行程。
on holiday.translation: 朋友：你下个月要去哪玩呀 你：我去海南度假 待一个星期 朋友：那边暖和吧 你：对 二十多度 特别舒服
on holiday.example: Friend: Where are you going next month? You: I'm going on holiday to Hainan for a week. Friend: It's warm there right? You: Yeah, around twenty degrees, really comfortable.

on purpose.context: 朋友问你是不是故意把水洒在他身上的，你说不是。
on purpose.translation: 朋友：你是不是故意把水洒我身上的 你：我真不是故意的 手滑了 朋友：下次小心点 你：好 真的抱歉
on purpose.example: Friend: Did you spill water on me on purpose? You: It wasn't on purpose, my hand slipped. Friend: Be more careful next time. You: OK, really sorry.

on sale.context: 商场换季打折，很多衣服都在特价销售。
on sale.translation: 朋友：商场最近有活动吗 你：换季了 很多衣服都在打折 朋友：那去淘两件 你：好 看看有没有合身的
on sale.example: Friend: Is the mall having a sale? You: It's the season change, many clothes are on sale. Friend: Let's go grab a couple. You: OK, see if anything fits.

on the other hand.context: 朋友问你为什么选这份工作，你说一方面钱多，另一方面离家近。
on the other hand.translation: 朋友：你为什么选这份工作呀 你：一方面工资不错 另一方面离家也近 朋友：那同事关系怎么样 你：大家都挺友好的
on the other hand.example: Friend: Why did you pick this job? You: On the one hand, the pay is good, on the other hand, it's close to home. Friend: What about the colleagues? You: They're friendly too.

once in a while.context: 你朋友偶尔才约你吃一次饭，大家都挺忙的。
once in a while.translation: 朋友：你和老同学多久聚一次 你：偶尔聚一次 大家都忙 朋友：那下次组织个聚会 你：好 十一的时候约
once in a while.example: Friend: How often do you get together with old classmates? You: Once in a while, everyone's busy. Friend: Then organize a gathering next time. You: OK, around National Day.

one after the other.context: 老师发卷子，同学们一个接一个上去领。
one after the other.translation: 朋友：发卷子怎么领呀 你：大家一个接一个上去领 朋友：我坐最后一排 等到什么时候 你：别急 很快就到你
one after the other.example: Friend: How do we pick up the test papers? You: One after another, going up to get them. Friend: I sit in the last row, how long till me? You: Don't worry, it'll be your turn soon.

one another.context: 室友之间要互相帮忙，彼此照应。
one another.translation: 朋友：你和室友相处得怎么样 你：我们互相照顾 关系特别好 朋友：有没有闹过矛盾 你：偶尔有 说开就好
one another.example: Friend: How do you get along with your roommates? You: We help one another, we get along really well. Friend: Ever had a fight? You: Occasionally, talking it out fixes it.

or so.context: 朋友问你工资多少，你说大概一万左右吧。
or so.translation: 朋友：你一个月工资大概多少呀 你：也就一万左右吧 朋友：在这城市算什么水平 你：中等 够花而已
or so.example: Friend: About how much do you make a month? You: About ten thousand or so. Friend: What level is that here? You: Middle, just enough to live.

out of control.context: 酒后开车太危险，司机喝醉后车辆完全失控。
out of control.translation: 朋友：昨晚那个车祸怎么发生的 你：司机喝醉了 车完全失控了 朋友：人没事吧 你：撞护栏上了 还好没大事
out of control.example: Friend: How did last night's crash happen? You: The driver was drunk, the car went out of control. Friend: Is anyone OK? You: Hit the guardrail, luckily nothing serious.

out of date.context: 你那部手机已经用了五年，系统都更新不了，过时了。
out of date.translation: 朋友：你这手机怎么这么卡 你：用了五年了 早就过时了 朋友：那换个新的呗 你：是 正在看新款
out of date.example: Friend: Why is your phone so laggy? You: I've used it five years, it's out of date. Friend: Then get a new one. You: Yeah, looking at new models.

out of the question.context: 朋友约你周末去爬山，你说这周要加班，去不了。
out of the question.translation: 朋友：周末一起去爬山怎么样 你：这周要加班 是不可能去爬山的 朋友：那就下周再说吧 你：好 下周我们再约
out of the question.example: Friend: Want to go hiking this weekend? You: Going out this weekend is out of the question, I have to work overtime. Friend: Then next weekend. You: OK, next weekend.

over and over again.context: 朋友总重复听同一首歌，你听多了都会唱了。
over and over again.translation: 朋友：你怎么最近总放同一首歌 你：我特别喜欢 反复听好多遍 朋友：你不累吗 你：不呀 越听越有味道
over and over again.example: Friend: Why are you playing the same song lately? You: I love it, over and over again. Friend: Aren't you tired of it? You: No, the more I listen, the more I like it.

pick up.context: 你去国外生活半年就自然而然学会了当地语言。
pick up.translation: 朋友：你法语怎么说得这么好 你：在那边住了半年 自然就学会了 朋友：那也要看环境 你：对 天天用就熟了
pick up.example: Friend: How is your French so good? You: I lived there half a year and just picked it up. Friend: Environment matters. You: Yeah, using it every day makes you fluent.

play a role in.context: 体育锻炼在保持身体健康方面起着很重要的作用。
play a role in.translation: 朋友：怎么才能保持健康呀 你：规律锻炼在其中起很大作用 朋友：那一周练几次合适 你：三次 每次半小时
play a role in.example: Friend: How do you stay healthy? You: Regular exercise plays a big role in it. Friend: How many times a week? You: Three times, half an hour each.

plenty of.context: 自助餐厅里有很多水果和甜点，你随便吃。
plenty of.translation: 朋友：这自助餐价钱划算吗 你：很划算 有很多吃的 随便拿 朋友：那我要多吃点海鲜 你：去吧 吃回本
plenty of.example: Friend: Is this buffet worth the price? You: Good value, there's plenty of food, help yourself. Friend: Then I'll eat lots of seafood. You: Go for it, get your money's worth.

point of view.context: 朋友问你对这件事怎么看，你说从个人角度来说是支持的。
point of view.translation: 朋友：你对这个政策怎么看 你：从我的角度来说 我是支持的 朋友：为什么呢 你：它方便了普通人的生活
point of view.example: Friend: What do you think of this policy? You: From my point of view, I support it. Friend: Why? You: It makes life easier for ordinary people.

point out.context: 你提醒朋友那个时间不对，让他再确认一下。
point out.translation: 朋友：明天几点集合呀 你：你等一下 我指出一个问题 时间不对 朋友：啊 我记错了 你：是下午三点 不是上午
point out.example: Friend: What time do we meet tomorrow? You: Wait a second, let me point out something, the time is wrong. Friend: Oh, I misremembered. You: It's three in the afternoon, not morning.

prepare for.context: 明天就要考试了，你今晚赶紧复习准备着。
prepare for.translation: 朋友：明天考试你准备得怎么样 你：今晚赶紧复习 做好准备 朋友：有把握吗 你：七八成吧 再看看书
prepare for.example: Friend: How prepared are you for tomorrow's exam? You: Tonight I'll prepare for it by reviewing. Friend: Confident? You: About seventy percent, I'll read more.

pretend to.context: 小朋友假装自己是个超人，披着床单飞来飞去。
pretend to.translation: 朋友：你家孩子在干嘛呢 你：他假装自己是超人 披着床单飞 朋友：真可爱 几岁了 你：五岁 想象力特别丰富
pretend to.example: Friend: What is your kid doing? You: He pretends to be a superhero, flying around with a sheet cape. Friend: So cute, how old is he? You: Five, really imaginative.

prevent from doing.context: 下雨天人多路滑，管理员赶紧拦住大家别往前挤，防止摔倒。
prevent from doing.translation: 朋友：前面怎么那么拥挤 你：管理员拦着大家 防止发生危险 朋友：那我们绕路走吧 你：好 这边太挤了
prevent from doing.example: Friend: Why is it so crowded ahead? You: The staff is stopping everyone to prevent an accident. Friend: Then let's take a detour. You: OK, it's too crowded here.

protect from.context: 夏天出门涂防晒霜保护皮肤不被晒伤。
protect from.translation: 朋友：夏天去海边要注意什么 你：涂好防晒霜 保护皮肤不被晒伤 朋友：多久补一次 你：两小时补一次
protect from.example: Friend: What to watch at the beach in summer? You: Put on sunscreen to protect your skin from sunburn. Friend: How often to reapply? You: Every two hours.

proud of.context: 朋友拿了奖学金，全家人都为他感到骄傲。
proud of.translation: 朋友：你儿子这次考了年级第一 你：是啊 我们全家都为他骄傲 朋友：他真争气 你：对 没白努力
proud of.example: Friend: Your son got first in the grade. You: Yeah, we're so proud of him. Friend: He really delivered. You: Yeah, his hard work paid off.

put off.context: 朋友带你去吃一道奇怪的菜，你看了就倒胃口。
put off.translation: 朋友：这道菜你尝尝 特别有名 你：看着就没胃口 真不想吃 朋友：味道其实不错 你：算了 我点别的
put off.example: Friend: Try this dish, it's famous. You: Just looking at it puts me off eating. Friend: It actually tastes good. You: Forget it, I'll order something else.

put on.context: 出门前你先穿上外套，再照照镜子看看整齐不整齐。
put on.translation: 朋友：你今天出门怎么磨磨蹭蹭的 你：我先把外套穿上 再收拾一下头发 朋友：快点 电影要开场了 你：来了 马上就好
put on.example: Friend: Why are you taking so long to leave? You: I put on my coat first, then fix my hair. Friend: Hurry, the movie starts soon. You: Coming, almost ready.

put up.context: 朋友来你家借宿一晚，你把客房收拾出来给他住。
put up.translation: 朋友：今晚我能在你家凑合一晚吗 你：当然 我把客房收拾出来给你住 朋友：太谢谢你了 你：客气什么 睡客房就行
put up.example: Friend: Can I crash at your place tonight? You: Sure, I'll put up the guest room for you. Friend: Thanks a lot. You: Don't mention it, just sleep in the guest room.

quite a few.context: 这次活动来了不少人，大概有几十个，比预想的多。
quite a few.translation: 朋友：今天活动来了多少人呀 你：来了不少 大概有几十个 朋友：比预想的多吧 你：对 我们准备的小礼品都不够了
quite a few.example: Friend: How many people showed up today? You: Quite a few, quite a few came. Friend: More than expected? You: Yeah, the small gifts we prepared are running out.

rather than.context: 朋友问你周末是在家看书还是出门玩，你说看书比较好。
rather than.translation: 朋友：周末你想在家看书还是出去 你：在家看书 而不是出去玩 朋友：那多无聊 你：刚好有本想看的书
rather than.example: Friend: Do you want to read at home or go out this weekend? You: Read at home rather than going out. Friend: That sounds boring. You: I have a book I want to read.

rely on.context: 遇到困难、需要信任的人帮忙时，用它表示对方是你可以指望依靠的人。
rely on.translation: 朋友：这次小组作业我一个人肯定做不完 你：没关系，你可以依靠我，咱们一起分工 朋友：真的吗？我还怕你太忙没时间 你：放心吧，你随时都能依靠我
rely on.example: Friend: I definitely can't finish this group project alone. You: Don't worry, you can rely on me; let's split the work. Friend: Really? I was afraid you'd be too busy. You: Relax, you can rely on me anytime.

responsible for.context: 团队出了差错，开会时需要明确谁该为这件事担责，就用它指出负责人。
responsible for.translation: 朋友：这次活动海报好像把日期印错了 你：那部分是我负责设计的，我来负责改 朋友：要不要我帮你重新排个版 你：不用，这事儿由我负责，我今晚就修好
responsible for.example: Friend: The poster seems to have the wrong date printed. You: That part I was responsible for designing, so I'm responsible for fixing it. Friend: Want me to help rearrange the layout? You: No, I'm responsible for this, I'll fix it tonight.

right now.context: 朋友急着找你办事，你看了看时间，表示现在就得动身或立刻处理，就会脱口而出。
right now.translation: 朋友：你现在方便帮我看下这份合同吗 你：我手头正忙，但这事重要，我现在就看 朋友：不急的话你可以晚点再弄 你：不行，客户还在等回复，我得马上处理
right now.example: Friend: Is it convenient to look at this contract right now? You: I'm busy, but this matters, so I'll read it right now. Friend: If it's not urgent you can do it later. You: No, the client is still waiting, I must handle it right now.

run out of.context: 做饭做到一半发现调料没了，或者墨盒、电池用光了，就用它说明东西耗尽了。
run out of.translation: 朋友：今晚想吃你做的番茄意面 你：糟了，家里的面条刚用完，我得下楼买 朋友：顺便带瓶番茄酱回来呗 你：好，酱油也快用完了，我一起补上
run out of.example: Friend: I'd love your tomato pasta tonight. You: Oh no, we've run out of noodles, I need to buy some downstairs. Friend: Bring a bottle of tomato sauce by the way. You: OK, we're also running out of soy sauce, I'll restock both.

same as.context: 评价两家店、两件商品差不多时，用它表示两者没什么差别、基本等同。
same as.translation: 朋友：这家新开的咖啡店跟你常去的那家比怎么样 你：味道差不多，价格也基本一样 朋友：有什么特别饮品推荐吗 你：招牌拿铁跟别家的没什么区别，随便点都行
same as.example: Friend: How is this new coffee shop compared to your usual one? You: The taste is the same, and the price is basically the same. Friend: Any special drink to recommend? You: The latte is the same as others, order anything.

satisfied with.context: 拿到新发型、新换的手机或新做的报告，问对方是否满意时就用它。
satisfied with.translation: 朋友：你对这次剪的新发型还满意吗 你：挺满意的，理发师手艺比上次好 朋友：那就好，我还怕你嫌太短 你：不会，这个长度我刚好喜欢
satisfied with.example: Friend: Are you satisfied with this new haircut? You: Quite satisfied, the barber's skill is better than last time. Friend: Good, I was afraid you'd find it too short. You: Not at all, this length is just right for me.

scared of.context: 聊起谁怕狗、怕黑、怕坐飞机，或自己不敢做某件事时，用它说出顾虑。
scared of.translation: 朋友：你小时候是不是特别怕黑 你：对，我那时特别怕一个人睡在关灯的房间 朋友：现在呢，还怕吗 你：现在好多了，但看恐怖片还是会害怕
scared of.example: Friend: Were you especially scared of the dark as a kid? You: Yes, I was scared of sleeping alone in a dark room back then. Friend: And now, still scared? You: Much better now, but I'm still scared of horror movies.

search for.context: 在图书馆、网上翻找资料，或者丢了钥匙四处翻找时，用它说明在找什么。
search for.translation: 朋友：你在书架前翻来翻去，找什么呢 你：我在找一本关于英国历史的参考书 朋友：要不要我用电脑帮你检索一下 你：好啊，你帮我在数据库里搜搜看
search for.example: Friend: You've been rummaging by the bookshelf, what are you searching for? You: I'm searching for a reference book on British history. Friend: Want me to help you search on the computer? You: Sure, help me search in the database.

set off.context: 提到某个举动触发了连锁反应、警报或冲突时，用它表示“引发、点燃”。
set off.translation: 朋友：怎么楼上突然火警响了 你：估计是谁炒菜油烟太大，触发了烟雾报警器 朋友：人都跑出来了，不会真着火吧 你：别怕，就是一个小火星触发了警报
set off.example: Friend: Why did the fire alarm upstairs suddenly go off? You: Probably someone's cooking smoke set off the smoke alarm. Friend: Everyone ran out, is there really a fire? You: Don't worry, just a small spark set off the alarm.

set up.context: 聊起谁创办了公司、建了账号或搭了个社团时，用它表示“创办、建立”。
set up.translation: 朋友：你大学时那个创业项目现在还在吗 你：我和同学一起创办的工作室，去年刚注册 朋友：启动资金是哪里来的 你：一开始我们凑钱建立了这个小团队
set up.example: Friend: Is that startup from your college still running? You: The studio I set up with classmates just registered last year. Friend: Where did the starting money come from? You: At first we pooled money to set up this small team.

show off.context: 看到有人穿新鞋、换新车，故意在人前炫耀显摆时，就用它吐槽这种行为。
show off.translation: 朋友：他今天又换了块新表，一直在手腕上晃 你：他就是喜欢炫耀，生怕别人看不见 朋友：至于这么特意显摆吗 你：没办法，他一有新东西就爱炫耀
show off.example: Friend: He changed to a new watch again today, waving it on his wrist. You: He just loves to show off, afraid people won't notice. Friend: Is it necessary to show off like that? You: Can't help it, he loves to show off whenever he gets something new.

similar to.context: 拿两件事物作比较，说它们在外貌、性格或风格上相近时，用它表示“与……相似”。
similar to.translation: 朋友：你妹妹跟你小时候长得真像啊 你：好多人都说她跟我长得很相似 朋友：性格也跟你差不多吗 你：脾气倒是跟我完全不同
similar to.example: Friend: Your younger sister looks just like you did as a child. You: Many say she's similar to me in looks. Friend: Is her personality similar to yours too? You: Actually her temper is totally different from mine.

since then.context: 提起过去发生的某件事，说从那以后情况一直延续至今，就用它引出时间起点。
since then.translation: 朋友：你从什么时候开始坚持跑步的 你：自从上次马拉松受伤后，我就一直规律训练 朋友：那都有两三年了吧 你：对，从那以后我再也没中断过
since then.example: Friend: Since when did you start running regularly? You: Since I got injured in that marathon, I've trained regularly. Friend: That's two or three years now? You: Yes, since then I've never stopped.

slow down.context: 生活节奏太快、加班太多时，朋友劝你放慢脚步、别那么拼，就会用到它。
slow down.translation: 朋友：你最近天天加班，身体扛得住吗 你：我也知道该放慢节奏，可项目催得紧 朋友：周末就别工作了，让自己慢下来 你：你说得对，是时候放慢生活了
slow down.example: Friend: You work overtime every day lately, can your body take it? You: I know I should slow down, but the project is pressing. Friend: Don't work on weekends, slow down. You: You're right, it's time to slow down my life.

so far.context: 聊到某项工作、比赛或项目到目前为止的进展时，用它表示“到现在为止”。
so far.translation: 朋友：这个季度的销售目标完成得怎么样 你：到目前为止已经完成了七成 朋友：剩下的时间能赶得上吗 你：希望到现在的势头能保持下去
so far.example: Friend: How is this quarter's sales target going? You: So far we've completed seventy percent. Friend: Can you catch up in the remaining time? You: Hope this momentum so far keeps up.

so that.context: 为了让某个目的能够实现，特意安排或叮嘱，说明“为了、以便”时用它。
so that.translation: 朋友：你把手机铃声调那么小干嘛 你：把它调到静音，这样图书馆里就不会打扰别人 朋友：那有人找你怎么办 你：没事，我设了震动，这样就不会漏掉
so that.example: Friend: Why did you set your phone ringer so low? You: I set it to silent so that it won't disturb others in the library. Friend: What if someone looks for you? You: It's fine, I set vibration so that I won't miss calls.

soon after.context: 叙述一件事紧接着另一件事发生，说“不久之后”就用它引出后续事件。
soon after.translation: 朋友：他出院以后身体恢复得怎么样 你：出院没多久，不久之后就回来上班了 朋友：医生不是让他多休养吗 你：是啊，可他闲不住，没多久就回来了
soon after.example: Friend: How is his recovery after being discharged? You: Soon after leaving hospital, he came back to work. Friend: Didn't the doctor tell him to rest more? You: Yes, but he can't stay idle; soon after he was back.

sooner or later.context: 劝人正视问题、别逃避，说“迟早、早晚有一天”会轮到，就用它。
sooner or later.translation: 朋友：他总把该还的钱一拖再拖 你：躲是没用的，迟早得面对现实 朋友：万一他一直赖着呢 你：放心，迟早他得把账算清楚
sooner or later.example: Friend: He keeps putting off the money he should repay. You: Hiding won't help; sooner or later he must face reality. Friend: What if he keeps stalling? You: Don't worry, sooner or later he'll have to settle the accounts.

sound like.context: 听到某个声音、某段话或某人的描述，觉得“听起来像”什么时，就用它。
sound like.translation: 朋友：电话那头的声音你听出来是谁了吗 你：听起来像是你弟弟，跟你嗓音很像 朋友：对吧，他最近总学我说话 你：光凭声音，真的很像他
sound like.example: Friend: Did you recognize the voice on the phone? You: It sounds like your younger brother, very similar to yours. Friend: Right, he's been copying my way of talking lately. You: Just by the voice, it really sounds like him.

spare time.context: 聊起工作之余的时间怎么打发，问对方空闲时爱做什么，就用它。
spare time.translation: 朋友：你平时空闲时间都喜欢干什么 你：我一有空闲就去公园跑步 朋友：不看看剧或者打打游戏吗 你：很少，我更喜欢把空闲花在运动上
spare time.example: Friend: What do you like to do in your spare time? You: Whenever I have spare time I go running in the park. Friend: Don't you watch shows or play games? You: Rarely, I'd rather spend my spare time on sports.

speed up.context: 车太慢、进度太拖沓时，催促或自己决定“加快速度、提速”，就用它。
speed up.translation: 朋友：再不快一点，我们就赶不上火车了 你：好，我这就把脚步加快 朋友：行李我来拎，你先跑 你：行，咱们一起提速
speed up.example: Friend: If we don't hurry, we'll miss the train. You: OK, I'll speed up my steps right now. Friend: I'll carry the luggage, you run ahead. You: Fine, let's both speed up.

stand a chance.context: 评估一件成功概率不大的事，判断“有没有希望、能不能成”时，就用它。
stand a chance.translation: 朋友：你觉得他能应聘上那家公司吗 你：以他的学历，倒还有一点希望 朋友：可竞争那么激烈 你：不好说，但他至少还有机会
stand a chance.example: Friend: Do you think he'll get that job? You: With his degree, he still stands a chance. Friend: But the competition is so fierce. You: Hard to say, but at least he stands a chance.

stand up to.context: 面对不公或压力，鼓励人“勇敢抵抗、顶住”，或说某物“经得起考验”时用它。
stand up to.translation: 朋友：老板又把烂摊子推给我们了 你：这次我们不能再忍让，要勇敢顶回去 朋友：可直接对抗他不太好吧 你：该坚持的立场就得顶住
stand up to.example: Friend: The boss dumped another mess on us. You: This time we can't back down; we must stand up to it. Friend: But confronting him directly isn't great. You: We must stand up to the position we should hold.

stare at.context: 某人一直盯着你或盯着某样东西看，让你觉得不自在时，就用它描述这个动作。
stare at.translation: 朋友：那个穿黑衣服的人一直盯着你看 你：我注意到了，他为什么老盯着我看 朋友：要不咱们换个位置 你：行，被人一直盯着真不自在
stare at.example: Friend: That man in black keeps staring at you. You: I noticed, why does he keep staring at me? Friend: Want us to change seats? You: OK, it's uncomfortable being stared at.

start with.context: 做报告、点菜或开工时，说明“从哪一步、从什么开始”，就用它引出起点。
start with.translation: 朋友：这么多任务，我该从哪件做起 你：我们从最紧急的那件事开始 朋友：然后再按顺序推进 你：对，先从这一步开始
start with.example: Friend: With so many tasks, where should I start? You: Let's start with the most urgent one. Friend: Then move on in order? You: Right, let's start with this step.

stay away from.context: 提醒某人“远离、别靠近”某些不好的人或物，就用它划清界限。
stay away from.translation: 朋友：那家酒吧听说挺乱的 你：那你最好离它远一点 朋友：我也就是好奇想去看看 你：听我一句，还是远离那种地方为好
stay away from.example: Friend: That bar is said to be pretty rough. You: Then you'd better stay away from it. Friend: I'm just curious to take a look. You: Take my advice, better stay away from that place.

stay the same.context: 事物经过很久仍“保持原样、没变化”，就用它表达这种状态。
stay the same.translation: 朋友：这家老店的味道这么多年变了吗 你：菜单和口味基本都没变 朋友：装修呢，翻新过吗 你：没有，一切都还是老样子
stay the same.example: Friend: Has this old shop's taste changed over the years? You: The menu and taste have basically stayed the same. Friend: And the decoration, renovated? You: No, everything has stayed the same.

stay up.context: 复习考试、追剧或熬夜赶工，聊起谁“很晚还没睡、熬夜”，就用它。
stay up.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么顶着黑眼圈来上课 你：昨晚熬夜复习到三点 朋友：以后别老熬夜了，伤身体 你：没办法，考试在即只能熬夜
stay up.example: Friend: Why did you come to class with dark circles today? You: I stayed up late reviewing until three last night. Friend: Don't always stay up late, it's bad for you. You: Can't help it, exams are near so I had to stay up.

step by step.context: 学一项新技能或解一道难题，强调要“一步一步、循序渐进”，就用它。
step by step.translation: 朋友：这个软件功能太多，我一下子学不会 你：别急，咱们一步一步来 朋友：先从哪个部分开始 你：对，一步步慢慢来就好
step by step.example: Friend: This software has so many features, I can't learn it all at once. You: Don't rush, let's go step by step. Friend: Start with which part? You: Right, just take it step by step.

stick to.context: 决定遵守计划、不改初衷，或坚持吃某种饮食时，用它表示“坚守、不偏离”。
stick to.translation: 朋友：健身餐那么难吃，你能坚持下去吗 你：我既然定了计划，就会坚持到底 朋友：偶尔吃顿火锅没事吧 你：不行，这段时间必须管住嘴
stick to.example: Friend: The fitness meals are so bad, can you stick to them? You: Since I set the plan, I'll stick to it. Friend: Is a hotpot once in a while OK? You: No, I must stick to it this period.

stick with.context: 在多个选择中“坚持选用”某一个，比如一直用某个牌子、某个方法，就用它。
stick with.translation: 朋友：那么多笔记软件，你偏用这一个 你：我用顺手了，还是愿意继续用它 朋友：不试试别的吗 你：不了，我就一直用这个
stick with.example: Friend: With so many note apps, why do you stick with this one? You: It's become my habit, I'd rather stick with it. Friend: Not try others? You: No, I'll just stick with this one.

struggle with.context: 与某个困难、疾病或难题长期“较劲、努力应对”时，就用它描述这种过程。
struggle with.translation: 朋友：最近看你总对着那道数学题发愁 你：我已经跟它耗了一晚上了 朋友：要不要看看答案解析 你：不了，我想自己把它琢磨出来
struggle with.example: Friend: Lately you always look troubled by that math problem. You: I've been struggling with it all evening. Friend: Want to look at the answer explanation? You: No, I want to struggle through it myself.

study for.context: 为准备某次考试而专门复习，说明“为……而学习”时，就用它。
study for.translation: 朋友：周末图书馆怎么全是人 你：大家都在为下个月的考试复习 朋友：你也在备考吗 你：对，我正为英语考试做准备
study for.example: Friend: Why is the library full on weekends? You: Everyone's studying for next month's exam. Friend: Are you preparing too? You: Yes, I'm studying for the English exam.

such as.context: 举例说明、罗列具体事物时，用它引出“比如、例如”。
such as.translation: 朋友：你平时都爱喝什么饮料 你：我喜欢喝带气泡的，比如可乐和雪碧 朋友：茶类呢 你：偶尔也喝点，比如红茶
such as.example: Friend: What drinks do you usually like? You: I like fizzy ones, such as cola and sprite. Friend: And teas? You: Occasionally some, such as black tea.

suffer from.context: 长期受某种疾病或不快困扰，说“患有、遭受……之苦”时，就用它。
suffer from.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总皱眉揉太阳穴 你：我这阵子一直受头痛困扰 朋友：去看过医生了吗 你：还没，这种毛病真磨人
suffer from.example: Friend: Why do you always frown and rub your temples lately? You: I've been suffering from headaches these days. Friend: Have you seen a doctor? You: Not yet, this ailment is really annoying.

suitable for.context: 判断某物是否“适合”某个场合、某人或某种用途时，就用它。
suitable for.translation: 朋友：这条连衣裙适合我参加婚礼穿吗 你：颜色和款式都挺适合的 朋友：会不会太素了点 你：不会，正好适合那种正式场合
suitable for.example: Friend: Is this dress suitable for me to wear to a wedding? You: The color and style are quite suitable. Friend: Isn't it a bit too plain? You: Not at all, it's just suitable for that formal occasion.

sum up.context: 开会或听完一段讲解后，用几句话把要点“概括、总结”出来，就用它。
sum up.translation: 朋友：今天的会开了这么久，到底说了啥 你：我帮你把主要内容概括一下 朋友：快讲讲，我下午还有别的会 你：好，核心就是三件事
sum up.example: Friend: Today's meeting was so long, what did it actually say? You: Let me sum up the main points for you. Friend: Quick, I have another meeting this afternoon. You: OK, the core is just three things.

supposed to.context: 按规定或按理说“理应、应该”做某事，或本不该做却做了时，就用它。
supposed to.translation: 朋友：按课表今天我们应该八点到教室 你：可老师说这节课临时取消了 朋友：那我们能走了吗 你：别急，按理说还得等他通知
supposed to.example: Friend: According to the schedule we should arrive at eight today. You: But the teacher said this class is cancelled. Friend: Can we leave then? You: Hold on, we're supposed to wait for his notice.

switch off.context: 累到不想动脑，或者关掉电器让脑子“放空、断电”时，就用它。
switch off.translation: 朋友：你下班回来怎么一句话也不说 你：我脑子已经转不动了，只想放空 朋友：要不要我陪你聊聊 你：不用，我想安静地歇会儿
switch off.example: Friend: Why don't you say a word since coming back from work? You: My brain can't work anymore, I just want to switch off. Friend: Want me to chat with you? You: No, I want to switch off quietly for a while.

switch on.context: 打开电器、设备让它运行，或形容人对新鲜事物“跟得上、时髦”时，就用它。
switch on.translation: 朋友：投影仪怎么没画面 你：你忘了把机器打开了 朋友：哦，电源在哪儿来着 你：按这个键就能把它打开
switch on.example: Friend: Why is there no picture on the projector? You: You forgot to switch the machine on. Friend: Oh, where is the power button? You: Press this key to switch it on.

take away.context: 把桌上的东西“拿走、收走”，或者饭后叫外卖“打包带走”时，就用它。
take away.translation: 朋友：这桌菜还剩不少，能打包吗 你：服务员，帮我们把剩下的打包带走 朋友：别浪费了 你：好，我把这些也一起拿走
take away.example: Friend: Quite a lot left on the table, can we take it away? You: Waiter, help us take away the leftovers. Friend: Don't waste it. You: OK, I'll take these away too.

take care.context: 告别时叮嘱对方“保重、小心”，或提醒做事要“留神”时，就用它。
take care.translation: 朋友：那我先下班回家了 你：路上注意安全，好好保重 朋友：你也是，记得早点休息 你：好，咱们回头见，多保重
take care.example: Friend: I'm leaving work now. You: Be careful on the way, take care. Friend: You too, remember to rest early. You: OK, see you later, take care.

take care of.context: 照顾生病的人、看管宠物，或负责处理某件杂事时，就用它表示“照料、负责”。
take care of.translation: 朋友：你出差这几天，猫怎么办 你：拜托你帮我照顾它几天 朋友：喂食和铲屎我都包了 你：谢谢，就靠你照看了
take care of.example: Friend: What about the cat while you're on a business trip? You: Please take care of it for me a few days. Friend: Feeding and cleaning the litter are on me. You: Thanks, I rely on you to take care of it.

take control of.context: 局面失控时站出来“接管、掌控”局面，或自己开车掌握方向时，就用它。
take control of.translation: 朋友：项目乱成一锅粥，没人管了 你：那我来接管这件事吧 朋友：你顶得住吗 你：放心，我会把局面控制住
take control of.example: Friend: The project is a mess, no one's in charge. You: Then let me take control of it. Friend: Can you handle it? You: Relax, I'll take control of the situation.

take in.context: 做深呼吸、或把某件事“理解、领会”进去，以及收留无家可归者时，就用它。
take in.translation: 朋友：考试前我总紧张得喘不过气 你：你先深吸一口气，慢慢呼出来 朋友：这样真的有用吗 你：试试，把空气深深吸入再放松
take in.example: Friend: Before exams I'm always too nervous to breathe. You: First take in a deep breath, then breathe out slowly. Friend: Does this really help? You: Try it, take in the air deeply then relax.

take off.context: 聊起某个产品、账号或艺人“突然走红、爆红”，或飞机起飞、脱衣服时，就用它。
take off.translation: 朋友：他那条短视频怎么一下子火了 你：自从被大号转发后，他真的爆红了 朋友：现在涨粉涨得快吗 你：对，账号一起飞就停不下来
take off.example: Friend: Why did that short video of his suddenly blow up? You: Ever since a big account shared it, he really took off. Friend: Is follower growth fast now? You: Yes, the account really took off and won't stop.

take on.context: 主动“承担、接下”一项责任或工作，或公司新招人手时，就用它。
take on.translation: 朋友：这个新项目没人愿意接 你：没关系，我愿意承担下来 朋友：你不怕太累吗 你：没事，我想多承担一些挑战
take on.example: Friend: No one wants to take on this new project. You: It's fine, I'm willing to take it on. Friend: Aren't you afraid it's too tiring? You: No, I want to take on more challenges.

take out.context: 把钱从账户取出、约人出去，或把鱼刺等“取出、剔除”时，就用它。
take out.translation: 朋友：这周末有空一起出去吃个饭吗 你：好啊，我请你出去吃 朋友：去哪一家 你：我先把钱取出来，再定地方
take out.example: Friend: Free to go out for a meal this weekend? You: Sure, I'll take you out to eat. Friend: Which place? You: I'll first take out some cash, then decide the spot.

take over.context: 老员工离职、新人“接替、接管”岗位，或某产品取代旧款时，就用它。
take over.translation: 朋友：老张退休后，这摊工作谁来管 你：领导安排我来接管他的工作 朋友：你接得过来吗 你：慢慢交接，我会把它接好
take over.example: Friend: After Old Zhang retires, who'll take over this work? You: The boss arranged for me to take over his job. Friend: Can you handle it? You: Hand over slowly, I'll take it over well.

take part in.context: 号召或询问某人“参加、参与”某项活动、比赛时，就用它。
take part in.translation: 朋友：学校下周有个英语演讲比赛 你：真的吗，我想参加 朋友：报名的人可多了 你：不管人多不多，我都要参与一下
take part in.example: Friend: There's an English speech contest at school next week. You: Really, I want to take part in it. Friend: Lots of people are signing up. You: No matter how many, I want to take part in it.

take place.context: 询问或说明某个活动、会议“何时何地举行、发生”时，就用它。
take place.translation: 朋友：年度公司大会什么时候开 你：它将在下个月的礼堂举行 朋友：地点定了吗 你：对，会议就在主会场举行
take place.example: Friend: When is the annual company meeting? You: It will take place in the auditorium next month. Friend: Is the venue set? You: Yes, the meeting takes place in the main hall.

take pride in.context: 为自己或他人的成就“感到自豪、引以为傲”时，就用它。
take pride in.translation: 朋友：你女儿这次比赛拿了一等奖 你：真的吗，我真为她感到骄傲 朋友：她练得可辛苦了 你：是啊，我为她的努力感到自豪
take pride in.example: Friend: Your daughter won first prize in the contest. You: Really, I take pride in her so much. Friend: She practiced so hard. You: Yes, I take pride in her effort.

take up.context: 某件家具、活动“占去”空间或时间，或开始学某项爱好时，就用它。
take up.translation: 朋友：这张新沙发占地方太大了 你：是啊，它把客厅占去不少空间 朋友：还摆得下茶几吗 你：摆不下了，它太占地方
take up.example: Friend: This new sofa takes up too much space. You: Yes, it takes up a lot of the living room. Friend: Can the coffee table still fit? You: No, it takes up too much room.

tend to.context: 描述某人有“照料、照看”的习惯，或某事“往往会、倾向于”发生时，就用它。
tend to.translation: 朋友：你奶奶在养老院有人照料吗 你：护工每天会照料她的起居 朋友：她身体硬朗吗 你：年纪大了，往往会忘事
tend to.example: Friend: Is your grandmother cared for at the nursing home? You: The staff tend to her daily life. Friend: Is she still strong? You: At her age, she tends to forget things.

thanks to.context: 把成功或好结果“归功于、多亏了”某人某事时，就用它。
thanks to.translation: 朋友：你这次怎么进步这么快 你：多亏了你每天陪我练 朋友：我也没帮多少忙 你：真的，多亏你的帮助
thanks to.example: Friend: How did you improve so fast this time? You: Thanks to you practicing with me every day. Friend: I didn't help much. You: Really, thanks to your help.

that is.context: 把刚才说的话换个说法、“也就是说、即”解释一遍时，就用它。
that is.translation: 朋友：你说的那个截止日是什么时候 你：就是本周五，也就是这周末前 朋友：那不就剩三天了吗 你：对，就是这个意思
that is.example: Friend: When is that deadline you mentioned? You: This Friday, that is, before the weekend. Friend: That leaves only three days? You: Right, that is what I mean.

the number of.context: 讨论某个可数事物的“数量、数目”本身时，就用它（谓语用单数）。
the number of.translation: 朋友：报名参加活动的人有多少 你：参与的人数还在统计 朋友：比去年多吗 你：今年的人数明显增加了
the number of.example: Friend: How many signed up for the event? You: The number of participants is still being counted. Friend: More than last year? You: The number this year has clearly increased.

the opposite of.context: 对比两个完全相反的概念，说“与……相反”时，就用它。
the opposite of.translation: 朋友：你觉得冷和热是什么关系 你：冷就是热的反面 朋友：那快和慢呢 你：慢正好是快的反义词
the opposite of.example: Friend: What's the relationship between cold and hot? You: Cold is the opposite of hot. Friend: And fast and slow? You: Slow is the opposite of fast.

the other day.context: 回忆“前几天、几天前”发生的某件事，不需要确切日期时，就用它。
the other day.translation: 朋友：我前几天在商场好像看见你了 你：对，前几天我去那边买东西了 朋友：跟谁一起去的 你：就我一个人，前几天去的
the other day.example: Friend: I think I saw you at the mall the other day. You: Yes, the other day I went there shopping. Friend: With whom? You: Just me; I went the other day.

the rest of.context: 把剩下的、其余的部分留给别人或留到以后时，就用它。
the rest of.translation: 朋友：这块蛋糕你先吃 你：好，剩下的你帮我收起来 朋友：就这么点了 你：对，剩下的给我妈
the rest of.example: Friend: Have this piece of cake first. You: OK, put the rest of it away for me. Friend: There's only this little left. You: Right, the rest of it is for my mom.

these days.context: 描述“如今、最近这段日子”的普遍现象或自己的状态时，就用它。
these days.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总熬夜 你：最近这阵子项目多，没办法 朋友：大家都这样吗 你：是啊，如今加班的人不少
these days.example: Friend: Why do you always stay up lately? You: These days there are many projects, no way out. Friend: Is everyone like this? You: Yes, these days many people work overtime.

think about.context: 认真“考虑、思索”一个决定，或回忆起某件事时，就用它。
think about.translation: 朋友：那份工作邀约你考虑得怎么样 你：我还在认真考虑当中 朋友：总得给人家个答复 你：给我两天时间，我再想想
think about.example: Friend: How is your thinking about that job offer? You: I'm still thinking about it carefully. Friend: You must give them an answer. You: Give me two days, I'll think about it more.

think of.context: “想起、想到”某个人或主意，或评价某事“觉得怎样”时，就用它。
think of.translation: 朋友：你刚才愣什么神呢 你：我突然想起了老家的外婆 朋友：想给她打个电话吗 你：对，我正想着呢
think of.example: Friend: What were you spacing out about just now? You: I suddenly thought of my grandma back home. Friend: Want to call her? You: Yes, I was thinking of doing that.

thousands of.context: 形容数量极多，“成千上万、数以千计”时，就用它。
thousands of.translation: 朋友：演唱会现场来了多少人 你：好几千人挤满了广场 朋友：有那么夸张吗 你：真的，成千上万的人
thousands of.example: Friend: How many people came to the concert? You: Thousands of people crowded the square. Friend: Is it that exaggerated? You: Really, thousands of people.

throw away.context: 把没用的东西“扔掉、丢弃”，或浪费机会时，就用它。
throw away.translation: 朋友：这堆旧报纸还留着吗 你：没用了，把它扔掉吧 朋友：可回收的别乱丢 你：好，该扔的扔，该留的留
throw away.example: Friend: Are we keeping this pile of old newspapers? You: They're useless, throw them away. Friend: Don't toss the recyclables. You: OK, throw away what's useless, keep the rest.

to start with.context: 开口谈一件事时，用它“首先、一开始”引出第一点。
to start with.translation: 朋友：你为什么不喜欢这份工作 你：首先，工资就太低 朋友：还有呢 你：其次，通勤也太远
to start with.example: Friend: Why don't you like this job? You: To start with, the pay is just too low. Friend: Anything else? You: Also, the commute is too long.

together with.context: 把某人或某物“连同、和……一起”算进来时，就用它。
together with.translation: 朋友：这次出游就咱俩吗 你：我还想带我妹妹一起 朋友：那行李得多带一份 你：对，连同她的东西一起准备
together with.example: Friend: Just the two of us on this trip? You: I want to bring my younger sister along. Friend: Then pack an extra set of luggage. You: Right, prepare together with her things.

traffic jam.context: 路上堵得一动不动，吐槽“堵车、塞车”时，就用它。
traffic jam.translation: 朋友：你怎么迟到了半小时 你：路上遇到大堵车，走不动 朋友：哪一段堵得最厉害 你：高架上堵成了一条龙
traffic jam.example: Friend: Why are you half an hour late? You: I hit a terrible traffic jam on the way. Friend: Which stretch was worst? You: The elevated road was one long traffic jam.

traffic light.context: 等红灯、过路口，聊起“红绿灯、交通灯”时，就用它。
traffic light.translation: 朋友：刚才那个路口你怎么没减速 你：我看见灯绿就直接开过去了 朋友：那灯明明是红的 你：真的吗，我没注意到交通灯
traffic light.example: Friend: Why didn't you slow down at that intersection? You: I saw the light was green and drove through. Friend: That light was clearly red. You: Really? I didn't notice the traffic light.

travel around.context: 计划假期“四处旅行、周游各地”时，就用它。
travel around.translation: 朋友：暑假你打算怎么过 你：我想周游一下云南 朋友：去哪些地方 你：先环游几个古城再说
travel around.example: Friend: How do you plan to spend summer vacation? You: I want to travel around Yunnan. Friend: Which places? You: First travel around a few old towns.

try on.context: 在服装店拿起新衣“试穿”，合不合适试了才知道，就用它。
try on.translation: 朋友：这条裙子你看怎么样 你：我先去试衣间试穿一下 朋友：合身吗 你：穿上才知道好不好看
try on.example: Friend: What do you think of this skirt? You: Let me try it on in the fitting room first. Friend: Does it fit? You: Only after I try it on will I know.

try out.context: 试用新产品、新方法，或参加选拔“试镜、试训”时，就用它。
try out.translation: 朋友：这款新跑鞋你买了吗 你：还没，我想先试穿一下再说 朋友：实体店能试吗 你：能，我先试用看看合脚不
try out.example: Friend: Did you buy these new running shoes? You: Not yet, I want to try them out first. Friend: Can you try in the store? You: Yes, I'll try them out to see if they fit.

turn down.context: 婉拒别人的邀请、工作机会，或把音量“调小”时，就用它。
turn down.translation: 朋友：那家公司给你发offer了 你：可我已经婉拒了 朋友：这么好的机会为什么拒掉 你：薪资不合适，只能拒绝
turn down.example: Friend: That company sent you an offer? You: But I already turned it down. Friend: Why turn down such a good chance? You: The pay didn't fit, so I had to turn it down.

turn into.context: 某物“变成、转变成”另一种样子，或把房间改成别的用途时，就用它。
turn into.translation: 朋友：小时候的空地现在怎么样了 你：它已经变成了一个停车场 朋友：变化真大 你：是啊，旧貌换了新颜
turn into.example: Friend: What happened to that vacant lot from childhood? You: It has turned into a parking lot. Friend: What a big change. You: Yes, it turned into something new.

turn off.context: 离开房间前“关掉”电器，或对某人突然“失去兴趣”时，就用它。
turn off.translation: 朋友：出门前检查一下灯关了没 你：我已经把灯和空调都关了 朋友：电脑呢 你：放心，都关好了
turn off.example: Friend: Before leaving, check if the lights are off. You: I've already turned off the lights and the AC. Friend: And the computer? You: Relax, all turned off.

turn out.context: 事情的结果“到头来、结果是”怎样，或把衣服翻面、赶人出去时，就用它。
turn out.translation: 朋友：这次比赛结果怎么样 你：没想到我们竟然拿了第一 朋友：真的假的 你：是啊，结果出乎意料
turn out.example: Friend: How did the contest turn out? You: Unexpectedly, we turned out to take first place. Friend: Really? You: Yes, it turned out quite surprising.

turn over.context: 翻身、翻动书页，或把生意“移交、交给”对方时，就用它。
turn over.translation: 朋友：你昨晚怎么没睡好 你：夜里翻来覆去睡不着 朋友：是心里有事吗 你：嗯，翻个身都醒
turn over.example: Friend: Why didn't you sleep well last night? You: I turned over in bed restlessly all night. Friend: Something on your mind? You: Yes, every time I turned over I woke up.

turn to.context: 遇到困难“求助于、找……帮忙”，或翻到书的某一页时，就用它。
turn to.translation: 朋友：这道题我怎么也解不出 你：你可以去问老师 朋友：不好意思老麻烦他 你：实在没辙时就找他帮忙
turn to.example: Friend: I can't solve this problem no matter what. You: You can turn to the teacher. Friend: Embarrassing to bother him all the time. You: When you're truly stuck, turn to him for help.

turn up.context: 人“出现、露面”，或把音量“调大”，以及衣服袖子卷起时，就用它。
turn up.translation: 朋友：约好的人怎么还没来 你：再等等，他总会出现的 朋友：都半小时了 你：别急，人马上就到
turn up.example: Friend: Why hasn't the person we arranged to meet shown up? You: Wait more, he'll turn up eventually. Friend: It's been half an hour. You: Don't worry, he'll turn up soon.

under pressure.context: deadlines、业绩压身，形容“身处压力之下”还得表现时，就用它。
under pressure.translation: 朋友：看你最近脸色不太好 你：项目截止在即，压力山大 朋友：能扛得住吗 你：没办法，只能顶着压力干
under pressure.example: Friend: You don't look well lately. You: The deadline is near, I'm under great pressure. Friend: Can you handle it? You: No way out, I must perform under pressure.

up to.context: “由……决定”、数量“高达”、或正忙于某事时，就用它。
up to.translation: 朋友：今晚吃火锅还是烧烤 你：吃什么由你决定 朋友：那我可点辣的了 你：行，怎么定都行
up to.example: Friend: Hotpot or BBQ tonight? You: It's up to you what to eat. Friend: Then I'll order spicy. You: OK, whatever you decide.

upside down.context: 东西倒放、翻个底朝天，形容“上下颠倒”时，就用它。
upside down.translation: 朋友：你把那幅画挂反了 你：真的吗，我看一下 朋友：整个都挂倒了 你：难怪看着别扭
upside down.example: Friend: You hung that picture upside down. You: Really? Let me check. Friend: It's hung upside down. You: No wonder it looked odd.

use up.context: 把资源、精力“用光、耗尽”时，就用它。
use up.translation: 朋友：打印机怎么突然没墨了 你：墨盒刚被用光了 朋友：还有备用的吗 你：没了，全用完了
use up.example: Friend: Why did the printer suddenly run out of ink? You: The cartridge has just been used up. Friend: Any spare? You: No, it's all used up.

used to.context: 回忆过去“曾经、过去常常”做某事，如今已不这样了，就用它。
used to.translation: 朋友：你以前是不是住城南 你：对，我以前常住在那边 朋友：现在搬哪了 你：早搬到城北了
used to.example: Friend: Did you use to live in the south of the city? You: Yes, I used to live over there. Friend: Where now? You: I moved to the north long ago.

walk away.context: 对某事失望、不再纠缠，“转身离开、抽身而退”时，就用它。
walk away.translation: 朋友：那场吵架你怎么一声不吭就走了 你：我懒得争，干脆走开了 朋友：不觉得憋屈吗 你：与其吵，不如走人
walk away.example: Friend: Why did you walk away silently in that argument? You: I couldn't be bothered arguing, so I walked away. Friend: Don't you feel wronged? You: Better walk away than argue.

warm up.context: 运动前“热身”，或冷场、冷机器“预热”时，就用它。
warm up.translation: 朋友：打球前先活动活动 你：对，我们先热身几分钟 朋友：直接打不行吗 你：不热身容易受伤
warm up.example: Friend: Warm up before playing ball. You: Right, let's warm up for a few minutes. Friend: Can't we just start playing? You: Without warming up you can easily get hurt.

warn against.context: 善意提醒某人“别做某事、当心……”，以免吃亏，就用它。
warn against.translation: 朋友：那条路上的坑挺深的 你：那我得提醒他当心 朋友：你怎么提醒的 你：我警告他别靠近那个地方
warn against.example: Friend: The potholes on that road are quite deep. You: Then I must warn him against them. Friend: How did you warn him? You: I warned him against going near that spot.

watch out.context: 路上有坑、有车，突然提醒对方“当心、小心”时，就用它。
watch out.translation: 朋友：小心脚下，那里有块冰 你：哎呀，差点滑倒 朋友：走路看着点 你：谢谢你提醒
watch out.example: Friend: Watch out under your feet, there's ice. You: Oh, I almost slipped. Friend: Watch where you walk. You: Thanks for the warning.

watch out for.context: 提醒对方“留意、提防”某个具体的人、事或物时，就用它。
watch out for.translation: 朋友：这一片骗子挺多的 你：那我得多加提防 朋友：尤其是上门推销的 你：好，我会小心这类人
watch out for.example: Friend: There are many scammers around here. You: Then I must watch out for them. Friend: Especially door-to-door salespeople. You: OK, I'll watch out for such people.

what about.context: 向对方提建议、或反问“……怎么样、……呢”时，就用它。
what about.translation: 朋友：周末去爬山怎么样 你：爬山有点累，那游泳呢 朋友：游泳也行 你：那就定游泳吧
what about.example: Friend: How about going hiking this weekend? You: Hiking is tiring; what about swimming? Friend: Swimming works too. You: Then let's settle on swimming.

what if.context: 设想某种假设情况，“万一、要是……怎么办”时，就用它。
what if.translation: 朋友：万一明天突然下雨怎么办 你：那我们就改室内活动 朋友：备选方案想好了吗 你：想好了，万一下雨就去看电影
what if.example: Friend: What if it suddenly rains tomorrow? You: Then we'll switch to indoor activities. Friend: Got a backup plan? You: Yes; what if it rains, we'll watch a movie.

what is more.context: 补充递进一层意思，“而且、更有甚者”，就用它。
what is more.translation: 朋友：这份工作工资低吗 你：不但工资低，而且还经常加班 朋友：那还干着干嘛 你：就是，更别提年终奖了
what is more.example: Friend: Is the pay for this job low? You: Not only is the pay low, but what is more, overtime is constant. Friend: Then why stay? You: Exactly; what is more, the year-end bonus is negligible.

what's more.context: 口语版的递进，“而且、更重要的是”，补充理由时就用它。
what's more.translation: 朋友：你为什么不租那间房 你：它采光太差，而且离地铁远 朋友：还有别的吗 你：对，更重要的是租金太贵
what's more.example: Friend: Why didn't you rent that room? You: The lighting is poor, and what's more, it's far from the subway. Friend: Anything else? You: Yes, what's more, the rent is too high.

when it comes to.context: 引出某个话题，“说到、就……而言”，尤其谈专长或难题时，就用它。
when it comes to.translation: 朋友：你数学怎么样 你：说到数学，我可就犯难了 朋友：英语呢 你：论英语我还挺自信
when it comes to.example: Friend: How's your math? You: When it comes to math, I'm in trouble. Friend: And English? You: When it comes to English, I'm quite confident.

why not.context: 热情地向对方提议“为什么不……呢、何不”，就用它。
why not.translation: 朋友：今晚要不一起看个电影 你：好啊，为什么不呢 朋友：那我订票了 你：行，何乐而不为
why not.example: Friend: Want to watch a movie together tonight? You: Sure, why not? Friend: Then I'll book tickets. You: OK, why not indeed.

with the help of.context: 在某人“帮助下、借助”某物完成了某事，就用它。
with the help of.translation: 朋友：你英语口语进步这么快 你：多亏了老师的帮助 朋友：他怎么帮你的 你：在他的帮助下我敢开口了
with the help of.example: Friend: Your spoken English improved so fast. You: Thanks to the help of my teacher. Friend: How did he help you? You: With the help of him, I dare to speak.

work as.context: 介绍自己或他人“从事、担任”什么职业，就用它。
work as.translation: 朋友：你现在做什么工作 你：我在一家公司当翻译 朋友：具体做什么岗位 你：我做英语翻译
work as.example: Friend: What do you do for a living now? You: I work as a translator at a company. Friend: What exactly? You: I work as an English translator.

work on.context: 正在“打磨、钻研、从事”某件作品或技能，就用它。
work on.translation: 朋友：你最近在忙什么 你：我在打磨我的演讲技巧 朋友：有进展吗 你：一直在练习
work on.example: Friend: What have you been busy with lately? You: I'm working on my speaking skills. Friend: Any progress? You: I've been working on it nonstop.

work out.context: 去健身房“锻炼”，或问题“解决、算出”结果，就用它。
work out.translation: 朋友：你今天气色不错 你：我刚在健身房锻炼完 朋友：天天都去吗 你：隔天练一次
work out.example: Friend: You look great today. You: I just finished working out at the gym. Friend: Go every day? You: I work out every other day.

worry about.context: 为某人或某事“担心、焦虑”，劝人别多想时，就用它。
worry about.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老皱眉 你：我总担心这次考试 朋友：尽力就好，别太焦虑 你：可我就是放心不下
worry about.example: Friend: Why do you always frown lately? You: I always worry about this exam. Friend: Do your best, don't worry too much. You: But I just can't stop worrying.

year after year.context: 形容某情形“年复一年、年年如此”地重复，就用它。
year after year.translation: 朋友：你们家乡的气候怎么样 你：年复一年都是这样，四季分明 朋友：不觉得腻吗 你：习惯了，年年都这样
year after year.example: Friend: How's the climate in your hometown? You: Year after year it's like this, with four clear seasons. Friend: Don't you get bored? You: Used to it; year after year it's the same.

zoom in.context: 用相机、手机“拉近、放大”画面看清细节，就用它。
zoom in.translation: 朋友：这张照片远处的字看不清 你：我放大看看 朋友：能看清吗 你：拉近一看就清楚了
