zoom in.example: Friend: The words in the distance in this photo are unclear. You: Let me zoom in. Friend: Can you see? You: Zoom in and it's clear.

wait for.context: 在车站、门口“等待”某人或车，就用它。
wait for.translation: 朋友：你在这儿干嘛 你：我在等朋友 朋友：等多久了 你：等了十分钟
wait for.example: Friend: What are you doing here? You: I'm waiting for a friend. Friend: How long? You: Waiting for her for ten minutes.

be late for.translation: 朋友：你怎么又迟到了 你：路上堵车了 朋友：下次早点出门 你：知道了，再也不迟到
be late for.example: Friend: Why are you late again? You: There was traffic on the way. Friend: Leave earlier next time. You: Got it, I'll never be late for class.

be good at.translation: 朋友：你乒乓球打得真好 你：我从小就擅长打球 朋友：能教教我吗 你：行啊
be good at.example: Friend: You play ping-pong so well. You: I've been good at it since childhood. Friend: Can you teach me? You: Sure, I'm good at ping-pong.

be interested in.context: “对……感兴趣”，聊爱好和好奇的事物，就用它。
be interested in.translation: 朋友：你业余时间喜欢什么 你：我对历史很感兴趣 朋友：最近看什么书 你：读了不少相关的书
be interested in.example: Friend: What do you like in your spare time? You: I'm interested in history. Friend: What book lately? You: I'm interested in history and read a lot.

be afraid of.context: “害怕、畏惧”某事或某物，就用它。
be afraid of.translation: 朋友：你怕不怕狗 你：我特别怕狗 朋友：为什么 你：小时候被吓过
be afraid of.example: Friend: Are you afraid of dogs? You: I'm especially afraid of dogs. Friend: Why? You: I'm afraid of dogs because I was scared as a kid.

be angry with.context: 对某人生气，“生……的气”，就用它。
be angry with.translation: 朋友：你怎么不理人 你：我还在生他的气 朋友：至于吗 你：他说话太气人
be angry with.example: Friend: Why are you ignoring people? You: I'm still angry with him. Friend: Is it worth it? You: I'm angry with him because he was rude.

be worried about.translation: 朋友：你这几天怎么愁眉苦脸 你：我担心这次面试 朋友：准备得怎么样了 你：还是不放心
be worried about.example: Friend: Why the long face these days? You: I'm worried about this interview. Friend: How's the prep? You: I'm still worried about it.

be different from.translation: 朋友：你跟你姐性格像吗 你：我们完全不同 朋友：怎么个不同法 你：她外向，我内向
be different from.example: Friend: Are you like your sister in personality? You: We're different from each other. Friend: How so? You: We're different from each other; she's outgoing, I'm not.

on duty.context: 老师、保安“值班、值日”，就用它。
on duty.translation: 朋友：今天谁值日 你：我今天值班 朋友：要做什么 你：打扫教室
on duty.example: Friend: Who's on duty today? You: I'm on duty today. Friend: What to do? You: I'm on duty and clean the classroom.

by bus.context: 出行方式“乘公交”（无冠词），就用它。
by bus.translation: 朋友：你怎么上班 你：我坐公交 朋友：堵不堵 你：还行
by bus.example: Friend: How do you get to work? You: I go by bus. Friend: Is it jammed? You: Going by bus is fine.

make a mistake.translation: 朋友：这次报表怎么对不上 你：我算错了一个数 朋友：改过来就行 你：下次注意
make a mistake.example: Friend: Why doesn't this report add up? You: I made a mistake in one figure. Friend: Just fix it. You: I made a mistake; I'll watch out.

take turns.context: 两人或多人“轮流”做某事，就用它。
take turns.translation: 朋友：谁先玩这个游戏 你：咱们轮流来 朋友：我先来 你：行，轮流玩
take turns.example: Friend: Who plays this game first? You: Let's take turns. Friend: I'll go first. You: OK, take turns.

turn on.translation: 朋友：屋里怎么这么黑 你：我把灯打开 朋友：电视呢 你：一起开
turn on.example: Friend: Why is it so dark in here? You: I'll turn on the light. Friend: And the TV? You: Turn on both.

put away.context: 用完东西“收好、放好”，就用它。
put away.translation: 朋友：玩具别扔一地 你：我这就收起来 朋友：养成习惯 你：用完归位
put away.example: Friend: Don't leave toys all over. You: I'll put them away now. Friend: Make it a habit. You: Put things away after use.

hurry up.translation: 朋友：要迟到了！ 你：来了来了 朋友：快点收拾 你：马上好
hurry up.example: Friend: We're going to be late! You: Coming. Friend: Hurry up and pack. You: Hurrying up, almost done.

write down.context: 怕忘记，把要点“写下、记下来”，就用它。
write down.translation: 朋友：你说的号码是多少 你：我记一下 朋友：别回头忘了 你：写下来就好
write down.example: Friend: What's the number you said? You: Let me write it down. Friend: Don't forget later. You: I'll write it down.

be able to.context: 表示“能够、有能力”做某事（可用于多种时态），就用它。
be able to.translation: 朋友：你会修电脑吗 你：我能帮你看看 朋友：现在有空吗 你：可以
be able to.example: Friend: Can you fix computers? You: I'll be able to take a look. Friend: Free now? You: I'm able to right now.

be anxious about.context: 为结果、成绩“焦虑不安”，就用它。
be anxious about.translation: 朋友：你这两天寝食难安 你：我担心面试结果 朋友：放宽心 你：可我就是焦虑
be anxious about.example: Friend: You haven't eaten or slept well lately. You: I'm anxious about the interview result. Friend: Relax. You: I'm anxious about it.

be bad for.context: “对……有害、不利”，劝人别做，就用它。
be bad for.translation: 朋友：他天天抽烟 你：抽烟对肺不好 朋友：劝过他吗 你：说过
be bad for.example: Friend: He smokes every day. You: Smoking is bad for the lungs. Friend: Did you tell him? You: Smoking is bad for him; I told him.

be born in.translation: 朋友：你出生在哪里 你：我出生在广州 朋友：哪一年 你：2000年
be born in.example: Friend: Where were you born? You: I was born in Guangzhou. Friend: What year? You: I was born in 2000.

be busy doing.translation: 朋友：周末有空吗 你：我正忙着赶报告 朋友：什么时候忙完 你：这周末
be busy doing.example: Friend: Free this weekend? You: I'm busy finishing a report. Friend: When will you finish? You: I'm busy doing it this weekend.

be careful of.context: “小心、当心”某物或某种危险，就用它。
be careful of.translation: 朋友：地上有冰 你：我会当心脚下 朋友：别滑倒 你：好
be careful of.example: Friend: There's ice on the ground. You: I'll be careful of my step. Friend: Don't slip. You: I'll be careful of the ice.

be covered with.translation: 朋友：一夜之间变白了 你：地上全是雪 朋友：真漂亮 你：到处白花花的
be covered with.example: Friend: It turned white overnight. You: The ground is covered with snow. Friend: So beautiful. You: Everything is covered with snow.

be eager to.translation: 朋友：你这么期待放假 你：我早就想出去玩了 朋友：去哪 你：海边
be eager to.example: Friend: You're so looking forward to the holiday. You: I'm eager to go out. Friend: Where? You: I'm eager to go to the beach.

be famous as.translation: 朋友：他是干什么出名的 你：他作为作家出名 朋友：写过什么 你：小说
be famous as.example: Friend: What is he famous for? You: He's famous as a writer. Friend: What did he write? You: He's famous as a novelist.

be fed up with.context: 对某事“受够了、厌烦透顶”，就用它。
be fed up with.translation: 朋友：你怎么老叹气 你：我受够了天天加班 朋友：想换工作吗 你：真想
be fed up with.example: Friend: Why do you keep sighing? You: I'm fed up with working overtime every day. Friend: Want to change jobs? You: I'm fed up with it.

be fond of.translation: 朋友：你业余时间爱干嘛 你：我喜欢听音乐 朋友：什么类型 你：古典
be fond of.example: Friend: What do you like in your spare time? You: I'm fond of listening to music. Friend: What genre? You: I'm fond of classical music.

be good to.translation: 朋友：那只流浪猫不怕人 你：我们一直对它好 朋友：它也粘人 你：对谁都温和
be good to.example: Friend: That stray cat isn't afraid of people. You: We've been good to it. Friend: It's also affectionate. You: We're good to it; it's gentle.

be grateful to.translation: 朋友：你最想感谢谁 你：我特别感激我的老师 朋友：为什么 你：他帮我太多
be grateful to.example: Friend: Who do you want to thank most? You: I'm grateful to my teacher. Friend: Why? You: I'm grateful to him for his help.

be happy with.translation: 朋友：新工作怎么样 你：我挺满意的 朋友：待遇好吗 你：不错
be happy with.example: Friend: How's the new job? You: I'm happy with it. Friend: Good pay? You: I'm happy with the pay.

be in trouble.translation: 朋友：他最近愁眉苦脸的 你：他遇到麻烦了 朋友：怎么了 你：欠了钱
be in trouble.example: Friend: He's been glum lately. You: He's in trouble. Friend: What happened? You: He's in trouble with debt.

be made of.translation: 朋友：这张桌子什么做的 你：它是木头做的 朋友：结实吗 你：实木
be made of.example: Friend: What's this table made of? You: It's made of wood. Friend: Sturdy? You: It's made of solid wood.

be made from.translation: 朋友：这纸是什么做的 你：它是木材做的 朋友：看不出啊 你：对
be made from.example: Friend: What's this paper made from? You: It's made from wood. Friend: Can't tell. You: It's made from wood pulp.

be made in.translation: 朋友：这手机哪儿产的 你：它是中国造的 朋友：质量好吗 你：不错
be made in.example: Friend: Where is this phone made? You: It's made in China. Friend: Good quality? You: Made in China, quite good.

be made up of.context: “由……组成、构成”，表成员或成分，就用它。
be made up of.translation: 朋友：这个团队多少人 你：它由五个人组成 朋友：分工明确吗 你：很清楚
be made up of.example: Friend: How many people in this team? You: It's made up of five people. Friend: Clear division? You: It's made up of clear roles.

be nervous about.context: 为上台、面试“紧张”，就用它。
be nervous about.translation: 朋友：你手怎么一直在抖 你：我对明天的演讲紧张 朋友：准备充分就别怕 你：可我还是紧张
be nervous about.example: Friend: Why are your hands shaking? You: I'm nervous about tomorrow's speech. Friend: Be prepared and don't fear. You: I'm nervous about it anyway.

be pleased with.translation: 朋友：老板对你的报告满意吗 你：他挺满意的 朋友：夸你了吗 你：说不错
be pleased with.example: Friend: Is the boss pleased with your report? You: He's quite pleased with it. Friend: Did he praise you? You: He's pleased with the result.

be popular with.translation: 朋友：那个老师学生评价如何 你：他很受学生欢迎 朋友：为什么 你：讲课风趣
be popular with.example: Friend: How do students rate that teacher? You: He's popular with students. Friend: Why? You: He's popular with them for his humor.

be proud of.translation: 朋友：你女儿考上名校了 你：我真为她骄傲 朋友：她努力没白费 你：是的
be proud of.example: Friend: Your daughter got into a top school. You: I'm proud of her. Friend: Her effort paid off. You: I'm proud of her achievement.

be ready to.translation: 朋友：需要帮忙吗 你：我随时乐意帮忙 朋友：太好了 你：有事开口
be ready to.example: Friend: Need a hand? You: I'm ready to help anytime. Friend: Great. You: I'm ready to lend a hand.

be satisfied with.translation: 朋友：这次的饭菜合口吗 你：我挺满意的 朋友：合你口味 你：刚好
be satisfied with.example: Friend: Is today's food to your taste? You: I'm satisfied with it. Friend: To your liking? You: I'm satisfied with the taste.

be sick of.translation: 朋友：你怎么老点外卖 你：我都吃腻了 朋友：那自己做呗 你：懒得
be sick of.example: Friend: Why do you always order takeout? You: I'm sick of it. Friend: Then cook yourself. You: I'm sick of takeout, but lazy to cook.

be strict in.translation: 朋友：你们老板对什么要求严 你：他对质量要求很严 朋友：对人呢 你：对事严
be strict in.example: Friend: What is your boss strict about? You: He's strict in quality. Friend: And about people? You: He's strict in his work.

be supposed to.context: “按理应、按理该”做某事，就用它。
be supposed to.translation: 朋友：我们这节课几点下课 你：按理四点下 朋友：可老师老拖堂 你：没办法
be supposed to.example: Friend: What time should this class end? You: We're supposed to end at four. Friend: But the teacher always drags it on. You: We're supposed to finish at four.

be sure of.translation: 朋友：你确定能赢吗 你：我有把握 朋友：别大意 你：放心
be sure of.example: Friend: Are you sure you can win? You: I'm sure of it. Friend: Don't be careless. You: I'm sure of the result.

be thirsty for.context: “渴望、渴求”知识或机会，就用它。
be thirsty for.translation: 朋友：那孩子求知欲真强 你：他特别渴望学新东西 朋友：像他这么大少见 你：是
be thirsty for.example: Friend: That kid is so thirsty for knowledge. You: He's thirsty for learning new things. Friend: Rare at his age. You: He's thirsty for it.

be tired of.translation: 朋友：天天加班你不烦吗 你：我早就烦透了 朋友：那就换换吧 你：想
be tired of.example: Friend: Aren't you tired of working overtime every day? You: I'm tired of it long ago. Friend: Then change it. You: I'm tired of the routine.

be tired from.translation: 朋友：你怎么一回家就瘫 你：我今天走了太多路 朋友：歇歇吧 你：累坏了
be tired from.example: Friend: Why do you collapse as soon as you're home? You: I'm tired from walking so much today. Friend: Rest. You: I'm tired from the long walk.

be used to doing.context: “习惯于做某事”（to 是介词），就用它。
be used to doing.translation: 朋友：你早起不难受吗 你：我习惯了早起 朋友：真自律 你：习惯成自然
be used to doing.example: Friend: Don't you feel miserable getting up early? You: I'm used to getting up early. Friend: So disciplined. You: I'm used to it.

be useful to.translation: 朋友：这本参考书值得买吗 你：它对复习很有用 朋友：真的吗 你：挺好
be useful to.example: Friend: Is this reference book worth buying? You: It's useful to revision. Friend: Really? You: It's useful to students.

be willing to.translation: 朋友：你愿意和我组队吗 你：我很乐意 朋友：那说定了 你：行
be willing to.example: Friend: Are you willing to team up with me? You: I'm willing to. Friend: It's a deal. You: I'm willing to join.

be worth doing.context: “值得做”某事（主动形式表被动），就用它。
be worth doing.translation: 朋友：这部电影值得看吗 你：非常值得一看 朋友：多长 你：两个小时
be worth doing.example: Friend: Is this movie worth watching? You: It's well worth watching. Friend: How long? You: It's worth watching for two hours.

add up to.context: 账目“总计达、加起来是”多少，就用它。
add up to.translation: 朋友：这个月开销怎么这么多 你：各项加起来有五千 朋友：超预算了 你：是
add up to.example: Friend: Why is this month's spending so much? You: The items add up to five thousand. Friend: Over budget. You: They add up to a lot.

agree with.context: “同意（某人的观点）”，或食物“适合”，就用它。
agree with.translation: 朋友：你觉得他说得对吗 你：我同意他的看法 朋友：真的吗 你：对
agree with.example: Friend: Do you think he's right? You: I agree with him. Friend: Really? You: I agree with his point.

break out.context: 战争、火灾、疾病“突然爆发”，就用它。
break out.translation: 朋友：昨晚仓库怎么起火了 你：半夜突然起火了 朋友：人没事吧 你：还好
break out.example: Friend: Why did the warehouse catch fire last night? You: A fire broke out at midnight. Friend: Is everyone OK? You: It broke out; people are fine.

bring up.context: “抚养、养育”孩子，或“提出”话题，就用它。
bring up.translation: 朋友：你一个人带孩子辛苦吗 你：我把他拉扯大不容易 朋友：想再要个吗 你：不了
bring up.example: Friend: Is it hard raising a child alone? You: Bringing him up wasn't easy. Friend: Want another? You: Bringing him up alone is enough.

call up.context: “打电话给”某人，或“使想起”，就用它。
call up.translation: 朋友：今晚记得给家里打电话 你：我等会儿打过去 朋友：别忘 你：好
call up.example: Friend: Remember to call home tonight. You: I'll call up later. Friend: Don't forget. You: I'll call up home.

come across.context: “偶然遇到、无意中发现”，就用它。
come across.translation: 朋友：你那本旧书哪儿淘的 你：我在旧书店偶然翻到的 朋友：真巧 你：是
come across.example: Friend: Where did you find that old book? You: I came across it in a used bookstore. Friend: What a coincidence. You: I came across it by chance.

come down.context: “下来、落下”，或物价“下降”，就用它。
come down.translation: 朋友：你在楼上干嘛呢 你：我这就下来 朋友：快点，吃饭了 你：来了
come down.example: Friend: What are you doing upstairs? You: I'll come down now. Friend: Hurry, dinner is ready. You: Coming down now.

cut down.context: “砍倒”树木，或“削减”开支，就用它。
cut down.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么不买奶茶了 你：我得省点花钱 朋友：砍开销吗 你：对
cut down.example: Friend: Why don't you buy milk tea lately? You: I have to cut down on spending. Friend: Cut expenses? You: I'm cutting down on extras.

die of.context: “死于”内因（疾病、饥饿、情感），就用它。
die of.translation: 朋友：那只老猫怎么走的 你：它老死的 朋友：年纪挺大了 你：十八年
die of.example: Friend: How did that old cat pass? You: It died of old age. Friend: Quite old. You: It died of old age at eighteen.

do with.context: “处理、对付”（常与 what 连用），就用它。
do with.translation: 朋友：这堆旧书怎么处理 你：你说怎么办好 朋友：卖废品吗 你：随你
do with.example: Friend: What to do with this pile of old books? You: What do you suggest doing with them? Friend: Sell for scrap? You: Do whatever with them.

dress up.context: 参加派对、万圣节“盛装打扮、乔装”，就用它。
dress up.translation: 朋友：今晚有化装舞会 你：那我得打扮一下 朋友：穿什么主题 你：随便
dress up.example: Friend: There's a costume party tonight. You: Then I'll dress up. Friend: What theme? You: I'll dress up for it.

drop in.context: “顺便拜访、串门”，不事先约，就用它。
drop in.translation: 朋友：周末我路过你那边 你：那你顺道来坐坐 朋友：方便吗 你：随时欢迎
drop in.example: Friend: I'll pass by your place this weekend. You: Then drop in for a visit. Friend: Is it convenient? You: Drop in anytime.

fall in love with.context: “爱上、喜欢上”某人或某物，就用它。
fall in love with.translation: 朋友：你什么时候喜欢上她的 你：第一次见面就爱上了 朋友：一见钟情啊 你：对
fall in love with.example: Friend: When did you fall for her? You: I fell in love with her at first sight. Friend: Love at first sight. You: I fell in love with her then.

fill in.translation: 朋友：这张表怎么交 你：先把空填上 朋友：有不会的吗 你：没有
fill in.example: Friend: How to submit this form? You: Fill in the blanks first. Friend: Anything unclear? You: Fill in the form carefully.

get away.context: “离开、脱身”，度假逃离日常，就用它。
get away.translation: 朋友：这周末我想出去透透气 你：难得放松一下 朋友：去哪好 你：找个小镇躲一躲
get away.example: Friend: This weekend I want to get away for some fresh air. You: Rare to relax. Friend: Where to get away? You: Get away to a small town.

get close to.context: “接近、靠近”，距离或关系，就用它。
get close to.translation: 朋友：别太靠近那只狗 你：它不咬人吧 你：小心点好 你：往后退
get close to.example: Friend: Don't get close to that dog. You: It doesn't bite? You: Better be careful. You: I'll not get close to it.

give away.context: “赠送、捐出”，或无意中“泄露”秘密，就用它。
give away.translation: 朋友：你这堆旧衣服怎么办 你：捐出去吧 朋友：给谁 你：捐给需要的人
give away.example: Friend: What to do with this pile of old clothes? You: Give them away. Friend: To whom? You: Give them away to those in need.

go ahead.context: 同意对方“开始、请便、继续”，就用它。
go ahead.translation: 朋友：我能用一下你的电脑吗 你：用吧 朋友：不耽误你吗 你：没事
go ahead.example: Friend: Can I use your computer? You: Go ahead. Friend: Won't hold you up? You: Go ahead, it's fine.

go by.context: 时间“流逝、过去”，或“遵循（规则）”，就用它。
go by.translation: 朋友：日子过得真快 你：一晃就一年了 朋友：有什么变化吗 你：时间不等人
go by.example: Friend: Time flies so fast. You: A year has gone by in a blink. Friend: Any change? You: Time goes by quickly.

hear of.context: “听说、听闻”某事（未必亲历），就用它。
hear of.translation: 朋友：你知道那家新店吗 你：我听说过 朋友：口碑怎么样 你：还不错
hear of.example: Friend: Do you know that new shop? You: I've heard of it. Friend: How's its reputation? You: I heard of it being good.

hold on.context: 打电话时“别挂、稍等”，或艰难时“坚持住”，就用它。
hold on.translation: 朋友：喂，是我 你：你稍等，我找支笔 朋友：我等你 你：别挂
hold on.example: Friend: Hello, it's me. You: Hold on, let me find a pen. Friend: I'll wait. You: Hold on a second.

keep away from.context: “远离、不靠近”不好的东西，就用它。
keep away from.translation: 朋友：那家店的东西别买 你：怎么了 朋友：不卫生 你：那离它远点
keep away from.example: Friend: Don't buy things from that shop. You: Why? Friend: Unsatisfactory hygiene. You: Then keep away from it.

keep doing.translation: 朋友：你怎么还在刷手机 你：我再看一会儿 朋友：别一直玩 你：好
keep doing.example: Friend: Why are you still scrolling the phone? You: I'll keep doing it a bit. Friend: Don't keep playing. You: I'll keep it short.

lie down.context: 累了或病了“躺下、躺一会儿”，就用它。
lie down.translation: 朋友：你脸色不太好 你：我想躺一会儿 朋友：床上歇着吧 你：好
lie down.example: Friend: You don't look well. You: I want to lie down a while. Friend: Lie down on the bed. You: I'll lie down now.

live on.translation: 朋友：他退休后靠什么过活 你：靠养老金生活 朋友：够花吗 你：凑合
live on.example: Friend: How does he live after retirement? You: He lives on his pension. Friend: Is it enough? You: He lives on it, barely.

look down upon.translation: 朋友：他怎么老被人排挤 你：大家都看不起他 朋友：为什么 你：因为他自大
look down upon.example: Friend: Why is he always excluded? You: People look down upon him. Friend: Why? You: They look down upon him for being arrogant.

look forward to.context: “期待、盼望”（to 是介词），就用它。
look forward to.translation: 朋友：你假期想去哪 你：我盼着去海边 朋友：什么时候 你：越快越好
look forward to.example: Friend: Where do you want to go for the holiday? You: I look forward to going to the beach. Friend: When? You: I look forward to it soon.

look through.translation: 朋友：这些资料你看完了吗 你：我大概翻了一遍 朋友：有重点吗 你：回头细看
look through.example: Friend: Have you read through these materials? You: I looked through them roughly. Friend: Anything key? You: I'll look through them in detail later.

lose one's way.translation: 朋友：我们怎么绕不出去了 你：坏了，我们迷路了 朋友：开导航吧 你：好
lose one's way.example: Friend: Why can't we find the way out? You: Oh no, we've lost our way. Friend: Turn on the GPS. You: We lost our way; let's navigate.

make a decision.translation: 朋友：到底买不买这套房 你：我得好好想想 朋友：别拖太久 你：这周定
make a decision.example: Friend: Should we buy this apartment or not? You: I need to make a decision carefully. Friend: Don't drag it on. You: I'll make a decision this week.

make progress.translation: 朋友：你这学期成绩怎么提高了 你：我每天都在进步 朋友：有诀窍吗 你：坚持
make progress.example: Friend: How did your grades improve this term? You: I'm making progress every day. Friend: Any trick? You: I make progress by persistence.

make up one's mind.translation: 朋友：你到底去不去旅行 你：我决定去了 朋友：真的吗 你：想好了
make up one's mind.example: Friend: Are you going on the trip or not? You: I've made up my mind to go. Friend: Really? You: I've made up my mind.

pick out.context: 从一堆里“挑出、选出”，就用它。
pick out.translation: 朋友：这么多蛋糕选哪个 你：我挑这个草莓的 朋友：你眼光真好 你：凭感觉
pick out.example: Friend: Which cake to choose from so many? You: I'll pick out this strawberry one. Friend: Good taste. You: I picked it out by feel.

prefer...to.translation: 朋友：咖啡和茶你爱哪个 你：比起咖啡我更爱茶 朋友：为什么 你：清淡
prefer...to.example: Friend: Which do you prefer, coffee or tea? You: I prefer tea to coffee. Friend: Why? You: I prefer tea to coffee because it's light.

prevent...from.translation: 朋友：这场雨会阻止我们出行吗 你：不会，我们照常走 朋友：带伞了吗 你：带了
prevent...from.example: Friend: Will this rain prevent us from going out? You: No, we'll go anyway. Friend: Bring an umbrella? You: We'll prevent it from ruining the trip.

protect...from.translation: 朋友：夏天出门记得涂防晒 你：为了保护皮肤 朋友：对，别晒伤 你：知道
protect...from.example: Friend: Remember to put on sunscreen in summer. You: To protect the skin from the sun. Friend: Yes, protect it from sunburn. You: Protecting skin from sunburn.

provide...with.translation: 朋友：公司给你们配电脑吗 你：公司提供设备 朋友：还配什么 你：笔记本
provide...with.example: Friend: Does the company provide computers? You: The company provides us with equipment. Friend: What else? You: They provide us with laptops.

put down.context: 把东西“放下”，或“写下、镇压”，就用它。
put down.translation: 朋友：你手里拿的什么 你：一摞书，放一下 朋友：小心别砸脚 你：好
put down.example: Friend: What are you holding? You: A stack of books; let me put them down. Friend: Don't drop them on your foot. You: I'll put them down.

put out.translation: 朋友：那边怎么冒烟了 你：快，把火扑灭 朋友：拿灭火器 你：快
put out.example: Friend: Why is there smoke over there? You: Quick, put out the fire. Friend: Get the extinguisher. You: Put out the fire now.

regard...as.translation: 朋友：你把他当什么 你：我把他当朋友 朋友：他也真心对你吗 你：是
regard...as.example: Friend: What do you regard him as? You: I regard him as a friend. Friend: Is he sincere to you? You: I regard him as a true friend.

remind sb of.context: “使某人想起、提醒某人”，就用它。
remind sb of.translation: 朋友：这首歌让我想起了什么 你：它让你想起了童年 朋友：真的吗 你：对
remind sb of.example: Friend: What does this song remind me of? You: It reminds you of your childhood. Friend: Really? You: It reminds you of those old days.

result from.context: “由……引起、源于”（后接原因），就用它。
result from.translation: 朋友：他的病是怎么得的 你：长期劳累引起的 朋友：能养好吗 你：得休息
result from.example: Friend: How did he get the illness? You: It resulted from long-term exhaustion. Friend: Can it recover? You: It resulted from overwork; rest is key.

see sb off.context: 到车站、机场“为某人送行”，就用它。
see sb off.translation: 朋友：明天你几点的飞机 你：早上八点 朋友：我去送你 你：好
see sb off.example: Friend: What time is your flight tomorrow? You: Eight in the morning. Friend: I'll see you off. You: I'll have you see me off at the airport.

sell out.translation: 朋友：那家网红面包还有吗 你：早就卖光了 朋友：这么火 你：去晚了没
sell out.example: Friend: Is that viral bread still available? You: It sold out long ago. Friend: So popular. You: It sold out if you're late.

send for.context: “派人去请、叫（医生、修理工）”，就用它。
send for.translation: 朋友：孩子突然烧起来了 你：赶紧请医生 朋友：打电话叫人 你：好
send for.example: Friend: The child suddenly has a fever. You: Quickly send for a doctor. Friend: Call someone. You: Send for a doctor right away.

separate...from.translation: 朋友：生熟菜板要分开 你：对，别混 朋友：怎么分 你：颜色区分
separate...from.example: Friend: Raw and cooked cutting boards should be separate. You: Yes, separate them from each other. Friend: How to tell? You: Separate them by color.

show up.context: 人“露面、出现”（尤指迟到或意外），就用它。
show up.translation: 朋友：约好的人怎么还不来 你：再等等，他总会出现 朋友：都等一小时了 你：别急
show up.example: Friend: Why hasn't the person we arranged to meet shown up? You: Wait more, he'll show up. Friend: It's been an hour. You: He'll show up eventually.

shut off.translation: 朋友：出门前检查一下阀门 你：我把水电气都关了 朋友：别漏 你：放心
shut off.example: Friend: Check the valves before leaving. You: I've shut off the water, gas and power. Friend: Don't let them leak. You: I shut them off.

speak highly of.translation: 朋友：客户对我们评价如何 你：他们对我们赞不绝口 朋友：真的吗 你：是的
speak highly of.example: Friend: How do the clients rate us? You: They speak highly of us. Friend: Really? You: They speak highly of our service.

spend...on.translation: 朋友：你每月房租多少 你：我花三千在租房上 朋友：占工资多少 你：三分之一
spend...on.example: Friend: How much is your monthly rent? You: I spend three thousand on rent. Friend: How much of your salary? You: I spend a third on it.

stand for.translation: 朋友：这个LOGO是什么意思 你：它代表公司的理念 朋友：具体讲 你：团结
stand for.example: Friend: What does this LOGO mean? You: It stands for the company's philosophy. Friend: Explain. You: It stands for unity.

stop...from.translation: 朋友：别让他淋雨了 你：把伞给他 朋友：他非要出门 你：拦着点
stop...from.example: Friend: Don't let him get soaked in the rain. You: Give him an umbrella. Friend: He insists on going out. You: Stop him from going out.

succeed in.translation: 朋友：他创业成功了吗 你：他做成了 朋友：怎么做到的 你：坚持
succeed in.example: Friend: Did he succeed in starting his business? You: He succeeded in it. Friend: How? You: He succeeded through persistence.

take action.translation: 朋友：光抱怨没用 你：对，得行动起来 朋友：从哪开始 你：先制定计划
take action.example: Friend: Just complaining is useless. You: Right, we must take action. Friend: Start from where? You: Take action after planning.

take charge of.translation: 朋友：这个项目谁牵头 你：我来负责 朋友：有信心吗 你：没问题
take charge of.example: Friend: Who leads this project? You: I'll take charge of it. Friend: Confident? You: I'll take charge of it well.

talk back.context: 对长辈、上级“顶嘴、回嘴”，就用它。
talk back.translation: 朋友：孩子怎么老跟大人顶嘴 你：这习惯得改 朋友：怎么教 你：不能让他顶嘴
talk back.example: Friend: Why does the kid always talk back to adults? You: This habit must change. Friend: How to teach? You: Don't let him talk back.

think over.context: “仔细考虑、斟酌”后再决定，就用它。
think over.translation: 朋友：这份工作邀约你接吗 你：我得再想想 朋友：尽快给答复 你：两天内
think over.example: Friend: Will you take this job offer? You: I need to think it over. Friend: Reply soon. You: I'll think it over in two days.

translate...into.translation: 朋友：这段中文翻成英文难吗 你：我来把它译成英文 朋友：准确吗 你：尽量
translate...into.example: Friend: Is this Chinese hard to translate into English? You: I'll translate it into English. Friend: Accurate? You: I'll translate it into English carefully.

wash away.context: “冲走、洗刷掉”，雨水、海水，就用它。
wash away.translation: 朋友：那场大雨把路冲坏了 你：泥沙都被冲走了 朋友：影响通行吗 你：有点
wash away.example: Friend: The heavy rain damaged the road. You: The mud was washed away. Friend: Does it affect traffic? You: The mud washed away, a bit.

wear out.context: “穿破、磨损”，或把人“累坏”，就用它。
wear out.translation: 朋友：你这双鞋怎么破了 你：穿太久磨坏了 朋友：该换新的了 你：对
wear out.example: Friend: Why is this pair of shoes worn out? You: They wore out from long use. Friend: Time for new ones. You: They're worn out.

at most.translation: 朋友：这趟行程多久 你：最多三天 朋友：能再长点吗 你：不行
at most.example: Friend: How long is this trip? You: At most three days. Friend: Longer? You: At most that.

by mistake.context: “错误地、不小心”做错事，就用它。
by mistake.translation: 朋友：这杯咖啡怎么是我的 你：我拿错了 朋友：没关系 你：抱歉
by mistake.example: Friend: Why is this coffee mine? You: I took it by mistake. Friend: No problem. You: I took it by mistake; sorry.

either...or.translation: 朋友：今晚吃什么 你：要么火锅要么烧烤 朋友：你定 你：烧烤吧
either...or.example: Friend: What for dinner tonight? You: Either hotpot or BBQ. Friend: You decide. You: Either one, let's pick BBQ.

for instance.translation: 朋友：有哪些休闲活动 你：比如爬山、游泳 朋友：还有别的吗 你：骑车
for instance.example: Friend: What leisure activities are there? You: For instance, hiking and swimming. Friend: Anything else? You: For instance, cycling too.

from time to time.translation: 朋友：你常回老家吗 你：我偶尔回去 朋友：一年几次 你：两三次
from time to time.example: Friend: Do you often go back home? You: I go back from time to time. Friend: How many times a year? You: From time to time, two or three.

in a hurry.translation: 朋友：你怎么走这么急 你：我赶时间 朋友：去哪 你：赶火车
in a hurry.example: Friend: Why are you walking in such a hurry? You: I'm in a hurry. Friend: Where to? You: I'm in a hurry to catch the train.

in all.translation: 朋友：这趟旅行花了多少 你：总共五千 朋友：超预算了吗 你：没有
in all.example: Friend: How much did the trip cost in all? You: In all, five thousand. Friend: Over budget? You: In all, under budget.

in order that.translation: 朋友：你把路线存下来干嘛 你：为了路上不迷路 朋友：详细点好 你：对
in order that.example: Friend: Why did you save the route? You: In order that we don't get lost on the way. Friend: The more detailed the better. You: Save it in order that it's handy.

in short.context: 总结“简言之、总之”，就用它。
in short.translation: 朋友：这报告到底想说什么 你：简言之，就是要节流 朋友：具体点 你：压缩开支
in short.example: Friend: What is this report trying to say? You: In short, it's about cutting costs. Friend: Be specific. You: In short, trim expenses.

in trouble.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么不吱声 你：他遇到麻烦了 朋友：要不要帮帮 你：该
in trouble.example: Friend: Why is he quiet lately? You: He's in trouble. Friend: Want to help? You: He's in trouble; we should help.

neither...nor.context: “既不……也不”，两者都否定，就用它。
neither...nor.translation: 朋友：周末你打算干嘛 你：我既不逛街也不看电影 朋友：那干嘛 你：在家休息
neither...nor.example: Friend: What are you doing this weekend? You: Neither going shopping nor watching a movie. Friend: Then what? You: I'll do neither, just rest at home.

no more.translation: 朋友：你还喝奶茶吗 你：我再也不喝了 朋友：怎么了 你：腻了
no more.example: Friend: Do you still drink milk tea? You: I drink it no more. Friend: Why? You: I drink it no more, tired of it.

not...any more.translation: 朋友：你还熬夜吗 你：我不熬了 朋友：好习惯 你：身体要紧
not...any more.example: Friend: Do you still stay up? You: I don't any more. Friend: Good habit. You: I don't stay up any more; health matters.

not only...but also.translation: 朋友：这份工作好在哪 你：不但工资高，而且有发展 朋友：真的吗 你：对
not only...but also.example: Friend: What's good about this job? You: Not only is the pay high, but also there's growth. Friend: Really? You: Not only good pay but also prospects.

not...until.translation: 朋友：你昨晚几点睡的 你：我写完作业才睡 朋友：几点 你：十二点
not...until.example: Friend: What time did you sleep last night? You: I didn't sleep until I finished homework. Friend: What time? You: Not until twelve.

now and then.translation: 朋友：你常去那家咖啡馆吗 你：我偶尔去 朋友：一周几次 你：一两次
now and then.example: Friend: Do you often go to that cafe? You: I go now and then. Friend: How many times a week? You: Now and then, once or twice.

on business.translation: 朋友：你这趟去上海干嘛 你：我出差 朋友：去几天 你：三天
on business.example: Friend: What's this trip to Shanghai for? You: I'm going on business. Friend: How many days? You: On business for three days.

on the contrary.context: “相反、恰恰相反”，纠正对方，就用它。
on the contrary.translation: 朋友：你好像不太喜欢这份工作 你：恰恰相反，我很喜欢 朋友：那就好 你：是
on the contrary.example: Friend: You don't seem to like this job. You: On the contrary, I like it very much. Friend: Good then. You: On the contrary, I love it.

once again.translation: 朋友：这道题还得重做吗 你：是的，再做一遍 朋友：我怎么又错了 你：细心点
once again.example: Friend: Must I redo this problem? You: Yes, do it once again. Friend: Why did I err once again? You: Be careful.

once upon a time.context: “从前、很久以前”，讲故事开头，就用它。
once upon a time.translation: 朋友：给孩子讲个故事吧 你：从前有座山 朋友：里面有什么 你：老和尚
once upon a time.example: Friend: Tell the kid a story. You: Once upon a time there was a mountain. Friend: What's in it? You: Once upon a time, an old monk.

out of.context: “从……出来、缺乏、脱离”，多义，就用它。
out of.translation: 朋友：我们的纸快用完了 你：对，纸用完了 朋友：去买点 你：好
out of.example: Friend: Our paper is running out. You: Yes, we're out of paper. Friend: Go buy some. You: We're out of paper; I'll buy.

out of work.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么老在家 你：他失业了 朋友：在找新工作吗 你：是
out of work.example: Friend: Why is he always home lately? You: He's out of work. Friend: Looking for a new job? You: He's out of work and job hunting.

to one's surprise.context: “令某人惊讶的是”，引出意外，就用它。
to one's surprise.translation: 朋友：结果出来了吗 你：让我惊讶的是，他竟然赢了 朋友：真没想到 你：是
to one's surprise.example: Friend: Is the result out? You: To my surprise, he actually won. Friend: Unexpected. You: To my surprise, he took first.

whether...or.context: “是……还是”，表选择或不管，就用它。
whether...or.translation: 朋友：你去不去都没关系 你：我得先想好去还是不去 朋友：尽快定 你：好
whether...or.example: Friend: It doesn't matter whether you go or not. You: I must decide whether to go or not. Friend: Decide soon. You: Whether I go or not, I'll tell you.

above all.context: 朋友选专业纠结要不要选自己不喜欢但好找工作的方向，你劝他最重要的是有热情。
above all.translation: 朋友：我不知道该选金融还是选历史 你：最重要的是选你真正热爱的 朋友：可是历史不好找工作呀 你：先把兴趣放第一位 以后再想办法
above all.example: Friend: I can't decide whether to major in finance or history. You: Above all, you should pick what you are truly passionate about. Friend: But history doesn't lead to good job prospects. You: Put your interest first, we'll figure out the rest later.

absorbed in.context: 图书馆里朋友喊你吃饭你没反应，因为你正全神贯注地看一本小说。
absorbed in.translation: 朋友：走啦 去吃午饭了 你：等一下 我正全神贯注地看这本书呢 朋友：都喊你三遍了 你完全没听见吗 你：真不好意思 这章太吸引人了
absorbed in.example: Friend: Come on, let's go have lunch now. You: Wait a second, I'm absorbed in this book chapter right now. Friend: I've called you three times, didn't you hear me at all? You: Sorry about that, this chapter is just so gripping.

access to.context: 新同学问学校里哪里能免费查资料，你告诉他图书馆对所有学生开放。
access to.translation: 朋友：学校里哪里能免费查学术资料 你：图书馆对所有学生开放 你可以直接进去 朋友：需要带学生证刷进去吗 你：要的 进门刷一下卡就行
access to.example: Friend: Where on campus can I look up academic materials for free? You: The library has access for all students, you can just go in. Friend: Do I need to swipe my student ID to enter? You: Yes, just swipe your card at the front door.

account for.context: 班级统计兴趣爱好，你说男生在体育方面占了很大比例，用 account for 表占比。
account for.translation: 朋友：咱们班男生都喜欢些什么运动 你：打篮球的人占了将近一半 朋友：那女生呢 都爱做什么 你：女生大部分喜欢跑步和瑜伽
account for.example: Friend: What sports do the boys in our class mostly like? You: Playing basketball accounts for almost half of them. Friend: How about the girls, what do they mostly enjoy? You: Most girls prefer running and yoga after class.

accustomed to.context: 你刚到南方工作没多久，朋友问你吃不吃得惯本地菜，你说慢慢习惯就好。
accustomed to.translation: 朋友：你来这边工作多久了 还吃得惯吗 你：才三个月 正在慢慢习惯这里的饮食 朋友：一开始是不是觉得太清淡了 你：对 现在反倒觉得很养胃
accustomed to.example: Friend: How long have you been working here, are you used to the local food? You: Only three months, I'm getting accustomed to the diet here. Friend: Didn't you find it too bland at first? You: Yeah, but now I actually feel it's easier on the stomach.

act on.context: 医生叮嘱你按照说明服药，你问能不能自己调整剂量，医生说要遵医嘱。
act on.translation: 朋友：这个药我需要怎么吃呢 你：请按照说明书上的剂量服用 朋友：能不能稍微多吃一点见效快 你：不行 要严格按照医嘱来吃
act on.example: Friend: How am I supposed to take this medication? You: Please act on the dosage written in the instructions. Friend: Could I take a bit more to get better results faster? You: No, you must act strictly according to the doctor's orders.

adapt to.context: 你刚从北方搬到南方上大学，朋友问你适不适应这边的潮湿气候。
adapt to.translation: 朋友：你刚来南方上学 习惯这边的天气了吗 你：正在努力适应 这里比老家潮湿多了 朋友：衣服是不是总晒不干 你：对 我买了个除湿机好多了
adapt to.example: Friend: You just moved south for college, have you gotten used to the weather? You: I'm still trying to adapt to it, it's much more humid than my hometown. Friend: Do your clothes never seem to fully dry? You: Yeah, buying a dehumidifier helped a lot.

adhere to.context: 团队做项目必须坚守安全规范，即使赶进度也不能违反原则。
adhere to.translation: 朋友：这个项目 deadline 快到了 能不能简化一下流程 你：不行 我们必须坚持安全标准不能妥协 朋友：可是时间真的很紧 你：再紧也要按规范走 不能出事故
adhere to.example: Friend: The project deadline is approaching, can we simplify the process? You: No, we must adhere to the safety standards without compromise. Friend: But time is really running short on us. You: However tight it is, we follow the rules, no accidents allowed.

adjust to.context: 你换了新工位，旁边是新来的同事，你说自己需要几天时间适应新环境。
adjust to.translation: 朋友：你换到新工位感觉怎么样 你：还在调整中 需要几天适应新环境 朋友：旁边那个新同事好相处吗 你：挺好的 我们中午一起吃饭了
adjust to.example: Friend: How do you feel about your new desk location? You: I'm still adjusting, it takes a few days to adapt to the new spot. Friend: Is the new colleague next to you easy to get along with? You: Pretty nice, we already had lunch together at noon.

among others.context: 这次获奖名单里有好多知名作家，包括村上春树在内都入选了。
among others.translation: 朋友：这次文学奖都有谁入选了 你：好几位知名作家 村上春树也在其中 朋友：你觉得谁最可能拿大奖 你：我个人最看好那位女作家
among others.example: Friend: Who made it onto the shortlist for this literature prize? You: Quite a few famous writers, Murakami among others. Friend: Who do you think is most likely to win the big prize? You: I'm personally rooting for that female author.

amount to.context: 你把几个月的零花钱加起来一算，总数差不多有五百块了。
amount to.translation: 朋友：你这个月攒了多少零花钱呀 你：把这些月的加起来 差不多有五百块了 朋友：这么多 你打算怎么花 你：想买个新耳机
amount to.example: Friend: How much pocket money have you saved this month? You: Adding it all up, the total amounts to about five hundred yuan. Friend: That's a lot, what are you planning to spend it on? You: I want to buy a new pair of headphones.

anxious about.context: 考试前你总担心复习不充分，朋友问你在焦虑什么，你说担心作文写不完。
anxious about.translation: 朋友：你怎么一直翻课本不休息 你：我对明天的考试感到特别焦虑 朋友：你主要担心哪一部分呢 你：怕作文写不完时间不够
anxious about.example: Friend: Why are you flipping through your textbook without a break? You: I feel really anxious about tomorrow's exam. Friend: Which part are you mainly worried about? You: I'm afraid I won't finish the essay in time.

anything but.context: 朋友约你去爬山，你说那部新电影一点也不好看，不如去爬山。
anything but.translation: 朋友：今晚一起去看那部新片吧 你：那部片子一点也不好看 不如去爬山 朋友：可是外面好像要下雨了 你：那我们就改成去逛商场吧
anything but.example: Friend: Let's go see that new movie tonight together. You: That movie is anything but good, let's go hiking instead. Friend: But it looks like it's going to rain outside. You: Then let's just go wander around the mall instead.

appeal to.context: 朋友纠结毕业是找工作还是考公，你建议他诉诸兴趣，选自己喜欢的路。
appeal to.translation: 朋友：毕业之后我是找工作还是考公呢 你：你应该诉诸自己内心真正喜欢的选择 朋友：可是爸妈都希望我稳定一点 你：先想清楚自己要什么最重要
appeal to.example: Friend: After graduation, should I look for a job or take the civil service exam? You: You should appeal to what you truly love deep down. Friend: But my parents both want me to have a stable path. You: Figuring out what you want matters most.

apply to.context: 学校规定适用于所有学生，你问老师这条新规定对研究生是否也有效。
apply to.translation: 朋友：学校新出的这项规定 研究生也适用吗 你：是的 这条规定适用于所有学生 朋友：那违反了会怎么样呢 你：会被警告处分 严重的记过
apply to.example: Friend: Does this new school rule also apply to graduate students? You: Yes, this rule applies to all the students here. Friend: What happens if someone breaks it? You: They'll get a warning, and serious cases go on record.

arise from.context: 团队项目出了纰漏，老板问问题出在哪里，你说失误源于沟通不畅。
arise from.translation: 朋友：这次项目出错主要是哪里的问题 你：问题主要源于团队之间沟通不畅 朋友：那以后怎么改进呢 你：每天固定开十分钟站会同步进度
arise from.example: Friend: Where did things mainly go wrong with this project? You: The problem arose from poor communication within the team. Friend: How can we improve that going forward? You: Hold a ten-minute standup every day to sync up.

around the corner.context: 圣诞节快到了，商场里已经摆满了圣诞树和彩灯，节日氛围很浓。
around the corner.translation: 朋友：商场里怎么这么早就摆上圣诞树了 你：圣诞节马上就要到了 当然要布置起来 朋友：你打算节日怎么过 你：和朋友一起在家吃顿大餐
around the corner.example: Friend: Why is the mall putting up Christmas trees so early? You: Christmas is just around the corner, of course they decorate. Friend: How are you planning to spend the holiday? You: Having a big meal at home with friends.

as a consequence.context: 你开车没系安全带被拦下来，因此收到了一张罚单。
as a consequence.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么垂头丧气的 你：因为没系安全带被开了罚单 朋友：罚了多少钱呀 你：两百块 下次再也不敢忘了
as a consequence.example: Friend: Why are you looking so down today? You: I got a ticket because I wasn't wearing my seatbelt. Friend: How much was the fine? You: Two hundred yuan, I'll never forget it again.

as a matter of fact.context: 朋友问你怎么突然辞职了，你说事实上是因为找到了更心仪的工作。
as a matter of fact.translation: 朋友：你怎么突然就从原来的公司辞职了 你：事实上 我找到了更心仪的工作 朋友：新公司是做什么行业的 你：做教育科技的 氛围特别好
as a matter of fact.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly quit your old company? You: As a matter of fact, I found a more desirable job. Friend: What industry is the new company in? You: It's in education technology, the vibe is great.

as a whole.context: 你评估公司业绩时要从整体上看，不能只盯着某一个季度。
as a whole.translation: 朋友：咱们这个季度业绩好像不太好 你：要从整体上看 不能只盯一个季度 朋友：全年来看其实还是增长的 你：对 下半年我们再冲一冲
as a whole.example: Friend: Our performance this quarter doesn't look so great. You: We should look at it as a whole, not just one quarter. Friend: Looking at the whole year, we actually still grew. You: Right, let's push harder in the second half.

as opposed to.context: 朋友问你喜欢大城市还是小镇，你说你更喜欢安静的小镇，而不是热闹的都市。
as opposed to.translation: 朋友：你更喜欢大城市还是小镇生活 你：我更喜欢安静的小镇 而不是繁华都市 朋友：可是小镇上工作机会少 你：那我可以远程办公呀
as opposed to.example: Friend: Do you prefer living in a big city or a small town? You: I prefer a quiet small town, as opposed to a bustling metropolis. Friend: But there are fewer job opportunities in small towns. You: Then I can work remotely, can't I?

as the saying goes.context: 朋友劝你早睡早起身体好，你说俗话说得好，身体是革命的本钱。
as the saying goes.translation: 朋友：你每天熬夜对身体不好 你：俗话说得好 身体是革命的本钱 朋友：那你打算几点睡呢 你：争取十二点前上床睡觉
as the saying goes.example: Friend: Staying up late every day is bad for your health. You: As the saying goes, health is the capital of revolution. Friend: Then what time do you plan to go to bed? You: I'll try to be in bed before midnight.

as though.context: 朋友看你盯着手机傻笑，问你在乐什么，你说感觉好像中了奖一样。
as though.translation: 朋友：你盯着手机傻笑什么呢 你：我收到消息 感觉好像中了大奖一样 朋友：到底什么好事快说 你：我投稿的文章被录用了
as though.example: Friend: What are you grinning at your phone for? You: I just got a message, it feels as though I won a prize. Friend: Come on, tell me what good news it is. You: The article I submitted got accepted.

aside from.context: 朋友问你除了英语还会什么外语，你说除了日语还会一点法语。
aside from.translation: 朋友：你除了英语 还会说哪门外语 你：除了英语 我还会一点日语 朋友：那法语呢 你：法语只会几个简单的单词
aside from.example: Friend: Besides English, what other foreign languages do you speak? You: Aside from English, I also speak a little Japanese. Friend: What about French then? You: I only know a few simple French words.

associate with.context: 你总是把红色和橙色这两种颜色联系在一起，因为它们都是暖色。
associate with.translation: 朋友：你为什么总把红色和橙色放一起 你：我总是把这两种暖色联系在一起 朋友：那冷色呢 你：蓝色和绿色会放在一起
associate with.example: Friend: Why do you always group red and orange together? You: I always associate these two warm colors with each other. Friend: What about the cool colors? You: I'd put blue and green together.

associated with.context: 哮喘往往与空气污染和过敏体质有关，医生在给你做诊断时提到了这一点。
associated with.translation: 朋友：你这哮喘是什么原因引起的呢 你：医生说这和空气污染以及过敏体质有关 朋友：那平时需要注意什么呢 你：出门戴口罩 远离花粉和灰尘
associated with.example: Friend: What caused your asthma? You: The doctor said it is associated with air pollution and allergies. Friend: What should I watch out for on a daily basis? You: Wear a mask outside, stay away from pollen and dust.

at all costs.context: 你答应朋友一定会帮他这个忙，无论如何都要办到。
at all costs.translation: 朋友：这件事真的只有你能帮我了 你：放心 我无论如何都会帮你搞定 朋友：太感谢你了 你：别客气 咱们之间不说这个
at all costs.example: Friend: You're the only one who can help me with this. You: Don't worry, I'll get it done for you at all costs. Friend: Thank you so much. You: Don't mention it, that's what friends are for.

at first sight.context: 你相亲第一次见到对方，乍一看觉得这人挺面善的。
at first sight.translation: 朋友：你第一次见那个相亲对象感觉怎么样 你：乍一看觉得这个人挺面善的 朋友：后来聊得怎么样呢 你：聊得还不错 约了下次再见
at first sight.example: Friend: How did you feel about that blind date when you first met? You: At first sight, the person seemed quite kind. Friend: How did the conversation go later on? You: It went pretty well, we agreed to meet again.

at hand.context: 你考试前把复习资料都摊在桌上，随手就能拿到需要的东西。
at hand.translation: 朋友：你桌上怎么堆了这么多复习资料 你：都放在手边 用的时候随手就能拿到 朋友：那你复习效率应该挺高 你：还行 就是桌面有点乱
at hand.example: Friend: Why is your desk piled with so many review materials? You: I keep them all at hand so I can grab whatever I need. Friend: Then your study efficiency must be pretty high. You: It's okay, just the desk is a bit messy.

at random.context: 抽奖活动从所有报名者中随机抽出十位幸运观众。
at random.translation: 朋友：这个抽奖活动怎么抽中奖者呢 你：从所有报名者中随机抽出十位 朋友：那中奖概率也太低了 你：参与一下嘛 万一中了呢
at random.example: Friend: How does this lucky draw pick the winners? You: They pick ten lucky audience members at random from all sign-ups. Friend: Then the odds of winning are really low. You: Just participate, you never know your luck.

at the end of the day.context: 朋友纠结选哪个工作，你劝他说归根结底还是要看自己喜欢什么。
at the end of the day.translation: 朋友：两个 offer 我到底选哪一个好 你：归根结底 还是要看你自己喜欢哪一个 朋友：可是薪水差距挺大的 你：喜欢做才能做得长久
at the end of the day.example: Friend: Which of the two offers should I actually choose? You: At the end of the day, it comes down to which one you prefer. Friend: But the salary difference is quite big. You: You can only stick with what you love doing.

at the expense of.context: 朋友为了拼业绩天天加班，结果把身体搞垮了，医生说不能以健康为代价。
at the expense of.translation: 朋友：他最近住院了 你知道吗 你：听说了 他以前总拿健康换业绩 朋友：现在后悔也来不及了 你：是啊 身体才是最重要的
at the expense of.example: Friend: He got hospitalized recently, did you know? You: I heard, he used to sacrifice his health for work results. Friend: Now it's too late to regret it. You: Yeah, health really is the most important thing.

at the heart of.context: 城市发展的核心是以人为本，不能只追求高楼大厦。
at the heart of.translation: 朋友：你觉得这座城市建设得怎么样 你：城市的核心应该是让人住得舒服 朋友：可是现在到处都在建高楼 你：是啊 公园和绿地反而变少了
at the heart of.example: Friend: What do you think of this city's development? You: The heart of a city should be making people live comfortably. Friend: But now they build high-rises everywhere. You: Yeah, parks and green spaces have actually shrunk.

at this point.context: 讨论到一半你突然意识到一个问题，就是大家都忘了算预算。
at this point.translation: 朋友：咱们这个方案还有什么漏洞吗 你：这时候我才发现 我们居然没算预算 朋友：那赶紧补上去 不然批不下来 你：好 我今晚就把它补上
at this point.example: Friend: Are there any gaps left in our proposal? You: At this point I just realized we forgot to calculate the budget. Friend: Then add it in quickly, otherwise it won't get approved. You: OK, I'll finish it tonight.

attempt to.context: 朋友第一次尝试做蛋糕，结果烤出来像块石头，但他不气馁。
attempt to.translation: 朋友：你第一次烤蛋糕感觉怎么样 你：我试着做了 结果烤得像块石头 朋友：没关系 下次调整温度就好 你：好 我再试一次争取成功
attempt to.example: Friend: How was your first time baking a cake? You: I attempted to make one, it came out like a rock. Friend: No worries, adjust the temperature next time. You: OK, I'll try again and get it right.

attend a job interview.context: 朋友下周要去参加一个重要面试，你问他准备得怎么样了。
attend a job interview.translation: 朋友：你下周那个面试准备得怎么样了 你：还在准备 把常见问题都过了一遍 朋友：你穿正装去吗 你：当然 穿西装显得正式一点
attend a job interview.example: Friend: How is your preparation for next week's interview going? You: Still preparing, I've gone through all the common questions. Friend: Will you wear a suit? You: Of course, a suit looks more formal.

balanced diet.context: 医生建议你平时多吃蔬菜水果，保持均衡膳食，少点外卖。
balanced diet.translation: 朋友：医生说我肠胃不太好 要注意什么 你：平时要保持均衡膳食 多吃蔬菜水果 朋友：外卖是不是要少吃 你：对 自己做饭最健康
balanced diet.example: Friend: The doctor said my stomach isn't great, what should I watch? You: Keep a balanced diet, eat more fruits and vegetables. Friend: Should I order takeout less often? You: Yes, cooking your own meals is healthiest.

be addicted to.context: 朋友每天下班就抱着手机刷短视频，他说自己已经沉迷其中了。
be addicted to.translation: 朋友：我最近一下班就刷手机停不下来 你：你这是沉迷短视频了 得控制一下 朋友：可是就是忍不住 你：出门跑跑步 转移一下注意力
be addicted to.example: Friend: I can't stop scrolling on my phone right after work. You: You're addicted to short videos, you need to control it. Friend: But I just can't help it. You: Go out for a run to shift your attention.

be bound to.context: 朋友说努力一定不会白费，你这么拼肯定能考上理想的学校。
be bound to.translation: 朋友：我已经复习三个月了 还是没把握 你：你这么努力 肯定能考上理想学校 朋友：真的吗 我心里还是没底 你：相信自己 一定没问题
be bound to.example: Friend: I've been studying for three months, still not confident. You: With how hard you've worked, you're bound to get into your dream school. Friend: Really, I still feel unsure. You: Trust yourself, it'll be fine.

be capable of.context: 朋友问你一个初学者能不能在一个月内学会做网站，你说有这个能力。
be capable of.translation: 朋友：我一个月能学会做个简单的网站吗 你：只要你肯学 完全有能力做到 朋友：那我从哪里开始入门呢 你：先学HTML和CSS 慢慢来
be capable of.example: Friend: Can a beginner like me learn to build a simple website in a month? You: As long as you're willing, you're fully capable of it. Friend: Then where should I start? You: Start with HTML and CSS, take it slow.

be exposed to.context: 在医院放射科工作的医生常年接触射线，需要穿防护服。
be exposed to.translation: 朋友：放射科医生每天工作安全吗 你：他们常年接触放射线 要穿厚厚的防护服 朋友：那对身体伤害大吗 你：防护到位就没事
be exposed to.example: Friend: Is it safe for radiologists to work every day? You: They are exposed to radiation all year, so they wear thick protective gear. Friend: Is that bad for their health? You: As long as protection is in place, it's fine.

be impressed with.context: 朋友看了你做的方案，说对你的数据分析能力印象深刻。
be impressed with.translation: 朋友：你做的这份方案真详细 你：谢谢你 我也是第一次做 朋友：我对你的数据分析能力印象很深 你：过奖了 以后多交流
be impressed with.example: Friend: The proposal you made is really detailed. You: Thanks, it's my first time doing one. Friend: I'm really impressed with your data analysis skills. You: You flatter me, let's exchange notes more often.

be keen on.context: 朋友周末喜欢去爬山，你问他是不是特别热衷于户外运动。
be keen on.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么总往外跑 你：我特别热衷于爬山和户外徒步 朋友：不累吗 爬上爬下的 你：出出汗特别解压
be keen on.example: Friend: Why do you always go out on weekends? You: I'm really keen on hiking and outdoor trekking. Friend: Isn't it tiring, climbing up and down? You: Working up a sweat is really stress-relieving.

be regarded as.context: 袁隆平被视作杂交水稻之父，朋友在课上做相关介绍。
be regarded as.translation: 朋友：你知道杂交水稻之父是谁吗 你：袁隆平被视作杂交水稻之父 朋友：他真的解决了很多人的吃饭问题 你：是啊 他的贡献太大了
be regarded as.example: Friend: Do you know who the father of hybrid rice is? You: Yuan Longping is regarded as the father of hybrid rice. Friend: He really solved the food problem for so many people. You: Yeah, his contribution was enormous.

be subject to.context: 机票价格会随节假日波动，朋友问现在买机票合不合适。
be subject to.translation: 朋友：现在买国庆的机票合适吗 你：票价受节假日影响 现在买偏贵 朋友：那等临近了会不会更贵 你：会 越早订越划算
be subject to.example: Friend: Is it a good time to buy National Day flights? You: Prices are subject to holiday fluctuations, it's expensive now. Friend: Will it be even closer to the holiday? You: Yeah, the earlier you book, the better the deal.

bear in mind.context: 朋友要去国外旅行，你提醒他记住当地的紧急求助电话。
bear in mind.translation: 朋友：我下周要去泰国玩 要注意什么 你：记住当地的报警电话 有急事联系 朋友：还有别的要带的吗 你：带个转换插头 那边插座不一样
bear in mind.example: Friend: I'm going to Thailand next week, what should I watch out for? You: Bear in mind the local emergency number for urgent help. Friend: Anything else I should pack? You: Bring a plug adapter, their sockets are different.

become accustomed to.context: 你刚到国外留学时吃不惯西餐，现在已经慢慢适应了。
become accustomed to.translation: 朋友：你刚到国外吃得惯西餐吗 你：一开始不适应 现在慢慢习惯了 朋友：你最爱吃什么西餐 你：意面 简单又好吃
become accustomed to.example: Friend: Could you get used to Western food when you first went abroad? You: I wasn't used to it at first, now I've become accustomed to it. Friend: What Western dish do you like most? You: Pasta, simple and delicious.

bring about.context: 新技术的普及带来了生活方式的巨大改变。
bring about.translation: 朋友：手机支付是怎么普及开的 你：一项新技术的出现引发了生活方式的改变 朋友：现在出门都不用带现金了 你：是啊 一部手机走天下
bring about.example: Friend: How did mobile payments become so widespread? You: The emergence of new technology brought about lifestyle changes. Friend: Now you don't even need to carry cash. You: Yeah, a phone is all you need.

bring out.context: 出版社明年准备推出一套新的科普丛书，朋友问你有什么计划。
bring out.translation: 朋友：你们出版社明年有什么新书计划 你：我们打算出一套新的科普丛书 朋友：目标读者是哪类人群 你：面向青少年 内容通俗易懂
bring out.example: Friend: What new book plans does your publishing house have for next year? You: We plan to bring out a new series of popular science books. Friend: Who is the target reader? You: For teenagers, with easy-to-understand content.

burst into laughter.context: 你朋友讲了个冷笑话，本来严肃的大家突然都大笑起来。
burst into laughter.translation: 朋友：你刚才那个笑话把大家逗成什么样了 你：大家听了之后突然就大笑起来 朋友：什么笑话这么好笑 你：就是那个企鹅的笑话
burst into laughter.example: Friend: What did that joke you told do to everyone? You: Everyone burst into laughter right after hearing it. Friend: What joke is that funny? You: That penguin joke I told.

burst out laughing.context: 看喜剧电影的时候，你和朋友看到搞笑片段突然都笑出声来。
burst out laughing.translation: 朋友：这部喜剧片哪段最好笑 你：看到主角摔那一跤时 我们都笑出声了 朋友：我也觉得那段特别逗 你：你看第二遍还是觉得好笑
burst out laughing.example: Friend: Which part of this comedy is the funniest? You: When the main character takes that fall, we all burst out laughing. Friend: I thought that part was hilarious too. You: Even the second time around it's still funny.

carbon dioxide.context: 科学课上老师讲植物吸收二氧化碳、释放氧气的原理。
carbon dioxide.translation: 朋友：科学课今天讲了什么内容呀 你：老师讲了植物吸收二氧化碳 释放氧气 朋友：那我们多种树就对了 你：对 树越多空气越清新
carbon dioxide.example: Friend: What did science class cover today? You: The teacher explained how plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen. Friend: Then planting more trees is the right thing. You: Yeah, the more trees, the fresher the air.

cast doubt on.context: 新证据的出现让警方对原来的结论产生了怀疑。
cast doubt on.translation: 朋友：这个案子不是已经结了吗 你：新证据让大家对原结论产生了怀疑 朋友：那还要重新调查吗 你：是的 要重启调查程序
cast doubt on.example: Friend: Wasn't this case already closed? You: New evidence has cast doubt on the original conclusion. Friend: Then they have to reinvestigate? You: Yes, they'll restart the investigation.

catch on.context: 那种宽脚裤去年在年轻人中一下子流行起来。
catch on.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总穿那种宽脚裤 你：这种裤子今年特别流行 年轻人都爱穿 朋友：穿着舒服吗 你：特别宽松 走路带风
catch on.example: Friend: Why are you wearing those wide-leg pants lately? You: This style really caught on among young people this year. Friend: Are they comfortable? You: Really loose, they feel great to walk in.

cater for.context: 这家餐厅菜单上既有中餐也有西餐，能满足不同顾客的口味。
cater for.translation: 朋友：这家店菜品种类多吗 你：中西餐都有 能满足不同人的口味 朋友：那我们一行人不同口味也好安排 你：对 点一桌子大家分着吃
cater for.example: Friend: Does this restaurant have a wide variety of dishes? You: They cater for both Chinese and Western tastes. Friend: Then it works for our group with different preferences. You: Yeah, order a big spread to share.

cater to.context: 这款软件专门迎合年轻用户的喜好，设计得非常可爱。
cater to.translation: 朋友：你手机里这个软件画风好可爱 你：它就是专门迎合年轻人的喜好做的 朋友：上面都有些什么功能 你：有打卡和手账 特别治愈
cater to.example: Friend: The art style of that app on your phone is so cute. You: It's designed specifically to cater to young people's tastes. Friend: What features does it have? You: Check-ins and digital journals, really soothing.

climate change.context: 新闻里说全球变暖加剧，极端天气越来越频繁。
climate change.translation: 朋友：最近新闻里都在说什么 你：在说全球气候变化 极端天气变多了 朋友：我们普通人能做些什么呢 你：低碳出行 节约用电就好
climate change.example: Friend: What has the news been talking about lately? You: It's all about climate change, extreme weather is becoming more frequent. Friend: What can ordinary people do? You: Low-carbon travel, save electricity.

coincide with.context: 你的生日和好朋友赶在同一天，每年都一起庆祝。
coincide with.translation: 朋友：你生日是哪一天来着 你：我生日和你的正好同一天 朋友：那我们每年一起庆生太好了 你：对 每年都买一个大蛋糕
coincide with.example: Friend: When is your birthday again? You: My birthday happens to coincide with yours. Friend: Then celebrating together every year is perfect. You: Yeah, every year we get one big cake.

come in handy.context: 你出门在外带一把折叠伞，万一遇到阵雨就能派上用场。
come in handy.translation: 朋友：你包里怎么总塞着一把伞 你：万一突然下雨 它就能派上用场 朋友：你这习惯挺好的 我以后也带着 你：对 有备无患嘛
come in handy.example: Friend: Why do you always keep an umbrella in your bag? You: In case it suddenly rains, it'll come in handy. Friend: That's a good habit, I'll start carrying one too. You: Right, better safe than sorry.

come to terms.context: 失业半年后他终于接受了现实，开始找新的工作。
come to terms.translation: 朋友：他失业这半年状态怎么样 你：他慢慢接受了现实 开始重新找工作 朋友：找到合适的了吗 你：面试了几家 有一家在谈
come to terms.example: Friend: How has he been doing during these six months unemployed? You: He came to terms with reality and started job hunting again. Friend: Has he found something suitable? You: Interviewed a few, one is in talks.

come to terms with.context: 你从小个子矮被同学嘲笑，长大后才慢慢接纳了自己。
come to terms with.translation: 朋友：你以前因为个子矮自卑过吗 你：有过 后来慢慢接纳了自己 朋友：现在完全不介意了吗 你：对 身高不是什么大问题
come to terms with.example: Friend: Did you used to feel insecure about being short? You: I did, then I came to terms with myself. Friend: Now you don't mind it at all? You: Right, height isn't a big deal.

comfort zone.context: 你一直待在熟悉的环境里，朋友建议你走出舒适区试试新挑战。
comfort zone.translation: 朋友：你天天做一样的工作 不觉得无聊吗 你：是有点 但待在舒适区里很安心 朋友：可以试着接受一点新挑战 你：好 我报个培训班试试
comfort zone.example: Friend: Don't you get bored doing the same work every day? You: A bit, but it's safe staying in my comfort zone. Friend: You could try stepping out for some new challenges. You: OK, I'll sign up for a training course.

comfortable with.context: 你在新公司还不太熟，跟同事相处起来还有点不自在。
comfortable with.translation: 朋友：你在新公司适应得怎么样 你：跟同事相处还有点不太自在 朋友：中午一起吃饭多了就熟了 你：对 慢慢来 不急
comfortable with.example: Friend: How are you settling into the new company? You: I'm still not completely comfortable with my coworkers yet. Friend: Eating lunch together more will help you get closer. You: Yeah, take it slow.

comparable to.context: 这款国产手机的性能已经可以和国际大牌相媲美。
comparable to.translation: 朋友：你新换的这个国产手机好用吗 你：性能已经可以和国际大牌相媲美了 朋友：真的假的 多少钱 你：才两千多 性价比特别高
comparable to.example: Friend: Is that domestic phone you switched to any good? You: Its performance is comparable to major international brands. Friend: No way, how much was it? You: Only two thousand something, great value.

compensate for.context: 你加班没赶上下班，公司给你补贴打车费作为补偿。
compensate for.translation: 朋友：你这么晚才下班 怎么回去呀 你：公司会给我补贴打车费 作为补偿 朋友：那还不错 你：对 比挤地铁舒服多了
compensate for.example: Friend: You're getting off work so late, how will you get back? You: The company will compensate me with a taxi allowance. Friend: That's not bad then. You: Yeah, much comfier than the subway.

compete against.context: 你参加创业比赛，要和来自全国的队伍同台竞争。
compete against.translation: 朋友：这次创业比赛对手强不强 你：我们要和全国优秀的队伍竞争 朋友：那压力是不是很大 你：是啊 但能学到很多东西
compete against.example: Friend: Are the opponents strong in this startup competition? You: We have to compete against top teams from across the country. Friend: That must be a lot of pressure. You: Yeah, but I'll learn a lot from it.

compete with.context: 学校辩论赛上，你们队和隔壁班争夺冠军。
compete with.translation: 朋友：这次辩论赛对手是哪个班呀 你：我们要和隔壁班争夺冠军 朋友：你紧张吗 你：有点 但准备很充分
compete with.example: Friend: Which class are we up against in this debate? You: We're competing with the class next door for the championship. Friend: Are you nervous? You: A bit, but we're well prepared.

composed of.context: 这支乐队由四个大学生组成，利用课余时间排练。
composed of.translation: 朋友：你参加的那个乐队有几个人呀 你：它由四个大学生组成 周末一起排练 朋友：你们玩什么风格呀 你：流行摇滚 特别嗨
composed of.example: Friend: How many people are in that band you joined? You: It's composed of four college students, we practice on weekends. Friend: What style do you play? You: Pop rock, it's really fun.

concentrate on.context: 自习室里大家都在埋头看书，你需要专心复习考试。
concentrate on.translation: 朋友：周末一起出去逛街呗 你：不去了 我得专心复习下周考试 朋友：你已经复习得很好了 你：不行 这次想考个好成绩
concentrate on.example: Friend: Let's go shopping together this weekend. You: No, I have to concentrate on studying for next week's exam. Friend: You've already studied enough. You: No, I really want a good score this time.

concentration deficit.context: 医生说有些孩子注意力缺陷，需要通过训练来改善。
concentration deficit.translation: 朋友：我家孩子上课总坐不住 怎么办 你：医生说可能是专注力不足 要做训练 朋友：那需要去专门机构吗 你：先去医院做个评估看看
concentration deficit.example: Friend: My kid can't sit still in class, what should I do? You: The doctor said it might be concentration deficit, needs training. Friend: Then do we need a special center? You: First get an evaluation at the hospital.

conducive to.context: 靠窗的位置光线好、安静，特别适合看书学习。
conducive to.translation: 朋友：图书馆哪个位置最适合自习 你：靠窗的位置光线好 有助于专注学习 朋友：那我们早点去占座 你：好 明天开门就去
conducive to.example: Friend: Which spot in the library is best for studying? You: The window seat has good light, it's conducive to studying. Friend: Then let's go early to claim it. You: OK, we'll go as soon as it opens.

conform to.context: 做实验必须遵守操作规范，不然容易出安全事故。
conform to.translation: 朋友：第一次进实验室要注意什么 你：一定要遵守操作规范 不能乱碰仪器 朋友：穿实验服有要求吗 你：必须穿 长发要扎起来
conform to.example: Friend: What should I watch out for on my first day in the lab? You: You must conform to the operating rules, don't touch instruments randomly. Friend: Are there rules about lab coats? You: Must wear one, long hair must be tied up.

contribute to.context: 空气污染严重会导致很多健康问题，你在课堂上听老师讲。
contribute to.translation: 朋友：老师今天课上讲了什么健康话题 你：空气污染会引发很多呼吸系统问题 朋友：那我们平时要怎么防护 你：雾霾天出门戴口罩
contribute to.example: Friend: What health topic did the teacher cover in class today? You: Air pollution can contribute to many respiratory problems. Friend: How should we protect ourselves daily? You: Wear a mask on smoggy days.

contributes to.context: 坚持每天阅读二十分钟，有助于积累词汇量。
contributes to.translation: 朋友：我想提高英语水平 该怎么做 你：每天坚持读二十分钟英文 有助于积累 朋友：读什么材料比较好 你：从简单的短篇故事开始
contributes to.example: Friend: I want to improve my English, what should I do? You: Reading English for twenty minutes daily contributes to building your vocabulary. Friend: What kind of material is best? You: Start with simple short stories.

cope with.context: 期末周事情特别多，你问朋友怎么同时应对这么多任务。
cope with.translation: 朋友：期末这一堆事我都忙不过来了 你：得学会同时应对多项任务 朋友：我总是顾此失彼 你：列个清单 按优先级做
cope with.example: Friend: I can't handle all these things during finals. You: You need to learn how to cope with multiple tasks at once. Friend: I always drop one while doing another. You: Make a list, work by priority.

cut down on.context: 医生建议你少喝奶茶、少吃甜食，控制糖分摄入。
cut down on.translation: 朋友：我最近体重涨了好多 怎么回事 你：你要少喝点奶茶 减少糖分摄入 朋友：那我改成喝无糖的行吗 你：最好还是喝白开水
cut down on.example: Friend: I've gained a lot of weight lately, what's going on? You: You should cut down on milk tea and reduce sugar intake. Friend: Is it okay if I switch to sugar-free? You: Better to just drink plain water.

distinguish between.context: 老师让你区分形近词，别把它们搞混了。
distinguish between.translation: 朋友：这两个单词怎么老搞混 你：你要学会区分它们的用法 朋友：有什么好办法吗 你：把它们放在句子里记
distinguish between.example: Friend: Why do I always mix up these two words? You: You need to distinguish between their usages. Friend: Any good way to do that? You: Memorize them in example sentences.

engage in.context: 学校鼓励学生积极参与社团活动，锻炼综合能力。
engage in.translation: 朋友：大学里要不要多参加社团活动 你：要积极参与 能锻炼很多能力 朋友：你参加了几个呀 你：两个 一个志愿者 一个辩论
engage in.example: Friend: Should I join more clubs in college? You: You should engage in them actively, it builds all kinds of skills. Friend: How many did you join? You: Two, volunteering and debate.

expose to.context: 长时间暴露在阳光下会晒伤皮肤，户外活动要涂防晒霜。
expose to.translation: 朋友：夏天去海边要注意什么 你：皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下会晒伤 朋友：那要涂多少防晒霜呀 你：出门前半小时涂 隔两小时补一次
expose to.example: Friend: What should I watch for at the beach in summer? You: Exposing your skin to the sun too long causes sunburn. Friend: How much sunscreen should I use? You: Apply half an hour before going out, reapply every two hours.

focus on.context: 复习时你先把课本从头到尾看一遍，再做练习题。
focus on.translation: 朋友：期末复习你是怎么安排的 你：我先把课本通读一遍 再做练习题 朋友：时间够吗 你：抓紧点 应该来得及
focus on.example: Friend: How are you organizing your finals review? You: I focus on reading the whole textbook first, then do exercises. Friend: Is there enough time? You: If I hurry, it should be enough.

focuses on.context: 他写论文的时候专注于一个研究方向，三年只发了两篇文章。
focuses on.translation: 朋友：他读博期间发了多少文章 你：他专注于一个方向 发了两篇 朋友：那毕业压力大吗 你：要求三篇 还在赶最后一篇
focuses on.example: Friend: How many papers did he publish during his PhD? You: He focuses on one research direction and published two. Friend: Is graduation pressure high? You: They require three, he's rushing the last one.

for the sake of.context: 项目先按现有方案做着，有问题再调整，你跟老板汇报。
for the sake of.translation: 朋友：这个项目接下来怎么推进 你：先按现有方案暂时做着 朋友：如果中途出问题呢 你：随时调整 灵活处理
for the sake of.example: Friend: How do we move this project forward next? You: For the moment, we proceed with the current plan. Friend: What if problems come up midway? You: Adjust as we go, stay flexible.

get involved in.context: 朋友提醒你别卷入办公室斗争，你说自己只做好本职工作。
get involved in.translation: 朋友：最近办公室里那些派系斗争你参与吗 你：我不参与 只做好自己的事 朋友：这样最安全 你：对 少说话多做事
get involved in.example: Friend: Are you involved in those office politics lately? You: I don't get involved, I just do my own work. Friend: That's the safest way. You: Yeah, talk less, do more.

graduate from.context: 你明年就要大学毕业了，问朋友哪所学校毕业好找工作。
graduate from.translation: 朋友：你是哪所大学毕业的呀 你：我从那所理工类大学毕业 朋友：那找工作应该挺容易吧 你：对 校招机会很多
graduate from.example: Friend: Which university did you graduate from? You: I graduated from that science and engineering university. Friend: Then job hunting must be easier. You: Yeah, lots of campus recruiting.

have access to.context: 学校图书馆对所有学生开放，你可以免费查任何资料。
have access to.translation: 朋友：写论文去哪里找资料比较全 你：图书馆对所有学生开放 资源都能查 朋友：需要办证吗 你：刷学生证就行
have access to.example: Friend: Where is the best place to find resources for papers? You: The library has access for all students, everything is available. Friend: Do I need a card? You: Just swipe your student ID.

higher education.context: 你朋友研究生毕业后继续读博，走的是高等教育路线。
higher education.translation: 朋友：你那个同学毕业后去哪了 你：他继续读博 在高等教育这条路上走 朋友：那要读好几年吧 你：是啊 还要读四五年
higher education.example: Friend: Where did that classmate of yours go after graduation? You: He's doing a PhD, staying in higher education. Friend: That's several more years of study. You: Yeah, another four or five years.

identify with.context: 你看那部电影的时候特别有代入感，感觉和主角同呼吸共命运。
identify with.translation: 朋友：你看那部电影为什么哭了 你：我特别能和主角产生共鸣 朋友：哪段情节最戳你 你：他和家人重逢那段
identify with.example: Friend: Why did you cry during that movie? You: I could really identify with the main character. Friend: Which part hit you the hardest? You: The reunion with his family.

in accordance with.context: 公司规章要求所有员工按规定流程操作，不能走捷径。
in accordance with.translation: 朋友：报销能不能快点 走个内部流程 你：不行 必须按规定流程走 朋友：那要多久批下来 你：五个工作日左右
in accordance with.example: Friend: Can the reimbursement go faster through an internal channel? You: No, it must be processed in accordance with the rules. Friend: Then how long for approval? You: About five working days.

in advance.context: 你买票要提前几天订，不然国庆的票早就抢光了。
in advance.translation: 朋友：国庆的票现在能买了吗 你：要提前买 越早越便宜 朋友：我现在就去订 你：好 晚了就没了
in advance.example: Friend: Can I buy National Day tickets now? You: You should book in advance, the earlier the cheaper. Friend: I'll book right now then. You: Good, they'll sell out.

in an attempt to.context: 你努力想在截止日期前完成项目，每天都加班到很晚。
in an attempt to.translation: 朋友：你最近天天加班图什么 你：我想在截止前把项目做完 朋友：那也要注意身体 你：等项目交了就轻松了
in an attempt to.example: Friend: Why are you working overtime every day lately? You: In an attempt to finish the project before the deadline. Friend: But watch your health. You: Once the project is handed in, I'll relax.

in any case.context: 不管你去不去，我今晚都要把这份报告写完。
in any case.translation: 朋友：今晚去看电影吗 新上的 你：不管你去不去 我今晚都要写完报告 朋友：那我自己去了 你：好 下次再约
in any case.example: Friend: Want to see a movie tonight, a new release. You: In any case, I have to finish the report tonight. Friend: Then I'll go by myself. You: OK, next time.

in contrast.context: 你喜欢早起安静的街道，朋友喜欢夜晚热闹的夜市，两人正好相反。
in contrast.translation: 朋友：你喜欢热闹还是安静 你：我喜欢安静 他却喜欢热闹 朋友：那你们俩怎么玩到一起的 你：互补嘛 各玩各的再聚
in contrast.example: Friend: Do you like it lively or quiet? You: I like quiet, in contrast he loves it lively. Friend: Then how do you get along? You: We complement each other, do our own things then meet up.

in contrast to.context: 和一线城市的高房价相比，小城市生活压力小多了。
in contrast to.translation: 朋友：大城市生活压力是不是很大 你：和大城市相比 小城市压力小多了 朋友：那你为什么还留在大城市 你：机会多 虽然累但成长快
in contrast to.example: Friend: Is life really stressful in the big city? You: In contrast to big city prices, small city life is far less stressful. Friend: Then why do you still stay? You: More opportunities, tiring but faster growth.

in effect.context: 虽然表面上他没表态，但实际上他已经同意了你的方案。
in effect.translation: 朋友：老板到底同意了没有 你：表面上没说 实际上已经默认了 朋友：那我就开始做了 你：对 他没反对就是同意
in effect.example: Friend: Did the boss actually agree or not? You: He didn't say on the surface, but in effect he's already consented. Friend: Then I'll start working on it. You: Yeah, his silence means yes.

in favor of.context: 公司投票决定团建去哪，大多数人都赞成去海边。
in favor of.translation: 朋友：团建去哪大家投票了吗 你：大部分人都赞成去海边 朋友：那爬山的提议呢 你：少数服从多数 就去海边
in favor of.example: Friend: Did everyone vote on where to go for the team trip? You: Most people are in favor of going to the beach. Friend: What about the mountain proposal? You: Majority rules, beach it is.

in honor of.context: 学校办了一场晚会，向退休老教师表达敬意。
in honor of.translation: 朋友：学校周五晚上办活动 你去吗 你：是为了致敬退休老教师办的 朋友：那挺有意义的 你：对 我作为学生代表发言
in honor of.example: Friend: There's an event Friday night at school, going? You: It's held in honor of the retired teachers. Friend: That sounds meaningful. You: Yeah, I'm speaking as a student representative.

in line with.context: 你的消费习惯和公司倡导的节约理念是一致的。
in line with.translation: 朋友：公司最近提倡节约用电 你做得怎么样 你：我的习惯和公司要求完全一致 朋友：大家都向你学习 你：举手之劳嘛
in line with.example: Friend: The company is promoting saving electricity, how are you doing? You: My habits are in line with what the company asks. Friend: Everyone should learn from you. You: It's just a small thing.

in reality.context: 他表面上看起来很开朗，实际上内心很孤独。
in reality.translation: 朋友：他每天都笑得那么开心 你觉得他快乐吗 你：实际上 他内心特别孤独 朋友：真没想到 你怎么知道 你：他私下跟我说过
in reality.example: Friend: He laughs every day, do you think he's happy? You: In reality, he's actually very lonely inside. Friend: Never would have guessed, how do you know? You: He told me in private.

in response to.context: 针对客户提出的问题，团队连夜拿出了解决方案。
in response to.translation: 朋友：客户那个投诉处理得怎么样了 你：作为回应 我们连夜赶了个方案 朋友：客户满意了吗 你：满意了 问题解决了
in response to.example: Friend: How is that customer complaint being handled? You: In response to it, we worked through the night on a solution. Friend: Is the customer satisfied? You: Satisfied, the issue is resolved.

in terms of.context: 从性价比来看，这款国产手机比苹果更划算。
in terms of.translation: 朋友：买苹果还是买国产手机 你：就性价比而言 国产的更划算 朋友：那系统流畅度呢 你：日常使用完全够了
in terms of.example: Friend: Buy an iPhone or a domestic phone? You: In terms of value for money, the domestic one is a better deal. Friend: What about smoothness? You: More than enough for daily use.

in the face of.context: 尽管面对很多困难，团队还是坚持把项目做下去了。
in the face of.translation: 朋友：这个项目中途想过放弃吗 你：面对那么多困难 我们还是坚持下来了 朋友：真不容易 你：是啊 结果是好的
in the face of.example: Friend: Did you think about giving up midway on this project? You: In the face of so many difficulties, we kept going. Friend: That's really something. You: Yeah, the result was worth it.

in the long run.context: 朋友问你现在工资够不够花，你说长远来看会越来越好。
in the long run.translation: 朋友：你刚工作工资够花吗 你：现在紧一点 但从长远来看会越来越好 朋友：那就好 你：对 经验涨了工资就涨
in the long run.example: Friend: Is your salary enough as a new grad? You: Tight now, but in the long run it'll get better. Friend: Good then. You: Yeah, experience grows, so does pay.

in theory.context: 这个方案理论上可行，但实际操作起来困难重重。
in theory.translation: 朋友：这个方案你觉得能行得通吗 你：理论上可行 实际做起来就难了 朋友：那还做不做呀 你：做 边做边调整
in theory.example: Friend: Do you think this plan will work? You: In theory it works, but practically it's full of difficulties. Friend: Then do we still do it? You: Yeah, adjust as we go.

in turn.context: 你帮了同事一个忙，他又把这份好意传递给了下一个人。
in turn.translation: 朋友：你帮他改了那个报表 他怎么谢你的 你：他没谢我 反而又去帮别人了 朋友：这种正能量传递真好 你：是呀 好人有好报
in turn.example: Friend: You helped him fix the report, how did he thank you? You: He didn't thank me, he in turn went and helped someone else. Friend: That's a great chain of kindness. You: Yeah, good deeds keep going.

interact with.context: 你在课堂上多和老师同学互动，学习效果会更好。
interact with.translation: 朋友：我上课总是走神 怎么办 你：多和老师同学互动 集中注意力 朋友：具体怎么做呢 你：多举手回答问题
interact with.example: Friend: I zone out in class, what to do? You: Interact with teachers and classmates more to stay focused. Friend: How specifically? You: Raise your hand to answer questions.

interfere with.context: 你准备考试的时候室友总大声放音乐，影响你学习。
interfere with.translation: 朋友：你最近学习效率怎么样 你：室友总放音乐 影响我复习 朋友：那你跟他说过吗 你：说过 他会戴耳机
interfere with.example: Friend: How's your study efficiency lately? You: My roommate always plays music, it interferes with my review. Friend: Have you talked to him? You: Yeah, he wears headphones now.

invest in.context: 朋友纠结要不要买那只股票，你说投资要谨慎。
invest in.translation: 朋友：那只股票你说我买不买 你：投资要谨慎 别全砸进去 朋友：那买多少合适 你：闲钱拿十分之一出来就行
invest in.example: Friend: Do you think I should buy that stock? You: Invest carefully, don't dump everything in. Friend: How much should I put in? You: A tenth of your spare money.

keen on.context: 你朋友特别热衷于登山，周末几乎都在山里。
keen on.translation: 朋友：你朋友周末怎么总不在家 你：他特别热衷于登山 一有空就往山里跑 朋友：那他身体一定很好 你：对 晒得黝黑
keen on.example: Friend: Why is your friend never home on weekends? You: He's really keen on hiking, runs to the mountains whenever free. Friend: Then he must be in great shape. You: Yeah, all tanned.

keep pace with.context: 科技发展太快，你得不断学习才能跟上行业步伐。
keep pace with.translation: 朋友：现在技术更新这么快 怎么跟得上 你：得持续学习 跟上行业发展 朋友：每天要花多少时间学 你：下班再学两小时
keep pace with.example: Friend: Tech changes so fast, how do you keep up? You: Keep learning constantly to keep pace with the industry. Friend: How long each day? You: Two more hours after work.

keep track of.context: 你每天花时间记账，记录每一笔开支，心里有数。
keep track of.translation: 朋友：你怎么知道钱花哪了 你：我每天记账 记录每一笔开销 朋友：那挺花时间吧 你：记一次一分钟 值得
keep track of.example: Friend: How do you know where your money goes? You: I keep track of every expense daily. Friend: Doesn't that take time? You: A minute each time, worth it.

let alone.context: 朋友连普通话都说不标准，更别说讲英语了。
let alone.translation: 朋友：他英语说得怎么样呀 你：他普通话都说不利索 更别说英语了 朋友：那他怎么和老外交流 你：靠翻译软件呗
let alone.example: Friend: How's his English? You: He can't even speak standard Mandarin, let alone English. Friend: Then how does he talk to foreigners? You: With translation apps.

live up to.context: 朋友问你新工作怎么样，你说希望自己能不负大家的期望。
live up to.translation: 朋友：新工作上手了吗 感觉怎么样 你：我希望能不负大家的期望 做出成绩 朋友：别给自己太大压力 你：好 我尽力就好
live up to.example: Friend: Settled into the new job yet, how's it feel? You: I hope to live up to everyone's expectations and deliver. Friend: Don't put too much pressure on yourself. You: OK, I'll do my best.

long for.context: 你在外漂泊多年，特别想念家乡的味道。
long for.translation: 朋友：你最怀念家里的什么呀 你：我特别渴望妈妈做的红烧肉 朋友：那下次回家多吃点 你：好 过年回家让她做
long for.example: Friend: What do you miss most about home? You: I long for mom's braised pork the most. Friend: Then eat more next time you go home. You: OK, I'll ask her to make it for Spring Festival.

major in.context: 你大学主修计算机专业，辅修了心理学。
major in.translation: 朋友：你大学主修什么专业呀 你：我主修计算机 辅修心理学 朋友：为什么学心理学呀 你：想做产品经理
major in.example: Friend: What did you major in college? You: I majored in computer science, minored in psychology. Friend: Why psychology? You: To become a product manager.

make the most of.context: 假期不长，你说要充分利用这几天好好休息。
make the most of.translation: 朋友：这三天短假你怎么安排 你：我要充分利用时间 好好休息 朋友：不出去旅游吗 你：不去 人太多 在家躺着
make the most of.example: Friend: How are you spending these three days off? You: I'll make the most of it and rest well. Friend: Not traveling? You: No, too crowded, just laze at home.

make use of.context: 你利用下班时间学编程，几个月后做出了自己的小应用。
make use of.translation: 朋友：你下班时间都干嘛 你：我利用业余时间学编程 朋友：学这么久有成果吗 你：做了个小应用 还上线了
make use of.example: Friend: What do you do after work? You: I make use of my spare time to learn coding. Friend: Any results after all this time? You: Built a little app, it's live.

might as well.context: 既然外面下雨，你说那干脆在家看电影算了。
might as well.translation: 朋友：外面下雨了 还出去吗 你：那就干脆在家看电影算了 朋友：那我点个外卖 你：好 我选部片子
might as well.example: Friend: It's raining out, still going? You: We might as well watch a movie at home. Friend: Then I'll order delivery. You: OK, I'll pick a film.

name after.context: 这个城市的一条主街是以一位英雄的名字命名的。
name after.translation: 朋友：这条大街叫什么名字呀 你：它是以一位英雄的名字命名的 朋友：为什么用他命名呀 你：他当年救了很多人
name after.example: Friend: What is this main street called? You: It is named after a local hero. Friend: Why was it named after him? You: He saved many people back then.

not to mention.context: 这次旅行住宿条件很差，更别说赶上火车晚点了。
not to mention.translation: 朋友：这次旅行怎么样 玩得开心吗 你：住宿就很差 更别说路上还晚点了 朋友：那不是糟透了 你：是啊 再也不去了
not to mention.example: Friend: How was the trip, did you have fun? You: The accommodation was bad, not to mention the train delays on the way. Friend: That sounds terrible. You: Yeah, never going back.

on behalf of.context: 年会上你代表全体员工发言，感谢公司一年的照顾。
on behalf of.translation: 朋友：年会上你要上台发言吗 你：是的 我代表员工讲几句话 朋友：紧张吗 你：有点 准备了稿子
on behalf of.example: Friend: Are you speaking at the annual party? You: Yes, I'll speak on behalf of the employees. Friend: Nervous? You: A bit, I prepared notes.

participate in.context: 学校组织志愿者活动，同学们都积极参加。
participate in.translation: 朋友：周末那个志愿活动你去吗 你：去 大家都积极参与 朋友：都做什么内容 你：去养老院陪老人聊天
participate in.example: Friend: Are you going to that volunteer event this weekend? You: Yes, I participate in it. Friend: What do you do there? You: Go to the nursing home to chat with elders.

range from.context: 这家咖啡店的价格从二十块到五十块不等。
range from.translation: 朋友：这家咖啡店贵不贵呀 你：价格从二十到五十不等 看你点什么 朋友：那美式多少钱 你：二十八一杯
range from.example: Friend: Is this coffee shop expensive? You: Prices range from twenty to fifty, depending on what you order. Friend: How much for an Americano? You: Twenty-eight a cup.

refer to.context: 朋友问你刚才说的那个词是什么意思，你让他查字典。
refer to.translation: 朋友：你刚才说的那个词是什么意思呀 你：你可以查字典自己看 朋友：你直接告诉我不就好了 你：自己查记得更牢
refer to.example: Friend: What does that word you just said mean? You: You can refer to the dictionary to look it up. Friend: Can't you just tell me? You: Go look it up yourself, you'll remember it better.

regard as.context: 大家都觉得他是个靠谱的人，同事们都很信任他。
regard as.translation: 朋友：你觉得他这个人怎么样 你：他被公认为是个靠谱的人 朋友：那合作应该很放心 你：对 交给他的事都办得好
regard as.example: Friend: What do you think of him? You: He is generally regarded as a reliable person. Friend: Then you can trust working with him. You: Yeah, he gets things done.

regardless of.context: 当你下定决心做一件事，不想被外界看法或花费影响时，用它表明不论代价都要去做。
regardless of.translation: 朋友：你真要花那么多钱去上那个口语班吗 你：对，不管花多少钱，我都想把口语练好 朋友：可有人说那性价比不高 你：我不在乎别人怎么说，反正我已经决定了
regardless of.example: Friend: Are you really going to spend that much on that speaking course? You: Yes, regardless of the cost, I want to get my spoken English right. Friend: But some say it's not great value. You: I don't care what others say; anyway I've made up my mind.

result in.context: 复盘一次失败的项目或比赛时，用它说明某个做法最终造成了什么结果。
result in.translation: 朋友：上次比赛我们怎么输得那么惨 你：因为准备不足，导致开场就连丢三分 朋友：是不是也跟替补没练配合有关 你：对，正是这些问题最终导致整场失利
result in.example: Friend: Why did we lose so badly in that match? You: Because our lack of preparation resulted in conceding three goals right at the start. Friend: Was it also because the substitutes hadn't practiced together? You: Yes, exactly these problems resulted in the whole loss.

so as to.context: 为了达成某个目的而特意做准备，说明“以便、为的是”时，用它连接意图。
so as to.translation: 朋友：你把会议资料提前打印出来做什么 你：以便开会时大家能直接对照着看 朋友：需要我帮你装订成册吗 你：好，这样讨论起来会更方便
so as to.example: Friend: Why did you print the meeting materials in advance? You: So that everyone can follow along during the meeting. Friend: Want me to bind them into booklets? You: Good, so it'll be easier to discuss.

stem from.context: 分析某个问题或情绪的根源，说它“源于、来自”某个深层原因时，就用它。
stem from.translation: 朋友：他最近为什么总发脾气 你：他的坏情绪其实源于工作压力 朋友：没人跟他聊聊吗 你：问题的根源还是长期积累的疲惫
stem from.example: Friend: Why is he losing his temper lately? You: His bad feelings actually stem from work pressure. Friend: Didn't anyone talk with him? You: The problem stems from long-built-up exhaustion.

strive for.context: 为某个目标、理想付出长期努力，说“为……而奋斗、争取”时，就用它。
strive for.translation: 朋友：你每天那么早起来练口语图什么 你：我一直想争取出国交流的名额 朋友：竞争那么激烈，能行吗 你：不管多辛苦，我都会努力争取
strive for.example: Friend: Why do you get up so early to practice speaking? You: I've been striving for a spot to go abroad for exchange. Friend: With such fierce competition, can you make it? You: However hard, I'll keep striving for it.

strive to.context: 下定决心“尽力去做、努力尝试”一件有挑战的事时，就用它表决心。
strive to.translation: 朋友：这次演讲比赛你敢报名吗 你：虽然紧张，但我会尽力去准备 朋友：万一忘词了怎么办 你：不管结果如何，我都会努力一搏
strive to.example: Friend: Dare you sign up for this speech contest? You: Though nervous, I'll strive to prepare for it. Friend: What if you forget your lines? You: Whatever the result, I'll strive to give it my all.

take advantage of.context: 趁某个好机会、好条件“加以利用”，或略带贬义说人“占便宜”时，就用它。
take advantage of.translation: 朋友：商场周年庆折扣很大，要不要去逛逛 你：当然，我们得好好利用这个机会 朋友：错过可就没这价了 你：对，这种便宜不占白不占
take advantage of.example: Friend: The mall's anniversary sale is huge, want to go? You: Of course, we must take advantage of this chance. Friend: Miss it and the price is gone. You: Right, such a deal shouldn't be wasted.

take for granted.context: 感慨某人把别人的付出当成理所当然、不懂珍惜时，就用它表达这种不满。
take for granted.translation: 朋友：他女朋友对他那么好，他却从不感激 你：他就是把别人的好当成了理所当然 朋友：这样早晚会出问题 你：是啊，谁也不该被这样对待
take for granted.example: Friend: His girlfriend is so good to him, yet he never appreciates it. You: He just takes her kindness for granted. Friend: This will cause trouble sooner or later. You: Right, no one should be taken for granted.

take into account.context: 做决策前提醒对方“把某因素考虑进去、计入考量”时，就用它。
take into account.translation: 朋友：定出发时间要不要把早高峰算进去 你：当然要把堵车的时间考虑进去 朋友：那我们得提前半小时出门 你：对，把这些因素都考虑进去才稳妥
take into account.example: Friend: Should we factor the morning rush into the departure time? You: Of course we must take the traffic into account. Friend: Then we should leave half an hour early. You: Right, take all these into account and it's safe.

take into consideration.context: 评估方案时，正式地提醒“把某种情况纳入考虑”，就用它，比 take into account 更书面。
take into consideration.translation: 朋友：这个方案预算够，可员工加班太多 你：所以我们得把大家的疲劳也考虑进去 朋友：那是不是该多请几个人 你：对，把员工负荷纳入考量才公平
take into consideration.example: Friend: This plan fits the budget, but staff work too much overtime. You: So we must take everyone's fatigue into consideration. Friend: Should we hire a few more people? You: Right, take the workload into consideration and it's fair.

take responsibility for.context: 出了问题主动“承担责任、担起责任”，不推卸时，就用它。
take responsibility for.translation: 朋友：这次失误谁来背锅 你：是我指挥错了，我来承担责任 朋友：可大家都有份啊 你：没事，这件事由我负责
take responsibility for.example: Friend: Who's to blame for this mistake? You: I misdirected, so I'll take responsibility for it. Friend: But everyone had a part. You: It's fine, I'll take responsibility for this.
