the majority of.context: 描述群体中“大多数、大部分”人或物的情况时，就用它。
the majority of.translation: 朋友：这次考试大家都过了吗 你：大多数人都顺利通过了 朋友：挂科的多吗 你：不多，大部分人都没问题
the majority of.example: Friend: Did everyone pass this exam? You: The majority of people passed smoothly. Friend: Are many failing? You: Not many; the majority are fine.

to a certain extent.context: 表达某种看法“在一定程度上、某种范围内”是对的，留有余地时，就用它。
to a certain extent.translation: 朋友：你觉得他说得有道理吗 你：在一定程度上是对的 朋友：那到底同不同意 你：部分赞同，完全同意谈不上
to a certain extent.example: Friend: Do you think what he said makes sense? You: To a certain extent, it's right. Friend: So do you agree or not? You: Partly agree; fully agree no.

to some extent.context: 与上一条相近，表“在某种程度上、部分地”承认某事时，就用它。
to some extent.translation: 朋友：这份报告到底有没有参考价值 你：某种程度上还是有参考意义的 朋友：能直接用吗 你：部分能用，别全信
to some extent.example: Friend: Does this report have any reference value? You: To some extent it's still useful. Friend: Can we use it directly? You: Partly usable; don't trust it all.

turning point.context: 人生或事业中出现重大转折的“关键时刻、转折点”，就用它。
turning point.translation: 朋友：你这辈子最关键的决定是什么 你：当年辞职创业是我人生的转折点 朋友：后悔吗 你：不后悔，那是我命运的转折
turning point.example: Friend: What's the most crucial decision in your life? You: Quitting to start a business was the turning point of my life. Friend: Regret it? You: No regret; it was my turning point.

vice versa.context: 两者关系反过来也成立，说“反之亦然、反过来也一样”时，就用它。
vice versa.translation: 朋友：你喜欢他，他也一定喜欢你吗 你：不一定，但反过来也成立 朋友：什么意思 你：就是他若喜欢你，你也会喜欢他
vice versa.example: Friend: If you like him, does he necessarily like you? You: Not necessarily, but vice versa holds. Friend: What do you mean? You: That if he likes you, vice versa you like him.

vicious circle.context: 问题互相强化、越陷越深的“恶性循环”，就用它。
vicious circle.translation: 朋友：他越缺钱越焦虑，越焦虑越干不好 你：这就是一个恶性循环 朋友：怎么打破它 你：得先从一个环节切断
vicious circle.example: Friend: The more broke he is, the more anxious; the more anxious, the worse he does. You: That's a vicious circle. Friend: How to break it? You: You must cut one link of the vicious circle.

with regard to.context: 正式地引出“关于、就……而言”某个事项，就用它。
with regard to.translation: 朋友：那个合同修订的事有进展吗 你：关于条款，我们还在商量 朋友：客户那边急吗 你：就价格而言，他们比较急
with regard to.example: Friend: Any progress on that contract revision? You: With regard to the clauses, we're still discussing. Friend: Is the client urgent? You: With regard to price, they're rather urgent.

with respect to.context: 更书面的“关于、至于”，用于正式邮件或报告，就用它。
with respect to.translation: 朋友：项目预算批了吗 你：关于预算，财务还在审 朋友：时间节点呢 你：至于时间，倒是定了
with respect to.example: Friend: Has the project budget been approved? You: With respect to the budget, finance is still reviewing. Friend: And the timeline? You: With respect to timing, that's settled.

with the exception of.context: 整体都如此，“除了……之外”都不例外，就用它。
with the exception of.translation: 朋友：这次考试大家都过了吗 你：除了小李，其他人都过了 朋友：他怎么挂了 你：就他一个人没过
with the exception of.example: Friend: Did everyone pass this exam? You: With the exception of Xiao Li, everyone passed. Friend: Why did he fail? You: He's the only one who failed.

go over.translation: 朋友：明天考试有把握吗 你：我今晚再过一遍 朋友：重点看哪 你：错题
go over.example: Friend: Confident about tomorrow's exam? You: I'll go over it again tonight. Friend: Focus on what? You: Go over the mistakes.

put up with.context: “忍受、容忍”（常指忍受不好的事），就用它。
put up with.translation: 朋友：隔壁天天吵 你：我实在受不了了 朋友：投诉过吗 你：没有
put up with.example: Friend: The neighbor makes noise every day. You: I can't put up with it anymore. Friend: Complained? You: I can't put up with the noise.

out of breath.context: 跑步、赶楼“上气不接下气”，就用它。
out of breath.translation: 朋友：你怎么喘成这样 你：我一口气跑上楼的 朋友：慢点 你：累死了
out of breath.example: Friend: Why are you so out of breath? You: I ran up the stairs in one go. Friend: Slow down. You: I'm out of breath from running.

be absorbed in.translation: 朋友：你连我进门都没发现 你：我正专心看书呢 朋友：这么入迷 你：对
be absorbed in.example: Friend: You didn't even notice me come in. You: I was absorbed in reading. Friend: So absorbed. You: I was absorbed in the book.

be accustomed to.translation: 朋友：你早起还适应吗 你：我已经习惯了 朋友：真自律 你：习惯了就好
be accustomed to.example: Friend: Are you used to getting up early? You: I'm accustomed to it. Friend: So disciplined. You: I'm accustomed to the routine.

be associated with.translation: 朋友：这个品牌总跟什么挂钩 你：它常跟高端联系在一起 朋友：价格也贵 你：对
be associated with.example: Friend: What is this brand associated with? You: It's associated with high-end. Friend: Price is high too. You: It's associated with luxury.

be committed to.translation: 朋友：他为什么天天泡实验室 你：他全心投入科研 朋友：图什么 你：热爱
be committed to.example: Friend: Why does he always stay in the lab? You: He's committed to research. Friend: What for? You: He's committed to his work.

be concerned about.translation: 朋友：你最近老看天气预报 你：我担心台风 朋友：影响大吗 你：沿海
be concerned about.example: Friend: Why do you always check the weather lately? You: I'm concerned about the typhoon. Friend: Big impact? You: I'm concerned about coastal areas.

be conscious of.translation: 朋友：你知道自己说话很快吗 你：我没意识到 朋友：放慢点 你：好
be conscious of.example: Friend: Are you conscious of speaking fast? You: I wasn't conscious of it. Friend: Slow down. You: I'll be conscious of it.

be content with.translation: 朋友：你对现在的生活满意吗 你：我挺知足的 朋友：不想更好吗 你：知足常乐
be content with.example: Friend: Are you content with your life now? You: I'm content with it. Friend: Don't you want better? You: I'm content with what I have.

be contrary to.translation: 朋友：结果跟你想的一样吗 你：跟预期完全相反 朋友：怎么会 你：意外
be contrary to.example: Friend: Is the result as you expected? You: It's contrary to expectations. Friend: How so? You: It's contrary to what I thought.

be dedicated to.translation: 朋友：那位老医生为什么受人尊敬 你：他毕生献身医学 朋友：真了不起 你：是
be dedicated to.example: Friend: Why is that old doctor respected? You: He's dedicated to medicine all his life. Friend: Remarkable. You: He's dedicated to his patients.

be dependent on.translation: 朋友：他还跟父母要钱吗 你：他经济上还靠家里 朋友：不独立吗 你：还没
be dependent on.example: Friend: Does he still ask his parents for money? You: He's still dependent on them financially. Friend: Not independent? You: He's dependent on them for now.

be determined to.context: “决心、下定决心”做某事，就用它。
be determined to.translation: 朋友：你真要辞职考研吗 你：我已经下决心了 朋友：想清楚了吗 你：想好了
be determined to.example: Friend: Are you really quitting to study for the exam? You: I'm determined to. Friend: Thought it through? You: I'm determined to do it.

be engaged in.context: “从事于、忙于”某项活动，就用它。
be engaged in.translation: 朋友：他现在在忙什么项目 你：他正从事一个课题研究 朋友：忙得过来吗 你：还好
be engaged in.example: Friend: What project is he busy with? You: He's engaged in a research topic. Friend: Can he manage? You: He's engaged in it full time.

be equal to.translation: 朋友：这份工作他能胜任吗 你：他完全能胜任 朋友：真的吗 你：是
be equal to.example: Friend: Can he handle this job? You: He's equal to it. Friend: Really? You: He's equal to the task.

be familiar to.context: “为……所熟悉”（主语是被熟悉的事物），就用它。
be familiar to.translation: 朋友：这个地名你熟吗 你：它对我来说很熟悉 朋友：去过吗 你：多次
be familiar to.example: Friend: Is this place name familiar to you? You: It's familiar to me. Friend: Been there? You: It's familiar to me from many visits.

be grateful for.translation: 朋友：你最感谢哪件事 你：我感激那次机遇 朋友：为什么 你：改变了我
be grateful for.example: Friend: What do you thank most? You: I'm grateful for that opportunity. Friend: Why? You: I'm grateful for it because it changed me.

be ignorant of.translation: 朋友：他怎么连这个都不懂 你：他对这领域一无所知 朋友：没接触过吗 你：没有
be ignorant of.example: Friend: Why doesn't he even know this? You: He's ignorant of this field. Friend: Never exposed? You: He's ignorant of it entirely.

be immune to.translation: 朋友：大家都感冒了就他没事 你：他好像对感冒免疫 朋友：真幸运 你：是
be immune to.example: Friend: Everyone caught a cold but he's fine. You: He seems immune to it. Friend: Lucky. You: He's immune to colds.

be inclined to.translation: 朋友：他遇到难题怎么办 你：他倾向于先自己查 朋友：不轻易问人 你：对
be inclined to.example: Friend: What does he do facing hard problems? You: He's inclined to look it up himself first. Friend: Doesn't ask easily. You: He's inclined to figure it out.

be independent of.translation: 朋友：他工作后还靠家里吗 你：他已经独立了 朋友：真能干 你：是
be independent of.example: Friend: Does he still rely on home after work? You: He's independent of them now. Friend: Capable. You: He's independent of his family.

be indispensable to.context: “对……不可或缺、必不可少”，就用它。
be indispensable to.translation: 朋友：他在团队里重要吗 你：他是不可缺少的人 朋友：为什么 你：技术核心
be indispensable to.example: Friend: Is he important in the team? You: He's indispensable to it. Friend: Why? You: He's indispensable to the team's core tech.

be involved in.translation: 朋友：那个项目你参加了吗 你：我参与其中了 朋友：负责什么 你：协调
be involved in.example: Friend: Did you join that project? You: I'm involved in it. Friend: Responsible for what? You: I'm involved in coordination.

be opposed to.translation: 朋友：他同意这个方案吗 你：他坚决反对 朋友：为什么 你：成本太高
be opposed to.example: Friend: Does he agree with this plan? You: He's opposed to it firmly. Friend: Why? You: He's opposed to it for the high cost.

be optimistic about.translation: 朋友：你对明天的比赛有信心吗 你：我比较乐观 朋友：理由呢 你：状态好
be optimistic about.example: Friend: Are you confident about tomorrow's match? You: I'm optimistic about it. Friend: Reason? You: I'm optimistic because I'm in good shape.

be relevant to.translation: 朋友：这个例子跟主题有关吗 你：它紧扣主题 朋友：别跑题 你：不会
be relevant to.example: Friend: Is this example relevant to the topic? You: It's relevant to it. Friend: Don't go off topic. You: It's relevant to the main point.

be reluctant to.translation: 朋友：他愿意帮忙吗 你：他不太情愿 朋友：为什么 你：怕麻烦
be reluctant to.example: Friend: Is he willing to help? You: He's reluctant to. Friend: Why? You: He's reluctant to help for fear of trouble.

be representative of.translation: 朋友：这个样本能说明问题吗 你：它很有代表性 朋友：真的吗 你：是
be representative of.example: Friend: Does this sample represent the whole? You: It's representative of it. Friend: Really? You: It's representative of the group.

be resistant to.translation: 朋友：这种药还有效吗 你：细菌已对它耐药 朋友：麻烦了 你：换药
be resistant to.example: Friend: Does this medicine still work? You: Bacteria are resistant to it. Friend: Trouble. You: They're resistant, switch drugs.

be sensitive to.translation: 朋友：她皮肤怎么老过敏 你：她对花粉敏感 朋友：春天注意 你：戴口罩
be sensitive to.example: Friend: Why is her skin always allergic? You: She's sensitive to pollen. Friend: Be careful in spring. You: She's sensitive to it; wear a mask.

be skeptical of.translation: 朋友：他信那个广告吗 你：他对此半信半疑 朋友：为什么 你：夸大
be skeptical of.example: Friend: Does he believe that ad? You: He's skeptical of it. Friend: Why? You: He's skeptical of its exaggeration.

be sympathetic to.translation: 朋友：大家对他的遭遇怎么看 你：都很同情他 朋友：愿意帮吗 你：是
be sympathetic to.example: Friend: How do people view his plight? You: They're sympathetic to him. Friend: Willing to help? You: They're sympathetic to his suffering.

be tolerant of.translation: 朋友：这里的人好相处吗 你：他们对不同意见很包容 朋友：真开放 你：是
be tolerant of.example: Friend: Are people here easy to get along with? You: They're tolerant of different views. Friend: So open. You: They're tolerant of diversity.

be typical of.translation: 朋友：这种天气正常吗 你：这是本地典型的春天 朋友：多变 你：对
be typical of.example: Friend: Is this weather normal? You: It's typical of spring here. Friend: Changeable. You: It's typical of the local spring.

be wary of.translation: 朋友：网上那些兼职靠谱吗 你：你得当心骗局 朋友：怎么分辨 你：先交钱的别信
be wary of.example: Friend: Are those online part-time jobs reliable? You: Be wary of scams. Friend: How to tell? You: Be wary of those asking for money first.

be worthy of.translation: 朋友：这家店值得去吗 你：它值得一试 朋友：口碑如何 你：不错
be worthy of.example: Friend: Is this shop worth going? You: It's worthy of a try. Friend: Reputation? You: It's worthy of the praise.

accuse...of.translation: 朋友：他被同事投诉了 你：大家指责他不守时 朋友：他承认吗 你：没有
accuse...of.example: Friend: He was complained about by colleagues. You: They accuse him of being late. Friend: Does he admit? You: They accuse him of laziness.

apply for.translation: 朋友：你拿到心仪的 offer 了吗 你：我正在申请 朋友：材料交了吗 你：交了
apply for.example: Friend: Did you get the offer you want? You: I'm applying for it. Friend: Submitted the materials? You: I'm applying for the job.

approve of.translation: 朋友：你爸妈同意你去留学吗 你：他们赞成 朋友：真的吗 你：是
approve of.example: Friend: Do your parents approve of your studying abroad? You: They approve of it. Friend: Really? You: They approve of my plan.

attribute...to.translation: 朋友：他为什么能成功 你：他把成功归于坚持 朋友：运气呢 你：也有
attribute...to.example: Friend: Why did he succeed? You: He attributes his success to persistence. Friend: Luck? You: He attributes it to both.

break away from.translation: 朋友：那家小公司独立了吗 你：它从总公司脱离了 朋友：以后自己干 你：是
break away from.example: Friend: Did that small company become independent? You: It broke away from the parent. Friend: On its own now. You: It broke away from the group.

break through.translation: 朋友：科研有新进展吗 你：他们终于突破了 朋友：可喜 你：是
break through.example: Friend: Any new progress in research? You: They finally broke through. Friend: Great news. You: They broke through the bottleneck.

burst into.translation: 朋友：她怎么突然哭了 你：她突然哭了起来 朋友：安慰一下 你：好
burst into.example: Friend: Why did she suddenly cry? You: She burst into tears. Friend: Comfort her. You: She burst into tears; let's calm her.

come about.translation: 朋友：这件事是怎么发生的 你：谁也说不清 朋友：查清楚了吗 你：还没
come about.example: Friend: How did this come about? You: No one can explain clearly. Friend: Figured it out? You: It came about from a misunderstanding.

come into effect.translation: 朋友：新规定什么时候执行 你：下个月生效 朋友：有影响吗 你：挺大
come into effect.example: Friend: When does the new rule take effect? You: It comes into effect next month. Friend: Big impact? You: It comes into effect then.

come into being.translation: 朋友：这个组织是怎么来的 你：它十年前成立的 朋友：初衷是什么 你：公益
come into being.example: Friend: How did this organization come into being? You: It came into being ten years ago. Friend: Original intent? You: It came into being for charity.

correspond to.translation: 朋友：这个数字跟报告对得上吗 你：它跟总数一致 朋友：没错吧 你：是
correspond to.example: Friend: Does this figure correspond to the report? You: It corresponds to the total. Friend: Correct? You: It corresponds to it exactly.

count on.translation: 朋友：这事能交给他办吗 你：你可以放心指望他 朋友：他靠谱吗 你：非常
count on.example: Friend: Can we leave this to him? You: You can count on him. Friend: Is he reliable? You: You can count on him fully.

cut across.translation: 朋友：走正门绕太远了 你：我们从操场穿过去 朋友：能省多久 你：十分钟
cut across.example: Friend: Going through the main gate is too far. You: Let's cut across the playground. Friend: Save how long? You: Cut across and save ten minutes.

cut off.translation: 朋友：怎么说着说着断了 你：电话被切断了 朋友：信号不好 你：重打
cut off.example: Friend: Why did we cut off mid-sentence? You: The call was cut off. Friend: Bad signal. You: It cut off; call back.

die away.context: 声音、风声“逐渐消失、减弱”，就用它。
die away.translation: 朋友：远处的鞭炮声怎么没了 你：它渐渐平息了 朋友：走远了 你：对
die away.example: Friend: Why did the distant firecrackers die away? You: It died away gradually. Friend: They're far. You: The sound died away.

distinguish...from.translation: 朋友：这俩双胞胎我老分不清 你：要分辨他们也不难 朋友：怎么分 你：看痣
distinguish...from.example: Friend: I always mix up these twins. You: Distinguishing them from each other isn't hard. Friend: How? You: Distinguish them by the mole.

do away with.translation: 朋友：老规定还执行吗 你：早就废除了 朋友：换了新的 你：对
do away with.example: Friend: Is the old rule still enforced? You: It was done away with long ago. Friend: Replaced? You: It was done away with.

draw up.translation: 朋友：这份合同谁写的 你：我起草的 朋友：法律审核过吗 你：过了
draw up.example: Friend: Who wrote this contract? You: I drew it up. Friend: Legally reviewed? You: I drew it up then reviewed.

drop out.translation: 朋友：那个选手怎么退赛了 你：他因伤退出了 朋友：可惜 你：是
drop out.example: Friend: Why did that contestant drop out? You: He dropped out due to injury. Friend: A pity. You: He dropped out of the race.

end up with.translation: 朋友：折腾半天结果怎样 你：最后白忙一场 朋友：不甘心 你：是
end up with.example: Friend: After all that trouble, what was the result? You: We ended up with nothing. Friend: Unwilling. You: We ended up with a loss.

face up to.translation: 朋友：他一直躲着这件事 你：总得勇敢面对 朋友：劝劝他 你：是
face up to.example: Friend: He keeps avoiding this. You: He must face up to it. Friend: Persuade him. You: He must face up to reality.

fall back on.context: “求助于、转而依靠”（退路），就用它。
fall back on.translation: 朋友：万一主业干不成怎么办 你：我还有副业保底 朋友：真有备手 你：是
fall back on.example: Friend: What if the main job fails? You: I can fall back on my side job. Friend: A backup plan. You: I fall back on my skills.

get across.translation: 朋友：学生听懂你的意思了吗 你：我把观点讲清楚了 朋友：他们反应如何 你：明白了
get across.example: Friend: Did the students get your point? You: I got the idea across. Friend: How did they react? You: I got it across clearly.

get away with.translation: 朋友：他迟到竟没被说 你：他每次都侥幸过关 朋友：迟早露馅 你：是
get away with.example: Friend: He was late but wasn't told off. You: He gets away with it every time. Friend: Sooner or later he's caught. You: He gets away with too much.

get down to.context: “开始认真着手”做某事，就用它。
get down to.translation: 朋友：别再聊了 你：对，该正经干活了 朋友：从哪开始 你：动手
get down to.example: Friend: Stop chatting. You: Right, let's get down to work. Friend: Start where? You: Get down to it now.

give rise to.translation: 朋友：这场争论是怎么起的 你：是一句话引发的 朋友：至于吗 你：小题大做
give rise to.example: Friend: What gave rise to this argument? You: A single remark gave rise to it. Friend: Is it worth it? You: It gave rise to a storm in a teacup.

go against.translation: 朋友：这么做行吗 你：这规定不能违反 朋友：会受罚吗 你：会
go against.example: Friend: Is it OK to do this? You: It goes against the rules. Friend: Will it be punished? You: It goes against policy.

go along with.translation: 朋友：这个方案你支持吗 你：我附和大家的意见 朋友：真心吗 你：嗯
go along with.example: Friend: Do you support this plan? You: I'll go along with the group. Friend: Sincere? You: I'll go along with it.

go back on.translation: 朋友：他答应的事怎么不算数 你：他总是反悔 朋友：不可靠 你：是
go back on.example: Friend: Why isn't his promise kept? You: He always goes back on his word. Friend: Unreliable. You: He goes back on promises.

go in for.translation: 朋友：你业余爱参加什么活动 你：我喜欢跑马拉松 朋友：多久一次 你：一年
go in for.example: Friend: What activities do you go in for? You: I go in for marathons. Friend: How often? You: I go in for running.

go through with.translation: 朋友：他真敢把计划做完吗 你：他咬牙坚持到底了 朋友：不容易 你：是
go through with.example: Friend: Will he really go through with the plan? You: He gritted his teeth and went through with it. Friend: Not easy. You: He went through with it.

hand down.translation: 朋友：这镯子是哪来的 你：是奶奶传下来的 朋友：有年头了 你：三代
hand down.example: Friend: Where did this bracelet come from? You: It was handed down from my grandma. Friend: Old. You: Handed down for three generations.

hand over.translation: 朋友：退休后工作谁接手 你：我会移交给副手 朋友：交接清楚 你：是
hand over.example: Friend: Who takes over after retirement? You: I'll hand over to my deputy. Friend: Hand over clearly. You: I'll hand it over.

hang on.translation: 朋友：这关快过不去了 你：再坚持一下 朋友：就快赢了 你：挺住
hang on.example: Friend: I'm about to lose this level. You: Hang on a bit more. Friend: Almost winning. You: Hang on, we'll make it.

lay off.translation: 朋友：公司最近怎么了 你：裁员了 朋友：裁了多少 你：二十人
lay off.example: Friend: What's wrong with the company lately? You: They laid off staff. Friend: How many? You: They laid off twenty people.

lay out.translation: 朋友：发布会现场谁布置的 你：我设计的 朋友：好看吗 你：挺专业
lay out.example: Friend: Who laid out the launch venue? You: I laid it out. Friend: Looks good? You: I laid it out professionally.

look on.translation: 朋友：大家都在帮忙，他干嘛呢 你：他在旁边看着 朋友：也不搭把手 你：是
look on.example: Friend: Everyone's helping, what's he doing? You: He just looks on. Friend: Won't lend a hand. You: He only looks on.

object to.translation: 朋友：他同意搬家吗 你：他反对 朋友：为什么 你：舍不得老朋友
object to.example: Friend: Does he agree to moving? You: He objects to it. Friend: Why? You: He objects to leaving old friends.

occur to.context: “被想到、想起”（主语是主意），就用它。
occur to.translation: 朋友：你怎么想到这个点子的 你：它突然冒出来的 朋友：灵感啊 你：是
occur to.example: Friend: How did you think of this idea? You: It occurred to me suddenly. Friend: Inspiration. You: It occurred to me out of the blue.

persist in.translation: 朋友：他撞了南墙也不回头 你：他就是固执 朋友：劝不住 你：是
persist in.example: Friend: He won't turn back even hitting a wall. You: He persists in his way. Friend: Can't persuade. You: He persists in doing it.

preside over.translation: 朋友：今天的会谁主持 你：由总经理主持 朋友：议程多吗 你：不少
preside over.example: Friend: Who presides over today's meeting? You: The general manager presides over it. Friend: Many items? You: He presides over a long agenda.

pull through.translation: 朋友：那场大病他挺过来了吗 你：他熬过来了 朋友：真不容易 你：是
pull through.example: Friend: Did he pull through that serious illness? You: He pulled through. Friend: Not easy. You: He pulled through the crisis.

put forward.translation: 朋友：这个方案谁想的 你：我提出的 朋友：大家反响如何 你：不错
put forward.example: Friend: Who put forward this plan? You: I put it forward. Friend: How was it received? You: I put forward a good plan.

reckon with.translation: 朋友：这个对手不好惹 你：得认真对付 朋友：轻敌要吃亏 你：是
reckon with.example: Friend: This opponent isn't to be trifled with. You: We must reckon with him. Friend: Underestimate and lose. You: We must reckon with the strong side.

reflect on.translation: 朋友：夜深了你在想什么 你：我在反思今天的事 朋友：有感悟吗 你：有
reflect on.example: Friend: What are you thinking late at night? You: I'm reflecting on today's events. Friend: Any insight? You: I'm reflecting on my mistakes.

rest on.translation: 朋友：这个结论可靠吗 你：它建立在数据之上 朋友：扎实吗 你：是
rest on.example: Friend: Is this conclusion reliable? You: It rests on data. Friend: Solid? You: It rests on solid evidence.

rule out.translation: 朋友：几个候选方案怎么样 你：我们排除了两个 朋友：为什么 你：不现实
rule out.example: Friend: How are the candidate plans? You: We ruled out two. Friend: Why? You: We ruled out the unrealistic ones.

run into.translation: 朋友：你在哪碰见老同学的 你：我在超市偶然遇到的 朋友：巧不巧 你：真巧
run into.example: Friend: Where did you run into your old classmate? You: I ran into her at the supermarket. Friend: A coincidence. You: I ran into her by chance.

set about.translation: 朋友：装修什么时候开始 你：下周动工 朋友：从哪下手 你：先拆旧
set about.example: Friend: When does the renovation start? You: We'll set about it next week. Friend: Start where? You: Set about removing the old stuff.

set aside.translation: 朋友：你每月存钱吗 你：我会留一点 朋友：多少 你：一千
set aside.example: Friend: Do you save money every month? You: I set aside a bit. Friend: How much? You: I set aside one thousand.

stand out.translation: 朋友：那么多求职者他凭什么被选上 你：他简历最亮眼 朋友：有什么特长 你：突出
stand out.example: Friend: Why was he chosen among so many applicants? You: His resume stands out. Friend: What special skill? You: He stands out from the rest.

step up.translation: 朋友：进度怎么落后了 你：得加快步伐 朋友：加派人手 你：是
step up.example: Friend: Why is the schedule behind? You: We must step up the pace. Friend: Add people. You: Step up the effort.

take to.translation: 朋友：他怎么突然爱起晨跑了 你：他很快就喜欢上了 朋友：坚持得好吗 你：是
take to.example: Friend: Why did he suddenly fall for morning running? You: He took to it quickly. Friend: Does he keep it? You: He took to it and stuck with it.

talk into.context: “说服某人做（原本不想做的事）”，就用它。
talk into.translation: 朋友：他本来不想来，怎么来了 你：我劝来的 朋友：真能说 你：是
talk into.example: Friend: He didn't want to come, why is he here? You: I talked him into it. Friend: Persuasive. You: I talked him into coming.

think highly of.translation: 朋友：领导对你印象如何 你：他对我评价很高 朋友：继续保持 你：是
think highly of.example: Friend: What's the boss's impression of you? You: He thinks highly of me. Friend: Keep it up. You: He thinks highly of my work.

throw light on.translation: 朋友：这个谜团解开了吗 你：新证据让真相大白 朋友：水落石出 你：是
throw light on.example: Friend: Is the mystery solved? You: New evidence threw light on it. Friend: The truth is out. You: It threw light on the case.

tower over.translation: 朋友：那座高楼显眼吗 你：它耸立在周围建筑之上 朋友：地标啊 你：是
tower over.example: Friend: Is that tall building noticeable? You: It towers over the surrounding buildings. Friend: A landmark. You: It towers over the skyline.

watch over.translation: 朋友：你出差时宠物谁管 你：我请朋友照看 朋友：放心吗 你：是
watch over.example: Friend: Who looks after your pet when you're away? You: I ask a friend to watch over it. Friend: Trust them? You: They watch over it well.

wear off.context: （效果、感觉）“逐渐消失、减退”，就用它。
wear off.translation: 朋友：麻药劲过了吗 你：药效慢慢退了 朋友：疼吗 你：有点
wear off.example: Friend: Has the anesthetic worn off? You: It's wearing off. Friend: Does it hurt? You: The effect wore off a little.

against all odds.context: “克服重重困难、尽管希望渺茫”，就用它。
against all odds.translation: 朋友：他一个人把项目做起来了 你：真不容易 朋友：太励志 你：是
against all odds.example: Friend: He started the project alone against all odds. You: So hard. Friend: Inspiring. You: He succeeded against all odds.

as far as...be concerned.translation: 朋友：你觉得这个方案怎么样 你：就我而言，还不错 朋友：别人呢 你：另说
as far as...be concerned.example: Friend: What do you think of this plan? You: As far as I'm concerned, it's fine. Friend: And others? You: As far as I'm concerned, it works.

as follows.translation: 朋友：会议议程是什么 你：安排如下 朋友：念一下 你：好
as follows.example: Friend: What's the meeting agenda? You: It's as follows. Friend: Read it. You: The agenda is as follows.

as regards.translation: 朋友：后续的事怎么安排 你：关于时间，还没定 朋友：人员呢 你：另说
as regards.example: Friend: How to arrange follow-up? You: As regards timing, it's not set. Friend: And people? You: As regards staff, to be decided.

as to.translation: 朋友：去哪度假定了吗 你：至于地点，我还在想 朋友：有候选吗 你：海边
as to.example: Friend: Decided where to vacation? You: As to the place, I'm still thinking. Friend: Any candidates? You: As to the spot, the beach.

at a loss.context: “困惑不解、茫然不知所措”，就用它。
at a loss.translation: 朋友：他听到消息什么反应 你：他一下子懵了 朋友：缓过来了吗 你：好一会
at a loss.example: Friend: How did he react to the news? You: He was at a loss. Friend: Recovered? You: He was at a loss for a while.

at any rate.translation: 朋友：明天下雨还去吗 你：不管怎样都去 朋友：带伞 你：是
at any rate.example: Friend: If it rains tomorrow, still go? You: At any rate we'll go. Friend: Bring an umbrella. You: At any rate, we go.

at heart.translation: 朋友：他外表严肃，人怎么样 你：他内心其实很善良 朋友：看不出来 你：是
at heart.example: Friend: He looks stern, how is he inside? You: At heart he's actually kind. Friend: Hard to tell. You: He's soft at heart.

at length.translation: 朋友：报告讲得怎么样 你：他详细阐述了一遍 朋友：很久吗 你：一小时
at length.example: Friend: How did he present the report? You: He explained it at length. Friend: Long? You: He talked at length for an hour.

at stake.translation: 朋友：这场比赛重要吗 你：输赢关系重大 朋友：怎么讲 你：进决赛
at stake.example: Friend: Is this match important? You: A lot is at stake. Friend: How so? You: The title is at stake.

at the mercy of.translation: 朋友：出海最怕什么 你：在海上只能听天由命 朋友：看天气 你：是
at the mercy of.example: Friend: What's the worst when sailing? You: At sea we're at the mercy of the weather. Friend: Depend on sky. You: We're at the mercy of the waves.

by all means.context: “务必、当然可以”，表同意或强调，就用它。
by all means.translation: 朋友：我能借用一下你的笔记吗 你：当然可以 朋友：太谢谢你 你：不客气
by all means.example: Friend: May I borrow your notes? You: By all means. Friend: Thanks so much. You: By all means, take them.

by chance.translation: 朋友：你们俩怎么认识的 你：我们偶然遇见的 朋友：在哪 你：书店
by chance.example: Friend: How did you two meet? You: We met by chance. Friend: Where? You: We met by chance in a bookstore.

by comparison.translation: 朋友：今年业绩怎么样 你：相比之下好很多 朋友：比去年强吗 你：强
by comparison.example: Friend: How is this year's performance? You: By comparison, much better. Friend: Stronger than last year? You: By comparison, yes.

by means of.translation: 朋友：你怎么联系上他的 你：通过邮件联系的 朋友：他回得快吗 你：是
by means of.example: Friend: How did you contact him? You: By means of email. Friend: Does he reply fast? You: By means of email, he does.

by no means.translation: 朋友：你觉得他靠谱吗 你：他一点也不靠谱 朋友：真的吗 你：是
by no means.example: Friend: Do you think he's reliable? You: He's by no means reliable. Friend: Really? You: He's by no means trustworthy.

by virtue of.translation: 朋友：他怎么升得这么快 你：凭借过硬的能力 朋友：运气好吗 你：实力
by virtue of.example: Friend: Why was he promoted so fast? You: By virtue of his strong ability. Friend: Lucky? You: By virtue of hard work.

by way of.translation: 朋友：去欧洲怎么走 你：取道巴黎转机 朋友：顺路玩吗 你：是
by way of.example: Friend: How to get to Europe? You: By way of Paris for a transfer. Friend: Sightsee on the way? You: We'll go by way of Paris.

for all.translation: 朋友：他那么有钱还这么抠 你：尽管有钱，仍小气 朋友：真的吗 你：是
for all.example: Friend: He's so rich yet so stingy. You: For all his money, he's stingy. Friend: Really? You: For all his wealth, he saves.

for good.translation: 朋友：他搬离这座城市了吗 你：他彻底走了 朋友：还回来吗 你：不
for good.example: Friend: Did he move out of the city? You: He's gone for good. Friend: Coming back? You: He left for good.

for life.translation: 朋友：那次事故留下了什么 你：给他留下终身的伤 朋友：遗憾 你：是
for life.example: Friend: What did that accident leave? You: It left him injured for life. Friend: A pity. You: He carries it for life.

for one thing.context: “一方面、一来”，引出理由，就用它。
for one thing.translation: 朋友：你为什么不换工作 你：一来工资还行 朋友：还有呢 你：离家近
for one thing.example: Friend: Why don't you change jobs? You: For one thing, the pay is OK. Friend: Anything else? You: For one thing it's near home.

for the benefit of.translation: 朋友：办这个讲座图什么 你：为了大家好 朋友：免费吗 你：免费
for the benefit of.example: Friend: What's the point of this lecture? You: For the benefit of everyone. Friend: Free? You: It's for the benefit of the students.

from memory.translation: 朋友：你没看稿就讲了 你：我凭记忆讲的 朋友：准确吗 你：八九不离十
from memory.example: Friend: You spoke without notes. You: I spoke from memory. Friend: Accurate? You: I recalled from memory, mostly right.

in behalf of.translation: 朋友：这封感谢信谁写的 你：我代表大家写的 朋友：替谁感谢 你：全体
in behalf of.example: Friend: Who wrote this thank-you letter? You: I wrote it in behalf of everyone. Friend: Thank whom for? You: In behalf of the team.

in case of.translation: 朋友：包里备伞干嘛 你：万一下雨 朋友：想得周到 你：是
in case of.example: Friend: Why carry an umbrella? You: In case of rain. Friend: Thoughtful. You: In case of sudden rain.

in collaboration with.translation: 朋友：这本书谁写的 你：我和同事合著的 朋友：真默契 你：是
in collaboration with.example: Friend: Who wrote this book? You: I wrote it in collaboration with a colleague. Friend: Great teamwork. You: In collaboration with her.

in debt.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么总躲着人 你：他欠了一屁股债 朋友：多少 你：不少
in debt.example: Friend: Why is he avoiding people lately? You: He's in debt. Friend: How much? You: He's in debt badly.

in defense of.translation: 朋友：他为什么站出来说话 你：为自己的立场辩护 朋友：有人质疑吗 你：是
in defense of.example: Friend: Why did he speak up? You: In defense of his position. Friend: Anyone questioning? You: He spoke in defense of his rights.

in essence.translation: 朋友：这两件事有区别吗 你：本质上是一回事 朋友：形式不同 你：对
in essence.example: Friend: Are these two things different? You: In essence, they're the same. Friend: Different in form. You: In essence, one thing.

in excess of.translation: 朋友：这次报名有多少人 你：超过了一千人 朋友：比往年多吗 你：是
in excess of.example: Friend: How many signed up this time? You: In excess of a thousand. Friend: More than before? You: In excess of last year.

in memory of.translation: 朋友：这座雕像立来干嘛 你：为纪念那位英雄 朋友：他做过什么 你：救人
in memory of.example: Friend: Why was this statue erected? You: In memory of that hero. Friend: What did he do? You: It stands in memory of him.

in no case.context: “决不、在任何情况下都不”，就用它。
in no case.translation: 朋友：能随便把资料外发吗 你：决不能这么做 朋友：记住了 你：是
in no case.example: Friend: Can we send the data out casually? You: In no case should we. Friend: Got it. You: In no case leak it.

in no way.translation: 朋友：这件事跟你有关吗 你：这跟我毫无关系 朋友：真的吗 你：是
in no way.example: Friend: Is this related to you? You: It's in no way related to me. Friend: Really? You: In no way did I do it.

in place of.translation: 朋友：他来替你开会吗 你：对，他代我去 朋友：行吧 你：是
in place of.example: Friend: Will he attend the meeting in your place? You: Yes, he goes in my place. Friend: OK. You: He'll sit in place of me.

in proportion to.translation: 朋友：奖金怎么算 你：按贡献大小分配 朋友：公平吗 你：是
in proportion to.example: Friend: How is the bonus calculated? You: In proportion to each contribution. Friend: Fair? You: It's in proportion to effort.

in relation to.translation: 朋友：这个数字怎么解读 你：要联系整体来看 朋友：单独看吗 你：不能
in relation to.example: Friend: How to read this figure? You: In relation to the whole. Friend: Look alone? You: In relation to the rest.

in return for.translation: 朋友：他为什么请你吃饭 你：作为谢我的帮忙 朋友：应该的 你：是
in return for.example: Friend: Why is he treating you to dinner? You: In return for my help. Friend: You deserve it. You: He did it in return for my favor.

in search of.translation: 朋友：他这两年去了哪 你：他一直在寻梦 朋友：找到了吗 你：还没
in search of.example: Friend: Where has he been these two years? You: He's been in search of his dream. Friend: Found it? You: He's in search of a chance.

in the absence of.translation: 朋友：没有老师能上课吗 你：缺老师就自学 朋友：能行吗 你：凑合
in the absence of.example: Friend: Can we teach without a teacher? You: In the absence of one, we self-study. Friend: Will it work? You: In the absence of guidance, we manage.

in the course of.translation: 朋友：项目期间有什么意外吗 你：过程中发现了新问题 朋友：解决了吗 你：是
in the course of.example: Friend: Any surprises during the project? You: In the course of it, new problems surfaced. Friend: Solved? You: In the course of the work, we fixed them.

in the distance.translation: 朋友：那边一片白的是什么 你：远处是雪山 朋友：真漂亮 你：是
in the distance.example: Friend: What's that white over there? You: In the distance are snow mountains. Friend: So beautiful. You: In the distance, a range of peaks.

in the event of.translation: 朋友：出事了怎么联系 你：万一停电就打应急电话 朋友：记好了 你：是
in the event of.example: Friend: What if something goes wrong? You: In the event of a blackout, call the emergency line. Friend: Noted. You: In the event of trouble, stay calm.

in the light of.translation: 朋友：方案为什么改了 你：根据新情况调整 朋友：合理吗 你：是
in the light of.example: Friend: Why was the plan changed? You: In the light of new circumstances. Friend: Reasonable? You: In the light of recent events.

in the name of.translation: 朋友：他凭什么这么做 你：他以公司的名义 朋友：有授权吗 你：有
in the name of.example: Friend: On what grounds did he do this? You: In the name of the company. Friend: Authorized? You: He acted in the name of the firm.

in vain.translation: 朋友：你找着那封信了吗 你：我翻了半天白忙活 朋友：再找找 你：没了
in vain.example: Friend: Did you find that letter? You: I searched in vain. Friend: Look again. You: I searched in vain; it's gone.

in view of.translation: 朋友：活动为什么延期 你：考虑到天气不好 朋友：改到哪天 你：下周
in view of.example: Friend: Why was the event postponed? You: In view of the bad weather. Friend: To when? You: In view of the rain, next week.

irrespective of.translation: 朋友：他参加比赛看身份吗 你：不论年龄都能报 朋友：真公平 你：是
irrespective of.example: Friend: Does entry depend on identity? You: It's open irrespective of age. Friend: Fair. You: Irrespective of background.

no less than.translation: 朋友：到场的有多少人 你：少说也有五百 朋友：真多 你：是
no less than.example: Friend: How many showed up? You: No less than five hundred. Friend: So many. You: No less than five hundred people.

no more than.translation: 朋友：他这次带了多少钱 你：就几十块 朋友：够吗 你：不够
no more than.example: Friend: How much did he bring this time? You: No more than a few dozen. Friend: Enough? You: No more than that.

of one's own accord.translation: 朋友：他是被叫来的还是自己来的 你：他主动来的 朋友：难得 你：是
of one's own accord.example: Friend: Was he asked or did he come himself? You: He came of his own accord. Friend: Rare. You: He volunteered of his own accord.

on board.translation: 朋友：乘客都到齐了吗 你：大家都上了飞机 朋友：可以起飞了 你：是
on board.example: Friend: Are all passengers aboard? You: Everyone is on board. Friend: Ready to take off. You: All on board now.

on condition that.translation: 朋友：我能借你车开吗 你：条件是你得加满油 朋友：成交 你：是
on condition that.example: Friend: Can I borrow your car? You: On condition that you fill it up. Friend: Deal. You: On condition that you return it clean.

on earth.translation: 朋友：他到底去哪了 你：我也不知道 朋友：急死人 你：是
on earth.example: Friend: Where on earth did he go? You: I have no idea. Friend: So worrying. You: Where on earth is he?

on end.translation: 朋友：他加班多久了 你：连续一周了 朋友：铁人啊 你：是
on end.example: Friend: How long has he worked overtime? You: For a week on end. Friend: Like a machine. You: Days on end.

on reflection.translation: 朋友：你当时后悔吗 你：事后想想，也有道理 朋友：释然了吗 你：是
on reflection.example: Friend: Did you regret it then? You: On reflection, it made sense. Friend: Relieved. You: On reflection, I was wrong.

on schedule.translation: 朋友：项目能按期完成吗 你：一切按计划进行 朋友：不延期吧 你：是
on schedule.example: Friend: Can the project finish on schedule? You: Everything is on schedule. Friend: No delay. You: It's running on schedule.

on the basis of.translation: 朋友：这结论怎么得出的 你：基于数据分析 朋友：可靠吗 你：是
on the basis of.example: Friend: How was this conclusion reached? You: On the basis of data analysis. Friend: Reliable? You: On the basis of facts.

on the grounds of.translation: 朋友：他为什么请假 你：以生病为由 朋友：真病了吗 你：不知道
on the grounds of.example: Friend: Why did he ask for leave? You: On the grounds of illness. Friend: Really sick? You: On the grounds of health.

on the move.context: “在活动中、在忙碌奔波”，就用它。
on the move.translation: 朋友：最近怎么老找不到你 你：我一直在外面跑 朋友：出差多 你：是
on the move.example: Friend: Why can I never reach you lately? You: I'm always on the move. Friend: Much travel. You: I'm on the move for work.

on the point of.translation: 朋友：你还没走吗 你：我正要出门 朋友：正好赶上 你：是
on the point of.example: Friend: Haven't you left yet? You: I'm on the point of leaving. Friend: Just in time. You: I was on the point of going.

on the spot.translation: 朋友：他看到事故什么反应 你：他当场就帮忙了 朋友：没犹豫 你：是
on the spot.example: Friend: How did he react to the accident? You: He helped on the spot. Friend: No hesitation. You: He acted on the spot.

on the verge of.translation: 朋友：那家店撑得住吗 你：它快倒闭了 朋友：可惜 你：是
on the verge of.example: Friend: Can that shop hold on? You: It's on the verge of closing. Friend: A pity. You: It's on the verge of bankruptcy.

on the whole.translation: 朋友：这次旅行怎么样 你：总体上挺满意 朋友：有遗憾吗 你：一点
on the whole.example: Friend: How was the trip? You: On the whole, quite satisfying. Friend: Any regret? You: On the whole, great.

once and for all.context: “一劳永逸地、干脆彻底地”，就用它。
once and for all.translation: 朋友：这事还拖多久 你：我想一次性解决 朋友：别再反复 你：是
once and for all.example: Friend: How much longer will this drag on? You: I want to settle it once and for all. Friend: No more back and forth. You: Once and for all.

out of order.translation: 朋友：电梯怎么不动 你：它坏了 朋友：走楼梯吧 你：是
out of order.example: Friend: Why isn't the elevator moving? You: It's out of order. Friend: Take the stairs. You: It's out of order.

out of place.translation: 朋友：他穿这身去派对奇怪吗 你：显得很不协调 朋友：换身衣服 你：是
out of place.example: Friend: Does he look odd in this outfit at the party? You: He seems out of place. Friend: Change clothes. You: He's out of place.

out of practice.translation: 朋友：你怎么球技退步了 你：太久没练了 朋友：捡起来 你：是
out of practice.example: Friend: Why did your skills decline? You: I'm out of practice. Friend: Pick it up. You: I'm out of practice; rusty.

out of reach.translation: 朋友：柜子顶的东西拿得到吗 你：太高够不着 你：搬凳子 你：好
out of reach.example: Friend: Can you reach the stuff on top of the cabinet? You: It's out of reach. You: Move a stool. You: It's out of reach; need a step.

prior to.translation: 朋友：截止日期前要交什么 你：请提前准备好材料 朋友：提前多久 你：一周
prior to.example: Friend: What must be submitted before the deadline? You: Prior to it, prepare the materials. Friend: How early? You: Prior to the meeting.

relative to.translation: 朋友：这地方消费高吗 你：跟周边比还算低 朋友：能接受 你：是
relative to.example: Friend: Is this place expensive? You: Relative to nearby areas, it's low. Friend: Acceptable. You: Relative to the city, it's cheap.

side by side.translation: 朋友：这对老夫妻感情真好 你：他们总是并肩走 朋友：恩爱 你：是
side by side.example: Friend: That old couple is so sweet. You: They always walk side by side. Friend: Loving. You: They stand side by side.

that is to say.context: “也就是说、即”，进一步解释，就用它。
that is to say.translation: 朋友：他说的什么意思 你：换句话说，他拒绝了 朋友：真的吗 你：是
that is to say.example: Friend: What does he mean? You: That is to say, he refused. Friend: Really? You: That is to say, no.

to date.translation: 朋友：这个项目进展如何 你：到目前一切顺利 朋友：有突破吗 你：是
to date.example: Friend: How is the project going? You: To date, all is smooth. Friend: Any breakthrough? You: To date, no problems.

to say nothing of.translation: 朋友：他连本地话都听不懂 你：更别说外语了 朋友：费劲 你：是
to say nothing of.example: Friend: He can't even understand the local dialect. You: To say nothing of a foreign language. Friend: Hard. You: To say nothing of English.

to the point.translation: 朋友：他的发言怎么样 你：简洁又到位 朋友：不啰嗦 你：是
to the point.example: Friend: How was his speech? You: Concise and to the point. Friend: Not wordy. You: It's to the point.

under construction.translation: 朋友：那栋新楼什么时候能用 你：还在施工 朋友：年底能好吗 你：够呛
under construction.example: Friend: When can we use that new building? You: It's under construction. Friend: Done by year end? You: It's under construction.

under control.context: “处于控制之下、得到控制”，就用它。
under control.translation: 朋友：那场火扑灭了吗 你：火势已经控制住了 朋友：好险 你：是
under control.example: Friend: Was that fire put out? You: It's under control now. Friend: Close call. You: The blaze is under control.

under the circumstances.context: “在这种情况下、既然如此”，就用它。
under the circumstances.translation: 朋友：还能怎么办呢 你：事已至此只能这样 朋友：也只能如此 你：是
under the circumstances.example: Friend: What else can we do? You: Under the circumstances, that's all. Friend: No choice. You: Under the circumstances, we manage.

up to date.context: “最新的、时髦的、跟上时代”，就用它。
up to date.translation: 朋友：这个系统版本旧吗 你：它是最新的 朋友：要更新吗 你：不用
up to date.example: Friend: Is this system version old? You: It's up to date. Friend: Need updating? You: It's up to date.

word for word.translation: 朋友：你把他的话记下来了吗 你：我一字不差地记下了 朋友：复述一下 你：好
word for word.example: Friend: Did you write down his words? You: I noted them word for word. Friend: Recite it. You: Word for word, exactly.
